games.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
games.summary: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

games.name: Chronicles of Albian: The Magic Convention
aliases: Chronicles of Albian: Der Konvent der Magier
games.summary: Gathering of wizards and sorcerers of the world is about to happen in Albian Castle. They have no idea what secret the castle holds!

games.name: Entwined: Strings of Deception
aliases: Karla Robbins: Im Netz der Täuschung
Wimmelbild Ermittlungskrimi: Mord in der Gruselvilla
games.summary: Can you solve the grisly murder of Mr Christopher Edward, who has been brutally murdered in his home! Step into the shoes of detective Karla Robbins in this elaborate murder investigation and seek out the real culprit in this classic whodunit murder mystery!

games.name: Home
games.summary: Home is a unique horror adventure set in a beautifully-realized pixel world. It’s a murder mystery with a twist—because you decide what ultimately happens.

games.name: Star Conflict
games.summary: Star Conflict is a Free to Play online space combat game featuring multiple Objective-Based Team Gameplay modes, three main factions with 2 respective sub factions each, and an array of ship customization and three types of ships complete with there own ship tree and skill tree.

games.name: Hitman: Absolution
games.summary:
Hitman: Absolution follows the Original Assassin undertaking his most personal contract to date. Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world.

Showcasing Io-Interactive’s new proprietary Glacier 2 technology, the game has been built from the ground up, boasting a cinematic story, distinctive art direction and highly original game design, Hitman Absolution combines much loved classic gameplay with completely new gameplay features for the Hitman franchise.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released only in Japan on December 26, 2002, Kingdom Hearts Final Mix is finally brought to the global scene as an HD Remaster in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". It has several events and a number of gameplay tweaks that are not in previous releases. New scenes, clarifying certain plot points, such as Riku's journey and foreshadowing of Kingdom Hearts II, were included, but no new dialogue was recorded. A gameplay option allows the player to skip cutscenes. The optional bosses are included, along with a new fight against "Unknown Man."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories is a full remake of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, originally released on the Game Boy Advance. It was originally remade for the PS2, and eventually remastered in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". The game was also changed in that completing the "Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days" cutscenes would unlock additional Enemy Cards that would have been unlocked in the original by having save data from "Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix"

games.name: Metro Redux
aliases: メトロ エクソダス
games.summary:
Metro Redux is the ultimate double game collection, including the definitive versions of both Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light, each rebuilt in the latest and greatest iteration of the 4A Engine for next-gen consoles and PC.

For the first time, console owners can expect smooth 60FPS gameplay and state of the art visuals that were once only available on high-end PC hardware.

Newcomers to the series will get the chance to experience two of the finest story-driven shooters of all time in one vast package; an epic adventure combining gripping survival horror, exploration and tactical combat and stealth.

Fans of the original games will find the unique world of Metro transformed with incredible new lighting, physics and dynamic weather effects, as well as a host of gameplay improvements and new features.

games.name: Metro: Last Light Redux
games.summary:
Metro: Last Light Redux is the definitive version of the critically acclaimed ‘Metro: Last Light’, rebuilt in the latest and greatest iteration of the 4A Engine for Next Gen. Newcomers will get the chance to experience one of the finest story-driven shooters of all time; an epic adventure combining gripping survival horror, exploration and tactical combat and stealth.

This definitive version also includes all previously released DLC, adding 10 hours of bonus single-player content to the huge solo campaign. Fans of the original game will notice new features and gameplay improvements, including new melee animations, the ability to check your watch and ammo supplies on the fly, and new full-body player animations.

And those who favoured the more survival-horror oriented gameplay of the cult prequel ‘Metro 2033’ will find a new way to experience the campaign thanks to the introduction of two unique Play Styles – Survival and Spartan. The former transforms Last light from a more action-oriented stealth combat experience to a fraught, slow burn fight for survival. With the legendary Ranger Mode included to offer an extra layer of challenge and immersion, Metro: Last Light Redux offers hours of AAA gameplay for an incredible price.

games.name: Metro 2033 Redux
games.summary:
Metro 2033 Redux is the definitive version of the cult classic Metro 2033, rebuilt in the latest and greatest iteration of the 4A Engine for Next Gen. Fans of the original game will find the unique world of Metro transformed with incredible lighting, physics and dynamic weather effects. Newcomers will get the chance to experience one of the finest story-driven shooters of all time; an epic adventure combining gripping survival horror, exploration and tactical combat and stealth.

All the gameplay improvements and features from the acclaimed sequel Metro: Last Light have been transferred to Metro 2033 Redux – superior AI, controls, animation, weapon handling and many more – to create a thrilling experience for newcomers and veterans alike. With two unique play-styles, and the legendary Ranger Mode included, Metro 2033 Redux offers hours of AAA gameplay for an incredible price.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix
aliases: KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
games.summary: Originally released exclusively in Japan. An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix was finally released globally for the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
games.summary: An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which was originally exclusive to Japan. It was released globally for the first time as part of the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX".

games.name: A Bird Story
games.summary: A Bird Story is a simple, surreal short about a boy and a bird with a broken wing. Its sole purpose is to tell a story, and can be viewed as a narrative/animation with interactivity -- but without a line of dialogue. It is a standalone game with its own beginning and endings; but for those who's played To the Moon, the boy eventually grows up to become the next patient in the series.

games.name: BeamNG.drive
games.summary: BeamNG.drive is a sandbox vehicle simulation game built around soft-body physics that simulate realistic vehicle handling, deformation, and damage in real time. The game originated as a spiritual successor to the open-source project Rigs of Rods and was initially released as a tech demo in 2013 before moving to Steam Early Access in 2015. Players can engage in campaigns, time trials, and free roam across various open-world maps, experimenting with vehicle collisions, environmental physics, and user-created mods. The game supports VR, features an integration with the car-building game Automation, and has native modding support with a community repository.

games.name: Prison Run and Gun
games.summary: The recent events in a state prison, involving Jake from Hot Guns Team was a perfect moment for some prisoners to escape - you are one of them.

games.name: Highway Blossoms
games.summary: The gold rush has struck the west for a second time. Highway Blossoms is the story of Amber, a girl trying her best to be alone on the road until she stumbles upon a young hitchhiker and the journal of a prospector from long ago.

games.name: Mafia III
games.summary: Mafia III is an open-world action-adventure game played from a third-person perspective and the third entry in the Mafia series. Players control Lincoln Clay across a large recreation of the fictional city of New Bordeaux, modeled on New Orleans, tackling missions with a mix of gunplay, melee combat, stealth, and a cover system. Objectives can be approached in different ways, and players seize territory from rival criminal outfits and hand districts to their lieutenants. Period cars can be driven across the city, and the setting and licensed soundtrack draw heavily on the late 1960s American South.

games.name: Mafia III: Family Kick-Back
games.summary: The Family Kick-Back Pack is a DLC for Mafia III. It contains three exclusive vehicles and weapons.

games.name: Quern: Undying Thoughts
games.summary:
Quern is a first person puzzle adventure with captivating story and beautiful graphics. Quern refreshes the genre with flexible gameplay and reuseable puzzle mechanics. The visuals and the music combine traditional and modern elements providing a unique mood for the game.

One of the specialities of Quern is that the tasks to be solved are not managed as separate, individual and sequential units, but as a complex entity, amongst which the players may wander and experiment freely. Often a bad or seemingly irrational result may bring the player closer to the final solution, if those are reconsidered and thought over again later, in the possession of the knowledge gained during the game.

games.name: Darkness and Flame: Born of Fire
aliases: Darkness and Flame: Das Feuer des Lebens
games.summary:
Darkness and Flame. Born of Fire - adventure quest game with hidden objects, mini-games, and puzzles, set in a unique fantasy world, the Fertile Lands, filled with oases and infinite deserts.

A young girl named Alice finds a strange box holding an egg. From that egg a Bird of Fire hatches, and somehow enters right into the girl, leaving a burn mark on her arm. From that moment on, Alice is part of the eternal battle between Darkness and Flame. Soldiers are after her, but Alice's father manages to save her - at the price of his life. Forced to flee her home, Alice sets off to find her only relative - her uncle - someone she has never met. Together they'll have to undergo many trials in all corners of the Fertile Lands, meet exotic tribes and races, avoid imminent danger, solve dozens of puzzles, and finally face the great evil threatening the whole fantasy world. Will Alice manage to harness the power of the Flame granted to her by destiny, and save her lands before they are turned into a lifeless desert?

games.name: Minecraft
games.summary: Minecraft focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In addition to blocks, the environment features plants, mobs, and items. Some activities in the game include mining for ore, fighting hostile mobs, and crafting new blocks and tools by gathering various resources found in the game. The game's open-ended model allows players to create structures, creations, and artwork on various multiplayer servers or their single-player maps. Other features include redstone circuits for logic computations and remote actions, minecarts and tracks, and a mysterious underworld called the Nether. A designated but completely optional goal of the game is to travel to a dimension called the End, and defeat the ender dragon.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
aliases: Kingdom Hearts HD II.8: Final Chapter Prologue
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.exe
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue is a compilation that brings the popular Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] to the PlayStation4 computer entertainment system platform remastered in high definition.

Originally released in 2012, Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] HD is a full-HD remastered version of Kingdom Hearts 3D [Dream Drop Distance]. Series protagonists Sora and Riku take on the Mark of Mastery exam in preparation for coming threats. The signature action of the Kingdom Hearts series has evolved, allowing players to experience faster-paced battles and exploration at a blistering pace.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts 0.2: Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage
games.summary: A short sequel to Kingdom Hearts Birth By Sleep that partially takes place during the events of the first Kingdom Hearts, A fragmentary passage gets its name from a hidden ending to BBS and tells the story of Master Aqua's ten-year journey through the Realm of Darkness. 0.2 acts as a prologue to the upcoming Kingdom Hearts III, and also as a demo of Kingdom Hearts traversal, combat, and graphics in Unreal Engine 4 as it will appear in KH3. This game is only playable as part of the collection Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.
aliases: KINGDOM HEARTS 0.2 Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage -

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD is a full HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance designed for the PlayStation 4. It was released as part of a package of three games entitled Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

The game is largely the same as its Nintendo 3DS counterpart, but includes some additional features as well as alterations designed to adapt the game to the PS4. The conversion from two screens to one is the most notable of the changes seen. Little has changed in terms of gameplay. However, three new Dream Eaters have been introduced and minor game features have been altered to adapt to the PS4.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix
aliases: Kingdom Hearts HD I.5 + II.5 Remix
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable Kingdom Hearts experiences. Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is the perfect opportunity to start wielding your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.

games.name: Mafia III: Faster, Baby!
games.summary: In Sinclair Parish, a rural town west of the Bayou, Sheriff “Slim” Beaumont rules on a platform of fear and violence. When a Civil Rights leader is murdered, and other activists are targeted, Lincoln joins forces with sister-in-arms Roxy Laveau on an explosive mission to expose the town’s corrupt underbelly. Engage in high-octane car chases, epic new military-grade combat tactics and seedy operations to bring Slim and his corrupt Sheriff’s Department to justice.

games.name: Mafia III: Stones Unturned
games.summary: Bound by a brotherhood forged in Vietnam, John Donovan never hesitated to answer Lincoln Clay’s call for revenge. Lincoln will return the favor when Connor Aldridge, a traitor who once left Donovan for dead, resurfaces to violently upend New Bordeaux in search of highly volatile lost cargo. To stop him, Lincoln and Donovan must fight Aldridge’s mercenary army side-by-side. Engage heavy weapons, turreted vehicles, sniper support and unique rewards to thwart Aldridge and protect the free world.

games.name: Mafia III: Sign of the Times
games.summary: "At Father James’ request, hunt down a mysterious cult responsible for a string of ritualistic killings from the dark heart of the bayou through the drug-ridden counterculture of the inner city."

games.name: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: Combat
aliases: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT
games.summary: A compilation of an HD version of "Brave Dungeon" and "Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT", a 3v3 strategy game.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5
games.summary: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Sigi: A Fart for Melusina
games.summary: Join Knight Sigi as he runs, jumps, and battles in a flatulent quest to save Melusina, the love of his life! Take down hordes of goofy enemies and crazy bosses. Earn riches, find long lost holy artefacts and make your way up to the top of Mount Stinkup!

games.name: Frostpunk
games.summary:
Frostpunk, the newest title from the creators of This War of Mine, is a society survival game where heat means life and every decision comes at a price. In an entirely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. You face the task of building the last city on Earth and securing the means necessary for your community to survive.

Optimization and resource management often clash with empathy and thoughtful decision-making. While city and society management will consume most of the ruler’s time, at some point exploration of the outside world is necessary to understand its history and present state.

games.name: Octopath Traveler
aliases: オクトパストラベラー
games.summary: A role-playing game from the Bravely Default team is being developed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch. They have brought a new world to life through a mix of CG, pixel art, and "HD-2D" visuals.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts III is the third main installment in the Kingdom Hearts series developed and published by Square Enix. It was initially released January 2019 for the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. An expansion, Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind was released in January 2020.

The story takes place after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. It features an older Sora as the main protagonist, who sets forth on a new adventure to search for seven guardians of light in an attempt to stop Xehanort from bringing about a second Keyblade War. Sora is joined by Donald Duck, Goofy, Mickey Mouse, Riku, Kairi, and others. Along the way, Sora travels to many worlds from Disney and Pixar intellectual properties, and cross paths with the real Organization XIII.

Kingdom Hearts III features hack and slash combat reminiscent of Kingdom Hearts II, with elements from later handheld entries, allowing the player to control Sora in a party with Donald, Goofy, and up to two other Disney characters from the various worlds he visits. A major addition compared is the Formchange mechanic, which allows his currently equipped Keyblade to grant him special abilities and change shape. Sora can equip up to three Keyblades at a time, and cycle between them to use his abilities. Another addition is the Attractions mechanic, which occasionally allows Sora to summon and pilot a vehicle inspired by Disney theme park attractions. At certain points throughout the game, the player will be able to control other characters.

games.name: Resident Evil 2
games.summary: Resident Evil 2 is a remake of 1998's Resident Evil 2. The game was not developed with the intent of improving the original, but rather a reimagining of the original story with redesigned maps, characters and story elements. Gameplay mechanics are more similar to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard though with the use of an over-the-shoulder camera.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind is a downloadable expansion to Kingdom Hearts III, released in 2020. Set during and after the game’s climax, it adds new story scenarios (“Re Mind,” “Limitcut Episode,” and “Secret Episode”), challenging boss battles, and extended lore connections. Two editions were made available, with the deluxe version including a recording of the Kingdom Hearts Orchestra -World of Tres- concert. A free patch released alongside the DLC also added the Oathkeeper and Oblivion Keyblades.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.summary: Resident Evil 3 is a remake of the original Resident Evil 3: Nemesis released in 1999. It updates the story and gameplay for a modern audience. Like the Resident Evil 2 remake, the game uses over-the-shoulder third person point of view similar to Resident Evil 4 and later installments. Players will spend most of their time playing as Jill Valentine, although on some occasions they will assume the role of Carlos Oliveira, giving him more screen time as a deuteragonist.

games.name: Highway Blossoms: Next Exit
games.summary: Return to Las Vegas with Amber and Marina in this new Highway Blossoms story! A couple months after the events of the first game, the two girls return to the desert city for an alien-themed convention and to see Tess for her birthday. They also end up reuniting with Cassi, the candy shop girl, who's determined to start following her own dreams.

games.name: Cotton Reboot!
games.summary: Suddenly one day, the waves of darkness messed up the prism of light and began to inhale the light of the world. Then the night went on, the morning light was lost, and people were living anxious lives in the dark. On the other hand, the gluttonous wizard Cotton, who is completely indifferent to such things, does not know the request from Fairy Silk. However, when I heard that I could get my favorite Willow when I got rid of the monsters, it was so glittering! Anyway, the journey to explore Cotton Willow begins.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind
games.summary: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: It Takes Two
games.summary: It Takes Two is a cooperative action-adventure game designed exclusively for two players, playable in local split-screen or online. Players control Cody and May, a married couple transformed into dolls, as they travel through fantastical environments based on their home and relationship. Gameplay combines platforming, puzzle-solving, and action sequences, with each level introducing new mechanics and giving the two characters different abilities that must be used together to progress. The game frequently changes its core mechanics from chapter to chapter, incorporating sections involving shooting, racing, flight, and other genres.

games.name: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori
games.summary: Connect eggs to clear and solve puzzles! Connect eggs with the same patterns with a line that bends twice or less to clear them. Clear all the eggs to complete the stage! Look across the entire board to find eggs to clear! Completing a puzzle will flip one illustration panel. Flip all of the panels to reveal the illustration!

games.name: Sifu
games.summary: Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.

games.name: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori: Snow Miku 2022
aliases: 初音ミク つなげるパズル たまごとり 追加コンテンツ「SNOW MIKU 2022」
games.summary: The new stages have SNOW MIKU themed eggs, birds, and berries! The birds in the puzzles are SNOW MIKU themed as well. Collect exclusive berries to find SNOW MIKU design birds and birds with special items!

games.name: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori: Kagamine Rin / Len Happy 14th Birthday
aliases: 初音ミク つなげるパズル たまごとり 追加コンテンツ「鏡音リン・レン Happy 14th Birthday」
games.summary:
The new stages have "Kagamine Rin / Len Happy 14th Birthday" themed eggs, birds, and berries!

Collect exclusive berries in new stages to find special birds and birds with limited items!
Exclusive egg designs and special events for this stage...!?

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.summary: Cult of the Lamb casts players in the role of a possessed lamb saved from annihilation by an ominous stranger, and must repay their debt by building a loyal following in his name. Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland worshippers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts
games.summary: Design warships the way you want them, command fleets, win the naval arms race for your nation!

games.name: Octopath Traveler II
games.summary:
This game is a brand-new entry in the Octopath Traveler series. It takes the series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, to even greater heights.
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. Embark on an adventure all your own.

games.name: Resident Evil 4
games.summary:
Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

games.name: Folletti
games.summary: In Folletti, step into the shoes of Yezac Folletti, who awakens to the horror of his wife being kidnapped by the sinister Degenite Church in the eerie land of Krycek. Embark on a quest across this bizarre realm, uncovering clues, forging alliances with quirky friends and peculiar creatures, and taking on odd quests. Unearth hidden conspiracies, brave terrifying territories, and perhaps find camaraderie in unexpected places.

games.name: Tingus Goose
games.summary: Tingus Goose is an idle game where you control a goose named Tingus that automatically moves and attacks. The goal is to collect treasure, defeat enemies, and upgrade Tingus' abilities. The game features automatic gameplay with occasional manual interventions, allowing you to let Tingus run on its own while you do other things. You can upgrade Tingus' abilities and equipment, collect treasure and resources, battle enemies and bosses, and explore different environments and levels.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon II
games.summary: The eagerly awaited follow-up to Red Hook's smash hit gothic horror RPG! DDII will test your mettle and drive you to the brink of madness. Armor yourself with purpose and provision your party for the journey ahead. It will be arduous.

games.name: Pocket Mirror: GoldenerTraum
games.summary:
Delve into the enthralling world of Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that'll take you on a moving journey of self-discovery.

This remaster includes new visuals, additional features, a brand new ending, 2D animated sequences, and a bonus room along with new game plus features.

games.name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
games.summary: Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their intimate secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the golden rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains: Do not feed the monkeys!

games.name: Beyond the Evil
games.summary: Beyond the Evil is an psychological horror game that places the player to a hard experience to find who created one supposed plague that might doom the world.

games.name: Devices Tycoon
games.summary: Devices Tycoon is a unique business simulator that will make you feel like the owner of a company that creates your own devices! In the game you can create your own smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart watches, headphones, operating systems and even your own processors!

games.name: Hollenburg: Hell Castle
games.summary: You are Father Karras, the only one who can enter the hell castle and defeat the dark army and its demonic creations. Explore every corner of the castle and get all kinds of items

games.name: Paths of Fight: Samurai
games.summary: Plan your moves, slash your enemies, and finish them with powerful combos. Find the correct fighting sequence and slash your enemies in this action puzzle game themed in japan feudal era.

games.name: Banchou Tactics
games.summary: Banchou Tactics is a strategy turn-based role-playing game in the Japanese Gangster High School.

games.name: Stone Age: Digital Edition
games.summary: Forge your way through the early days of recorded history and build the foundation of human civilization. How bright is humanity's future? It depends on You! Lead your Tribe through the Stone Age!

games.name: Usagi Shima
games.summary: Usagi Shima (うさぎしま, Rabbit Island) is a free-to-play 2023 mobile rabbit-collecting game developed by Jess Yu (pank0). The game is developed using the Godot engine, with gameplay inspired by Neko Atsume. The player builds up a selection of toys and structures in the game to attract rabbits to a tropical island. It was released on September 1, 2023 for iOS and Android and has received several updates since then, with a release on Steam anticipated in 2026.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
games.summary: Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth in FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: FrontWars
games.summary:
FrontWars.io is a large-scale, multiplayer real-time strategy game where players battle for global dominance on a single massive map. Start with a small territory and expand through conquest, diplomacy, and resource management. Construct cities, fortify your defenses, trade with allies, and unleash devastating bombs to tip the balance of power.

Victory requires more than brute force—tactical decision-making and cooperation are key to survival. Every match is a high-stakes struggle for control, where only the most strategic players will rise to claim the world as their own.

games.name: The Crew: Motorfest
games.summary: The Crew Motorfest is an open-world racing game set on scaled-down versions of the Hawaiian islands of Oahu and Maui. The third entry in The Crew series, it is structured around a festival theme with "Playlists" consisting of staged races, side activities, and challenges built around topics like specific car brands or motorsport disciplines. Players can control cars, boats, and planes across the open world, and multiplayer modes include the Grand Race and Demolition Royale. The game originally started development as DLC for The Crew 2 before becoming a standalone title, and draws comparisons to the Forza Horizon series for its festival-based structure.

games.name: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways
games.summary:
The mission requires secrecy. Failure is not an option.

Play as Ada Wong in this additional scenario and experience the events of Resident Evil 4 from her perspective, filling in unanswered questions posed in the main story.

In addition to the action available in the base game with Leon, a grappling gun can be used to get to various locations, as well as take down enemies from a distance and launch a ranged melee attack. This allows for a more exciting and fast-paced gameplay experience.

games.name: Anvil Saga
games.summary: Anvil Saga is a management sim with RPG elements where you take control of a blacksmith shop amidst the Hundred Years' War. Each decision you make impacts the story and gameplay.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

games.name: Weekend Solitaire: Summer Village
games.summary: It's time to take on Solitaire Challenge. Pass the game's several stages. Conquer challenging card configurations and take on a big, vibrant game with several levels of varying difficulties. Overcome challenges, create combinations, and get bonuses.

games.name: Rocket Racing
games.summary: From the developers of Rocket League comes Rocket Racing, a supersonic arcade racer that lets you drift, fly, and boost your way to the finish in a rocket-powered car! Climb the ranks and test your skills in Ranked or pull up to Casual Racing and enjoy the thrill of racing without high stakes. Want to race against the clock? Drop into Speed Run and put your best time on the leaderboard.

games.name: House Flipper 2
games.summary: It's time to dust off your hammer - House Flipper is back in a brand-new fashion! Buy and renovate run-down houses! Or maybe you want to build new ones? Now you can! Start as a rookie Flipper and make a fortune by helping out the community of the charming town of Pinnacove.

games.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
games.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

games.name: Empires Shall Fall
games.summary: Empires Shall Fall is a turn based tactics set in a dieselpunk world. Exploit terrain for combat advantage, combine troops, upgrade your army, eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

games.name: Pixel Royale 3D
games.summary: Dive into Pixel Royale 3D, a pixelated FPS with 40+ weapons, intense gameplay, and customizable character skins. Engage in thrilling gunfights across 3 maps, and challenge opponents in 3 different game modes. Gear up and lock and load for the ultimate Pixelated FPS experience!

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

On your journey, you’ll be joined by Pawns, mysterious otherworldly beings, in an adventure so unique you will feel as if accompanied by other players while on your own adventure.

All of these elements are elevated further by the latest in graphics, artificial intelligence (AI) and physics technology to create a truly immersive fantasy world in Dragon's Dogma 2.

games.name: Climber Animals: Together
games.summary: Climber Animals is a challenging and dynamic parkour game for 1-8 players. In this game,overcome obstacles and climb to the top with your friends. If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.

games.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
games.summary: Nightmare: The Lunatic is an action roguelite platformer game where you escape your nightmare. Swap between 3 weapons constantly, use special attacks, and dodge and dodge enemy attacks. Strengthen yourself by collecting powerful and distinctive totems.

games.name: Survivor Cells
games.summary: Discover the beauty and fragility of life in Survivor Cells, a unique survival game against viruses and bacteria, which strategically combines the elements of roguelite, bullet hell and tower defense in a challenging experience. Your destiny depends on your agility and choices. How far will you get?

games.name: Arctic Eggs
games.summary: A Sci-Fi Cooking game where you take up the role of a Poultry Peddler stuck in Antarctica and longing for a way out. Sell your illegal eggs to those who look hungry.

games.name: Isles of Sea and Sky
games.summary: A fantastical, oceanic, and open world puzzle adventure game. Solve novel block-pushing puzzles while unearthing a mystifying narrative, awakening delightful new friends, gathering collectables, and unleashing extraordinary powers beyond your wildest imagination.

games.name: Octopath Traveler + Octopath Traveler II Bundle
games.summary: Two HD-2D RPGs from SQUARE ENIX’s Team Asano, OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II are now available as a bundle! This series features distinctive HD-2D graphics that combine pixel art with 3D.

games.name: MyPopgoes
games.summary:
Popgoes is an official Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff series, produced by Scott Cawthon and developed by fans as part of the "Fazbear Fanverse Initiative".

MyPopgoes is a short and simple resource management minigame, where you take care of an extremely needy weasel named Popgoes. Housed in an adorable plastic LCD toy, your new pixelated best friend will need pizza, fizzy drinks, and only the best entertainment provided by Freddy Fazbear himself. And if Popgoes doesn't receive what he desperately needs, he passes out. Or maybe he straight up dies. Up to your imagination.

games.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
games.summary: Battle your way through a seedy tavern filled with gambling addicted townspeople in this Blackjack Roguelike Adventure. From aces and face cards to tarot cards, business cards and more, create your unique deck to beat the house.

games.name: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
games.summary: An action-farming-roguelite, full of whimsical flora and mischievous creatures that really want to ruin your dark and mysterious plans of… Going vegan!

games.name: Under the Red Sky
games.summary: Under The Red Sky is a 3D parkour game where speed is king! Your goal is to get to the end of each level as quick as possible by taking one of the many different routes possible, or by finding your own. Watch out though, this isn't all fun and games. You may accidentally fall into the past and uncover dark secrets, slowly deciphering the hidden propaganda behind it all and how to get back above. As you look up, you may find that you're Under the Red Sky.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary: I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

games.name: Train Yard Builder
games.summary: Let your childhood dreams come true and become a full-time train models collector! Buy vintage or modern trains and wagons. Paint them, use stickers, or even design them from a scratch! Then plan a landscape and lay tracks. And don't forget to charge the visitors for viewing your unique collection!

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Mouthwashing
games.summary: The five crew members of The Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

games.name: Cheddar Beach: Episode 0
games.summary: Take a trip to Cheddar Beach in this interactive visual novel! Join Hamston & The Homies as they search for a crackin’ house party on a Friday night, in a world inspired by LA in the early 90’s. Let’s Chase That Cheese, Ya’ll!

games.name: Eclesiar
games.summary: Eclesiar is a free online multiplayer strategy game. Build nations, run economies and wage war with thousands of real players, right in your browser.

games.name: HorrorVale
games.summary: Welcome to HorrorVale, a world full of monsters, ghouls, and all sorts of fiendish undead. Help Alice on her quest to save her dog from strange and unusual monsters who suddenly showed up in HorrorVale!

games.name: LEGO Harry Potter Collection
games.summary:
The LEGO Harry Potter: Collection is an action-adventure compilation that combines LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1–4 and LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5–7 into a single experience.
This enhanced version improves upon earlier releases on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch with upgraded visuals and performance, including native 4K resolution, smoother frame rates, and additional technical enhancements such as improved lighting and haptic feedback, while retaining the same core content.

games.name: Burggeist
games.summary:
Burggeist is a real-time action strategy that features the use of height differences and the terrains as part of your tactics.
Move around the field, quickly analyze the situation, choose the effective move to create and defend your Tower.

games.name: Hidden Objects
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of hidden object search! In this exciting game you will find many unique locations hand-drawn by the artist. The game will give you positive emotions.

games.name: Carry The Glass
games.summary:
Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer!
Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges.
Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles.
Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

games.name: Karate Survivor
games.summary: Become a martial arts master in this survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use your fists, feet, and the environment to fight off relentless thugs. Master powerful combos, enhance your skills, and remember: everything around you is a weapon!

games.name: Solar Sandbox
games.summary: Solar Sandbox is a game where you can interact with physics in space.

games.name: Antonblast
games.summary: Antonblast is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

games.name: My Life: Zoo Vet
games.summary: Take care of sick zoo animals!

games.name: Snø: Ultimate Freeriding
games.summary: Snø is a raw, fast paced and challenging, yet minimalistic game about freeriding. Experience beautiful mountains inspired by Scandinavian nature and score points by doing risky moves like grinding on rocks, jumping off tree trunks and fly close to the treetops using your speedglider.

games.name: Hyper Panda
games.summary: An exciting adventure in the classic style of old platform games. Face this adventure with a Panda who needs to reclaim his forest, challenging enemies and many obstacles.

games.name: Asylum
games.summary: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

games.name: Look Outside
games.summary:
Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in. Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
DONT LOOK OUTSIDE

A survival horror RPG by Francis Coulombe, with music by Eric Shumaker, made in one month for the Hawktober game jam.

games.name: Coin Smith
games.summary: Coin Smith is an idle clicker that starts with a hammer and a single coin. Players strike the coin at the centre of the screen, keeping a rhythm to heat up the forge for bigger and more frequent critical hits, and buy fourteen buildings that rise from ruins across a world that grows from the ground into the Cosmos and beyond. Prestige resets the run in exchange for Eternal Coins, spent in a talent tree that speeds up the next one.

games.name: Pinball FX VR
games.summary:
Bring pinball to life with the ultimate ‘80s arcade atmosphere - now fully immersive in virtual reality. Dive into a fully customizable and interactive setting with the integrated Mixed Reality mode and transform your living room into a personal arcade paradise with cabinets and unlockable decorations.

This includes the same tables as Pinball FX's "Secrets and Shadows" bundle: Curse of the Mummy, Pinball Noir, and Sky Pirates. Many more are available as DLC.

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
aliases: FATAL FURY City of the Wolves.exe
games.summary: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

games.name: Colorful Boi 2
games.summary: Get ready for a pulse-pounding platforming challenge in Colorful Boi 2! With 74 meticulously designed levels, you'll test your reflexes, precision, and patience against a gauntlet of devious traps and hazards.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Peak
games.summary: Peak is a cooperative climbing game for up to four players. After crash-landing on an unknown island, players take the role of scouts attempting to ascend the mountain at its center. The mountain is semi-procedurally generated and changes every 24 hours, featuring five distinct biomes with unique obstacles and enemies. Players manage stamina, collect climbing tools like ropes and pitons, and must work together to survive hazards while ascending.

games.name: Baseball Card Shop Simulator
games.summary: Collect, trade, dominate the market and outsmart the competition.

games.name: Tales from the Dancing Moon
games.summary: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a life-sim RPG set in a parallel universe inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels. After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and collect hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

games.name: Treasure Tiger
games.summary: Treasure Tiger is a first-person horror game where every spin brings you closer to fortune… or to something far worse.

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

games.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
games.summary:
This release contains the 3 classic side-scrolling 2D action games "Azure Striker Gunvolt" (2014), "Azure Striker Gunvolt 2" (2016), and "Azure Striker Gunvolt 3" (2022), including all available DLC.

Enjoy not just the action, but deep story that plays out without interrupting gameplay in "Live Novel" dialog that plays during missions. With full voiceover (Japanese only in Gunvolt 1 and 2) and a total of 37 vocal tracks sung by the "Muses", you'll be immersed in the near-future dystopian world.

In addition, the series director has renewed all three titles, polishing the action gameplay and updating the music. Previously separately available items such as voice drama CDs are now included in-game in Library Mode, making for the most complete "final version" of the trilogy.

games.name: Primal Planet
games.summary: Unveil a heartfelt story of family, dinosaurs, and UFOs! Craft, upgrade, and survive in a realm of primeval predators, savage tribes and... ancient aliens. Rise from a humble cave dweller to the planet’s last hope — alone or in local co-op. Welcome to the dinovania!

games.name: Heartworm
games.summary: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

games.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
aliases: Guardianes de la Noche -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Las Crónicas de Hinokami 2
鬼灭之刃 火之神血风谭2
鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.summary:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 is an action fighting game based on the Demon Slayer series.

It follows the events of the anime, continuing the story of Tanjiro Kamado and his companions. Players take part in arena-based battles using characters with distinct moves and abilities. The game includes a story mode and versus modes for local and online play. It expands on the mechanics and roster introduced in the original Hinokami Chronicles.
series: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles

games.name: Fallen City Brawl
games.summary: Brawl through the city in hard-hitting pixel art style inspired by arcade classics! Inspired by arcade beat ’em ups of the late ’80s and early ’90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

games.name: Sword of the Sea
games.summary:
Sword of the Sea is an action-adventure game developed by Giant Squid, the studio behind Abzû and The Pathless.

Set in a vast desert landscape, players control a character known as the Wraith, exploring ruins and uncovering a lost world. Movement is centered on the "Hoversword," a tool that combines surfing, skateboarding, and snowboarding mechanics. The game emphasizes fluid traversal, atmospheric exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

games.name: Moonlight In Garland
games.summary: A chill open-ended life sim about finding your feet, making a positive impact and enjoying the journey in the big city. Find an apartment, make friends, grow plants and love your city life!

games.name: Mortal Sin
games.summary: An Action-Horror Roguelike unlike any other where you must strategically dismember horrific monsters to survive. Discover powerful weapons and magic as you explore beautifully detailed and haunting environments which are randomly generated on every playthrough.

games.name: Hell is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Hell Is Us: Hollow Walker Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Hollow Walker Pack and other bonuses. The Hollow Walker Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell is Us: Phol Guard Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Phol Guard Pack and other bonuses. The Phol Guard Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell Is Us: Military Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Military Pack and other bonuses. The Military Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell is Us: Secret Code
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Secret Code DLC and other bonuses. With the Secret Code DLC, you start the adventure with a mysterious code in your pocket. What does it open?

games.name: Supercar Collection Simulator
games.summary: Supercar Collection Simulator is a game where you sell surprise car boxes to earn money, build a car collection and engage in exciting races with rivals.

games.name: Candy Shop Simulator
games.summary: Dive into a sugary world of sweetness in Candy Shop Simulator! Open your shop, create delectable pastries, manage sales, and expand your candy empire. Satisfy your sweet tooth and build your confectionery legacy now!

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
games.summary: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Hidden Dogs
aliases: Hidden Dogs: In the Dog House
games.summary: Find over 500 hidden dogs and items across 16 levels - all set in a charming English countryside village! Help Labby find his friends for a special mission in this cozy, hand-drawn hidden object adventure.

games.name: HyperViolent
games.summary: An ancient evil has awoken in the depths of a remote mining asteroid, stirred from its slumber by man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become stranded, surrounded by monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this violent retro shooter!

games.name: 9 R.I.P. Sequel
aliases: ナインリップ シークエル

games.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix!
games.summary: Travel through fantasy worlds and build an idol sanctuary! An idol × city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

games.name: Mister Scary
games.summary: A halloween-themed side-scrolling platformer for the Nintendo Entertainment System, developed by calgames. Featuring a purple monster named Mister Scary, who is searching for his family.

games.name: Darkenstein 3D
games.summary: A retro shooter inspired by the older Wolfenstein and Doom games. A tribute of sorts, if you like, where I aspire emulate the games I love the most and that requires a certain amount of skill to complete, while adding a few personal and more current-day touches.

games.name: Shockwave Triggers
games.summary: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS is an arcade high resolution pixel art shmup/shoot'em up, in which you use the power of Shockwaves and a good timing to get the most bonus from your destroyed enemies. It's simple: shoot, dodge, wait and SHOCKWAVE!

games.name: RV There Yet?
games.summary: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

games.name: Tormented Souls II
games.summary: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari
aliases: ワンス・アポン・ア・塊魂
games.summary: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: Choice of Life: Samosbor
aliases: The Choice of Life: New Centurion
games.summary: You're just a simple inhabitant of the endless Gigastructure. The best you'll get is seven shifts at a machine and a bowl of feed concentrate, and that for good service to the party.... Is that it? Or do you have a choice?

games.name: Void Miner
games.summary: Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.

games.name: A Dark Cave
games.summary: A Dark Cave is a story-driven survival, settlement-building, and incremental adventure where every decision matters. Inspired by the minimalist incremental classics, A Dark Cave trades flashy graphics for intense atmosphere, discovery, and meaningful choices. Build a thriving village, uncover ancient secrets, and descend ever deeper into a world that becomes more dangerous the stronger you grow.

games.name: Aion 2
games.summary: AION 2 is the only MMORPG built around a world where the sky is the battlefield. Choose your faction, ascend as a Daeva, and fight a faction war across a world 36 times larger than the original. PC only, on Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!
aliases: Губка Боб Квадратные Штаны: Гиганты глубин
Bob Esponja: Titanes de la Marea
Bob l'éponge: les Titans des marées
海綿寶寶：海洋巨頭之亂

games.name: Shoresy: Legends of the North
games.summary: Shoresy: Legends of the North brings the hit TV comedy series Shoresy (Hulu, Crave, Netflix, SBS) to life with a modern take on classic hockey video games. Enjoy fast-paced Sudbury Blueberry Bulldog hockey gameplay with hits, goals, fights, chirps and more.

games.name: Hail to the Rainbow
games.summary: The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. You have to face the trials of a new reality and plunge into the secrets of the surrounding chaos.

games.name: Kousai Toshi
games.summary: An upcoming kinetic novel by Key and Matsuyama Takeshi, which tells the story of an investigator in the near future was demoted after becoming entangled in a conspiracy.

games.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
games.summary: Dive into Ayasa, a dark and mysterious platformer where light and shadow hold the key to survival. Journey through six haunting lands, solve challenging puzzles and restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.

games.name: BioMenace Remastered
games.summary: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay. Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!

games.name: Space Rock Breaker
games.summary: Space Rock Breaker is a short incremental game about mining asteroids in space. Mine asteroids with guns, unlock new materials, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and spend your credits on upgrades in a massive skill tree.

games.name: DuneCrawl
games.summary: DuneCrawl is an online coop action-adventure game where players take on the roles of desert faring privateers. Together, players explore the dust seas by piloting their Dune Crawler, a gigantic walking crustacean festooned with cannons and treasure maps.

games.name: Mirrors of Deception: The Poisoned Legacy
games.summary: A quiet estate visit turns into a deadly investigation full of secrets, lies, and hidden clues.

games.name: Dreadway
games.summary: A co-op horror about surviving a nuclear apocalypse as a small group of people on a train, scavenging for various scrap to upgrade the train.

games.name: Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Cleaning Simulator offers a relaxing and satisfying experience where mess turns into order and dirt into shine. Sweep, scrub, and polish. Every corner transforms under your touch!

games.name: Skyship Quest Story
games.summary: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG

games.name: War From Above
games.summary: Pick your unit and then control all unit at once and win the war.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.summary: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Performance Cars Pack
games.summary: The Performance Cars Pack includes the Nissan GTR R-35 Nismo, Nissan 370Z Nismo and Bugatti Mistral.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Customization Pack
games.summary: The Customization Pack includes 3 carbon-fibre bonnets for 7 Japanese cars, 5 themed neon lights for all cars (including themes for both France and Japan).

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Career Start Pack
games.summary: The Career Starter Pack includes 200,000 GCU3 Dollars, 50 "Alloy" resources, 50 ""Electronic Circuit"" resources, 50 "Component" resources and 2 Engineers for the Story mode.

games.name: Frost Survival: Winter
games.summary: The wind howls across the frozen mountains. Snow stretches endlessly to the horizon, and the cold cuts deeper with every step. In Frost Survival – Winter, you are alone in a merciless wilderness where nature shows no mercy and survival is never guaranteed.

games.name: Birdseed VR
games.summary: Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature.

games.name: The Walking Trade
games.summary: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

games.name: Swarm Me
games.summary: A minimalist horde survival arena where you can’t shoot back. You’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.

games.name: Corner Shop: NightShift
games.summary: Take a night shift job in a place that runs on habit, not purpose. Restock shelves, take deliveries, clean the mess, and try to make it till morning. Not everything feels right and you’re never quite alone. Something waits in the dark.

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
games.summary: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

games.name: SCP-3008: Infinite Store
games.summary: An observation-driven psychological horror set inside an endless furniture superstore. Spot anomalies, choose the correct path, complete your shopping list — and escape the loop.

games.name: Rave Heart+
games.summary:
Rave Heart+ is an enhanced edition of the turn-based sci-fi RPG Rave Heart, combining classic JRPG exploration, party-based combat, and a story-driven adventure across an expansive galactic setting.

This edition introduces enhanced 2D visuals, redesigned combat encounters without random battles, new character artwork, professional voice acting, an original soundtrack, additional playable characters, and optional content. It also features rebalanced gameplay, updated interface elements, and various quality-of-life improvements.

games.name: Cue Knight
games.summary: Cue Knight is a physics-based roguelite inspired by billiards. Slingshot yourself through dungeons, smashing monsters with precision shots. Collect powerful weapons and items, upgrade your stats, and clear an endless series of rooms in as few moves as possible.

games.name: YAR: Forgotten Throne
games.summary: This is a role-playing game with RPG-survival elements, based on an alternative history of ancient Slavs. You'll also find numerous references and plots based on Slavic mythology and fairy tales. Explore the open game world on your own or with friends.

games.name: Shadow Rose
games.summary:
Shadow Rose is a stylish puzzle adventure about two mysterious phantom thieves, Mysterious Mask X and Masked Beauty Z, infiltrating the Black Rose Auction House. Outsmart each room, manage your limited moves, uncover hidden treasures, and escape with elegance as the secrets behind the auction begin to unfold.

Play as Mysterious Mask X and Beauty Mask Z as they infiltrate an illegal auction to recover stolen and illegal treasures and relics. Plan every move carefully. One wrong step can make your escape impossible!

games.name: Spica Adventure
games.summary:
From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Whether it's slashing combos, shooting, jumping off platforms, gliding, or floating, Nico and her parasol have an arsenal of moves that are as varied as her colorful foes. Don’t forget to use the parasol for protection—and we don’t mean against the sun! Defend, parry, and reflect the enemy projectiles in up to 8 directions!

Tackle the challenge of 28 stages spread across multiple paths. With each playthrough, choose a new journey through the universe of Spica!

games.name: Opi Popi
games.summary:
Opipopi is a short point-and-click adventure game where the player spends time in their room before falling asleep.

Players can interact with various objects in the room in any order. Each interaction increases the character's "sleepiness." Once the sleepiness reaches a certain level, the night ends, and time progresses.

The game features three different endings, which branch depending on whether the player discovers specific elements in the room before falling asleep. Hints for unlocking these conditions are hidden within the game's UI, such as backlog text colors and speech bubble shapes. The average playtime is 15 to 20 minutes per playthrough.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.summary: Cubic Cosmos is a roguelike deckbuilder which combines fast-paced card battles with unique tower-defense gameplay. Build up your deck, construct your strategy, unlock heroes, and encounter random events. Forge your unique path ahead with every step you take!

games.name: Toycrafter
games.summary: You lost your passion for crafting small toys. You shifted your focus to working on larger dolls. Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear. Don't forget to lock the door & wishlist before you leave

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Heavy Duty
games.summary: The mines are about to get a whole lot louder.

games.name: Floppy Ear Chaos
games.summary: Unleash pure chaos as a furious rabbit in this fast-paced comedic brawler with roguelike elements! Fight through waves of quirky enemies, unlock absurd upgrades, and experiment with wild abilities that change every run. Smash, spin, and explode your way through vibrant, comic-style arenas where every battle is unpredictable, over-the-top, and packed with humor.

games.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
games.summary: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

games.name: Heavy Metal Death Can
games.summary: Heavy Metal Death Can is a Brutal Survival Horror game set on a Swedish Cold War–era submarine. Trapped beneath the ocean, you must fight against the terrifying Sludge which has turned your crew into Zombies. Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.

games.name: Ai ka, Sabishisa ni Nita Nani ka.
Crushed in Time
games.summary: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click adventure. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

games.name: Frog Sqwad
games.summary: 🐸Up to 8 player co-op extraction puzzle-platformer where you swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. Squad up with your frog friends and storm the Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King!🐸

games.name: Weekend Solitaire: Voyage
games.summary: Embark on a Serene Journey with Weekend Solitaire Voyage!

games.name: Escape From Vlogger: Runaway
games.summary: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

games.name: Color Attack!
games.summary: Rotate and React

games.name: Storebound
games.summary: A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

games.name: Poco Loco
games.summary:
Poco Loco is a chaotic racing game for Twitch and Kick streamers. Host your own races, stream them live, and let your viewers join the grid with their own vehicles. Fill the track with up to 500 racers, start the madness from your creator arena, and watch your community battle for XP, standings, and bragging rights.

Engage more with your viewers by turning chat into a full racing grid on your stream. Create a session, fill the lobby, launch the race, and crown the fastest legends when the finish flag drops!

Get ready for fast, furious, hilariously chaotic races for your viewers and you!

games.name: Cozy Radiation Cleaner
games.summary: Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup game where you scan dangerous zones, locate radioactive objects, and restore contaminated environments using specialized equipment and radiation detection tools.

games.name: Velocity: Midnight Run
games.summary:
Velocity - Midnight Run is an arcade survival racer where every run is a high-speed pressure test through endless midnight traffic. Highways open up. Streets squeeze tighter. Alleys punish hesitation. Cops close in if you slow down. Rival racers pull alongside and dare you to hold the line.

Your goal is not to finish first. Your goal is to keep going.

Scrape through gaps. Thread near misses. Switch cameras. Burn out at the line. Blow the engine if you abuse the redline. Push acceleration, grip, or top speed when the run demands it, then live with what you drained to get there.

games.name: Queen's Blade Re:Build
games.summary: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Season Pass 3
games.summary:
Season Pass 3
- DLC Character 1 "Rick Strowd"
- DLC Character 2 "Duck King" (August 2026)
- DLC Character 3 "Kim Kaphwan" (September 2026)
- DLC Character 4 "Manjiro Sano & Ken Ryuguji" (October 2026)
- DLC Character 5 "Laocorn" (November 2026)
- DLC Character 6 "???" (December 2026)
- Additional stages

games.name: Remembrance
games.summary: Step into the fractured mind of a dying scientist in Remembrance, a mind-bending VR puzzle adventure. Piece together broken memories, uncover devastating truths, and decide the fate of a world teetering on the edge of collapse. Will you save humanity?

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
games.summary: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

games.name: Paw Patrol: Dino World
games.summary: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

games.name: Hamventure
games.summary:
Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

games.name: The Last Admiral
games.summary: A 2D roguelite turn based space adventure. You play as the last admiral commanding your fleet as you make your journey into the unknown! fleet and weapon customization will give you near limitless combinations of skills and abilities as you fight vast fleets of enemies from planet to planet.

games.name: Choice of Life: Floors
games.summary: Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness

games.name: Hellbound, Inc.
games.summary: HELLBOUND INC is a hellish 2D platformer where you jump & carry packages to deliver against time, demons and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.

games.name: Agefield High: Rock the School
games.summary: Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

games.name: Omni Growth
games.summary:
Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived... Now you are the last hope of your kind.

Explore the abandoned sections of the colossal spacecraft, hunt space insects and invaders, consume your prey, and evolve from a helpless creature into a deadly predator.

Each level takes you to a new part of the ship, featuring unique environments, biomes, traps, and enemies. Use your surroundings to survive, grow stronger, and unlock new abilities.

games.name: Chess Folk
games.summary:
ChessFolk is a chess game featuring offline play against hundreds of fictional AI opponents with distinct profiles, playing styles and difficulty levels. Its opponent system combines Maia-2, Stockfish and custom behaviour rules.
Players can compete in Swiss, round-robin and knockout tournaments, track their in-game rating and match history, and practise through guided lessons, opening exploration and game analysis. The game offers 2D and 3D board views, animated battle-style captures, custom time controls, PGN import and export, and local two-player play on one device.

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Titanic Escape Simulator
games.summary: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

games.name: Kesu-Ji
games.summary: Kesu-Ji is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

games.name: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
games.summary: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP is a vibrant arcade game where every match turns into a real fight! PvP sports battles, mini football and the spirit of street playgrounds inspired us to create this online game. Here you are a football manager, a goalkeeper, and a striker - in short, a true football star! These are not just football games - players of all ages will enjoy them!

games.name: House 2
games.summary:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

games.name: The Abjuration Stand
games.summary:
Fast 2D tower defense and survival game. You play a small wizard who holds the line while green slimes and other monsters flood the path.

You fight on the field and build at the same time. Place attacking orbs, swords and staffs. Spend crystals on new defenses. Between waves choose upgrades that stay for the rest of the run.

games.name: Shardwatch Dominion
games.summary:
Shardwatch Dominion is a classic top-down tower defense game set in circular arenas. You protect a central fortress and its glowing crystals from waves of enemies that attack from every direction.
Every decision matters: where you build, what you spend crystals on, and which upgrades you take between waves. Placement and resource management decide whether the fortress holds.

games.name: Island Market Simulator
games.summary: Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

games.name: RV There Yet? St. Búttin Bay
games.summary:
New map expansion for the game 'RV There Yet?'.

Once again our fellow vacation aficionados are on the lookout for a way home via Route 65, but this time they’re traveling from the wonderful beaches of St. Búttin Bay. So crack your fingers, clean out the sand between your cheeks and get ready to finish this EPIC TRILOGY with ONE LAST RIDE home!

games.name: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart
games.summary: Plan your moves. Time your strikes. Prove you are the strongest.

games.name: Mebula Legends
games.summary:
Mebula Legends is a free-to-play idle RPG. Your empire produces gold and resources around the clock, even while you are away. Use them to recruit Mebulis, level them up and send a team of five creatures into automatic battles.

More than 100 Mebulis in six rarity tiers, each with its own element, family ultimates and element bond bonuses. Story campaign with elemental realms, the Shadow Journey and the Prism Rift. Arena and league with leaderboards and a weekly tournament. Roguelike dungeons and the Endless Tower. Guilds with guild wars, a guild merchant and chat with built-in translation. Equipment with a forge, jewelry and the Resonance Chamber. Prestige system with an energy tree for long-term progression.

All content can be reached without paying. Mebula Legends is an online game and requires a Bitmeup account.

games.name: NightClub Simulator
games.summary: seduce girls or get into fights, you can do anything in a virtual nightclub that you can't do in real life whether its in multiplayer or single player.

games.name: Dungeon Swipe
games.summary: Dungeon Swipe is a portrait action role-playing game with pixel art and deckbuilding. Players swipe through dungeon encounters, fight enemies using timed attacks and defenses, collect equipment, and develop a roster of heroes. Cards modify combat, while exploration includes treasure, puzzles, companions, and persistent progression between expeditions.

games.name: How to Wait for the Bus
aliases: How to Wait for the Bus.exe
games.summary:
The bus will arrive when it arrives. In the meantime, make some tiles explode.

Fire coloured tiles into the board from any edge. Line up three or more matching tiles to make them explode, trigger chain reactions, and gradually clear the board.
