Every shot can solve a problem, create a spectacular cascade — or leave you with an even worse problem than the one you started with.

No ads. No energy timers. No daily chores. No in-app purchases. Just a small puzzle game with exploding tiles.

games.name: Harvest Tycoon
games.summary:
Harvest Tycoon is a farming simulation set in a 3D valley, in which the player expands a few starting fields into a large estate. Crops grow in real time, from two minutes for wheat to a full day for sunflowers, and longer crops keep growing while the player is offline. Crops and animal produce such as eggs, milk, wool and honey are turned into goods in production buildings, then sold at a market whose prices change daily or delivered to customer orders, while quests, daily challenges and levels unlock new crops, buildings and helpers such as a tractor.

Players can join farm families of up to ten members that work toward shared weekly goals and compete in tournaments, take part in timed events in leagues of players at a similar level, fish at a farm pond and chat with other players. From level 100 a second world opens: a mountain village with its own market, crops, mine, forest, smithy and fishing lake. The game is free to play with optional in-game purchases, requires an internet connection, and keeps one farm per account across the web browser, Android and iOS versions.

games.name: Aetherfall
games.summary: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

games.name: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
aliases: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
games.summary: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

games.name: Hack 'n' Stack
games.summary: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game up to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

games.name: Used Cars Simulator
games.summary: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

games.name: Corrida: Chega De Intocavéis
games.summary:
Made infamous for its heavy usage of AI-generated visuals, controversial political satire and unauthorized usage of a popular gaming influencer's likeness in its advertisements, Corrida: Chega De Intocavéis is a browser-based online kart racer developed for Brazilian presidential candidate Romeu Zema's 2026 campaign.

Shortly after Zema's defeat in the first round of the elections, the game was taken offline.

games.name: Dr. Mancell and Mr. Flame
games.summary:
Short homage game to go with the song collaboration between Waterflame and Josh Mancell, composer of the original Crash Bandicoot! Just in time for the 30th anniversary (unintentionally)!

We always thought the boss fights of the original classic games like these were the most fun part but too short and unsatisfying. This scratches that itch and lets you duke it out in an unending 1v1 fashion with the boss continuously escalating in difficulty!

games.name: Dead Position
games.summary:
Dead Position is a chess roguelike. Each round is a fresh game of chess against an engine on a 3D board: the player has ten moves and three take-backs to reach a score target, and every move scores chips × mult, from quiet moves through captures, checks, forks, pins, skewers and discovered attacks up to checkmate. Chaining tactics builds a streak that raises the mult of the next move.

Between rounds, players buy Gambits, passive cards that alter scoring and in some cases the rules of chess, along with study packs and card editions. The opponent, the Host, alters the board with Blaze and Frost events, and each ante ends with a boss lieutenant who imposes a special rule. A run consists of four antes of four rounds, and lost pieces stay lost unless bought back in the shop.

The game also includes free play against four engine levels, tutorial lessons and a Blitz mode played against the clock.

games.name: Fish the Web
games.summary:
Fish the Web is a little online fishing game on a pixel art island. Everyone you see on the pier is another real player, so you end up chatting with whoever's next to you and showing off whatever you just pulled out of the water.

Cast, wait for a bite, then hold to keep the fish in the green bar until it gives up. Sell your catch at the stall and save up for a better rod. There are over 200 fish, some only out at night or in the rain, plus a cave and an old shipwreck that open up once you've been around a while.

games.name: Nomad Drive
games.summary: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

games.name: Chromascape
games.summary: Step into a gentle, hand-drawn world in Chromascape. As Luna the hedgehog, you hold the power to absorb and share colors in a land fading into gray. Use warm hues to light fires, cool tones to freeze paths, and restore vibrancy to this heartwarming 2D adventure.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Crazy Balloon
games.summary:
"CRAZY BALLOON" is an action game released by TAITO in 1980.
Guide a swaying balloon through a thorny maze and attempt to reach the goal while avoiding traps such as moving thorns, scrolling mazes and more.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Balloon Bomber
games.summary:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

games.name: Involved
games.summary: Build ships block by block, launch, mine, trade, and explore a procedurally generated low-poly solar system—solo or with friends. Crash, rebuild, repeat. And now, PvP: turrets, shields, missiles, and raids.

games.name: Ozark
games.summary: OZARK is a dark, story-driven 2.5D indie action horror game made for a short, intense playthrough. Crash-land in remote mountains, enter a derelict facility, survive macabre human experiments, and uncover what lies beneath. Play solo, couch co-op, or online co-op through Steam Remote Play Together.

games.name: Restart Zero
games.summary: Restart Zero is an action shooter in cyberpunk style. Experience a fast-paced adventure single or local coop multiplayer.

games.name: Huckleberry Fields Forever
games.summary: Huckleberry Fields Forever is a co-op mystery action-platformer. Track thieves in scenic real-world locales, run and jump through procedurally generated levels assembled from hundreds of handcrafted challenges, gather clues, interview witnesses, uncover secrets... but can you solve the case in time?

games.name: Rhythmic Keyboard
games.summary: Rhythmic Keyboard is a music-based typing game with integration of a talent system that allows for the player to increase their effectiveness. Procedurally spawned keys inhibit pattern formation, so reaction speed and hand/eye coordination are a priority -- not memorization.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

games.name: Monsters & Memories
games.summary: Monsters and Memories is an independently created, niche Fantasy MMORPG that harkens back to the classic MMO era of the late '90s and early '00s.

games.name: Crying Booth
games.summary: Sacrifice, survive, trick or treat, and go home. Experience four first-person scenarios with stealth, survival, and puzzle elements along with one side scroller platformer.

games.name: Mystic Land: The search for Maphaldo
games.summary: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

games.name: Gus Game
games.summary: Gus Game is a multiplayer party game that immerses you in a fantastic world full of hilarious and competitive mini-games. Gus Game allows you to compete against your friends in challenges such as cannonball throwing, obstacle courses, and much more...

games.name: BloomTale
games.summary: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions that speak the language of flowers, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a world of blooming possibilities.

games.name: The Depths of Despair
games.summary: Slower-paced souls-like RPG with classic MMO progression, skills and ability bar. The world is grim and unforgiving, steeped in despair. Heavy punishment and consequences are naturally present.

games.name: Ominous Recall
games.summary: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

games.name: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
games.summary: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

games.name: Fiefdom
games.summary: Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer medieval slasher where players change the world, one battle at a time in a dynamic world. Bring your realm to glory in battles of up to 100 players both by land & by sea!

games.name: Star-Coat
games.summary: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

games.name: End of Abyss
games.summary: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.name: Steel Ark
games.summary: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

games.name: What Is The Ghost
games.summary: Ghosts haunt the living, and only your company can identify them. Search haunted apartments, collect suspicious artifacts, and reveal cursed objects. But beware: the longer you stay, the stronger the ghost’s presence grows - and the deadlier your investigation becomes.

games.name: Sous Raccoon
games.summary: Play as a raccoon sous chef managing restaurants while defending customers from monsters in this action-packed roguelike that blends cooking with combat!

games.name: The Last Keeper
games.summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: C4: Classical Caliber Combat Contest
games.summary: The Arena Shooter Party Game with Item Boxes, Minigame rounds, loads of Weapons and Modifiers, and a card-based Party Mode! Classic action meets stage hazards, comeback mechanics and comic style in this retro multiplayer FPS with modern twists.

games.name: Super Chillers: The Chat Room
games.summary: Travel back to the 90s in this campy point-and-click horror adventure inspired by classic YA horror books like Fear Street and Point Horror.

games.name: Minute Man
games.summary: Freeze time and defeat your enemies! Minute Man is a 2D beat 'em up platformer where you can freeze time as you're fighting to secure an advantage. Fight through various waves of enemies and defeat bosses in seven levels, keeping time frozen as you chain combos against your enemies!

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends Pack
Corinne
games.summary: Corinne is a female name, the French and English variant of Corina, of ancient Greek origin, derived from κόρη (korē) meaning "beautiful maiden". It became popular following the publication of Corinne, or Italy, an 1808 novel by Madame de Staël. Various spellings of the name exist, although some attest that "Corinne" is the most appropriate and age-old spelling. Other spellings include: Corrine, Corin, Corine, Corinn, Coryn, Corryn, Koryn, Korryn, Korin, Corinna, Korinna, Corrin, and Korinne.

games.name: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
games.summary: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

games.name: Hollow Faces
games.summary: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

games.name: The Calamity Trials
games.summary: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.

games.name: The Gardener
games.summary: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

games.name: No Service
games.summary: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

games.name: Bravery
games.summary: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

games.name: Castle Wars: Legacy
games.summary: Strategy card game where you need to crush enemy caste or raise yours by playing the right cards. With 3 types of cards, build, attack and magic players need to balance their resources and manage castle and wall better than the opponent in order to win. This is version of castle wars has both single player mode for playing campaign levels or vs the AI and multiplayer and advanced multiplayer mode in daily tournaments.

games.name: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme
games.summary: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme is a dark fantasy romance visual novel set in the religious city of Marenis, where reality has merged with the mysterious world of the dead known as Sullyland.

games.name: Spline: Part One
games.summary: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.

games.name: The Legend of Chalkvania
games.summary: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

games.name: Havoc Heirs
games.summary: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

games.name: Ake no Yosuga: Twilight Loop
games.summary:
This is a loop-based psychological horror visual novel.

Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.
The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.
As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

games.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
games.summary: With this collection, you’re not just getting one fantastic shoot ’em up, but two! This Boosted re-release features a fully arranged soundtrack with brand new tracks from a fresh lineup of arrangers. (These differ from the 2011 console version.) In addition, you get several different game modes, including Arcade and Arrange, Online Rankings that let you compete with players worldwide, and Local Replay Support where you can save your best runs for review. A tasty deal indeed!

games.name: Spooky Market
games.summary: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

games.name: Penguin Weapons
games.summary: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

games.name: Umbral Coterie
games.summary: A dark city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines across generations and uncover the sinister forces moving beneath the city.

games.name: Faybound: Veils of Magic
games.summary: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies and unite their powers. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

games.name: No Register
games.summary: Cross the threshold between existence and non-existence in search of a forbidden singularity. Decipher the logic of an abstract realm, solve puzzles, and survive the vigilance of the Guardians who protect this domain. Accept the destiny set before you or break the silence to forge your own.

games.name: D-Extinction
games.summary: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

games.name: Reversi2048
games.summary: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

games.name: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
games.summary: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
games.summary: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

games.name: Vertigo Enigma
games.summary: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

games.name: Goldfish Simulator
games.summary: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

games.name: Whistling at Night
games.summary: A short horror experience inspired by Indigenous Folklore

games.name: Crow's Curated Closet: Shop Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

games.name: Grapixo Arte em Guerra
games.summary: Scratch in a 2.5D world that blends hip hop aesthetics with action/platforming, where urban art has come to life. Explore dynamic environments, face cleaning robots, and uncover secrets of this vibrant world as you reclaim your identity in this intense and colorful adventure.

games.name: Kitty Found a Camera
games.summary: A First-and-Third-Person Photo Shooter (FATPPS) where you take photos to solve problems and get into mischief.

games.name: Hex Tower Boogie
games.summary: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

games.name: Shady Business
games.summary: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

games.name: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Medieval Houses
aliases: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Medieval Houses DLC
games.summary: Medieval style timberframe houses for that high fantasy or Laketown style Bulwark settlement.

games.name: Bureaucromancer
games.summary: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

games.name: Backrooms: Research
games.summary: A multiplayer backrooms extraction game up to 4 players where you manage your own base and enter open, non-linear levels to complete objectives, explore unknown environments, and gather resources and items needed to survive.

games.name: Crescent Break
games.summary: Blast robots, use their pieces to start chain reactions, and navigate your way through destructible levels in this platformer ROGUELIKE. Crescent Break fuses together NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. Augment your cyborg suit for ridiculous synergies, and try over and over to survive!

games.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game
games.summary: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

games.name: No Witnesses
games.summary: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

games.name: Black Hollow
games.summary: Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.
aliases: Black Hollow, New South Wales, Australia

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: Equinox
games.summary: Contains the U.S.S. Equinox as playable ship (exclusively in a new, upcoming game mode) along with new heroes, technologies and more

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Continental Europe
games.summary:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.

games.name: Train Station Tycoon
games.summary: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

games.name: Sanasana
games.summary: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

games.name: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
games.summary: Build a global industrial empire on a 3D planet earth. Mine resources, manufacture complex goods, trade across continents, and shape your companys reputation through powerful policies. Control every step of the supply chain and turn industry into influence.

games.name: Down Pit
games.summary: Dig. And Get Paid.

games.name: BeBalance
games.summary: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

games.name: Not Monsters
games.summary: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

games.name: Pinched
games.summary: Multiplayer horror game about being lost in pitch-black tunnels with nothing but a flashlight and your voice. Four players spawn in a procedural generated maze in total darkness, where proximity voice chat echoes and bounces down the halls, so you hear each other long before you find each other. Race for the exit, climb ahead of rising floodwater, or survive the thing that hunts you by sound. Every map is generated fresh each round, and nobody has the layout memorized, including the developer.

games.name: The Roach Hotel: Chapter 2
games.summary: Continue the story of The Roach Hotel, descending deep below, where the air grows heavy and the shadows feels alive. Down here, the cockroaches are the least of your concerns… something far worse is waiting to play.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The award winning epic returns. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yotei experience.

The Complete Edition includes:
• Ghost of Yotei
• Echoes of Sekigahara - A New Story Expansion
• Most Wanted - A Combat Survival Mode
• In-game Mask
• Charm of Hokkyokusei
• The Snake Armor
• Digital Deluxe Armor Dye
• Digital Deluxe Horse & Saddle
• Sword Kit
• Traveler’s Maps (Early Unlock)
• Charm of Amaterasu

games.name: Tile & Error
games.summary: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

games.name: The Gastarbeiters
games.summary: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

games.name: Absolutely Nothing Good
games.summary: Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then youre probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket...

games.name: Carry the Count
games.summary: Carry the Count is a co-op adventure game for 1 to 4 freaky little freaks. Carry your vampire master across a medieval fantasy world to his bloodthirsty lover Romilda. Fight barbarians, solve puzzles, outsmart evil fish guys, and don't let the masters coffin break. Maybe one day, Igors will be free?

games.name: Seven Nights With Hanako
games.summary: Ancient Leylines, a once in a 10 millennia blood moon, and one seriously bratty ghost! Seven Nights, Seven Challenges, Seven Hearts; Survive a week in Hanako's Hell realm or become her eternal play-thing!

games.name: Infested DX
games.summary: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

games.name: Extravalence
games.summary: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

games.name: Elsewar
games.summary: Master the unpredictable forces of Elsewar, a roguelike deck-builder where tactical synergy meets high-stakes fantasy combat. Draft powerful cards, uncover game-changing relics, and adapt your strategy on the fly as you battle through an ever-shifting, perilous world. Can you build the ultimate deck and survive the onslaught?

games.name: Enarian: Orbital Command
games.summary: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

games.name: Flippy the Spider
games.summary: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

games.name: Grape by Grape
games.summary: A cozy vineyard idler with no clicking and no game-over. Hover to water your vines, then turn grapes into wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez across your own little estate and sell them at your shop. 14 grapes, gentle automation, and a vineyard that works while you're away.

games.name: Beefy Boi
games.summary: A job simulator horror. Gather ingredients, assemble orders, and hand them to customers. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Pay your bills when you get back to your room.

games.name: So Close
games.summary:
So Close is a cooperative platformer for one to four players in which a team escapes a linear level filled with unpredictable traps. The players wear explosive collars that detonate if they move too far apart, and the death of a single player restarts the run for the entire team. Two modes are available: Realism, which restarts the full level after each death, and Easy,
which resumes from the last checkpoint. The game is hosted by an in-game gamemaster named Proxxy.

games.name: Corid
games.summary: CORID is a first-person hardcore psychological horror game that draws you into a dark, ever-changing world. Explore your surroundings, solve puzzles, and question your own perception—because even when nothing happens, it does not mean you are alone.

games.name: Puckoff: Reloaded
games.summary: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!

games.name: Sculpturillo
games.summary: You get a secret word and you have to sculpt it in 3D clay while your friends spam the chat guessing absolute nonsense. Are you an artist or a disaster with hands? An online party game for 2 to 10 players, with characters you create yourself and matches in 6 languages.

games.name: Oath of Stigmata
games.summary: In a world shattered by the Starfall Calamity, sanctuaries, city-states, and surviving factions fight for their last hope. Lead characters with unique beliefs and abilities on a perilous journey. Build your deck, deploy your units, and make tactical decisions that can turn the tide of battle.

games.name: Biodome Bastion
games.summary: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

games.name: Pusheen's Place
games.summary: Pusheen’s Place is a cozy casual game centered around collecting, caring for, and spending time with different versions of Pusheen. Players can create their own little Pusheen paradise by decorating rooms with hundreds of items and mixing furniture and decorations from different themes. More than 100 Pusheens can be collected, ranging from Common to Legendary, including special variants such as Pusheenicorn, Laptop Pusheen, and Pancake Pusheen. Players can feed, pet, and play with their Pusheens while completing a variety of bite-sized minigames and puzzles. With its relaxed pace, colorful rooms, and emphasis on collecting and customization, Pusheen’s Place offers a simple and cozy place for fans of Pusheen to unwind and make their own home for the beloved cats.

games.name: Crown Of Blight
games.summary: Crown of Blight is a dynamic top-down 3D metroidvania. As an elite Hunter of the Church, descend into cursed dungeons to find the source of the Blight. Annihilate hordes of enemies, unlock new paths, and uncover the grim truth hidden in the depths.

games.name: Eden Camp
games.summary: Arrive at Eden Camp as John, the newest counselor at a remote summer retreat. Three women welcome you warmly perhaps too warmly. As bonds deepen and nights grow darker, you'll learn that devotion has a price. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it home.

games.name: Chiasmus
games.summary: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

games.name: Exit_ComputerLab
games.summary: Stuck in an infinite loop inside a computer lab. To escape, you need to find the necessary anomalies to break the loop, making it possible to get out of this place. Good luck ;)

games.name: Cradle of Ash
games.summary: Survival horror in a quarantined company town. You wake alone at the edge of Ashbrook, where the dead get back up from anything you do to them - unless what is left of them burns. Play solo or in co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Flowers and Deities: Thief Prince Expansion Pack
aliases: Flowers and Deities - Thief Prince Expansion Pack
games.summary: A destitute prince fighting for vengeance has joined the Arena! This DLC unlocks two exclusive Backgrounds, and adds 16 mechanically unique Cavefolk units: thieves, Explosive Detonation infantry, assassins, powered armor, Drills, Psionic Power... and even two mighty Demigods!

games.name: Emberlost
games.summary: The world went cold a long time ago. One ember remembers the light. A wordless, atmospheric journey through ten chapters - carry the last fire through fog, ruin and silence, and rekindle the Hearths of a world that forgot how to burn.

games.name: My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Boys
games.summary:
Every promotion has a price.
He's about to show you his.

games.name: My Sexy Boss: Office Romance Girls
Better Chaos
games.summary: A massive supermarket, over 32,141 products scattered everywhere, and one mission: put it all back in order. Explore every aisle, find where each item belongs, and use powerful abilities to turn this total chaos into a perfectly organized store.

games.name: Disconnected
games.summary:
What if your largest audience became witnesses to your own death? In Disconnected, you play as Robex, a successful streamer who gets trapped in a supposedly deserted property during a live Urbex exploration.

The connection drops, the doors lock, and your only window to the outside world is your smartphone screen. To get out, you’ll need to do more than just solve puzzles; you’ll have to manage a chaotic chat and survive a presence that doesn’t take kindly to trespassers.

games.name: Society Chess 3D
games.summary: Society Chess 3D is a multiplayer chess game for up to 32 players. Each player preselects their move, and the most popular move is the one played on their side. The key to victory is to convince your teammates using the chat function to secure the win. An offline mode is also available.

games.name: Scraplings
games.summary: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

games.name: Ballshit 2D
games.summary: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

games.name: Backrooms Adventure
games.summary: You were walking home, and then the ground wasn't there. Now it's damp carpet, a hum that never stops, and yellow rooms that go on longer than any building could. Someone came through here before you. Follow what they left behind, solve the puzzle, and find a way out.

games.name: 007 First Light: Extended Operations
games.summary: Adds new activity “Valhalla Protocol,” new operation “Jungle Heist,” new weapons and outfits, New Game Plus, Photo Mode, and more

games.name: Zero Parades: Director's Cut
games.summary: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes Zero Parades - the acclaimed espionage RPG, now expanded with the Director’s Cut. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

games.name: Drake's Mansion
games.summary: At 3:07 AM, one last delivery takes you to a mansion. The door locks behind you, every light in the house dies, and the house has six floors. Drake's Mansion is a first-person horror game: search six floors for six numbers, open the safe and get out before six while something hunts you through the dark, and whatever you do, don't look at his face. A parody, not affiliated with Drake or OVO.

games.name: Beta Bar
games.summary: Beta Bar sends you and your friends partying on 4 floors of bars and an active dance floor. Talk to the ladies to build your confidence and be ready to swing back when one of your friends throws a punch. If things get serious, grab a drink and make sure you're the last man standing.

games.name: AeroBloom
games.summary: AeroBloom is a single-player first-person action game set in a coastal city. Players throw bouncing discs to destroy the environment block by block, earn credits, buy upgrades, and unlock powers. The city includes parkour challenges, areas to explore, a tornado flight ability, and nighttime fireworks. Casino Brisa offers blackjack, roulette, and other minigames using currency earned in the game, with no real-money gambling.

games.name: Volume.art
games.summary:
A series of innovative yet questionable volume sliders.
Created in collaboration with over 20 game developers.

games.name: Helping Your Boyfriend
games.summary: A cute-turned-creepy horror visual novel

games.name: Wizherd
games.summary: Wizherd is a fast-paced VR wizard game where you cast spells with your own hands. Blast through waves of enemies, explore dungeons, and take down giant bosses in this magic dungeon crawler.

games.name: Console Archives: Chack’n Pop
games.summary:
Chack’n Pop was released by Taito in 1985 for an 8 -bit home console.
Control "Chack'n" skillfully to take back the Heart inside the maze taken by "Beluga".
The Technique of character "コ" to run along walls and ceilings to evade enemies, the Technique of Hanabi to detonate bombs simultaneously... By using various advanced techniques, "Chack'n" can defeat "Beluga".
With just a single technique, "Chack'n" can do an amazing job!

games.name: One Piexel
games.summary: A One Piece versus fighting browser game in pixel art. You can play online in a lobby, try your way through the arcade mode or train your combo. You can play with either keyboard or controller

games.name: Sumoo
games.summary: Sumoo is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

games.name: Algorithomus
games.summary: Algorithomus is an interactive puzzle and "found phone" simulator set in the Mundo Torajo universe. Players explore a mysterious smartphone, play embedded minigames, and solve codes to uncover the secrets of the Tyrant Algorithomus.

games.name: Le Shampoo War II
games.summary: Fight through floors, build a deck from 146 cards, and take on 6 bosses in Le Shampoo War II, a roguelike deck builder. Beat the final portals gauntlet and the terror at the end to discover what controls the universe.

games.name: Starlathe
games.summary: Command your ship and fleet in a galaxy that truly lives: 150 sectors where six factions mine, haul, trade, build and wage war whether you're there or not. Trade it, rob it, defend it - or forge your own fleet and carve out your place in it. Play solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Comet's wayfaring odyssey
games.summary: Born from a graduating students' capstone project featured on the 2025 BAFTA Student Awards Longlist and the Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2025, discover an adorable and zany physics-based puzzle adventure following a dog training to become a stellar superstar.

games.name: Crabrun
games.summary: Face an unforgiving arcade ecosystem made up of simple rules and filled with subtle interactions. Learn to walk sideways, dash through danger, and combo your way to an absurdly high score. The gods of the sea reward persistence and style in CRABRUN.

games.name: Antes del Sur
games.summary: Juego MMORPG ambientado 200 años antes del aclamado Tierras del Sur. Está desarrollado sobre la base del mítico Argentum Online. Actualmente disponible para la plataforma Windows.

games.name: SpyCat: Codename Wu
games.summary: SpyCat: Codename Wu is a 2D action-adventure platformer starring a feline secret agent. Run, climb, sneak, and fight past traps and pursuers. Every conversation walks the line between trust and betrayal. Uncover the truth, expose the conspiracy, find your place between humans and animals.

games.name: My Desktop Cat
games.summary: Bring a cozy animated cat to your Windows desktop. Care for your companion, play with toys, decorate every screen, unlock new cats and achievements, and play mini games while normal apps stay unobstructed.

games.name: In Your Dreams
games.summary: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

games.name: Arlasoft Soccer
games.summary: A Sensible Soccer inspired game for the C64 and C128 in C64 mode - for an extra speed boost!

games.name: Blindsight
games.summary: Your voice lets you see. It also lets them find you. BLINDSIGHT is a co-op horror game for 1 to 4 players about hauling loot through the dark and knowing when to shut up. Bring friends. Preferably ones who can handle five seconds of silence.

games.name: OCDust: One Room. Every Last Speck. One Way Out.
games.summary: You woke up in a room full of dust. The only way out is to clean it all. All one million specks.

games.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game - Scrubdesignz Liveries
games.summary: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.

games.name: Bball Destiny
games.summary: Bball Destiny is a text-based basketball career simulator for web browsers, iPhone and Android. The player creates a 16-year-old prospect, picks a nationality, a position and a build, then guides the career one decision at a time. The road runs from high school in the United States or a European youth league, through college or the pro ranks overseas, to the NBA draft, contracts, trades, injuries, playoff runs and retirement. Each season unfolds as written scenes whose choices move the player's ratings, health, money and reputation. A finished career is ranked on a legacy ladder and can enter a public Hall of Fame. A full career lasts 10 to 20 minutes. The game uses no real players, is free to play, needs no account, and is available in English and French.

games.name: Sump
games.summary: A short baroque atmospheric horror game. Manipulate a labyrinth of levers and unnatural shadows. Find courage in a place that only goes down.

games.name: Permit Pending
games.summary:
You are the mayor. You know exactly what this city needs. Now get it past the zoning board, the neighbors, the appeals court and the next election.

Permit Pending is a city simulation in the spirit of the classics, with one difference: you are not a god. You are an elected mayor. Every apartment block, bus lane and factory goes through hearings, reviews, objections, lawsuits and appeals. The economy underneath is real. The neighbors are not always rational. Win the argument, or win the election. Ideally both.

games.name: Liga Ride
games.summary:
Liga Ride is an indoor cycling and running game. Cyclists ride on a smart trainer and runners on a treadmill, on real Polish triathlon courses recreated from map and elevation data, and on the bike the trainer's resistance changes with every climb and descent.

Players can train alone or together with others online and follow structured workouts. Cyclists can also chase times on timed segments and leaderboards and compete in virtual stages of a national amateur triathlon league, where the swim and the run take place outside the game and the bike leg is ridden in it.

games.name: Trionis Land
games.summary: Trionis Land is a free-to-play multiplayer fantasy browser RPG based on rock-paper-scissors. Players develop a persistent hero, fight other players and monsters, raise a pet, gather resources, craft and trade equipment, and explore seven-floor Catacombs in parties of up to five heroes. The game shares characters and progress between web browsers and its Telegram Mini App, with English and Russian interfaces.

games.name: Odd Odds
games.summary: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

games.name: Origin Hunt
games.summary: A kidnapped monster in a foreign country caught in a secret war between seven of the most powerful mages alive.

games.name: Obstacle Overdrive
games.summary: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

games.name: Vexcell
games.summary: Vexcell is an elegant, minimalist puzzle game. Embrace the satisfaction of everything falling into place.

games.name: Cyber Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Vacuum space junk, polish derelict ships, and clear alien worlds of debris as you upgrade your high-tech cleaning gear.

games.name: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest
games.summary: Play as Spencer, a chaotic demon as you experience vastly different games, styles, and genres in an arcade-like world

games.name: Bloodspill
games.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Birb
games.summary: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

games.name: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate
games.summary: Investigate the Redwood Estate as officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury in this classic top-down survival horror game. Face terrifying creatures, manage scarce resources, and uncover the dark secrets behind the mysterious events that took place within the estate.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
aliases: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
games.summary:
Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

The initial model of the carrier-based fighter series that would later be upgraded to the Super Tomcat.
Its role of using long-range missiles to outrange and eliminate threats to the fleet has remained consistent from its creation. Its nickname is Tomcat.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Customizable Cosmetic Set
aliases: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE - Customizable Cosmetic Set
games.summary:
This set contains the following items usable in ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE:

Aircraft Skins
- F-4E Mobius Squadron 25th Anniversary Skin
A Mobius Squadron 25th anniversary skin for the F-4E Phantom II
- F/A-18C Team Zvezda Skin
A Team Zvezda skin for the F/A-18C Hornet

- Online Lobby Avatar Outfit: Tasha
An outfit inspired by Tasha, the pilot of Joker Flight's third aircraft in Campaign Mode.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

- Aircraft Upgrade Part Missile Smoke [Scarlet]
An upgrade part that changes missile smoke color to Scarlet when equipped to an aircraft.
*Exclusive item for the online mode ACE COMBAT ONLINE.

*The Deluxe Edition also includes the Customizable Cosmetic Set. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

games.name: Unpossess 2
games.summary: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

games.name: Infinite Museum
games.summary: A psychological game where you spot anomalies in a looping museum and choose the correct exit to reach G Floor.

games.name: Bering Tonnage
games.summary: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

games.name: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles
games.summary: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

games.name: Crack the Pack
games.summary: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

games.name: Monster Nursery
games.summary: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.

games.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle
games.summary: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

games.name: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the Collection!
games.summary: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

games.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
games.summary: The halls never end...

games.name: Space Snatcher
games.summary: 6-player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

games.name: Night Shift: Something Is Wrong
games.summary: Your night shift was supposed to be simple. Watch the cameras, patrol the building, and report anything that changes. But the longer you stay, the less certain you become of what is real. Follow procedure. Pay attention. Something is wrong. Endless Mode and Speed Run Mode included.

games.name: Murmuring of Moth Mouth
games.summary: An eleven-year-old video shows Yuna's car on the road today. Its instructions promise to get her to the interview that could change her life... A short psychological horror visual novel about desperation and dependence.

games.name: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea
aliases: Dark Are The Crypts: The Lost Idea
games.summary: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea is a psychological exploration horror set in surreal, weirdcore-inspired liminal spaces. Use your camera to solve environmental puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden within the fractured mind of a tormented artist.

games.name: Penis Bird
games.summary: Slide into the role of arcade gaming's first feathered phallus! Dodge attacking wildlife, poke through tight spaces, and chase high scores across frantic danger filled runs. Collect all the power-up costumes! Features full controller support and a stream-safe Eggplant Mode.

games.name: Dub Party
games.summary: Dub Party is a party game where players replace every voice in a video with their own. Import a clip or pick a community scene, claim the roles, record each line, then watch the finished dub together. Play solo, pass one mic around the couch, or invite up to seven friends online.

games.name: Nova Slash
games.summary: Play as Veil, a hooded rebel infused with the cataclysmic energy of a collapsed artificial star. Tear through the corrupt mega-nation of Giaath in Nova Slash, an intense action platformer featuring roguelike progression and lethal melee combat.

games.name: Aery: Calm Horizon 2
games.summary: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
games.summary: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.

games.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
games.summary: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

games.name: Sediment
games.summary: A pixel-physics sandbox. Fifty materials, and every one of them is physics: sand finds its angle, water freezes, lava crusts into stone, gunpowder blows. Build your own materials and worlds, and share them in the Workshop.

games.name: Wizard Harder or Get Laid Off
games.summary: An evil baron poisoned the king's mind in the kingdom you hail from, convincing him that enchanted objects in the hands of simple goblins meant he could reduce headcount - that means you. Explore this new town, complete quests, fight goblins, and increase your power to gain the favor of the king.

games.name: Connected Hearts: Vanished Beauty - Collector's Edition
Urbanism
games.summary: Explore abandoned environments, complete objectives, and survive an entity you cannot see with your own eyes. Your only advantage is a video camera that reveals what is hunting you.

games.name: Amanda's Magic Book 16: The Dragon Chronicle
Stone Run
games.summary:
The ultimate test of reflexes and nerves!
A giant, unstoppable rolling stone is breathing down your neck, and there’s only one golden rule to survive: never look back!
Dive headfirst into Stone Run, a fast-paced, hand-drawn retro arcade experience designed for non-stop adrenaline and pure fun. Outrun disaster, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and push your reaction speed to the absolute limit in a beautifully crafted world that feels like an interactive cartoon.

games.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2: Winter Trip DLC
games.summary: After leaving the boarding house, relationships with familiar characters begin to move in new directions. From new episodes with Suzy, Gyu-ri, and Yu-jeong to unexpected moments where you become entangled once again with the original boarding house members. Experience the closer distance that unfolds during the winter trip and a special romance that changes depending on your choices.

games.name: Kawaii Push
games.summary:
Kawaii Push is a casual and relaxing Sokoban-style game in which players must push boxes to the correct locations.
The protagonist is a red-haired girl who explores cute and colorful anime-style environments.
With moderately challenging puzzles, the game offers a fun and accessible experience for players of all ages.

games.name: Scary Cave
games.summary: Scary Cave is a survival-horror game released by Alex After All Glazer Infinity. The game can be downloaded for free on Itch.io or Game Jolt.

games.name: Factorized
games.summary: A 2D side-scroller about killing robots with janky guns as a morally questionable main character.

games.name: Rooftops Jam
games.summary:
Quake Rooftops map jam, ran from August 4th to September 15th.
The theme is "Rooftops", and mappers were free to interpret it however they wanted.

games.name: Intravenous 3: Borderline
games.summary: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the shoes of Gideon, a feared mercenary with nothing left to lose, and carve a bloody path of revenge through deep systemic stealth and brutal tactical gunplay.

games.name: Dude, Trust Me
games.summary: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

games.name: Keepshore
games.summary: A calm 3D island town-builder spanning nine ages, from stone huts to electric streets. Raise workshops, wire production chains, work a living market, and grow a town that keeps producing while you're away. Settle a new island to advance the age — every shore you leave sends tribute home forever.

games.name: Super Flávio World
games.summary: Super Flávio World is an independent, free-to-play newsgame that uses the structure of Super Mario World as a form of political satire, presenting a series of investigations and controversies involving Flávio Bolsonaro through platforming levels.

games.name: Save Amani
games.summary: The city in the game has been destroyed beyond recognition by war; its former prosperity now lies in ruins. The rubble everywhere, the smoke filling the air, and the gloomy sky all convey the cruelty and ruthlessness of war, delivering an immersive experience to players.

games.name: Major Mutt
games.summary: Play as a combat ready pup in this 3D survivorlike. Blast through swarms of giant critters with auto firing weapons attached to your harness, but don't just survive, Do Your Job! Herd lost sheep to safety to earn permanent stat boosts and become the ultimate Good Boy

games.name: Marked
games.summary: In a world ravaged by climate collapse, flee a ruthless mafia alongside fellow survivors in this cooperative turn-based strategy game: manage hunger, thirst and resources while journeying together toward safety.

games.name: Sengoku Rance
games.summary: Fresh from wreaking havoc on the vast fields of the Continent, the sword-wielding warrior Rance has reached the eastern nation of Nippon. With his loyal companion Sill by his side, Rance hopes to enjoy Nippon's hot springs!

games.name: Snow War
games.summary: Snow War is an FPS (First Person Snowball) Game! No blood is shed, but that does not mean the stakes are not real.

games.name: Demon Lord: Clicker
games.summary: A Steam-Drop Clicker with real game mechanics in a high fantasy setting. Click for drops, then choose to combine them for stronger/rarer variants, equip them for power! Amass wealth and glory! Be the hero, assault the Demon Lord! (No fruit is harmed during gameplay)

games.name: Dreamspring
games.summary: Dreamspring is a dark fantasy styled, open world souls-like game. Explore a dying kingdom and it's different realms in first person action combat, styled in a mix of retro and vaporwave aesthetics.

games.name: General Idler
games.summary: General Idler is an idle conquest game set on a parallel Earth — 195 nations, real borders, and one objective: total world domination. You start with a single home country and nothing but ambition. Build industries to generate cash. Fund military units to generate Army Power. Accumulate enough AP, declare war on a neighbor, and add their flag to your wall. Then do it again. And again. Across every continent on the globe.

games.name: Keine's Terakoya: A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo
games.summary: Play as Keine Kamishirasawa, the half-beast teacher of Gensokyo! Teach humans and yokai, grow their minds, hearts, and bodies, and guide them to graduation. Balance tradition and change, expand your influence, and build your ideal school. Write your legend on the education frontlines!

games.name: Spring Me Up
games.summary: A challenging physics-based 2.5D platformer. Use your spring to bounce and land with precision, navigating tricky platforms and obstacles. Every miscalculation can send you back, testing your skill, patience, and self-control.

games.name: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
games.summary: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you…

games.name: Unknown Horizon
games.summary: Retro styled, top-down, space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home.

games.name: In These Hallowed Halls
games.summary: In These Hallowed Halls is a first person, psychological horror puzzle game. Make your way through a decrepit, abandoned mental Institution as you solve puzzles and unravel the story behind what lurks in the darkest corners of the building.

games.name: Dream Hike
games.summary: A peaceful adventure through a beautiful world.

games.name: Save The President
games.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

games.name: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko: A Game Made in 4 Hours
Timefract
games.summary: Move through time. Back and forward. Create clones across timelines and cooperate with yourself to solve impossible puzzles.

games.name: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6
aliases: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6: The Comeback
games.summary: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6 is the latest MMA release by developer Adam Ryland and makes a massive step forward in the series. In WMMA6, you run your own MMA organization in a lively, vivid, competitive game world that evolves over time. Play with companies, fighters, and teams from all around the globe. WMMA6 adds over 100 new features to the series. Deal with contracts, morale, promotional work, hype and more…this is the deepest MMA sim available.

games.name: Warspace
games.summary: Warspace is a free first-person tactical shooter that runs in the browser, with nothing to install. Two teams fight over bomb sites in 5v5 and 2v2 matches: one life a round, the Ts plant the C4, the CTs defend or defuse it. Every map is built on the same 55-metre planet, so the horizon is close and fights come over the curve; a lap takes about a minute. The guns follow Counter-Strike 1.6's numbers and the knife and grenades follow CS:GO's. Play against bots in practice, open casual rooms with friends, climb 18 ranked tiers with a Discord account, and build and publish your own maps in the in-game editor, CREATORS. Warspace is independent and not affiliated with Valve.

games.name: Screw Workshop
games.summary: Screw Workshop is a single-player browser puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players remove screws from layered enamel plates to complete color orders while managing a limited spare tray. Plates pivot around their final screw, and later boards introduce keyed locks and linked pairs. The game includes 36 restoration puzzles across six collections, a daily commission, undo, hints and local progress saving. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

games.name: Exit Please
games.summary: Exit Please is a single-player browser platform adventure developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players guide a night-shift courier through glasshouse terraces, rooftops, canals and clocktower bridges. Twelve scrolling missions combine guarded relays, moving lifts, low tunnels, collapsing platforms, checkpoints and four guardians. Actions include jumping, stomping, dashing and deflecting projectiles. The game also includes 60 practice and mastery rooms, daily challenges, route ghosts and a local room workshop. Keyboard, touch and gamepad controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

games.name: The Incredimental Horse
games.summary:
Help your horse win the race at the fair! Buy various updates with tickets that you won in previous races to increase your chances.

Credits

Programming: Pianfensi
Art: nova_linah
Plushies: AnnoyingEdu, POLYmechanical, tanybunny
Sounds: TamelessNee, POLYmechanical
Music: Julius H., Kevin MacLeod

games.name: Intercept Line
games.summary: Intercept Line is a strategy and simulation game in which you command Ukraine's air defense on a real map of Ukraine. Every night swarms of Shahed drones, cruise missiles, ballistic and hypersonic missiles strike your cities and infrastructure, and there are never enough interceptors: deploy SAM batteries, anti-aircraft guns, mobile fire teams, radars and fighter jets, and decide what to protect. By day it is your turn: plan long-range drone and missile strikes on enemy refineries, airbases and depots, routing around enemy radars and air defenses or suppressing them to open a corridor for the next wave. When orders are not enough, take the controls of a fighter jet yourself. Online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: Rabbit Simulator
games.summary: An Action-Adventure game. Gameplay consists of mainly bullet-hell and shooting, but also features puzzles and mini-games.

games.name: Private Mining Company
games.summary: Private Mining Company is a tower defense game with perma-death and extraction elements. Keep your soldiers while you complete contracts, as long as they aren't killed. Make money defending mining outposts on hostile alien planets. Balance mining upgrades and growing your army.

games.name: Piworld
games.summary: First pixel 2D game, which include MMO and PVP system for anyone, who wants to try something new.

games.name: Banana Clicker
games.summary: Click. Upgrade. Conquer. Build a banana empire, unlock powerful upgrades, and uncover a wild banana-fueled conspiracy. Meet silly NPCs, test your luck in gacha, and unleash Banana Storms! With skills, achievements, and endless growth, the bananas never stop!

games.name: PostApo
games.summary: It’s a post-apocalyptic game set in the year 2067. The game will feature full voice acting and all in-game texts and descriptions will be localized. It will be released in 9 languages. Unreal Engine 5.4.4 Unreal Engine 5.2.1

games.name: Jolly: Anniversary Edition
games.summary: "Jolly: Anniversary Edition" is a fan-remake made from the ground up of the original "Jolly 1" by IvanG. This is designed to give the original game a fresh new coat of paint with better polished gameplay and a new story that helps it connect to the wider Jolly story.

games.name: Jono
games.summary: Work together to complete one million levels, one player at a time. Continue where the previous left off. Chat with others while you wait for your turn. How long will it take?

games.name: Bramble Sling
games.summary: Bramble Sling is a single-player browser physics puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players launch woodland heroes from a slingshot to dismantle clockwork beetle towers made from glass, timber and stone. Four heroes provide dash, split, slam and burst abilities. The game includes 24 levels in four worlds, golden acorns, three-star objectives and local progress saving. Keyboard, pointer and touch controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.

games.name: Dumpling Delight
games.summary: Welcome to Dumpling Delight! Drop adorable dumplings, merge matching pairs, and watch them grow! Chase high scores, master satisfying physics, and enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience where every drop brings a little joy. How big can your dumplings get?

games.name: The Empty Suitcase
games.summary: A psychological horror game following a detective investigating the murder of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046. The investigation begins normally, but as strange events unfold, the case takes a disturbing turn.

games.name: The Voice Party
aliases: The Voice Party: Mimic Together Game
games.summary: The Voice Party is a voice-mimic party game in which players listen to short sounds, record imitations through a microphone and compare scores. It includes solo practice, local pass-and-play for two to four players, private online rooms, a scene-dubbing mode and local custom audio packs.

games.name: The Truth Written by the Stars
games.summary: When you start the game, the narrator will instruct you to “close your eyes.” At that moment, whether you actually close them or keep them open will change the course of the story. Listen carefully to the voice as you proceed, and find your way to the truth.

games.name: GeoFußball
games.summary: GeoFußball is a daily football geography quiz in German. Every day there are five football moments – famous goals, finals, stadiums and players' birthplaces. Read the hint, drop a pin on the map where it happened and score points by distance. Play the free daily round and timer round, challenge friends to duels via link and play for your club in the Fan League. Pro adds private groups (Stammtische), custom rounds and the archive. No ads, no betting.

games.name: Touhou: BlackEight
games.summary: If there is an anomaly, do not put the lights out. Survive eight nights at Eientei in this first person Touhou Project horror fan game. 99 ruinous anomalies warp the sleeping girls in the dark, and the distance between Reimu, Marisa, Kaguya and Mokou shifts night by night. Exit 8 like, yuri horror.

games.name: Gear Puzzle: the inheritance of grandpa
games.summary: Carl is an ordinary teenager who works in a mechanical factory far from home for a living. To celebrate his sister's birthday, he returned home and met two unkind people. The story began.

games.name: Ascendant's Roguelike
games.summary: A fantasy based roguelike. Ascend and slay endless hordes or monster while gaining the abilities of each creature you slay.

games.name: SystemCrash92
games.summary: Face the machines of the evil hacker in this action roguelite. Your avatar will assist you in battle as you improve your skills with items and level up to build a powerful strategy. An unforgettable adventure for survival fans!

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Bony Bones Adventures
games.summary: Bony Bones Adventures - is a 3D platformer where the lands of Zagrobiya have been enslaved by a necromancer. Help those in need, drive away the invaders, become a hero of Zagrobiya and return its freedom.

games.name: Uppercute
games.summary: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.name: Stickility
games.summary: Explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center Biotec, filled with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Find the burrowed truth and close this facility for good.

games.name: Mycopsychosys: Project Jupiter
games.summary: Explore, investigate, and survive this new infection. Collect clues, meet and interact with people, and bond with the main cast. Solve the mysteries like a true detective and follow the non-linear narrative. Are you ready to face this new deadly infection?

games.name: Shroomwood
games.summary: Shroomwood is a top-down 2D action roguelike where you play as a little mushroom exploring ever-changing forests, battling infested forest creatures, dual wielding weapons with awesome power, and collecting enchanted items.

games.name: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
games.summary: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

games.name: The Drawn Hour
games.summary: The Drawn Hour is a haunted-terminal card roguelike. Dial into a cursed dial-up BBS as one of three operators, build a deck, and claw through three corrupted sectors. Manage your rising Corruption, hunt relics, and face what waits at the drawn hour — alone, or in 2–4 player online co-op.

games.name: Chill Cat
games.summary: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

games.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
games.summary: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

games.name: Midwest Goodbye
games.summary: A narrative deck builder that mixes 2D and 3D art and makes you want to say goodbye just a little longer.

games.name: The Listener
games.summary: "The Listener is a first-person investigation game. Play as a Yugoslav radio amateur at the height of the Cold War. Use your equipment to pick up mysterious transmissions, analyze cryptic messages, and gather hidden clues to uncover a sinister conspiracy"

games.name: Sinever: First Seal
games.summary: Sinever: The First Seal is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror game. Explore an isolated Victorian estate, operate paranormal equipment, manage your sanity, and uncover the truth behind its imprisoned entity before the house claims you too.

games.name: Cosmo Solitaire 4: Edge of the Galaxy
Veillombre
games.summary: Multiplayer pixel-art horror for 1-16 players. A manor drowned in darkness, a candle as your only ally, a monster on the prowl — and maybe traitors among you. Scavenge, barricade, hide, vote… and survive the night.

games.name: Hello, Luigi!
games.summary: Luigi is ready to play! Touch Luigi's face to play together with your children in Hello, Luigi! Hello, Luigi! is part of the My Mario series – a collection of products designed for young children and their parents to enjoy together.

games.name: Turkish Hairlines
games.summary: Turkish Hairlines is a single-player puzzle and simulation game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games, set in a fictional Istanbul hair-transplant clinic. Across four chapters and twelve patient cases, players plan hairlines within a limited donor supply, harvest and place grafts, manage freshness and see a twelve-month result based on their decisions. Some cases involve declining an unsuitable procedure. The game is a parody and is not affiliated with any airline, airport or clinic; it does not provide medical advice. It is free to play in web browsers with English and Turkish text, mouse, touch and keyboard controls, and local progress saving. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

games.name: Werfast
games.summary: A dark metroidvania where you pilot a powerful mech to explore a surreal underground world. Unlock new abilities, discover hidden areas, battle deadly enemies, uncover ancient secrets, and survive the horrors lurking below.
