games.name: Norn Saber: The Guardian's Oath
games.summary: 《女神：守護之約》是一款揉合了策略戰棋、合成製作、裝潢佈置、戀愛養成等眾多精采元素的遊戲作品，搭配史詩劇情的鋪陳醞釀，玩家們將在其中體驗自己從脆弱到強大，最終超越極限的冒險歷程，絕對是不可錯過的經典之作。

games.name: Lugano Bay Tycoon
games.summary: Build and manage your lakeside business in Lugano Bay Tycoon. Rent out pedal boats and boats, serve customers, reinvest your profits, and expand your operation in a relaxing management game set on the shores of an Alpine lake.

games.name: Retro Survival
games.summary:
Retro Survival is a fan-made, single-player survival action game set in the DOFUS Retro universe, playable directly in your browser. Play as a Feca, Iop, Sram, Enutrof, or Osamodas and battle waves of monsters in iconic locations such as Astrub, Litneg Wood, and Wabbit Island.

Real-time combat combines movement, spells, and unique class abilities. As you progress through each run, earn experience, choose upgrades, and combine equipment and spells to shape your character. Take on bosses, collect rare items, and gather the Dofus as you strive to survive for as long as possible.

The game brings the graphics, animations, and sounds of DOFUS Retro into a roguelite survival experience with progressive character development.

games.name: Starbloom Ranch
games.summary: Build an alien homestead in a cosy creature-collecting farming RPG. Tame 300 companions to fight in turn-based battles and work your ranch. Grow crops, harpoon fish to feed your team, decorate your cottage, and brave the mines with sword combat. Play solo or with friends—100% free to play!

games.name: Gambapets
games.summary: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

games.name: Hello, Peach!
games.summary: Peach is ready to play! Touch Peach's face to play together with your children in Hello, Peach! for Nintendo Switch. You can also play on Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: King Kong Remastered
games.summary: Peter Jackson's King Kong (X360) on PC, running natively, with the launcher and options of a modern PC release.

games.name: King's Cup
games.summary: King's Cup is a drinking game played online with friends. Players each pull a card from the circle and have to drink, give drinks, or a mini-game is started to determine who should drink. King's Cup comes with default rules or you can host games using your own custom rules!

games.name: Devil Peach Soda
games.summary: Carve your way through a twisted and demonic manor in this fast paced roguelike. Devil Peach Soda combines quick arcade gameplay and RPG mechanics, featuring a variety of ways to build and customize your character each run.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary: Experience Emergence Day – the brutal origin story of one of gaming’s most acclaimed third-person shooter franchises.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Paunchy Pets
games.summary: Paunchy Pets are your chubby little monsters that love to battle almost as much as they love to eat. Train them in flash-style mini-games, Feed them junk food in a cozy farming sim, Battle opponent’s pets in an autobattler based on skill, and Breed rare Paunchies to bolster your roster.

games.name: Lostbound
games.summary: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

games.name: The Call Button
games.summary: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

games.name: Cliax Codec
games.summary: It's time for a change in perspective! Explore an adventure full of tricky action and puzzles in this third-person and top-down shooter hybrid!

games.name: Weekend Solitaire: Grace in Motion
games.summary: Over 200 exciting levels, three game modes, beautiful natural environments, a variety of bonuses, and unique obstacles. A relaxing solitaire adventure that both newcomers and seasoned card puzzle fans will enjoy.

games.name: Olympus 2249
games.summary:
Olympus 2249 is a single-player, turn-based cRPG set in a post-nuclear dieselpunk America.

A journey through an atmospheric world packed with meaningful choices, branching dialogue, and brutal, bloody battles.

games.name: StreamQuiz
games.summary: StreamQuiz is a free live quiz tool for Twitch streamers (Czech language interface). Build your own questions with up to four answers, show them on stream and let viewers answer in chat or on a web page. Faster correct answers earn more points, the leaderboard and end-of-quiz stats appear right on the overlay. Made for community nights, events and interactive streams.

games.name: Forgery: Before the Law (Study)
games.summary: Push the box and go beyond the gate. A warehouse keeper-style 3D puzzle adventure inspired by Kafka's novels and myths. A short game exploring an absurd inner world across 6 stages.

games.name: Escape the Playground
games.summary: One hears your voice. One only moves when you look away. One doesn't follow rules at all. The playground is open. Bring friends. 1-4 player co-op horror.

games.name: StarL 9 Ashes Of The Past
games.summary: Enjoy a magical Match-3 journey through a mysterious island filled with secrets and adventure. Complete colorful levels, solve challenging puzzles, restore ancient magic, and uncover the truth behind an unforgettable legend.

games.name: ClearIt M4
games.summary: Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills! Shoot colorful balls, match them by color, trigger chain reactions and overcome unique obstacles. Explore challenging levels, use powerful special elements and compete against the computer!

games.name: Stick Life: The Daily Grind
games.summary: Start in a tent with twenty-five dollars and a whole city to work out. Climb a career to the corner office, gamble, fight, date, adopt a stray, buy the mansion on the hill, and try not to miss rent. An isometric life sim where every day lasts 24 real minutes.

games.name: NDHA: Non Dominant Hand Adventures
games.summary: A quirky survival arcade game about Fistavo punching fish. Drawn entirely with the creator’s non-dominant hand, it also includes a gallery of the complete comic strip that inspired the game.

games.name: Ring Release
games.summary: Ring Release is a single-player ring-untangling puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players rotate linked rings until their gaps align and every piece can lift free. It includes 60 handmade puzzles across three collections, introducing fixed pins, closed loops and beads. The game has unlimited undo, solution-checked hints, an inspect view and local progress saving, with mouse, touch and keyboard controls. It is available free in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

games.name: Snake King
games.summary: Snake King is a single-player arena snake game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players collect food to grow, spend mass to boost and try to make rival snakes collide with their body. Opponents are computer-controlled and marked BOT. Six shrine powers, arena events, a tutorial, death replays, daily missions and achievements accompany unlockable skins and cosmetics. It supports mouse, keyboard, gamepad and touch controls, with local progress saving. The game is free to play in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.

games.name: Plates of Peril
games.summary: Plates of Peril is a chaotic cannibalistic restaurant-management game. Play solo or team up with up to 5 friends as you harvest limbs, prepare dishes, and screen guests for undercover cops to become the ultimate 5-star chef.

games.name: Moge
games.summary: Moge is a multiplayer VR Game with gamemodes including, Tag, Horror & Casual, The Tropical Beachy Main Map And The beach itself. Moge is meant for all users of all ages for max fun.

games.name: CyberSprawl: Survivors
games.summary: CyberSprawl: Survivors is a single-player cyberpunk bullet heaven with loot extraction. Players build weapon combinations with automatic attacks, upgrades, and evolutions, fight hordes, and explore for weapons, armor, and accessories. Extracting secures new equipment for later runs; dying before extraction loses the equipment carried on that run. Chapter progression unlocks operators, permanent upgrades, Doctrines, and relic hunts.

games.name: Expand TD
games.summary: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite where you build and upgrade towers and traps while gradually uncovering an expanding map between waves. As you explore new locations and terrain, you'll discover resources, rewards, and unexpected threats that can shift your strategy. When your base falls, the run ends, but you earn Technology Points to unlock permanent upgrades for future attempts across four distinct biomes.

games.name: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 5: A Grim Doctrine
games.summary: The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.

games.name: Mimic Party: Halloween
games.summary: Listen, imitate, and laugh through every replay. Play solo, pass the mic with up to 6 local players, or join an online Halloween party.

games.name: Idle Rocket Miner
games.summary: Idle Rocket Miner is an idle game with a hands-on core. You pilot a rocket by hand, taking off from the Command Centre, landing at mines and hauling atoms home to sell, until the periodic table is complete. Every flight you make is recorded as a route, and autopilot then replays it while you’re away.

games.name: Bloodborne for Windows
games.summary: An unofficial Bloodborne port for Windows 10 and 11.

games.name: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Ashes and Ascension
games.summary: The ninth MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries DLC. An 18-mission campaign, the longest yet, following the First Whitting Conference after the Battle of Coventry, spanning 3058–3060. Adds 13 new Clan 'Mechs, 3 Inner Sphere OmniMechs, new Inner Sphere variants and weapons, 5 Career Mode faction starts set in 3050, and 10 new High-Reward Crates.

games.name: Hidden Land of Ana: Ghostly Realm
Bork: A Text Adventure
games.summary: A perfectly normal text adventure. Explore 200 rooms, solve bizarre puzzles, collect questionable objects, and discover multiple endings in a world of dark humor and increasingly unreliable guidance.

games.name: RaidKids
games.summary: Still, the boy keeps walking.

games.name: Spam
games.summary:
Explore the different cards and let your imagination run wild to develop an original strategy. Once you're ready for battle, jump into the arena and face players from around the world in a dynamic duel that will require observation and adaptation. Each victory will allow you to earn new cards and expand your possibilities.
Beware, strategy can hide where you least expect it.

games.name: Horde Arena
games.summary: Horde Arena is a third-person shooter roguelite where you survive endless enemy waves. Pick a character, upgrade your stats and weapons, and evolve to dominate the battlefield. Play solo or team up with up to four players in co-op mode.

games.name: Insomnia
games.summary: Insomnia is a top-down shooter with psychological horror elements. Take part in fierce firefights, perform tasks covertly, act on intuition. Will you be able to survive all the enemies, stop moral outrage around you, and save others without losing your mind?

games.name: Superhero Simulator
games.summary: Superhero Simulator is an open-world superhero game where you fight villains and save lives! But being a hero isn’t free! You’ll need to work, pay rent, and survive. Can you handle both sides of the superhero life?

games.name: Blyte
games.summary: A wacky and hilarious walking simulator that throws you into a surreal universe alongside EVA (who cares about her name, anyway?), filled with improbable misadventures and traps worthy of a master troll. A breath of mocking fresh air in an industry that's far too tame!

games.name: Gridlords
games.summary: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

games.name: March of the Red Queen
games.summary: March on a rival Queen. Choose who eats and who doesn’t, who sleeps and who burns the midnight oil, who keeps walking by your side and who is left behind. Then pay the consequences.

games.name: One More Floor
games.summary: A small box dungeon crawl for one player. A deck of rooms, a handful of dice, four numbers on a character sheet, and five floors that do not care how well you did last time.

games.name: Highway Blossoms: Gold Rush Edition
games.summary: A yuri VN about two girls on a roadtrip through the southwest United States.

games.name: Shelved
games.summary: Sort 1,560+ cursed VHS tapes across 20 genres as a tiny orc! Master magical powers, upgrade your gear, and outsmart a chaotic poltergeist who scatters your work. Features Hidden secrets, 26 achievements, and a Spooky-Free Peaceful Mode. The ultimate cozy horror organizer!

games.name: Do You Remember?
games.summary: A realistic psychological experience where you undergo psychic tests while living a repetitive routine in a kind of psychiatric clinic.

games.name: P.T. for PC
games.summary: A native PC port of P.T., the 2014 PS4 teaser by Kojima Productions.

games.name: Oink Splash Party
games.summary: Oink Splash Party is a chaotic multiplayer physics-based party brawler where adorable pigs battle it out across colorful inflatable waterparks! Punch your opponents, inflate yourself to bounce and launch across arenas, and compete in a variety of competitive and team-based game modes. Customize your pig, tackle interactive obstacles, and dive into the mayhem with friends in online multiplayer or private matches.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Fighting Golf
games.summary:
"FIGHTING GOLF" is a golf game released by SNK in 1988.
Choose one of four characters with unique strengths in distance and accuracy, and take on 18 varied holes filled with three types of rough, two types of bunkers, oceans, rivers, and dense trees.
Advice is displayed before starting each hole, and the optimal club is automatically picked for you based on the distance to the pin to guide your strategy!

games.name: PokéSurvivor
games.summary: PokéSurvivor is a Pokémon survival game inspired by Survivor.io and Vampire Survivors. It’s free to play in your browser: choose a companion, move around an endless map, and let your attacks fire automatically as hordes of wild Pokémon try to surround you. How long can you survive?

games.name: Babel Legacy
games.summary: An idle game where you gather resources and grow your city. Sit back and watch your city expand!

games.name: Puzzle Arrows: The Original
games.summary:
One click. One direction. The right order

Arrow Puzzle is a calm single-player puzzle game about clearing crowded boards one arrow at a time. Click any part of an arrow to launch it toward its head. If the route is clear, it leaves the board. If another arrow blocks the way, you lose a life, and it returns. To solve each level, study which arrows block one another, choose the right sequence, and think several moves ahead.

games.name: Royal Cartographer: Restore the Map
games.summary: Royal Cartographer: Restore the Map is a single player organization simulator where you gather, rotate, and piece together thousands of scattered map fragments. Enjoy the satisfaction of restoring the map, tidying the tower, and unlocking new abilities. The King is waiting. Best get to work!

games.name: Afterbeat
games.summary: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.summary: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.summary: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Wildaria
games.summary: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.summary: Dive into the cybermyth roguelike chaos of Neon Abyss 2! Now featuring up to 4-player online co-op, more combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic, action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Invokyr
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play with up to 5 friends. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A gentle ghost story about learning to live after loss, set in a lively Thai river village. Teenage Mai befriends Pim, a cheery ghost who needs Mai's good karma to recover lost memories. Play as both as they help each other heal through friendship, dance, and heartfelt kindnesses to their neighbors.

games.name: Cyan Heart
games.summary: A horror exploration puzzle adventure where you relive events through a selfie viewpoint. Alone, with only voice communication from comrades as support, she simply keeps the camera rolling. Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

games.name: Tower Tactics 2
games.summary: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

games.name: Drillbound
games.summary: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

games.name: Ship Shape Slam!!!
games.summary:
Out-dodge, out-dash, and outlast your friends in chaotic 1–4 player bullet hell arenas. Side effects may include shouting, betrayal, and broken couches.

Enter arenas with up to 4 players where you can only move and dash. Bullets fly in from every direction with wild properties, forcing you to dodge, weave, and time your dash just right. Dashing isn’t just for escaping—it builds temporary invincibility and can even send friends flying. Land a charged dash to earn a full second of invulnerability against all bullets!

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Dragon Dinner
games.summary: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

games.name: Run Giraffe Run
games.summary: Run Giraffe Run is a multiplayer fast-paced giraffe racing 2D platformer. Poop bombs. Spit banana peels. Slip on banana peels. Race against friends through chaotic and colorful levels. Have you tried farting?

games.name: DungeonOS
games.summary: Crawl Dungeons, Loot and Equip your Adventurers! Log in to an old-school operating system. Manage your adventurers and use puzzles to damage your enemies. Are you ready to find the five artifacts you always dreamed of?

games.name: Dino Time Raiders
games.summary: Travel back in time to capture dinosaurs and turn them into profit! Lead a team of scientists through chaotic time-travel missions, catch prehistoric beasts, and build the ultimate dino park. Manage research, upgrades, and disasters - all in the name of science and the free market.

games.name: Chicks in Trouble
games.summary: A peaceful farm is thrown into chaos when a mother hen's chicks mysteriously vanish! Team up with the brave father rooster and embark on a quirky, obstacle-filled adventure to bring them home. Grab your mouse or gamepad—it's time to save the flock!

games.name: Anomalous Cleaning Detail
games.summary: A first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

games.name: Maid Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Run a maid café with five charming kemonomimi maids! Make drinks, serve customers, and tackle troublemakers in this first-person management sim. Get to know the girls behind the aprons as you turn a rundown café into a thriving business and aim for three Maidchelin stars.

games.name: Click & Mine
games.summary: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts
games.summary: Death comes for us all - Overcome powerful curses, strange new enemies and deadly trials as two new Survivors but never forget for a moment She is watching.

games.name: All You Can Fish!
games.summary: All You Can Fish is an active, relaxing incremental fishing adventure where every voyage matters, every upgrade counts, and every fish brings you one step closer to maritime legend.

games.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
games.summary: Build your elite team in Duelist: Idle Expedition, the idle auto-battler that lives on your taskbar. Recruit from a pool of 90+ JRPG pixel-art roles and lead your traveling camp to victory against all the powerful Guilds on the Continent. Your epic journey continues even when you are busy!

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III]
games.summary: Play Kingdom Hearts I–III together in one unforgettable collection. A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind (DLC).

games.name: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
games.summary: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

games.name: Keep Watering
games.summary: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

games.name: Rainbow Islands CS
games.summary: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!

games.name: Kill Your Friends
games.summary: Kill Your Friends is a chaotic 4-player combat party game where every round twists the rules and no two rounds play the same.

games.name: Garden Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

games.name: PlantUp
games.summary: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

games.name: Once Upon A Katamari: Rolling Live Highlights
games.summary: This paid DLC features ten stages originally featured in "Katamari Damacy Rolling Live", twelve new songs, six new cousins, and 18 new accessories.

games.name: Boku to Tsuri Nikki
games.summary: Boku to Tsuri Nikki is a freshwater fishing game set in a peaceful, nature-filled world, where players can enjoy an immersive fishing experience.

games.name: Big Market Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage a massive supermarket. Order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your business into the ultimate shopping destination.

games.name: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up
aliases: Cauldron Chaos Brew Potions & Tidy Up.exe
games.summary: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up is an alchemy organization game enjoyable solo or co-op. Clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them in multiple ways and brew almost 200 unique recipes to place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Piloted Weapon - Blacker Number 5
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Piloted Weapon - Combat Frame Phantasia Shield Nyx
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Vehicle - Caliban Armored Ambulance Joyful Marking
Earth Defense Force 5: Air Raider Weapon - FZ-GUN
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Support Device - Wild Skeleton
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Weapon - Grim Reaper Shield
Earth Defense Force 5: Fencer Weapon - Happy Body Pillow
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger & Air Raider Weapon - EDF: WB Decoy Set (ver Civilian)
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger & Air Raider Weapon - EDF: WB Decoy Set (ver Soldier)
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Piloted Weapon - Blacker Number 4.1
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Piloted Weapon - Omega Freesia
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Support Device - Detector S-Type
Earth Defense Force 5: Ranger Vehicle - Light Truck
Earth Defense Force 5: Wing Diver Support Device - Reverse Core S-Type
Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
games.summary: Step right up! We’re searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

games.name: Sort the Capybaras
games.summary: Sort the Capybaras is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,800 unique capybara toys onto the correct shelves. Play with friends or go solo. Enjoy the satisfaction of using powerful skills turning a messy capybara store into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: The Clown's Forest: Shadows of Blood
games.summary: Set during the events of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, join Officer Dragon as he is kidnapped by Chester, and taken to a very familiar location. He isn't the only victim stuck in the forest though. Meet familiar, and unfamiliar faces as you fight to survive, or succumb to your death.

games.name: The Residual
games.summary: The Residual is a short, free atmospheric narrative platformer about loneliness, memory, love, and a collapsing world that may or may not be real.

games.name: Thunder Hoop Collection
games.summary: The adrenaline of 90s coin-ops is reborn! Thunder Hoop Collection unites the cult-classic 2D side-scrolling platformers in one definitive package, bringing the original 1992 masterpiece and its massive 1994 sequel, TH Strikes Back, straight to your screen.

games.name: Beyond the 10th
games.summary: First-person anomaly horror game. Spot what's wrong, advance the levels, survive what's hunting your soul and go Beyond the 10th.

games.name: More Slots More Money
games.summary: A short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.

games.name: Demon General Kirsten
games.summary: Kirsten is a soldier troubled by her current way of life. During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people, and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

games.name: Drowse
games.summary: DROWSE is a first-person psychological horror game set in the 1990s. A late-night favor brings you back to the office for a few photocopies. Explore, examine objects and solve puzzles as familiar places give way to memories you would rather leave behind.

games.name: Astral Ascent: Expedition 33 - For Those Who Come After
games.summary: A free crossover update bringing Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 into Astral Ascent, featuring three new bosses, three themed rooms, and special summons based on Expedition members. Encounter Golgra, the Mimes, and Pétank, then choose an ally at the Campfire, each with unique combat abilities. The content unlocks after completing the game on its base difficulty.

games.name: Dragon Quest VIII: Recompiled
games.summary: An experimental native port of Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King for PlayStation 2.

games.name: Monkey
games.summary: Welcome to monkey, play different gamemodes, explore different maps and make sure to have fun!

games.name: MOBA Manager 2026
games.summary: Pick and run a professional MOBA esports club with a goal of becoming the best team in the world through management of drafts, training, transfers and many other gameplay elements.

games.name: VHS Tapes
games.summary: VHS Tapes is a 1-4 player, online co-op horror. Experience a collection of mysterious video tapes, each one containing completely different stories, locations, puzzles and nightmares to endure. INSERT. PRESS PLAY.

games.name: Log Away - Halloween DLC
games.summary: Turn your Log Away cabin into a playful, spooky hideaway. Add pumpkins, cute spiderwebs and ghosts, then follow a calm Halloween soundtrack into a cozy night. Nothing grim, nothing urgent. Just a warm glow, soft shadows, and gentle magic.

games.name: SpeedBreaker
games.summary: Most Wanted, the way you remember it. The definitive Need for Speed: Most Wanted recompilation. Built from the 2005 Xbox 360 version, the best-looking one, and made sharper, wider, and smoother for the modern era.

games.name: Manggis: Night Market Survivor
games.summary: Manggis is an arena survival roguelite set in a Southeast Asian night market in 1997. The player controls Manggis, an unsold mangosteen armed with a frying pan and a bottle blaster, who must survive thirty nights against waves of rats, ants, cockroaches, stray cats, macaques, seagulls and dogs. The blaster aims and fires automatically, the frying pan swings at nearby enemies, and the player moves, dashes and switches between ten kinds of fruit ammunition held in a revolving drum. A boss appears every third night, nine mini-bosses and a final boss on night thirty. Between nights, a broker sells items and ammunition paid for with banknotes collected during the fight.

games.name: Hood Warfare 2
games.summary: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

games.name: CPM 2
games.summary: Open-world racing sandbox with cross-platform multiplayer. Complete parking challenges, drift, and participate in races: drag, rally, circuit, and Drift. Tune cars and organize car meets with friends.

games.name: Cricket Franchise Master
games.summary: A T20 cricket Franchise builder allow you to put together your squad and challenge people across the world in daily and weekly events

games.name: The World of Dokkaebi
games.summary: Set 300 years before the events of the popular web novel/webtoon Demon Exterminator's Cultivation, World of Dokkaebi is a 2.5D dot-art MMORPG set in a world governed by the balance of natural order and corruption. Players step into the shoes of a Taoist cultivator during an era when humans and Dokkaebi (Korean goblins) are still learning to trust one another, embarking on a journey to combat rising demonic forces and restore harmony to the realm.

games.name: My Friend Is Blind
games.summary: A two-player online co-op puzzle game where one of you sees everything and the other almost nothing. The Guide spots the mines, traps and guards; the Blind has to get through every trial trusting only their partner's voice. Talk, fail, explode, try again.

games.name: ReStreet
games.summary: ReStreet is a Windows PC version of FIFA Street (2012) made by recompiling the Xbox 360 game.

games.name: Console Archives: Ripple Island
games.summary:
Ripple Island was released by Sunsoft in 1988 for an 8 -bit home console.
This is an adventure game in which the player takes on the role of the protagonist Kyle and goes on an adventure while operating 9 types of commands. Whether you can rescue Princess Nasareru, who was kidnapped by a monster calling himself Emperor Groaker, bring peace back to Ripple Island, and be united with the heroine depends on your judgment and actions.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

games.name: True Love For Her
games.summary: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

games.name: Permafrost
games.summary: Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Car Park Capital
games.summary: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

games.name: Lost & Found
games.summary: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

games.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
games.summary: You can’t understand them—yet. Decode the “Second Reality” through talk, mind read, and translate in an empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure.
aliases: さとり中二病相談室 -第二現実の翻訳者-
中二病咨询室：第二现实译者
中二病諮詢室：第二現實翻譯者

games.name: Tied to the Beat
games.summary: A music-driven arena survivor where lyrics trigger effects across the battlefield. Pick one of 8 instruments, fight through 4 themed worlds with more than 50 included songs, or import your own music. Over 1,000 lyric-triggered effects, Steam Workshop support and an interface in 31 languages. Your music. Your weapon.

games.name: Escape: Immersion
games.summary: Escape: Immersion is a horror adventure inspired by Inside and Little Nightmares. An atmospheric survival adventure with puzzles, platforming, and unpredictable challenges inside a collapsing underwater lab.

games.name: Celestay Craft&Slowlife
games.summary: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

games.name: Botlings
games.summary:
A factory automation game where workers become buildings and develop sentience.
Lead a swarm of mindless robots in a factory automation game where your workers are also your machines.
Direct your forward-walking robots through turners, splitters and bridges, transform them into production buildings, have them transport your resources, and design ever-growing production networks in all 3 dimensions. In Botlings, every robot is a resource: guide them to work, reroute their paths, or sacrifice them to construct the infrastructure your factory needs.
But be wary, the more your factory grows, the more unpredictable your workforce becomes.

games.name: Sealed Fortress
games.summary:
Sealed Fortress is a dungeon-crawling RPG in which you take a party of 3 through the treacherous halls of a castle corrupted by wild magic.

Facing dangerous monsters, finding treasure and sharing soup together are all part of the adventure!

games.name: Colorfall
games.summary: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.name: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
games.summary: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!
aliases: 风纪委员会梦见魅魔吗？

games.name: The Hat Man
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary: Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. There’s so much to do with Elmo and your Sesame Steet friends. Enjoy exploring their world, growing beanstalks, cooking tasty food, and helping your new friends throw a big party for the neighborhood.

games.name: Magical Girl Yusya-chan and the Labyrinth of Lust
games.summary: Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike! Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen
games.summary: This is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma II and the Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion.

games.name: WildRoot
games.summary: Build a thriving colony in a mysterious forest where every season, setback, and choice creates a different story.

games.name: Doamari
games.summary: Doamari is a RPG game about strange places and strange things. Meet people, fight enemies, uncover secrets, and more. This is my diorama... I made it for you.

games.name: Horse Club Ride West
games.summary: Travel to the Wild River Ranch and experience exciting adventures.

games.name: Shelf-Employed
games.summary: Shelf-Employed is a first-person organization game set inside a chaotic magical warehouse. Sort thousands of packages, master useful spells, and upgrade your workflow as you turn towering piles of boxes into perfectly ordered shelves.

games.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
games.summary: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

games.name: Words of Power
games.summary: A galaxy enslaved by ancient words. Type fast, spell true, and fight back — every word is a weapon. Duel bosses, battle across a neon-vector galaxy, and prove you're eloquent enough to save the universe. Multiplayer coming soon!

games.name: Game Market Mayhem
games.summary: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

games.name: Mortality... Please
games.summary: Penelope falls for a nineteen-year-old who has not aged in over a century. His face survives in yearbooks, VHS tapes, and dead forum pages. Then an elderly woman arrives with a photograph of herself beside him. A short psychological horror VN about eternal youth and the people it leaves behind.

games.name: Podstakannik Rails
games.summary:
Podstakannik Rails is a first-person social co-op game set aboard an overnight sleeper train. One to four players board the same car, take their berths, and spend the trip together. There are no quests, scores, or progression systems: the host sets the trip to 10, 15, or 20 minutes, the train pulls into the station when time runs out, and nothing carries over to the next trip.

Players talk over proximity voice chat, so voices are clear inside a compartment and fade down the corridor. Around the car, they can fill a glass of tea at the samovar and carry it in a metal glass holder called a podstakannik, tune the radio by hand through the static, make up a berth and lie down for a nap, and work the reading lamps, ceiling lights, and compartment doors. Non-player characters include the sleeping car attendant, a police officer, and passengers who tell stories to anyone who sits down to listen, while the countryside passes outside the window by day or by night.

games.name: Touhou Garden of the Yukkuri
games.summary: Raise your very own Yukkuri in this free-to-play Yukkuri raising simulator, featuring 3D environments and multiplayer. Take it easy!!!

games.name: Overdue
games.summary: OVERDUE is a co-op multiplayer horror game for up to 6 players set in a massive shifting industrial warehouse where survival is based on productivity. Navigate through an anomalous industrial maze, manage your orders, and fulfill your mandate in time.

games.name: Hazmat Simulator
games.summary: A chaotic cleaning simulator and exploration game. Explore strange and mysterious environments, clean up massive messes, uncover hidden objects, complete each level. You never know what you’ll find along the way—so keep your eyes open and hope for the best.

games.name: Dreamer's Wake
games.summary: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa, a Japanese clay figure, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

games.name: Rhythm Roll
games.summary: Roll into a universe of rhythm and light! Feel the beat, master the high-speed motion, and test your reflexes.

games.name: My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
aliases: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
games.summary: My Cat Scattered Games is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Put 5,798 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

games.name: Cybernetic Strategy
games.summary: Cybernetic Strategy is a flamboyant sci-fi auto-battler with an emphasis on being easier to play, powerful unit fantasies, and social competition!

games.name: Conquisterra Roguelie
games.summary: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

games.name: Whisker Mess
games.summary:
Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!

games.name: Tiny Techie in Puzzle Land
games.summary:
Help the crafty pink-haired gearhead complete a series of intricate puzzles in a beautiful pixel art world! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems!

Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard. Can you help the tiny techie beat puzzle land?

games.name: Cozy Meowmory
games.summary:
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

games.name: Dungeon Quest
games.summary: Dungeon Quest is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on exploration, precision, combat, and challenging dungeon environments. Players take full control of the character as they run, jump, dash, overcome deadly traps, defeat enemies, and interact with different mechanisms to progress through each stage. Across 40 handcrafted levels, new mechanics and increasingly challenging situations are gradually introduced, keeping the experience varied while rewarding players who master movement, combat, and the game's different environmental challenges.

games.name: Rootabasis
games.summary: Play as Jimmy, a little seed who ended up in a peculiar cave. You'll need to help him find his way out, and escape the creatures (and people?) lurking around... But will you go through the correct path?

games.name: Eyes Behind 2
games.summary: Eyes Behind 2 is the sequel to Eyes Behind, a retro-graphics FPS survival horror game inspired by cult horror classics. The killer has been caught and is behind bars. The file is closed. So why are you still finding notes on your car?

games.name: Obsessed
games.summary: OBSESSED is not a classic horror game focused on jump scares, but a psychological thriller-drama where Halloween night takes a terrifying turn. The mysterious One Wish Walnut can grant any wish... as long as you're willing to live with the consequences.

games.name: Webs of Reverie
games.summary: Webs of Reverie is a first-person Survival horror game where you must explore the halls of Ironveil Psychiatric Hospital, solving puzzles, avoid detection from the staff, and managing your sanity levels. Will you decipher the clues and safely escape or fall victim to what hides in the shadows?

games.name: Polda 5.5
games.summary: Polda 5.5 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game featuring full Czech voice acting, stylized environments, and classic inventory-based puzzle solving. Players control three distinct characters across dozens of locations to uncover what happened during Pankrác's time as a pharaoh.

games.name: Final Selection
games.summary: Fast-paced action adventure with brutal close combat. Lose limbs, learn the dungeon, and survive a seven-day trial beneath a ruined castle.

games.name: SpringRO
games.summary: SpringRO is a custom server/modification for Ragnarok Online that gives an experience similar to early versions of the game while providing quality of life tweaks and balance changes.

games.name: Light Work
games.summary: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.

games.name: Another Tavern Simulator
games.summary: Open your own tavern in a fantasy valley. Mix unusual cocktails, cook hearty meals, furnish the hall and hire a helping hand. Restore the old inn and rent out rooms to travelers. Get to know your neighbors and join their little adventures. Just remember who that drink was for.

games.name: Soredemo Ore ha Binyuu ga Suki: Kyonyuu Osananajimi no Kyousei Approach
ClaimLand
games.summary:
ClaimLand is a location-based multiplayer game played on a real-world map. The Earth's land surface is divided into a grid of plots of roughly 25 × 30 meters, and players can only visit and buy the plots near their actual GPS position. Owned plots earn in-game gold every minute, and other players can buy them away at a price that rises with every sale.

Players level up from 1 to 40 to extend their reach, build on their land in five stages from a tent to a castle, and compete on worldwide and per-country leaderboards. All currency is earned by playing; there are no real-money purchases and no payouts.

games.name: Rotor City
games.summary: Rotor City is a single-player helicopter game with a mission-based career. Starting with a bubble-canopy trainer and a timber hangar, the player builds up a helicopter operator with 14 fictional helicopters across five living cities: a seaside town, a river-mouth port, a mountain valley with a ski resort, a tropical island chain and a skyscraper metropolis. Jobs include firefighting with an underslung bucket, air ambulance flights, hoist rescues, police pursuits, air taxi and tour flights, offshore crew changes, heli-skiing and cargo sling loads. Every flight starts with a cold engine, fuel can only be refilled at headquarters, and earnings pay for new helicopters, hangars and heavier landing pads. It has day and night, weather, and keyboard or controller support.

games.name: Pigeons Away
games.summary: Pigeons Away is a logic puzzle game set on city rooftops. Each pigeon can only fly in the direction it faces: tap one with a clear path and it flies away, tap a blocked one and it bumps into its neighbour, which costs a feather. Find the right order to clear the roof across 120 levels in six districts, from a sunny park to the harbour at night. Every ten levels a new kind of bird or rooftop surprise arrives: sleepy pigeons, big pigeons, weathervanes, crumbs, gulls, tied pairs, gusts, twin lofts, the cat and night lamps. Optional challenges earn medals, and a new daily puzzle works fully offline.

games.name: Buitopia DVD
games.summary: A short interactive DVD game. Today is Jess's Birthday! Can you find her a suitable gift? Just don't get distracted and forget about Jess. DVDs can't be cursed... right? Yeah it's fine.

games.name: TardiGeddon
games.summary: TardiGeddon is a free turn-based artillery game starring tardigrades, the toughest animals on Earth. Teams take turns to walk, aim and fire across destructible maps, allowing for the wind, with 29 weapons from the Spore Bazooka to the Concrete Tun. Every match is a new map in one of 7 styles, from floating Sky Realms to tunnel-riddled Caverns. Play against the computer at four difficulty levels, with up to 10 teams on one device, or online with friends, plus a new daily challenge with leaderboards. It plays in any modern browser on computers, phones and tablets, with no download, no ads, and nothing to buy that helps you win.

games.name: Dice Keeper
games.summary: Play chill or try to beat the world record in this dice-based Puzzle Game, Dice Keeper the very first game of Zanarka Studios.

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is a psychedelic action-platformer where every attack is set to a grungy midwest emo soundtrack. Soar across the crumbling Psyche, recruit bizarre party members, and tear a path towards your withering Heart.

games.name: Make the Empire Great Again
games.summary: A simulation + turn-based auto-battle game. The "Dusk Apocalypse" nears; the empire teeters! Your people need food, work, maybe some thrilling fun. But monsters seize Your lands, plunder Your fields & mines! Fight, reclaim lost! Build, forge grandest! Fear not the "Dusk", for a new "Sun" has risen!

games.name: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics VR
games.summary: A first-person virtual reality puzzle game. Immerse yourself in a high-tech sci-fi world where everything is built on logic and interaction with the environment. Solve puzzles, control lasers, and find your way through mysterious high-tech laboratories.

games.name: Danganronpa: Dungeons & Despair
games.summary: Danganronpa Fangame which takes place in the Dungeons&Dragons Universe. This isn’t your average DND Campaign

games.name: Lord Liberty Quest II: Pure White
aliases: ロードリバティクエスト2 ~純白~
神官木叶之自由征程2 ~纯白~
games.summary: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

games.name: Textorio
games.summary: Textorio is a factory automation game made entirely of text characters. You crash on the dead planet Kepler-442b with a wrist terminal and 50,000 colonists asleep in cryo below you, and the reactor keeping them alive is off. So you mine, smelt, automate, and dig down through four stacked worlds toward the core. The systems are real: electricity flows along grids that brown out, fluids have pressure, steam condenses back into water, and there is a pneumatic logic language you can build computers out of. It runs on almost anything. Free demo on Steam.

games.name: No Stars Football
games.summary: A retro pixel-art soccer game with old-school arcade action on the pitch and a deep management sim underneath - play or simulate every match, build a squad, and take a club from the lower divisions to the title over a full multi-season career.

games.name: Sort Labs
games.summary: Sort Labs is a casual, first-person organization simulator with a laboratory experiment theme, daily puzzles and leaderboards, dynamic levels, and all the shape-sorting you could ask for.

games.name: Rage Mountain Rally
games.summary: Rocket League and Happy Wheels had a baby, and someone gave it a mountain to climb! Drive, crash, bounce and rage your way to the summit while trying to keep your oversized balls under control.

games.name: Rusty Prison: Horror
games.summary: You probably shouldn't be here.

games.name: Evenin' Shift
games.summary: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.

games.name: Bar Keeper
games.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 3,235 scattered bottles, glasses, casks and more throughout a three-storey bar. Match every item to its proper place, combine half bottles, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

games.name: Kyro
games.summary: Kyro is a top-down pixel art action-adventure game inspired by classics like The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, Shadow of the Colossus, and the Souls series. The player controls Aiden in Ka'a, an Amazonian sci-fi setting, with the core objective of exploring, growing stronger, and defeating a series of challenging bosses, subtly unraveling the world's mysteries through environmental storytelling.

games.name: God of War III Remastered for PC
games.summary: A native port of God of War III: Remastered (PlayStation 4) for Windows 10 and 11.

games.name: Virtua Fighter Recomp
games.summary: Virtua Fighter Recomp is a fan-made project that rebuilds the 1993 arcade fighting game for native execution on modern hardware. It translates the arcade code into native code and recreates the surrounding Sega Model 1 board. No ROMs or game files are included.

games.name: Music Band Simulator: Together
games.summary: Form a band with friends and play any song freely on realistic instruments! Gain fame, grow your fanbase, and rise from garage jams to massive stadium shows.

games.name: Nova Warp
games.summary: Nova Warp is a free multiplayer game with three player factions. Team up against the creatures of deep space, collect resources, master co-op dungeons, level your ship and equip your individual loadout. Dive into massive faction battles and conquer the stars, pilot!

games.name: The Human Bench
games.summary: Three thousand words, one ending. Made for EctoComp 2026's La Petite Mort with contributions and revisions by Lacunova.

games.name: Recharged
games.summary: A native PC port built from the source code of Mario Strikers Charged for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Steam Deck.

games.name: Legends of the Pitch
games.summary: Football meets roguelike deckbuilding. Choose your nation, build your team, and combine cards in tactical battles. Upgrade your deck, explore branching paths, and defeat legendary bosses across five regions on your journey to football glory.

games.name: Guess the Ace Attorney OST
games.summary: An Ace Attorney OST guessing game with more than 350+ tracks, a daily case and a Court Record that fills as you play.

games.name: Apex Swoop: Card Game - Space Aliens Pack
games.summary: Beam your matches into deep space with the Swoop: Space Aliens Pack! Features cybernetic extraterrestrial card royals, the glowing Cosmic Nebula card back, galaxy felt table, and an out-of-this-world Alien Abduction Beam victory celebration effect.

games.name: Within
games.summary: Explore a broken world and gain the power to fix it, dealing with demonic adversaries along the way.

games.name: Splinter Cell: Double Agent - Recompiled
games.summary: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Splinter Cell: Double Agent via static recompilation.

games.name: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner
games.summary: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner is a football club management simulation in which the player is the owner of a club rather than its coach. The player runs the club's money, squad, transfers and contracts, the stadium and facilities, and business ventures in the club's town, answers the press and manages supporter expectations. The club world is shown in 3D, with an office, dressing room, press room and stadium, and matches are presented as staged 3D broadcasts with highlights and replays. The game was released as an early beta for Windows on itch.io.

games.name: BoomGround
games.summary: BoomGround is a solo/multiplayer voxel destruction game.

games.name: Vikings: Sex and Blood - Chapter 2
games.summary: Vikings: Sex and Blood - Chapter 2 is a standalone adult RPG and the second chapter of Vikings: Sex and Blood. The player is now Jarl of Krokr, leads turn-based raids with a warband, grows Renown, holds a feast in the Longhouse and wins over the fully voiced women of Krokr. The game contains explicit sexual content.

games.name: ReBirth: Rebuild & Resist
games.summary:
A province lies in ruins. An earthquake, a flood or years of drought have torn it apart, and an insurgency called the Shadow Front is filling the vacuum. You are the coordinator of an international stabilization mission. Rebuild the province, earn the people's trust, command your forces and end the war, ideally at the negotiating table rather than on the battlefield.

ReBirth is a 3D military strategy and management game about nation building and counter-insurgency. every road you repair, every clinic you open and every unit you deploy changes the stability, support and security of 14 districts.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: You're stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings to escape the shadows of your past.

games.name: Ghost Hunter
games.summary: Ghost Hunter is an online collaborative psychological horror game that can be played by at least one and up to five players together. Unlike other ghost hunting games, it incorporates rich Taoist elements and experiences traditional Chinese supernatural culture.

games.name: 9 Kings
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

games.name: Ghost Villa
games.summary: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary: It's time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

games.name: Burn With Me
games.summary: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.name: Life of a Thug
games.summary: This game throws you into the shoes of a character struggling to survive in a corrupt ghetto overrun by gangs, mafia bosses, and crooked politicians. This is no ordinary RPG; Life of a Thug is designed for players who dare to delve into the heart of darkness and pay the price of their choices.

games.name: Moonfrost
games.summary: Moonfrost is an isometric, next-gen pixel art, lo-fi multiplayer life-sim set in a fantasy version of the modern day that offers a premium experience but as a free-to-play game.

games.name: Meow Garden
games.summary: Welcome to Cat Island, a cozy farming sim where cats sprout from the soil! Plant seeds, care for your cats, and discover over 40 breeds. Decorate your home, train your cats, fulfill orders, and grow your own cat estate.

games.name: Hyperfight 2
games.summary: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. This is the next evolution of HYPERFIGHT!

games.name: Ward Off Evil
games.summary: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

games.name: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror
games.summary: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is an open world, survival horror experience where you play as a caregiver for the elderly. Navigate the dark streets of Tokyo, choosing where to go and whom to care for. Not everyone can be saved. How many deaths will be on your watch this week?

games.name: Hubert
games.summary: Hubert je mužské jméno germánského původu. Je odvozeno ze jména Hugberaht s významem „duchaplný člověk, skvělé mysli“ (hugu – mysl, bert – jasný). Další podobou je Hugbert i Hugo. V českém občanském kalendáři má svátek 3. listopadu.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Julio's Adventure 3
games.summary: Survive in Tamixa School in this horror adventure. Explore the school without attracting the attention of the mysterious creatures until they leave the area. Use the school cameras, your flaslight and your stealth skills to avoid getting caught before it's too late...

games.name: Spoofs Playland
games.summary: Play, paint, fish, collect and decorate! Spoofs Playland is a relaxing, family-friendly collection of point-and-click minigames where you collect decorations and bond with the adorable Spoofs. Earn rewards, complete quests, buy new backgrounds and hundreds of items, and make your ideal room!

games.name: The Doll Shop
games.summary: The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?

games.name: Battleplan
games.summary:
Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation.
Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data.
Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command.
Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

games.name: Barfender
games.summary: Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar management game where you build your dream bar, serve wild customers, and desperately try to survive the nightly madness. Craft drinks, clean messes, stop bar fights, and keep your crew sanity intact. Do you have what it takes to run the messiest bar in town?

games.name: Bandit Simulator TD
games.summary: This is a Tower Defense + Base Building game where you establish a bandit stronghold from scratch. With Tower defense at its core, you can ambush travelers, develop characters through profession and equipment systems, and expand your stronghold by researching, forging, and constructing!

games.name: Spy Drops Gaiden
games.summary: Infiltrate enemy bases and undertake a series of covert ops in thrilling, old school 2D stealth action.

games.name: Daily Burden
games.summary: Daily Burden is a chest-opening roguelike parodying mobile games. Experience short runs where you’ll learn to crave ads, build your way out with over 100 items and to keep up with key inflation… but beware of (FAKE) microtransactions !

games.name: Pursuit of Mercantile Power
games.summary: Pursuit of Mercantile Power is a single-player economic sim with light RPG. No money spawns—money only moves. Control the village’s cash flow, use proposals and loans, buy shares, and take over enterprises to seize GuYuan’s commercial order.

games.name: Haunted Heist
games.summary: Haunted Heist is a 3-8 player round-based PvP horror party game where Heisters find and retrieve gems in a procedurally generated mansion, while Tricksters use chaotic abilities to distress, disrupt, and dispose of them to protect their home.

games.name: Vicarius
games.summary: A small handcrafted open world focused on exploration and combat. Leave your safe zone to gather the resources that will help you craft better gear. The further you go, the more dangerous it gets but the resources are also better. Dying means losing everything that you are carrying.

games.name: Desire's Burgers
games.summary: It’s your first real job—and you get to keep all the profits! But your boss? She’s a seductive succubus who drains your energy at night. Run a cozy burger joint by day, survive her temptations by night, and shape your fate in this rhythm-infused visual novel.

games.name: American Cooking Simulator: Multiplayer
games.summary: Team up in chaotic co-op shifts at Joe’s Freedom Burgers! Cook with guns, serve hungry customers, and travel across a totally normal, definitely accurate version of America in the most patriotic cooking sim of all time.

games.name: The Traveller's Sight
games.summary: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

games.name: Contract Cooks
games.summary: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a bubble tea kiosk. Tomorrow, an economy flight galley. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

games.name: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
games.summary: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

games.name: Last Round at the End of the World
games.summary: Dream the riddle. Question the village. Choose who drowns. A poetic folk-horror game about divine messages, guilty villagers, ritual games, and the terrible cost of keeping a place safe.

games.name: Monkey Bizniz
games.summary: An online co-op physics game about collecting bananas for the Monkey King's feast — fill your cart, find the summit, and try not to blame your friends when it all goes wrong.

games.name: Dinerz
games.summary:
Dinerz is a diner simulation game, where you manage you own diner.
Cook meals, server customers, clean tables, wash dishes and hire staff, you can play alone or with your friends.

games.name: Demersus
games.summary:
Demersus is a first-person walking sim and psychological thriller experience that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction and how that influences the people around you, through environmental storytelling and immersive atmosphere. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape.

Created for the ZTGK game dev contest by a two-person indie team.

games.name: The Last Flight
games.summary: Rebuild a forgotten airplane, manage your survival, and soar across a hauntingly beautiful world. Balance your stats, scavenge for parts, and chart your course through a post-apocalyptic sky. Every flight is a step closer to freedom... If your past doesn’t catch up first. Prepare for takeoff!

games.name: Ghostpunk
games.summary: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

games.name: Voidtrain: Big Catch
games.summary:
Who said you need water to go fishing? The Void has plenty of wildlife of its own—all that's left is to grab your gear, try your luck, and see what you can catch.

Catch different species of fish and earn Scales with every one you reel in. Upgrade your rod and reel, and use familiar resources as bait.

games.name: Not An NPC Game
games.summary:
Not an NPC Game is a 2D arena game where you never attack your opponent directly. Use walls, speed, and the arena itself to manipulate monsters, trap your rival, and make the monsters attack for you.

Every match is about strategy, prediction, and skill. The monsters don’t take sides — the better player knows how to use them.

games.name: We Are Cooking
games.summary: Grab your apron and enjoy chaotic cooking action with your friends or solo! Prepare dishes before time runs out and prove yourself a worthy chef.

games.name: Mushroom Marketplace
games.summary: Run a whimsical mushroom café by day and explore a quiet village by night in this cozy tea-brewing roguelike!

games.name: Smoke.exe
games.summary: One cigarette is all the time you get to break in. Lay out nodes, wire them into an auto-hacking routine, then light it and let it run. A cyber-noir roguelite about how deep you can get before the smoke runs out.

games.name: Keepshore: Hearth Seal
games.summary: A ceremonial hearth at the heart of every town you build. Host a Hearth Festival and the fire roars three times as long. The town gathers there. Beauty first — duration only, never a standing production bonus.

games.name: I Was Reincarnated as a Bosozoku Hamster, so I Became a Racing Champion to Return Home
games.summary: A bicycle hits you, you die, and you wake up as a hamster in another world. There is only one way home: down the pass at night, five exhaust pipes over your roof and a rival on your bumper. A touge racing RPG with the full bosozoku kit welded on.

games.name: Road to Verdant
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a massive magical world where you will start as a humble archer and grow to become a legend. An auto-runner with RPG elements where you can craft your equipment, upgrade your character, trade items, and complete quests... some of them very well hidden!

games.name: Space Manager
games.summary: Take on realistic space missions, manage your economy, and explore the solar system. Build and expand your space center on Earth, accept contracts, and launch satellites into orbit. Research, adapt and collect valuable scientific data to commence your growing aerospace empire.

games.name: Refund This Game
games.summary: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and earn that refund?!

games.name: No More Pain
games.summary: No More Pain is a first-person psychological horror adventure game. Stepping into the shoes of different characters, you will examine personal belongings, gather photos, and inspect clues within mysterious environments to unravel the truth buried beneath past memories.

games.name: OpenCMR2
games.summary: OpenCMR2 is a work-in-progress native port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (PC, 2000) to modern platforms.

games.name: Scary Baboon: Spooky Baboon
games.summary:
Scary Baboon received its Halloween-themed “Spooky Baboon” update on October 9, 2026.

The seasonal update introduces a Halloween makeover across the game, alongside themed enemies and activities. New additions include Pumpkin Meatman, a Halloween variant of the existing Meatman boss, and the Mimic Monster.

The update also adds a limited-time Trick or Treat event. During the event, players have eight minutes to collect 50 pieces of candy while exploring the game.

Spooky Baboon is available as a seasonal update for Scary Baboon on Meta Quest.

games.name: Embers of War
games.summary: The Tang has fallen. The realm has no master. Fifteen years. Five dynasties. Emperors come and go like post-horses. Grain costs more than a man, a life is worth less than grass, and there are bones along every road. In an age like this one trade always pays — selling your life by the day, following the coin and not the flag. They call it soldiering for hire. That is the company you command.

games.name: Miecze Valdgira I+II
games.summary: Swords of Valdgir is without a doubt a true legend of the Polish retro gaming scene, having achieved cult status on 8-bit Atari computers. Both parts take players on an unforgettable journey into a dark world of sword and sorcery, where finding the titular weapon grants unimaginable power. The mechanics masterfully combine arcade elements with demanding puzzles, guaranteeing high-energy fun.

games.name: Tekken 6 Native Online
games.summary: Tekken 6 for Xbox 360 running natively on Windows with rollback netcode (GGPO principle) and an online lobby in the launcher.

games.name: Kirr
games.summary: Cooperative horror where surviving isn't enough: you must locate and destroy the thinking brains behind a collective hive mind before it finishes calculating your end. Stay alert, trust no one — not even the voices in the dark. Coordinate, move fast: hesitation is what it's counting on.

games.name: Project RE: Visited - Resident Evil 3
games.summary: A native PC port & clean-room static recompilation of Resident Evil 3: Nemesis (1999, PlayStation 1) for Windows.

games.name: Half Haunted
games.summary: Half Haunted is a puzzle game with roguelike elements in which the player cuts haunted objects into two halves of equal weight to free the ghosts trapped inside. Objects hide heavy parts such as pits, cores and lumps of iron, so the player turns each one before drawing a cut. The game spans 19 rooms across four floors of the Halverson family manor, each floor ending in a boss object, plus 12 more rooms in a second house, Kringle Keep. Relics, Seance cards and coin bets change each run.

games.name: Evergallery: Jigsaw Museum
games.summary: Evergallery: Jigsaw Museum is a jigsaw puzzle game set in a museum whose paintings have fallen to pieces. The player restores public-domain artworks from collections including the Cleveland Museum of Art, the Art Institute of Chicago and The Met, at sizes from 16 to 100 pieces, with no timers. Each restored painting adds a short note about the work, and restoring three works by one of sixteen artists brings that artist back to walk the museum.

games.name: Next time... I'll work from home
games.summary: Eric Stokes, a 27-year-old office clerk, finally found a new job after a long unemployment. As a new father, he eagerly starts his new job, but quickly finds that something about this office is off.

games.name: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout
games.summary: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you build a squad of machines, upgrade your loadout, and fight through dangerous missions using cards, factions, and powerful combat abilities.

games.name: Swords of Valdgir
games.summary: A classic action-adventure game for Atari in which the player journeys through a fantasy world, battling enemies to find the titular swords. Simple design, retro atmosphere, and challenging gameplay create an adventure tailored for fans of classic gaming.

games.name: Swords of Valdgir II
games.summary: Swords of Valdgir II is an action-adventure game. This time king Aldir must defeat Bloody Zenon, that uses Cyclops eye to terrorize the surrounding area.

games.name: Beset
games.summary: Beset is a top-down arena brawler. Build a 4-slot loadout from 75 abilities, read your opponents, and wipe them out — across five modes, twelve battlefields, and an opt-in ranked ladder. Online with up to 20 players. No bots. Free to play. No pay to win.

games.name: Iverian Wars: Craxion vs Defugel
