games.summary: Iverian Wars: Craxion vs Defugel is a faction-based strategic action MMORPG set in the world of Iveria. Engage in large-scale battles, customize your gear freely, and shape the fate of the continent through war and strategy.

games.name: Evard the Hermit: Through Fears
games.summary: Evard's gift and a curse — the ability to absorb other people's fears and phobias. Immerse yourself into Evard's story and discover the secret of his origins. Explore his medieval Metroidvania world, look for the sources of fears and overcome them.

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.summary: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

games.name: Legion Was Here
games.summary: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

games.name: Feudal Craft
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an exciting medieval settlement simulator where you will have to fight for your place in the feudal hierarchy. Use a smart strategy to develop your settlement. After all, it is the skills and equipment of each peasant that can make the difference.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Pixel Survivors: Defense
games.summary: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel roguelike defense game where you fight off endless waves of monsters. Collect skills, upgrade your heroes, combine items, and survive as long as you can!

games.name: Rolla
games.summary: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

games.name: Roguefort
games.summary: A deeply simulated turn-based open-world roguelike on a vast magical continent. Explore, dungeon crawl, sail, steal, fish, build, spellcraft, become a vampire, and live out your wildest dreams.

games.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel to Me
games.summary: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures, and uncover the subtle threads of melancholy from which this place was born.

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.summary: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

games.name: Poly Fighter
games.summary: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title!

games.name: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
games.summary: Dive into Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn! Rebuild an Atlantean capital amid coral and ancient magic. Manage resources, explore the abyss, and revive a sunken kingdom in this unique marine city builder. The legend awaits you beneath the waves.

games.name: Double Dealers
games.summary: A 3–6 player auction game built around bluffing, deception, and manipulation, where you must outsmart your opponents in tense bidding wars, hide the truth, and turn risky trades into profit. Every round is a battle of mind games where trust is fragile and strategy decides the winner.

games.name: Office Manager
games.summary: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

games.name: Legion Breaker
games.summary: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Arjun
games.summary: Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques!

games.name: Bio-Submariner DX
games.summary: You're the captain of a Bio-Submarine! A living submarine that gains power from flesh! Cruise through the Deep Sea and devour your enemies!

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: National Championship Air Races
Murder Castle
games.summary: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

games.name: Trash Day
games.summary: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Arjun & Outfit 2
Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary: Just Dance: Decades of Hits je hra z kategorie Hudební videohra od studia Ubisoft Paris pro PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch. Termín vydání: 13. 10. 2026.

games.name: Maneki Mania
games.summary: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

games.name: Attic Antiquities
games.summary: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

games.name: Witch Cabin Cleanup
games.summary: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Dub Night Live
games.summary: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.

games.name: Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition
games.summary: Experience the updated, enhanced, and complete version of the grand strategy classic; Total War: Shogun 2 and all of its DLC, including the Rise of the Samurai and Fall of the Samurai campaigns. Battle across an exquisite, authentic realisation of Feudal Japan stretching from 1175 to 1876, combined with Total War’s seamless blend of turn-based empire building and massive real-time tactical battles.

games.name: Handle with Care!
games.summary: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

games.name: Roll Pick Go!
games.summary: Build a team of pixel monsters in a free-to-play strategy auto battler. Buy, merge, and equip your squad, discover powerful combinations, and turn battles around with unique abilities and ultimates. Can your team reach 10 wins?

games.name: Triogram
games.summary:
Triogram is a cosy puzzle game where three flat Nonogram grids come together to reveal a 3D object. Use the number clues to work out its front, top and side silhouettes and watch the model take shape.

There are 480 puzzles across four worlds, arranged into 40 collections of 12. Start with small, straightforward objects and work your way towards intricate sculptures.

Three views, one object. Solve the front, top and side grids for each puzzle, meaning 1440 grids in total!

Watch it take shape. The 3D preview changes as you fill the grids.

games.name: Leg It: Don't Stop
games.summary: Leg It: Don't Stop is a fast-paced melee survival arena game in which the player fights continuous waves of enemies and elemental bosses. Across 32 arenas, players can choose from 35 character sets and mix and match arenas and characters, while pursuing higher scores, facing increasingly difficult bosses, and unlocking additional content.

games.name: The Conjuring: Unspoken
games.summary:
The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new Netflix game, is coming October 13.

Set in a decaying English pub where a family is haunted by an ancient evil, use your phone as a paranormal investigation tool and make life-or-death choices that shape your story.

Developed by Supermassive Games.

games.name: PigPonyPocalypse
games.summary: PigPonyPocalypse is a twin-stick shooter built entirely around boss fights. The game consists of four bosses with no levels in between, and each boss has its own mechanics: a fight in darkness, a collapsing bridge chased by a wall of fire, floor tiles that explode in a sequence the player has to memorize, and a final boss with four phases. Every boss can be fought on two difficulties, Forgiving and True Challenge, the latter adding new phases and mechanics. Victories post the player's damage per second to per-boss Steam leaderboards, and achievements unlock color variants for the heroine.

games.name: Smiley Arena
games.summary:
Smiley Arena is a single-player game that combines tower defense with
direct, action-based combat. The player controls a smiley character on the
battlefield, moving with WASD and aiming with the mouse, while placing and
upgrading turrets across five lanes to stop incoming waves of enemies.

Six classes are available, each with its own ability: Fire (burn damage),
Ice (slowing and freezing), Shadow (invisibility and critical hits), Medic
(regeneration and healing), Bomb (splash damage) and Speed (a high-speed
dash). Defeated enemies yield currency, which is spent on building turrets
and upgrading them through several tiers. Level-up choices are made while
the game continues to run, without pausing. Boss enemies appear at regular
intervals between the standard waves.

The full version features endless waves, all six classes, the complete
upgrade tree and an achievement system. A free browser-based demo covering
the first nine waves and the first boss encounter is also available. The
game supports English and German.

games.name: Whispers Of The Lost Ticket
games.summary: Whispers of the Lost Ticket is an exploration horror game centered around uncovering the events surrounding Guilded Hollow Carnival through story and event interactions while shadowy forces try to stop you. Uncover the secrets of those who came before you, as the carnival welcomes its final visitor.

games.name: Heartfall: A Tale in Three Lives
aliases: Heartfall — A Tale in Three Lives
games.summary: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!

games.name: New Worlds
games.summary:
New Worlds is a space-faring universe simulation game where you navigate gravity to explore, complete missions, trade, upgrade and improve your ship fleet. Adventure to uncharted planets, to settle and develop the “New Worlds” of the last great frontier!

Features a 2D space simulation built on multi-body Newtonian gravity. The player starts with a single ship in the Solus system and flies by planning burns and adjusting their trajectory: moons can capture a ship, gas giants can slingshot one, and an efficient orbit can reach a target with a fraction of the fuel a direct burn needs.

Stations and worlds are markets in a simulated economy, where rival powers expand whether or not the player takes part. The player hauls cargo and passengers, trades between markets, takes on missions and builds a fleet of scouts, freighters, starliners, carriers, colony ships and drones. Earnings pay for ship upgrades, stations, settlements and infrastructure. The player can join a faction or found their own and compete for territory through politics and diplomacy. Settlements grow from outposts into cities, and hostile worlds can be terraformed until they are habitable.

The game spans three star systems with 38 worlds. It supports co-op multiplayer for up to four players, has an original 19-track soundtrack and plays in the browser as well as on Windows, Linux and Android.

games.name: Dozens
games.summary: Dozens is a number puzzle with no clock. Each turn the player gets a tile from 1 to 11 and places it on a free cell of an 8×8 board, where it joins the neighboring tiles into a block. A block that adds up to exactly 12 clears and scores; one that would go past 12 is not allowed. Levels have no end, walls appear from level 3, and the player has three wildcards per run. Single player, offline, free, no in-app purchases.

games.name: Meaningless
games.summary: Meaningless is a narrative-driven 2D adventure focused entirely on its characters and their inner worlds. Follow the footsteps of Violet and Jack, explore the details of a seemingly ordinary world, and find your own meaning along the journey.

games.name: Invincible Vs.: Like Father, Like Son - Skin Bundle
games.summary: Before the battles, before the betrayals, before the fate of worlds rested on their shoulders... there was a dad cheering on his son, and a kid who couldn't wait to become a hero. Some memories are worth holding onto.

games.name: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom Levy - Additional Fighter
games.summary: From a thousand worlds comes Angstrom Levy, the genius transformed by tragedy and obesssion. Once driven by a desire to unite infinite versions of himself, Angstrom now carries the memories of countless realities. This brilliant and dangerous dimensional traveler can tear open portals to teleport, control space, and always keeps his opponents guessing.

games.name: Invincible Vs.: Atom Eve - Everyday Eve Skin
games.summary: No super suit. No dramatic entrance. Just a comfy outfit, a day off, and absolutely no intention of fighting off multiverse versions of the world's greatest superheroes... unless it becomes really, really necessary. Turns out matter manipulation powers don't come with a dress code.

games.name: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom - Multitudes Skin
games.summary: I am Angstrom Levy and Invincible made me into a monster! I've walked through more realities than you could ever comprehend. Worlds where empires rose, worlds where they fell, worlds where your greatest heroes never existed... and worlds where they became monsters. Every step taught me something. Every dimension made me stronger. This? It's simply the attire befitting a man who has seen them all.

games.name: RyGT
games.summary: Gran Turismo Sport running as a native Windows program.

games.name: Nebula
games.summary: Nebula runs Super Mario Galaxy natively on Windows.

games.name: Hegemarch
games.summary:
Hegemarch is a real-time space strategy roguelite played in the web browser.

Players choose one of several dynasties, colonize planets, manage an economy and command fleets against AI-controlled rival dynasties to take control of a star sector. Each run takes place in a newly generated sector, and a daily run gives all players the same seeded sector. All graphics, sound and music are generated procedurally in code.

games.name: One Million Coins
games.summary: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

games.name: World Simulation: Drive & Fly
games.summary: Drive, fly and sail anywhere on Earth. Type any address and it's there: real roads, real buildings, real terrain. Race a Formula car through Paris, pick up taxi fares in New York or fly over Tokyo at sunset, with 45+ vehicles, live weather, live flights and 150+ hand-built landmarks. Free roam is free, with no ads. On iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

games.name: Not A Drone
games.summary: Not A Drone is an arcade flying game in which Gus, a pigeon disguised as a delivery drone, delivers packages through San Francisco, New York and Tokyo, built from real map data. The player taps to flap and steer, finds the way by street names and written directions, and avoids raising suspicion; a full suspicion meter sends a security drone in pursuit. Perks are chosen between deliveries, and coins buy 21 permanent upgrades.

games.name: Two Winds
games.summary: Two Winds is a gentle hot-air balloon puzzle made for the whole family. Your balloon rides two winds over the board, a warm wind down low and a cold wind up high, both drawn as air currents you can read at a glance. Move square to square towards the meadow, step into a current to be carried along and tap the balloon to climb into the cold wind or drop back to the warm one, while clouds drift, storms chase you after every move and lightning glows the turn before it strikes. 120 levels in six valleys, from First Flight to Fiesta, add more balloons, flocks of birds, eagles, cloud walls and storms, plus a daily flight. Undo is always free and every level plays offline.

games.name: Frog Garden
games.summary: Grow a garden with friends or strangers. Plant flowers, decorate your patch, collect hats, and occasionally swallow or cast spells on your gardening partners.

games.name: Motor City Turf Wars
games.summary: Motor City Turf Wars is a top-down crime sandbox set in Detroit, played in the browser. You start with nothing and build a street operation: grow and sell weed, text clients on a burner phone, run a stash house and put together a crew. Rival gangs hold the neighborhoods. You can take out their dealers, start turf wars and claim the hoods while keeping police heat down. You drive cars, fight with fists, bats and guns, and tag walls with spray paint.

games.name: Tidewild
games.summary: Tidewild is a mobile action RPG set on a wild island whose six element stones (fire, ice, lightning, wind, light and dark) have been stolen. The player starts as a castaway and grows stronger by clearing monster camps, which raises the hero's damage, health and speed. Each chapter ends in a boss fight, including the Lizard Warrior, the Ice Golem and the three Bone Dragon brothers, and wins back one of the elements. Element gems can be forged into swords, bows and wands, giving attacks an element, a passive effect and a special ability. The game has more than 200 items to collect in sets, a 40-stage Colosseum of monster waves, and PvP. It can be played in portrait with one thumb, with an optional auto mode.

games.name: Fire and Ashes
games.summary: You wake up in a terrifying psychiatric hospital. Fire and Ashes is an immersive horror game where madness and reality blur, and every monster hears your scream… even beyond the hospital walls.

games.name: Among the Trolls
games.summary: Among the Trolls is a first-person narrative-adventure game where the secret mysteries of Finnish forests are unraveled. Venture deep into the Finnish wilderness to uncover family truths and confront what lies beyond.

games.name: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
games.summary: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

games.name: Thanks, Light.
games.summary: 《THANKS, LIGHT.》 is a first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary: The Witch's Bakery is a 2D Adventure RPG where you live a magical life as a witch-baker in Paris! Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants! 🥐

games.name: Nowhere
games.summary:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

games.name: Nientum: Opus Zero
games.summary: Nientum - Opus Zero is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A fantastic journey of the director and singer, and the storytelling of music from the world. Run through the stage to complete their fate!

games.name: Slowburn
games.summary: Your kill count matters. Your life doesn't. Absorb, aim, kill. Hunt the "Gemstones" to find the truth about yourself in a post-apocalyptic city in this isometric action game.

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Block Trucks Multiplayer Racing
games.summary: SuperTrucks is a competitive, real time, ranked multiplayer racing game. Race against real opponents on challenging track surfaces, upgrade your truck and rank up as you win races.

games.name: Fire and Ashes
games.summary: It's 1977. Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital, haunted by the ghosts of his past. Fire and Ashes await: An immersive survival horror where nothing is certain, insanity and reality mix, and voice recognition means every monster will hear you scream - within the asylum and beyond…

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: No Such Place
games.summary: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

games.name: Astrolite
games.summary: Astrolite is an arcade-styled bullet heaven in a race against time. Conquer each planet before the forces of the galaxy overpower you. The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare a final stand against their greatest enemy... that enemy... is you.

games.name: Signal Lost
games.summary: A short horror game where you keep a spacecraft operational as it reaches Venus by completing tasks and repairs.

games.name: Cozy Builder
games.summary: Build, design, and decorate your dream château in a cozy vineyard valley. Live among your creations, harvest grapes from sunlit vineyards, and craft artisanal wine blends in a relaxing sandbox builder where every home helps restore beauty and balance to the countryside.

games.name: Eternally
games.summary: Build one of four Eternals from 260+ skills across 17 skill trees. One campaign earns about a third of an Eternal's skills, so every run is a new build. A dark fantasy tactical RPG with dice combat on a hex grid. Play alone, online with up to 3 friends, or with 1 friend on one PC.

games.name: Ferry Good Day
games.summary: Set sail and bring your passengers to their destination. In this relaxing boat simulation you explore different maps, plan your routes and ensure your reliable arrival at port. Utilize currents, locks and catch fish to experience the best possible journey with your ferry.

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.summary: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

games.name: Keysaster
games.summary: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

games.name: Cheap Screamer
games.summary: Try to survive the experiments being conducted on you while you attempt to uncover the truth about why you are there.

games.name: Annalog
games.summary: Annalog is a "Zachtroidvania" homebrew NES game, combining Zach-like programming puzzles with Metroidvania-style platforming, exploration, upgrades, and bosses.

games.name: Phobos
games.summary: Discover an expansive online multiplayer world of battle, stories, and intrigue. Wield great weapons or conjure terrifying magics. Explore the world, solve quests, and slay great beasts and players alike.

games.name: Thank You Bus Driver
games.summary: Thank You Bus Driver is a chaotic bus driving game where you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous!

games.name: Spooky Dwellers 5: Collector's Edition
games.summary: Dive into this spooky Match 3 puzzle adventure by conquering eerie levels, exploring hidden object scenes, and solving minigames to decorate your ultimate party parlor and banish the ancient shadows! Destroy the evil of Kthal-zghor!

games.name: Halley's Big Catch
games.summary: A cartoon cat who loves to fish. Come home to Hidden Pond, fight real fish, and follow a trail of relics to waters around the world. New shores, new tackle, and a story that unfolds one cast at a time.

games.name: Deunocta
games.summary: In a realm where witchcraft evolved along side technology, a lone marauder, Cassidy Chrome seeks vengeance against a tyrannical demi god who enslaves souls to conquer worlds and prolong his immortality. Cassidy, trained in the black arts fights against undead corrupted entities in a forsaken world.

games.name: Kyoufu Yawa: Dai-ni-ya
games.summary: On a rainy night, three ghost stories are told in an old-fashioned café. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. A psychological horror visual novel that slowly builds a sense of dread.

games.name: Parallel Park
games.summary:
Parallel Park is an action game about time travel and parking cars. Each time you successfully park, time rewinds and another car is added to the map. Fill the map with cars as you cleverly dodge all your past selves and unravel a story about a future that's in danger of never happening.

Competitive multiplayer allows you to out-park your friends - adding more and more cars to the map as you go.

A built in level editor allows you to make custom levels too, and play the creations of others.

games.name: Where It Happened
games.summary: You wake up to find yourself standing before an old house. The painful memories buried deep within your heart suddenly return. You don’t remember it well, but you used to live here. This is where it happened.

games.name: My Recycling Center 2
games.summary:
Keep recycling - new challenges, containers, improved models, garbage trucks, management and much more.

Design and expand your new recycling center in this first-person simulation game. Take care of unloading, sorting and compacting the waste.

The new level editor allows you to freely design the yard, place upgrades and set it up the way you like.

With increasing experience, multiple customers will show up simultaneously and might create a queue if unloading does not happen fast enough.

Completely new shaders for containers and vehicles bring realistic graphics and more possibilities. You can not only clean containers with the pressure washer but also restore worn paint jobs with the paint gun.

games.name: BitWise
games.summary: BitWise is a puzzle game about electricity. Players place parts on a board, wire them by hand, and a circuit simulator runs the result. It starts with a battery and a lamp and climbs through relays, logic gates, adders, latches and counters to a small stored-program machine. The grader checks what a circuit actually does, so a strange build that does the job passes. 238 levels across seven chapters end with the telegraph, with a Koch-method Morse trainer, a Sandbox, a level editor and Steam Workshop sharing.

games.name: Gallery Organizer
games.summary: Tidy up the gallery, sort and hang all the paintings where they belong. Choose a gallery size. Enjoy the satisfaction of turning a messy gallery into a perfectly organized collection. 1,000 artworks by real artists.

games.name: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily
games.summary: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a heartfelt spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and a lifetime shared together. Restore Riku’s fading memories across 21 illustrated chapters, solo or in local co-op.

games.name: Veilborn
games.summary:
Veilborn is a single-player 2D action roguelite set in a dark fantasy world.

Players explore hostile regions, battle dangerous creatures and powerful bosses, and develop their heroes across successive expeditions.

The game features multiple playable heroes, character progression, equipment preparation and a camp that serves as a base between expeditions.

Players can explore two distinct regions: the mysterious Lands of the Veil and the volcanic Crown of the Furnace, home to the Colossus of the Last Forge.

Death is part of the experience, with each fallen hero contributing to an ongoing legacy.

Veilborn was developed by BLACKSHADOW using the Godot engine and was released as a free-to-play PC game on October 14, 2026.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Stinger
games.summary:
"STINGER" is a shooter released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1983.
Take control of the "STINGER WOLF" and head to the center of an enemy base where evil life forms roam.
In an emergency, you can call on the friendly robot "BONGO" to automatically destroy the enemy.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Thundercade
games.summary:
"THUNDERCADE" is a shooting game released by SETA in 1987.
As a member of the special forces, use a high-speed motorcycle equipped with machine guns to reach the enemy stronghold.
Destroying structures such as buildings will reveal power-up items in the form of sidecars equipped with gun barrels. Sidecars come in various types some fire bullets further, while others can only shoot sideways so choose the right one for each situation!

games.name: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.6: Sanctuary of Ink
games.summary:
Version 1.6 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Si, Argent Flow
• New RE-Factor Headhunting: Tangtang
• New Areas: Si's Painting
• New Story Content: New story chapter and missions
• New Gameplay Modes: Contingency Contract, Arena of Games
• New Systems: Gear Plans, Auto-Farmer
• New Events and Rewards

games.name: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Expansion Pass
games.summary: Expand the saga with new stories, allies, and more! Discover additional stories, enlist gods to your side, and more in DLC for the Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game.

games.name: Lootkeeper: Tidy Up the Loot
games.summary: An adventurer has returned from his journey with 1834 items he'll never use. Now it's your job to sort his loot. Organize weapons, potions, relics, and all kinds of RPG junk, and use magic and upgrades to speed up the work. The loot chaos awaits!

games.name: Catnip Arcade
games.summary: Catnip Arcade is four small cat games for iPhone and iPad. In Herding Kittens you steer a litter of hungry kittens to the food bowl with a laser dot and catnip. Kitty Jump is a 3D box climber starring Space Cat. Balloon Pop calls a color and you pop it, and every color also has its own shape. Emergency Stress Relief! is the same balloons with the rules taken out. You can pet the cat, and the purrs are the developer's own two cats, Samantha and Sabrina. Free, no ads, no account.

games.name: Keyboard Chaos
games.summary: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

games.name: Grave Odds
aliases: Grave Odds: Six Feet of Loot
games.summary: Grave Odds is a roguelike in which the player digs graves in a haunted graveyard. Each headstone shows the chance of loot and the chance of waking what is buried, and clearing a grave raises the odds on its neighbours. The game has 78 items in five rarities, quick turn-based fights against undead enemies, crypt bosses, and a branching map for each run of about 5 to 10 minutes. Bone Dust earned in every run buys permanent upgrades and hires diggers.

games.name: Twin Drive
games.summary: Twin Drive is an online co-op racing game built around one gimmick: a single car split in half. One player drives the front, the other drives the rear. Stay in sync to steer straight, or fight each other into a screeching donut. Climb a giant stunt tower and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

games.name: Cyber Breaker ’95
games.summary: Relive classic brick-breaking arcade action in a neon 16-bit world. Control your paddle, keep the ball in play, and smash through colorful brick formations as you chase a high score. Collect power-ups to widen your paddle, fire lasers, split the ball, unleash a fireball, or activate an energy shield. Each stage features new brick patterns, retro-inspired visuals, and synthesized arcade sounds. Play with a keyboard or mouse.

games.name: Desolus
games.summary: Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

games.name: CyberPunk Sex Tower
games.summary: The world of the future, modern technologies make it possible to create a super realistic sexual experience ...

games.name: Alveron: Withering Roots
games.summary: Dive into the magical realm of Lyhjem and help save the World Tree. In "Alveron" you take on the role of Valec, who is drawn from the human world into the world of the Alveri.

games.name: Enshrouded
games.summary: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Odd Town
games.summary: Odd Town is a retro-styled first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized open world, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, steal sandwiches, dodge cops, and uncover a conspiracy hidden under the pixels.

games.name: Area 37
games.summary: Area 37 is a 16-bit retro action platform game, set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by machines, where the protagonist, Pink, risks his life performing dangerous missions to earn money.

games.name: Whispers of The Shadow
games.summary: Detective Grace Lawson sets out immediately upon receiving a tip about her missing stepsister Amy, and when she gets there, she suddenly finds herself trapped inside the house. Now, Grace has only one goal: to find her missing sister and escape this nightmare.

games.name: Pestilence
games.summary: Players can expect to enter a 90's narrative-based psychological horror, where they get to experience a series of grim, dark, and very immersive environments while solving puzzles and unravelling the horror within.

games.name: Frosthaven
games.summary: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

games.name: Game of Fitna Vol. 1
games.summary: Game of Fitna Vol. 1: A thrilling death game visual novel set in 2030. Play as Zayn, a high school student thrown into sinister survival games known as "TEST." Fight for your life, uncover shocking truths, and face intense moral dilemmas in this mature, thought-provoking experience.

games.name: Thalia
games.summary: Ariadna Thalía Sodi Miranda, celým jménem Ariadna Thalía Sodi Miranda (* 26. srpna 1971 Mexico City) je mexická zpěvačka a herečka. Je známa pod jménem Thalía a byla několikrát nominována na cenu Grammy a Billboard Latin Music Awards.

games.name: Fatal Train
games.summary: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

games.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2
aliases: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
games.summary: Discover 500 hidden cats across 5 artistic hand-drawn scenes. Relax with color-by-numbers and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op, while Meow FM sets the perfect creative mood.

games.name: Realm of Taiwu
games.summary: Demons ravage, calamities rage. Xiangshu's scourge devours the mortal realm. In this ink-wash dark fantasy world, you'll wander, unearth rare treasures, reclaim divine swords. Seek like-minded companions to save the world. Survive—in this dimming world, you can still kindle a faint light.

games.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
games.summary: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike 'clock-like' deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

games.name: A Blade for the Emperor
games.summary: An interactive fiction epic fantasy.

games.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
games.summary: Become a water balloon champion in Don Pepe & his Balloons, a projectile based arena fighter for up to 4 players!

games.name: We Are So Cooked
games.summary: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Navy Island Confidential
games.summary: Discover the secrets of Navy Island in this captivating and funny story, and follow the misadventures of Archibald Figg: a slightly clumsy secret agent in this colorful and relaxing point‑and‑click adventure!

games.name: Chant Wizard
games.summary: Scream to win! Shout over-the-top spells in this hilarious voice-controlled battler. Assemble your magical deck from the five elements for 1v1 duels testing your wits and shame. Warning: Play safely—don't let your roaring summon the neighbors before you beat your rival!

games.name: Hypnostasis
games.summary: A survival horror game about psychological trauma. You wake up from your room to an unsettling world of disturbing creatures. The world you know has warped into something sinister. Navigate nightmarish worlds, uncover buried memories, and confront the shadows. Will you find the path to salvation?

games.name: Cuboy Adventure
games.summary: An exciting and incredibly cute platformer full of parkour, puzzles, action-packed moments, and boss battles awaits you! Collect stars, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, defeat your enemies, and overcome every challenge!

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary: Time to play! Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

games.name: Pavane: See No Evil
games.summary:
Melody Green saw something she shouldn't have.

A music teacher at a local elementary school finds herself in the midst of something bizarre and unexplainable: an abandoned building, a thick fog enveloping the area, and no wi-fi or phone signal to allow her to call for help.

Faced with strange riddles, eerie messages from her past, and something horrible haunting her from within the screens, Melody realizes that someone or something is calling out to her, trying to show her a truth that could shatter her world and turn her life completely upside down.

games.name: Echoes of the Unread
games.summary: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary: It’s the golden age of game nights with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Play 5 brand-new party games designed to turn your standard bash into a sidesplitting blast. You bring the friends, we’ll bring the fun. Coming this fall to screens near you!

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary: Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
games.summary: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

games.name: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
aliases: Disney•Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
games.summary: Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

games.name: Sword Flinger
games.summary: Throw swords to fight in this roguelite chain-action game. Weapons bounce off walls and enemies, chaining hits from one foe to another. Build damage bonuses with every chain and dive deeper into ever-changing dungeons while collecting swords, spears, axes, staves, shields, and more.

games.name: Not My Son
games.summary: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

games.name: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand
games.summary: In The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand, you step into the shoes of a disgraced magician who, in his quest to regain his former glory, unleashes an interdimensional invasion while experimenting with a mysterious book.

games.name: Loot Goblins
games.summary: Step into Loot Goblins, a online pvp chaotic realm of greed and gas. Snatch treasures before rivals do, but watch out for their tricks and gassy surprises! Experience an exhilarating frenzy like no other! play with up to 32 players

games.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
games.summary: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

games.name: FreshWomen: Season 3
games.summary: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Bonus Contents Pack
Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
games.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.
aliases: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard

games.name: Silent Wounds - The Doll
games.summary: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.

games.name: Gran Turismo 7: Spec IV
games.summary:
The Spec IV Update includes:

October:
• A new circuit, 'Sportsland SUGO'
• Six new cars
• A new 'Spec IV' opening cinematic
• Vintage: a section featuring cars not available to purchase as new
• Car Concierge: a service for ordering Used and Legend cars
• Experience: a mode featuring brand-specific driving challenges
• Car Viewer: a feature that lets you admire the cars in your garage
• Collector Level cap increase.

December:
• A new circuit, 'Autumn Ring'
• Six new cars
• Family: a new mode to be enjoyed by the whole family, from kids to adults
• Shuffle Race: a luck-based race with randomly selected cars
• Online Drift Trial: a new mode where players can test their drifting skills against others worldwide
• The next evolution of Gran Turismo Sophy
• New difficulty level in Power Pack for advanced players.

games.name: Good Job
games.summary: Take charge of a business that no one could put on their resume. Manage the girls at the underground massage parlor, delight customers with herbal blends, expand your e-commerce business, and grow your empire without drawing too much attention!

games.name: Scam With Your Friends
games.summary: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

games.name: Mimic Busters
games.summary: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

games.name: Vanirya Legends
games.summary: Vanirya Legends is a browser-based fantasy idle role-playing game. Players progress through maps and boss encounters with automated combat, collect and upgrade equipment, customize character builds, and ascend to continue their progression. The game also features pets, expeditions, castle defense, guilds, a player market, and player-versus-player battles.

games.name: Sole Mates: Tidy Up the Shoe Store
games.summary: Two thousand pairs of sneakers are scattered across the shop floor and every shelf is empty. Find each shoe's match, read its model and size, then put it where it belongs. Alone, or online with friends - 2 to 4 players. No timers, no score, no way to fail.

games.name: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
games.summary: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends in online co-op.

games.name: Reason and Rhyme
games.summary: Birds of a feather solve puzzles together! An online co-op puzzle adventure specifically for 2 friends (or soon-to-be-friends) to play together.

games.name: Wolfsschanze: Operation Götterdämmerung
games.summary: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

games.name: Fishy
games.summary: Fishy is a free-to-play social VR fishing game for Meta Quest, developed by ENVER. Built around fishing, friendship and discovery, FISHY lets players cast out together, explore colorful locations, collect an ever-growing variety of fish and upgrade their rods, bait, clothing and gear. Along the way, players can take on challenges, hunt for rare catches, tackle larger-than-life boss encounters and get caught up in unexpected multiplayer moments. Designed as much for hanging out as it is for fishing, FISHY turns a familiar pastime into a shared virtual world built to be explored with friends.

games.name: Troll Slayer
games.summary:
The forest near the kingdom has become overrun with trolls, and only one brave knight stands between them and the kingdom.

Take up your sword and venture into the forest in this simple and challenging 2D pixel art platformer. Jump across dangerous terrain, avoid deadly hazards, and fight different types of trolls standing in your way.

Each troll has its own behavior and abilities, requiring you to learn their patterns and choose the right moment to strike.

games.name: Solid Void: Halloween Nonograms
games.summary:
Solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive. Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up. Start with quick 5x5 grids and work your way up to 15x15 monsters.

It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.

Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.

games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
games.summary:
Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town! is a first-person building and tidy-up game that supports solo play and online co-op for up to five players. Players collect and sort 18,490 scattered bricks by shape and color, then place them according to building plans to reconstruct a small town.

Players unlock helpful abilities and use equipment such as a wheelbarrow, scaffolding, and a magnet to collect, transport, and place bricks. Completed buildings light up and gain decorations, gradually transforming the town as reconstruction progresses.

games.name: Silly Souls
games.summary: Silly Souls is an online hide-and-seek party game for 2–8 players. Hide your soul, throw props, and taunt a friend playing the Grim Reaper to steal time—or grab the scythe and hunt your friends. Expect close calls, silly escapes, and proximity voice chat.

games.name: The Factory in the Shadows
games.summary:
Some places are abandoned. Others are left behind for a reason.

The Factory in the Shadows is a psychological mystery horror experience that takes you into the remains of forgotten places, where traces of the past still linger and unanswered questions wait beneath the surface.

What happened here? Why was everything left behind? And what secrets were buried before the world moved on?

Explore, investigate, and uncover fragments of a story hidden across time. Every room, every recording, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth or just lies.

The deeper you look, the more you realize that the shadows are not empty.

They are hiding something.

games.name: Ampanic
games.summary: AIM × Shop Management! Gather, process, craft, and serve customers — all with your aim. Let a customer escape and it's Game Over! Master flick & tracking aim and survive the chaos. 3 difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned veterans! Online co-op & competitive multiplayer!

games.name: Shanwen
games.summary: 1990s: Windswept mining town Linshan, dependent on fading coal mines, worshipped a mountain god’s stele. After it cracked and oozed brown liquid, a strange illness spread. Lin Tianqing returned for his sick father, uneasy as the eerie town neared, having overheard whispers.

games.name: Delenar TD: Remastered
games.summary:
Delenar TD Remastered is an old school Grid based Tower Defense game, where you control the path of the mobs. Build towers, place mazing rocks, and adapt to the mobs in each level. The game is difficult, but the strategy of solving each level is completely up to you!

Game comes out tomorrow 10/15/2026

games.name: Colors of V
games.summary: A vector dungeon on a monochrome tube, lit by three subtractive colour gels. Drop a gel and half the room stops existing: a wall you cannot see is not solid, an enemy you cannot see is frozen and cannot be shot. The colour channel is the collision layer, so sight and physics never drift.

games.name: Half-Life 2: All Good Things
games.summary: 11 map campaign inspired by the Epistle 3 storyline

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Lost Savior
aliases: G-MODEアーカイブス+ ロストセイヴァー
games.summary:
This is a port of a JRPG originally developed exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.
Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.
This story is a sequel to the previous title, LOST CHRONICLE.

games.name: Amanojaku Nightmare
games.summary: Based on the Touhou Project, this is a fantastical and intense bullet-hell Shoot 'em up. Dive into a nightmare where Gensokyo’s strongest fighters gather, and aim to conquer it. There are no special systems or complex controls. From Beginners players to those who have “graduated from being human,” we await your challenge.

games.name: Kings of Antikva
games.summary: Turn-based strategy with hidden information. Position your army, outsmart your opponent and capture the enemy flag before it’s too late. Easy to learn, hard to master. Ranked online multiplayer and offline mode versus AI.

games.name: Under Review
games.summary: Under Review is an anomaly-hunt horror game. Inspect uncanny hotel rooms, document discrepancies and survive the strict, unforgiving bureaucracy of the Manager.

games.name: Hero Chains of Destiny
games.summary:
Hero Chains of Destiny is a fantasy dungeon-crawling, deck-building RPG developed by TavernCatGames. Players build and manage their own guild, collect cards, assemble a party of three characters, and venture into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, treasure, and encounters.

Combat combines turn-based strategy with collectible cards, character abilities, equipment, summoned monsters, and a shared Power Stone resource system. Players can expand their collections through dungeon expeditions and card packs, experiment with different party and deck combinations, and challenge increasingly difficult enemies.

The game also features arena battles, multiplayer activities, card collection management, and optional town activities such as fishing and the Wheel of Fate.

games.name: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker
games.summary: Shot across Los Angeles by a team with Hollywood experience, this live-action interactive drama stars Zhong Chenyao as Ayaka, with a cast shaped by 200,000+ votes. As a cash-strapped student posing as a wealthy heir, navigate five dangerous relationships—and risk losing yourself behind the mask.

games.name: Brushpath
games.summary: Brushpath is a painting puzzle game. Each pixel of a picture is a small puzzle on a honeycomb grid, painted by dragging a single brush from cell to cell and loading or mixing colours from paint pots along the way. Each finished puzzle becomes one pixel of a larger picture. There are 112 pictures across eight themed shelves, with no timers or failure; stars reward clean routes.

games.name: Console Archives: The Drug Store
games.summary:
The Drug Store was released by Human in 1998 for a 32-bit home console.
This is a simulation game where you manage a drug store, aim to open many stores, and increase your capital.
Manage your business while considering locations, the types of products sold, customer demographics, and build the ultimate drug store!
Sometimes, an employee you've become close with might even propose Original products...?

games.name: Pindemonium
games.summary: A roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Beat each stage's target score before you run out of balls. Between stages, buy passives and upgrades in the shop to build your deck. Choose from 10 flippers, clear 12 stages, then see how far your build can go in Endless Mode.

games.name: Lonely Hospital: Revelations
games.summary: A dark third-person survival horror experience where fear, violence, and disturbing secrets await behind every door.

games.name: Bloock
games.summary: Bloock is an 8x8 block-placement puzzle built around one extra move: Shift. Clear lines on consecutive moves to earn a charge, then slide any row or column by exactly one cell; the block that falls off one edge comes back on the other. The campaign runs to 500 levels across 20 regions with ice blocks and bomb countdowns, alongside an endless Classic mode, a Daily Challenge and a weekly tournament. Pieces never rotate, and Shift is earned through play, never sold.

games.name: Toys Co.
games.summary: Enter a colorful toy store full of playable toys! Scan, sort and organize the mess, try the toys yourself, test your luck at the claw machine, unlock useful skills, and turn chaos into satisfying order.

games.name: Croc's World 5
games.summary: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! Jump, run and swim through 60 hand-crafted levels across four islands, packed with new enemies and huge boss fights. This time whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move — and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling. Classic 2D platforming with a twist, for players of every age.

games.name: Starworn
games.summary:
Crash-landed on an uncharted alien planet, your survival depends on your creativity.

Starworn is a procedurally generated, voxel-based multiplayer sandbox with dynamic physics-driven combat. Mine the terrain, craft powerful gear, and construct your home base in a fully destructible world.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares?

games.name: Beyond These Stars
games.summary: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

games.name: Feed the Cups
games.summary: Feed the Cups is a game made of drinks. It will make you experience every bit of a drink shop. You will work in various beverage stores: preparing materials, ordering for customers, making drinks, making cups, and so on. You can cooperate with up to 2 people on the screen!

games.name: Shards of the Past
games.summary: A trading trip with a nearby village turns into an epic adventure when you discover a hidden truth about your world. You will meet new friends and foes, explore amazing places, and face a choice that will shape the future. Your actions and choices will determine the outcome of this story.

games.name: Ducking Grenades
games.summary: Ducking Grenades is a physics based game in which the protagonist traverses the world in a very unconventional way: With grenades! Hunt down the evil General Goosey and his minions and bring peace to the universe in this hand-made, fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action game!

games.name: A Dungeon Is You
games.summary: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

games.name: Night Blood W: Cutthroat Wolf
games.summary: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

games.name: Mahjong Sex & Girls
aliases: 少女 X 愛 X 麻將
games.summary: Mahjong, Sex & Girls is a lighthearted adult mahjong game. You are the part-time worker at the mahjong parlor. Besides getting entangled in various heart-pounding interactions with the female characters, even the boss lady has her eyes on your body...

games.name: Doomed Otaku
games.summary: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

games.name: Season Island
games.summary: Season Island is an interactive role-playing experience in which you guide Spike, a human stranded in a mystical seasonal globe…

games.name: Terradune
games.summary: Terradune is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG where you battle monsters, discover hidden treasures, and shape your hero’s fate. Explore scorching deserts, moonlit forests, and thrilling dungeons to uncover secrets in this fast-paced, immersive adventure.

games.name: Order: The New Dawn
games.summary: Order: The New Dawn is a colony sim with space adventure. As a legendary captain from the United Stellar, build a base on the desert planet New Terra and face the perils of the Wastespace—how will you shape the destiny of the stars?

games.name: Flipping is Hard
games.summary: A flippin' hard game where rotation is your only motion. Flip, fall, and climb through the land of lost things to return to your boy.

games.name: DayZ: Badlands
games.summary: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

games.name: The Guardians
games.summary: The Guardians is a decision based RPG with flight simulator and first person shooter mechanics. Every decision you make has consequences, your actions will shape the outcome.

games.name: Dimenshot
games.summary: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

games.name: Poem for the Caged
games.summary: You wake in a monster’s cage with no memory and 30 days to act. Choose to escape, obey, or become its favorite.

games.name: Sparky Rush: Purrils in Pawsville!
games.summary: Sparky Rush is a lost media 3D Platformer PS1 game with elements of Psychological Horror where its developer descends into complete sorrow and madness. Play as Sparky and discover all the morbid secrets left by its creator before his sudden disappearance.

games.name: Futa Slug EX
games.summary: Futa Slug EX is a top-down shooter roguelike where you collect and fuck beautiful dickgirls. Build your team and discover powerful upgrades as you pilot your SLUG through procedurally generated dungeons.

games.name: Dawn of Irkalla
games.summary: Dungeon. Horror. Survival. Dawn of Irkalla plunges you into a terrifying world of dungeon exploration: find loot, outsmart monsters, and uncover hidden artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Build your deck, use your items wisely, and escape before time runs out. Your survival depends on it.

games.name: Dreadline Express
games.summary: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

games.name: Purranoia
games.summary: Purranoia is an action roguelike with a twist to the genre - you have no control over your characters movement. Instead you control a variety of powerful scientific inventions to protect poor cat Mousti from waves of enemies.

games.name: A Game About Opening a Chest
games.summary: Open the chest, collect legendary swords, craft powerful synergies, and amass enough gold to pay the King. Dodge the Goblin, survive the Dragon’s fire, and earn the Angel’s blessing. Can you conquer the dungeon and reach 2,000,000,000 gold coins?
aliases: A Game About Opening a Chest.exe

games.name: Supermarket Guard Simulator
games.summary: Play as a supermarket security guard. Build security systems, conduct surveillance, catch thieves, stop criminals, and drive company profits. Use security devices and weapons to bring more value to shareholders. Do your best and grind that promotion!

games.name: Dawn of Irkalla
games.summary: Dawn of Irkalla is a 4 player co-op horror stealth dungeon-crawler where you have no weapons and no way to fight back. Build your deck, unlock skills, scavenge vital items, and race against the clock to retrieve artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Your survival depends on it.

games.name: Vanisha
games.summary: Vanisha is a sci-fi arcade shooter where you dodge bullet waves, craft builds from collected cards, and climb through six sectors of increasingly dangerous space. Level up, spend skill points, hit shops along the way, and see how far your build can take you.

games.name: The Little Land
games.summary: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and watch as they gather resources and expand their village.

games.name: Online: 404
games.summary: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

games.name: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: Stream Train
games.summary: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

games.name: VHS World '89
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

games.name: Sleep Walk
games.summary: "Sleep Walk" is an instrumental composition written, recorded, and released in 1959 by American instrumental rock and roll duo Santo & Johnny, with their uncle Mike Dee playing the drums. Prominently featuring steel guitar, the song was recorded at Trinity Music in Manhattan, New York City. "Sleep Walk" entered Billboard's Top 40 on August 17, 1959. It rose to the number 1 position for the last two weeks in September and remained in the Top 40 until November 9. "Sleep Walk" also reached number 4 on the R&B chart. It was the last instrumental to hit number 1 in the 1950s and earned a gold record for Santo & Johnny.

games.name: Solemnfable
games.summary: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

games.name: Manorbound
games.summary: Explore a manor trapped in a time loop and solve puzzles to uncover the manor's deepest secrets and break the cycle.

games.name: Tidy Up the Town
games.summary: What have you done to the market?! Practising your amateur sorcery in the town square might not have been the best idea… You should really tidy up the market stalls before everyone arrives for a hard day’s work!

games.name: Mendicant Sea
games.summary: Assume command of a five-floor containment facility. Manifest 200 strange PTF species, study their needs, direct staff, and build a live defense line for the moment containment fails—then field your subjects in 1v1 or 3v3 Containment Combat.

games.name: Money Burner
games.summary: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

games.name: House Zero
games.summary: A social casino where the only thing at stake is bragging rights. Play 20+ games, from slots, Plinko and Crash to live poker and case battles with friends, using free play-money chips. Climb weekly leaderboards, finish quests and unlock cosmetics. No real-money gambling or payouts.

games.name: M!racle Home_Page
games.summary: They were going to be social media millionaires! ...Five years later, they have only eighteen subscribers. Now Roo’s bedroom has been rebuilt, his friend is missing, and strangers laugh at everything he does! A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel about finally being watched.

games.name: Lights On My Screen
games.summary: Lights On My Screen is a 2D adventure RPG set inside a video game. Help Kid navigate the colorful world, solve puzzles, talk to characters and fight (or don't fight) the enemies. And find the one who brought them to this world...

games.name: Lotwick Hill
games.summary: Buy plots. Run shops. Outsmart your rivals. Lotwick Hill is a business tycoon set in a living town. Choose from 72 shop types, set prices and keep your shelves stocked. Customers have different budgets and tastes, and those tastes change as the years pass. Bid for plots when leases expire, react to your rivals, and zoom down to street level to watch customers queue outside your shops. Play single-player against AI, or compete online with up to four players and up to six competitors in total with AI.

games.name: Diceminoes
games.summary: Diceminoes is a score-chasing roguelike where you roll dice, pair them up to make dominoes, and connect them into scoring patterns. Discover powerful upgrades, bend the rules, and turn clever placements into huge scoring cascades.

games.name: Sproutrex
games.summary:
Take control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together.

Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage.

Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge.

But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. In this strange world, nature has found a way to thrive among gears, metal and forgotten mechanisms — and this little robot is living proof that the two can grow together.

games.name: Resonurgy
games.summary: Build an automated factory where machinery meets alchemy. Explore a technomagical world, scan matter and extract its hidden principles. Connect production lines, assemble research circuits and contain the Dissonance your factory creates. Play solo or with friends.

games.name: Joker's Knock
games.summary: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

games.name: Video Store Chaos
games.summary: Video Store Chaos is a single-player simulation. Pick up, sort and shelve over 2,500 movie, game and VHS cases to turn a messy video store into an organized collection. Unlock upgrades to carry more and work faster, find clues on the covers and explore the hidden basement.

games.name: Take My Bomb
games.summary: An online party game where up to 16 players shove a bubblegum bomb onto each other. It pops after 30 seconds, and takes anyone nearby with it. Only the one holding it can see the timer. As long as it's not you. Take My Bomb.

games.name: What He Left
games.summary: Every night at 3:03, someone knocks on your door. Through the peephole you see a hood, but no face. He wants to play a game: you step away, he changes one thing in your apartment, and you have to find what. Miss it, and something else comes through the door. He also asks you questions, and your answers come back later. A short first-person psychological horror game about spotting changes in your own apartment over seven nights, with a cat named Tisha and five endings.

games.name: Todd The Technician
games.summary: A first-person puzzle game where you're guided by a slightly sarcastic AI earpiece named A.N.D.I., you will use tools, warp reality, and solve a variety of mechanical and logic-based puzzles to keep the strange technology of the Anomaly Corporation running, all while hoping you won't get fired!

games.name: Mercenaries Of Vector
games.summary: First-person mech combat where everything is made of lines of light. 100 missions in open battlefields, inside Battlecruisers and Dreadnoughts, and out in deep space! 10 Mega Mech bosses and a salvage economy that pays for every piece of hardware you rip from your dying opponents.

games.name: Matryoshka
games.summary:
Matryoshka is a spooky spot-the-difference puzzle game that tests eyes and nerves.

Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away.Miss a curse, or burn an innocent doll—even once—and... you will find out

games.name: Alice Nation
games.summary: Explore, talk, and solve puzzles with cards in a solo tabletop adventure! Play as Alice, a girl trapped in the Beyond. Drag cards to craft items, meet curious companions, and find your way home. Stuck? Try a different card—and a different approach. This charming fairy-tale world has its secrets.

games.name: Moto X
games.summary:
Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

Compete against a friend in 2 player mode (split screen) and discover once and for all who is the best Moto X racer.

games.name: House Music Incremental
games.summary: A music based incremental in which progress in the game through buying instruments also changes and progresses the music.

games.name: Severed Chains
games.summary: Severed Chains is an unofficial port of Legend of Dragoon for PC and Steam Deck, created by Monoxide.

games.name: Who's Cheating?
games.summary: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for 3 to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

games.name: Maldhalla
games.summary: Just one more minute. Then another. Outlast endless hordes and a new boss every three minutes in this survival roguelite with 21 characters, 32 weapons, and relics triggered by weapon combos.

games.name: Shores of the Fallen
games.summary: Shores of the Fallen is a first-person, open-world zombie survival game set on a storm-battered island. Zombies track the player by sight and sound, making stealth a core part of play, and night fog brings larger hordes. The surrounding water is patrolled by sharks. Players scavenge buildings and wrecks for supplies, hunt wildlife, fish, craft tools and weapons, and build a base piece by piece. A drivable truck and boat are used to cross the island, and a day/night cycle and storms shape each run. The game is in Early Access and is developed by a single developer.

games.name: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout
