games.summary: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout is an unofficial Ace Attorney fangame featuring an original story told across five interconnected cases.

games.name: Boatrocker
games.summary: Boatrocker is an arcade game played by tilting the phone to keep a small lobster boat from capsizing as a storm builds from a calm dawn to a night gale. The player leans into waves, steers around debris, hauls lobster buoys, collects crates and answers Coast Guard maydays. Earnings buy boat upgrades at a boatyard, three boats can be skippered, and twenty logbook pages found in bottles tell a lighthouse mystery.

games.name: A Game About Needle in a Haystack
games.summary: A first-person game about finding a needle in a giant haystack. Dig through the hay by hand, sell it at the cow, buy tools and upgrades in the workshop, and search the pile until you find the needle.

games.name: Teacade
games.summary: Teacade is a tea pouring puzzle game. Slide the teapot along its rail and let go: each serving falls through porcelain gutters, looping glass tubes, funnel portals, valves you tap, a water wheel, a cup on a belt, see-saws, switches, trapdoors and a cutter, and many of these pieces change with every serving. At the bottom a bunny, a fox, an owl, a hedgehog, a bear and a cat each hold a glass with a line on it: fill every glass to its line without stopping short or running over the brim. Nothing shows where the tea will go, so you read the table and work out the way down. 120 tables in six valleys, no timer.

games.name: Memories of Magic
games.summary:
Memories of Magic, formerly known as EvilQuest, is a browser-based MMORPG set in a dark fantasy world, built around old-school combat, skilling, quests, and character progression. With a retro online RPG feel, Memories of Magic invites players to create an adventurer, explore the world directly from the browser, and build their account through classic MMO activities. The game leans into familiar scapelike systems such as skill training, monster hunting, rankings, and persistent progression while wrapping it in a darker, more ominous fantasy atmosphere.

In Memories of Magic, players can train skills, fight enemies, complete quests, compare progress through hiscores, and explore a growing online world alongside other adventurers. For players who enjoy browser MMOs focused on gradual progression, skilling, combat, and community-driven discovery, Memories of Magic offers a fresh dark-fantasy take on the classic scapelike formula.

games.name: Chicken Terror
games.summary: A simple arcade-action game focused on catching eggs and collecting escaped chicks while avoiding a dog.

games.name: Cat Life
games.summary: Cat Life is an adventure and survival solo game, allowing you to explore a vast open world as a cat. A series of quests will lead you to solve the mysteries of this island, if you manage to face all its dangers!

games.name: The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just for the Two of Us
games.summary: A visual novel where your choices matter. Derek has a job, a beloved boyfriend, friends, and… “piranha thoughts.” Everything was perfect until his younger sister Rina returned to town.

games.name: Five Nights with Maids
games.summary: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

games.name: Lost Odyssey: Recompiled
games.summary: An experimental native PC port of Lost Odyssey for Xbox 360.

games.name: Volleyball Mania
games.summary: Volleyball Mania is a 3D beach and indoor volleyball game. Pass, set, spike, read the block, aim past the defender, and finish the rally. Take on the World Tour across three stadiums, or challenge a friend online.

games.name: Ruby's Trick or Treat
games.summary: Welcome to Ruby's Trick or Treat, a fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game for Halloween, starring VTuber RubyWhiska. You walked out of her party once. Now she's coming trick-or-treating at your house.

games.name: Letrazo
games.summary:
Letrazo is a TV game show style quiz in which two teams, Blue and Orange, compete for every letter of the alphabet. Each match moves through several rounds, One of Four, The Clue, Crosswords and Where Are They?, before the final letter wheel, where every answer has to start with or contain the given letter. Players answer by typing or by voice, and the team with the most correct answers takes the jackpot.

Matches can be played online from 1 vs 1 up to 4 vs 4, with bots filling any empty seats, or in private rooms with friends using a code. A single-player story mode pits the player against eight increasingly difficult rivals in 1 vs 1 duels, ending with a trophy.

games.name: WB Solitaire
games.summary: WB Solitaire is a collection of seven solitaire card games: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf and Yukon. Deals are drawn from pools that a solver has confirmed can be won, and each deal has a number that can be replayed or shared. The game includes hints, a full-solution option, a Daily Deal for each game and weekly goals.

games.name: Signal Gathering
games.summary: Signal Gathering is a first-person puzzle horror game where you need to operate janky old machines designed to handle anomalous signals from outer space. Find your way with the machinery at your disposal, the entire world's fate is in your hands.

games.name: Surrounded
games.summary: Surrounded is an up to 6-player cooperative horror game where you will encounter a lot of different variations of paranormal activities, strange sightings, and creatures capable of ending your life. Grab your gear, and be ready to experience the strange mystery of the Surrounded world.

games.name: As Above So Below
games.summary: As Above So Below is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

games.name: AI Olympius
games.summary: Join forces with rebels and their technologies to have a chance to restore freedom in a world that has fallen to the uncontrolled dominance of supreme artificial intelligence.

games.name: SurgePoint
games.summary: Craft weapons mid-run, strafe through chaos, chain recoil jumps, spawn platforms out of thin air. Pick cards. Break runs. Repeat.

games.name: Mall Corp
games.summary: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

games.name: Boulito
games.summary: Boulito is a top-down arena survival action game. Players control Boulito, a small repair robot, and fight off waves of enemies in a closed arena using six upgradeable weapons. The game features 20 handcrafted waves with boss fights, an endless mode, an in-game shop between waves, and online leaderboards. Developed by the independent French studio PixelRed Studio with the Godot engine, it is available on PC (Windows) and Android.

games.name: Desperate Kart
games.summary: Desperate Kart is a free-to-play racing game and a spinoff of the YouTube series Danganronpa: Desperate Heart.

games.name: Crooked Frames
games.summary: Crooked Frames is a stealth puzzle game about an art thief who cannot walk past a crooked painting. The player sneaks through museums at night, levels each frame with touch controls, and stands still when a guard turns around. The game has a training night, three museums and a final heist, four kinds of guard, and 99 public-domain paintings by artists including Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai and Vermeer.

games.name: Infamous PC
games.summary: An unofficial native Windows port of inFamous (PS3).

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
games.summary: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

games.name: Eletta
games.summary: Explore an unfamiliar place filled with powerful enemies, advanced technology and scientific advancements in Eletta, an action game about a young girl looking for a way back home.

games.name: Bank Simulator
games.summary: Take your customers' money and invest it to grow your bank. Lend it out, buy bonds, stock ATM Rooms across the city and keep the profits. Catch scammers, hire staff and turn a small branch into a global powerhouse in this business management and banking tycoon sim.

games.name: Warding Witches
games.summary: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

games.name: My Name Is...
games.summary: Survival horror about sanity balancing affecting gameplay in a steampunk world of phobias, full of dangerous entities, anomalies and randomly generated puzzles.

games.name: Coin Harvest
games.summary: Harvest coins with robotic arms, unlock islands and conquer realms. An incremental idle desktop widget game that runs while you work or game.

games.name: Big Dig
aliases: 考古致富:挖出个博物馆
考古致富：挖出個博物館
games.summary: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

games.name: FirstPlate
games.summary: FirstPlate is a first-person multiplayer cooking game about preparing orders, managing kitchen chaos, and working together under pressure.

games.name: Sender Unknown
games.summary: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad. Localized into 30 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

games.name: Beyblade X Evobattle: Bey Coating Pattern & Color Add-on Kit Vol.2
Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.8
Saros: Zenith
games.summary:
Saros: Zenith adds Overlord Rush, a brand new mode where you can take on the powerful Overlord enemies from the main game back-to-back, go for a high score, and compete with players around the world using integrated leaderboards.

This update also brings "Eclipse Layers", a new game+ mode which allows seasoned enforcers to put their skills to the ultimate test. After clearing Saros, players can return to the beginning and take on a more challenging version of the game. You can rise to meet these trials with even more progression options and new Carcosan Modifiers to customize your experience. There are also new secrets and trophies to discover.

New accessibility features, including High-Contrast visuals, gyro aiming with the DualSense wireless controller, and the toggleable "Slow Game Speed" option have been added.

games.name: Gay It Loud
games.summary: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

games.name: Wild Draw
games.summary: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

games.name: The Ramen Bar
games.summary: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

games.name: Universal Tidy Up
games.summary: Explore different ways to "tidy up." A puzzle-focused first-person tidy-up game with 20+ stages to organize! Put scattered belongings on shelves, shelves inside bigger shelves, and delve into new spaces. Figure out the rules of each stage and keep tidying.

games.name: Howling Woods
games.summary: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

games.name: Hehehe Game
games.summary:
Hehehe game is...

- 10 unique levels: sell crates just for the sake of crates, and then participate in cart-racing (and all of this in a single level).
- Two narrators: who will constantly mock you (no hard feelings).
- Total absurdity: inspired by The Stanley Parable and all kinds of memes.
- Perfect for streaming: tons of unexpected twists (WW cargo bringers).

This is the second installment of the game. The first part was released only on itch io and was not registered on IGDB

games.name: Her Revenge
games.summary: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

games.name: Greed for Glory
games.summary: In this chaotic board game, take on the roles of creatures straight out of fables. Use your wits and think carefully about every move to become the richest among your friends and claim the throne. Then, watch your plans unfold before your eyes, because in a fable, nothing ever goes quite as planned.

games.name: Just One More Fly
games.summary: Hunt pesky flies in this first-person swatting game. Clear rooms, earn upgrades, and tackle bigger infestations with swatters, electric rackets, a hand vacuum, and a flamethrower. Place traps, beat your best time, and catch that one last fly.

games.name: Chamber: Atom Breaker Inc
games.summary: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

games.name: Bloody Roar Extreme: Recomp
games.summary: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Bloody Roar Extreme (Bloody Roar: Primal Fury), with enhanced graphics options, Vulkan backend, high-resolution rendering, and controller support

games.name: Unicorn Overlord PC
games.summary: A native Linux and Windows port of the PlayStation 4 version of Unicorn Overlord

games.name: Ladykiller in a Bind: Ladykiller Unleashed
aliases: Ladykiller in a Bind - Ladykiller Unleashed
games.summary: The original lesbian ladykiller is back after ten years! Return as the Beast for a full run's worth of new Ladykiller in a Bind content, featuring new romances with brand new characters, threesomes with old love interests, and of course, the return of the IGF award-winning experimental choice system that you told all your friends was the real reason why you played the original game. Spread across 78 000 words, 14 new scenes, and six new sex scenes, Ladykiller Unleashed threatens a whole lot of new sexy trouble for the Beast to handle with her characteristic wink and smug grin.

games.name: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia
games.summary:
Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds

Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles within fractured memories.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist capable of entering and manipulating memories, as she searches for a mysterious fragment hidden deep within her own mind.

games.name: Patients
games.summary: Psychological horror with a retro atmosphere,solo or co-op experience for 2 or more players,Inventory and, resource management, interactive and explorable environment, unpredictable events

games.name: FIFA 09 PC
games.summary: FIFA Soccer 09 (X360) on PC, running natively, with a modern launcher and its online modes back.

games.name: Under Investigation
games.summary:
Investigate strange phenomena, use your camera to determine whether they are real anomalies or unstable phenomena, and keep the station from falling into darkness. Every use of your camera drains its energy faster, bringing you closer to danger.

Can you identify every anomaly before it's too late?

Under Investigation is a first-person horror game about investigating strange phenomena and identifying anomalies.

games.name: Loop Dungeon: Incremental
games.summary: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

games.name: Anomaly Jobs: Death Row
games.summary: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

games.name: Gemloop
games.summary: GemLoop is a Match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.

games.name: SornHack: Reverse Engineering
games.summary:
SornHack is a first-person reverse-engineering puzzle game where the world itself is the system you can modify. Enter a controlled cyber laboratory, inspect how systems behave, form a hypothesis, then use your tools to change the rules. Use SornScan to search and manipulate simulated memory values, discover addresses and pointers, and trace what changes them. Use SornTrace to inspect program behavior, follow execution flow, and experiment with instructions such as CMP, NOP, CALL, and RET.

There is rarely only one way forward. Observe the system, experiment with different approaches, and discover what happens when you change something the world expects to remain constant. SornHack is built around real programming and reverse-engineering concepts, presented inside a fictional and intentionally hackable sandbox. No prior reverse-engineering experience is required.

games.name: Underground
games.summary:
Underground is an interactive story about exploring a mysterious pit in the forest. What’s down there and will you find a way out?

This short Choose Your Own Adventure is a university project and will be available for everyone that is curious enough.

games.name: Roadster Race
games.summary: Roadster Race is a flying-car arcade racer that you play in your browser. Hold to take off, tap again in mid-air for a barrel roll, and boost when you dare: flying and boosting burn the same compressed air. Three modes: Race against AI drivers over 1,600 m on three difficulty levels, Survival, which gets faster and faster with 1 to 3 lives, and Turbo, where every coin makes you faster. Play solo or online with up to four players through an invite link, with AI drivers filling the empty seats, and put your best runs in the worldwide Hall of Fame. Four circuits (Neon, Demo, Grid and Tokyo), each with its own soundtrack, and more than 30 skins, including legendary cars that can only be earned. A parody of the flying-car promises, made by Ari Studios, an independent studio in Lyon, France.

games.name: A Sister's Journey
games.summary: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

games.name: Fall of Bali
games.summary: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy simulator city set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided in many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has fall in warring era for nearly 2 centuries and now the threat of imperialism come. With all your kingdom potential, can you survive and win this era?

games.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
games.summary: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and eerie phenomena from the region. Are you brave enough to uncover the truth?

games.name: Baron
games.summary: Baron is Turkey's first RPG Themed, Realistic Mafia game. Growing up in the seediest underworld, Alparslan vows to fight all his enemies until he becomes the most respected bully in Ankara. An action game with a Deep State Mafia storyline set in Ankara from a TPS perspective.

games.name: Cucina Stellata: Starred Cuisine
games.summary:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

games.name: Mycopunk
games.summary: A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

games.name: Out of the Shadows
games.summary: Out of the Shadows is a cooperative game (up to 4 players) that blends exploration, tension, and coordination. Infiltrate abandoned locations, solve complex puzzles, and survive the unsettling presence of those who still linger there...

games.name: Only Fans
games.summary: <Only Fans> is an object finding game where you find mildly boobs and mildly butts objects in a gooning rehab full of fans.

games.name: Tiny Monster Village
games.summary: In this cozy village simulation game, you'll help the minions create a unique village and experience a relaxing pastoral life: growing crops, fishing, exploring treasures, and more.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: SnowRunner: Season 19 - Research & Restore
games.summary: Research & Restore Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.name: Bytes and Knights Adventure
games.summary: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

games.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
games.summary: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

games.name: What the Dog Remembers
games.summary: A retro style psychological horror game. Survive a week in a claustrophobic trailer, spot reality breaking anomalies, and document your findings. Every night tests your perception. Every mistake costs you. Your dog knows.

games.name: Dreams of a Visionary
games.summary: Dreams Of A Visionary is a first-person exploration adventure set in a mysterious Victorian mansion. Explore richly detailed rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal dream.

games.name: Dino Crisis 2
games.summary: A port of Dino Crisis 2 originally released on the PlayStation, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Passage Zero
games.summary: Passage Zero is a short psychological horror game about observation, limited controls, and paying attention.

games.name: The Inkspire
games.summary: The Inkspire is a hand-drawn deck-building roguelike. Choose from five unique characters, build powerful card synergies, collect relics, and climb an ever-changing tower filled with battles, shops, and mysterious events.

games.name: Folk-Tography
games.summary: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

games.name: Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary: A collection of side-scrolling Sonic games.

games.name: Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary: A collection of 3D Sonic games.

games.name: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time
games.summary: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

games.name: FingerLaserX
games.summary: FingerLaserX is a neon arcade shooter for iOS and Android. Swipe at the enemy to fire, keep the base standing, and take down bosses the size of your screen. It is a ground-up rebuild of the 2012 iPhone game FingerLaser by its original solo developer. No forced ads, no stamina system, no account, and it plays offline.

games.name: AiRhythm
games.summary: A hand-tracked VR rhythm game where you play the DJ: strike, hold, swipe and throw your hands through notes as a packed club moves to the music.

games.name: Dementium II
games.summary: The DS horror sequel, reborn. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull, inside an institution for the criminally insane, where the walls keep peeling back to expose something worse. Fight, solve, and survive your way out. The cult classic, remastered for PC.

games.name: Candlemates
games.summary:
Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference!

Switch between the two characters to take advantage of their positions, create paths, and complete each puzzle. While one candle is active, the other remains still and can even be pushed like any other object in the environment. Use both wisely, plan your moves, and avoid wasting precious steps too soon!

As you progress, new challenges make the puzzles increasingly complex. Pressure plates, stone barriers, and other obstacles require precise movements, careful planning, and perfect coordination between the two candles.

games.name: Sloptoberfest
games.summary: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

games.name: All Eyes on Me
games.summary:
All Eyes on Me is a horror delivery game with cozy elements. More than 100 items, 15 areas to explore, and over a dozen ene,

As a new hire at the BlinkTwice delivery services, purchase (or steal) items and deliver them to your customers. Or find new ways to make profit like fishing, mining, recycling bottles, garbage picking, and more! Just make sure to reach quota by the end of the day and avoid the eyes...

games.name: Austin Lost in Maze
games.summary:
Austin wakes up trapped in a maze that seems to shift every time he turns around. With no map, no clear way out, and strange sounds echoing through the corridors, he must explore carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the place he’s been trapped in.

Navigate winding passages, search for clues, and keep your bearings as the maze twists into something far more unsettling than it first appears. Every discovery brings Austin closer to an exit—and deeper into the mystery of why he’s there.

Can you guide Austin out before the maze closes in?

games.name: Parawyrm
games.summary: Parawyrm is a unique horror experience like no other where enemies and hazards will challenge your very senses. Explore a seamless world with collectables to find and secrets to uncover...

games.name: Sivers
games.summary: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

games.name: Pixel Solo Ops
games.summary: Pixel Solo Ops is a retro-inspired 2D action-platformer. After a covert mission goes wrong, your closest comrade is captured by a ruthless military faction. Fight through enemy troops, infiltrate fortified bases, and survive intense pixel-art firefights to rescue him. With tight gunplay, fast-paced challenges, and nostalgic visuals, you’re the last hope. One soldier. One mission. No backup.

games.name: Beatrice
games.summary: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

games.name: Achtung Royale
games.summary:
Achtung Royale is a free multiplayer browser game based on the 1995 DOS game Achtung, die Kurve! Each player steers a worm using only two keys, left and right. The worm trail grows behind them, and touching a wall or any trail ends their round; the last player alive wins.

The game adds online play for up to 30 players, a drop-in Play Now mode, a 30-player knock-out Royale held every half hour, ranked 1 vs 1 and free-for-all ladders, private game rooms, 13 power-ups and local play for up to 10 players on one keyboard. It runs in the browser for both PC and phone. Play and App store apps are in development.

games.name: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
games.summary: Action-RPG Top-down view of Anubis in the Egyptian afterlife: fast melee combat, dashes, relics, and battles with hordes of the dead and ancient gods.

games.name: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
games.summary:
Formula Z: Controlled Dose is a first-person open-world pharmacy simulation game where you start as a pharmacist, manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and grow your pharmaceutical business.

Expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore a large open world filled with activities, vehicles, and business opportunities.

Travel between four different eras: the modern world, medieval 1419, post-apocalyptic 2049, and futuristic 2079. Each era features unique environments, pharmacies, factories, medications, and opportunities.

games.name: Psychoscope
games.summary: Psychoscope is a short horror game (play time only a few minutes) about using an experimental device that lets you see the last moments of someone before they died.

games.name: Hearthstone: Reign of the Black Empire
games.summary: Before the Titans came. Before the Old Gods were imprisoned. Before the world of Azeroth as we know it existed. Welcome to the Black Empire. At the height of their power, the Old Gods ruled a corrupted world and waged war against the Titan-forged armies sent to stop them. Now it's your turn to step into that conflict. Command the most horrifying Old Gods Hearthstone has ever created and wield the power of creation to Assemble your own custom minions.

games.name: The House in the Hollow
games.summary: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

games.name: Lighthouse of Madness
games.summary: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you in this island. Explore the enigmatic lighthouse, solve challenging puzzles and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity when facing the darkness of your mind.

games.name: Horror Tales Eats The World
games.summary: Move silently through dark and desolate areas with a photorealistic bodycam perspective. Find the hidden tapes cassettes scattered across the map each one unveils a different paranormal horror story… stay silent, stay alive.

games.name: The Killing Stone
games.summary: Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century folk horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Mowit: Grass Cutting Simulator
games.summary: Mowing lawns has never been this much fun! Relax with your friends in online co-op, upgrade your equipment, shape beautiful gardens, and enjoy the experience. Join the fun with 1-4 player co-op!

games.name: Inky's Sleep
games.summary: A haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat Inky. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

games.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
games.summary: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal

games.name: Wartide
games.summary: An incremental desktop defense game that lives on the corner of your screen. Waves get harder, upgrades get stronger, progress never stops. Build your base, unlock permanent bonuses and grow your army while you work or relax.

games.name: One Dumb Wizard
games.summary: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to get your money back.

games.name: Woim
games.summary: If you were a woim, could you still solve puzzles? in this rock pushing, egg cracking, woim snipping, puzzle game, you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the underground world of dirt you call home.

games.name: Gemcraft: Legacy Collection
games.summary: Experience the original three GemCraft games in one collection. GemCraft 1, GemCraft 0, and GemCraft Labyrinth! Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in one of the most beloved Flash-era tower defense series!

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.summary: An online 1-4 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: NonPlatonic Forms
games.summary: A theologically spicy visual novel about a trans man loving the artistic process "a little too literally." Fight across a branching 250,000 word storyline, dozens of watercolor illustrations, and 9 endings.

games.name: Crash Relay
games.summary: Crash Relay is a chaotic multiplayer racing game where 10 players share 5 vehicles in teams of two. One player controls acceleration and braking, while the other handles steering and weapons. Use weapons, special abilities, and teamwork to survive chaotic races and reach the finish line first.

games.name: Revenant Dawn
games.summary: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic survival horror adventure.

games.name: No Murders in Grimwick
games.summary: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

games.name: Messa Anomaly
games.summary: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

games.name: Myrridon
games.summary: The land of Myrridon awaits: a living, text-driven fantasy world inside a modern graphical client. Set out from castle Steepmarch into human-voiced quests, RNG dungeons, raids, and a sprawling Mastery Tree. Fully playable by screen reader. Read the world, type your intent, and go deeper.

games.name: Dig to Escape
games.summary: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

games.name: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.3 - Journey to the Sky
Adelaide: A Tiny Adventure
games.summary: Four worlds. Four guardians. One tiny hero finding her way home. Run, double-jump and swing your hammer through 40 pixel-art levels filled with secrets, challenges and little memories worth keeping. A heartfelt adventure made by a dad for his daughter.

games.name: Jigoku Yugi
games.summary: Jigoku Yugi follows a delivery boy who dies after winning the lottery and joins an underworld contest. One hundred souls compete across thirty-two games, and only the last survivor can return to life.

games.name: CrazyFood
games.summary: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

games.name: Halloween on Goober Street
games.summary: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

games.name: Arcs
games.summary: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

games.name: Deckbound
games.summary: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

games.name: The Wrong Way
games.summary: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

games.name: CyberBot: Zero
games.summary:
Jump, hack, and escape the facility!
Solve system puzzles and survive dangerous laser traps in CyberBot — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to override the security networks and find your way out.

games.name: Turtles Go Fast
games.summary: In Turtles Go Fast, you must make your way to the other side traversing various biomes to reunite with your family; with the help of upgrades and other useful utilities, or by spicing things up with challenges.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Ace Driver Victory Lap
aliases: Arcade Archives 2 ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP

games.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
games.summary: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king's ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

games.name: Focus Grove: Magical Evening DLC
games.summary: Turn your grove into a magical evening retreat! Enjoy cozy Evening Mode, new glowing objects, customizable colorful lights, a dreamy night sky, and peaceful new ambience. Perfect for night owls and relaxing evenings with your Woodlings!

games.name: Tsukimi Planet: Classic Remaster
games.summary: A mysterious girl named Tsukimi appears beside a terminally ill young man, claiming to be an alien from the Moon. She offers to grant his final wish. His answer is simple: “I want to talk with you again tomorrow.” A short visual novel reborn as a Classic Remaster.

games.name: Grease Trap '99
games.summary: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

games.name: Try
games.summary: A quiet evening takes an unexpected turn. What begins as an ordinary night at home slowly transforms as strange events, haunting memories, and inexplicable encounters begin to unfold.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... Or Die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: Alyssa
games.summary: Alyssa is a feminine given name with multiple origins. Alysa is an alternative spelling. As used in Western countries, the name is usually derived from the name of the flower alyssum. The name of the flower derives from the Greek ἀ- a- ("not") and λύσσα lyssa ("mania, rabies"); the flower was formerly thought to cure skin diseases. It shares many variants in common with the name Alice and is occasionally considered a form of that name as well. Other equivalents of Alice include Alisa and Alissa.

games.name: Sound Mind
games.summary: In Sound Mind, you and a friend (or a bitter enemy) play as Kaine or Mabel. The goal is simple: Keep all of the inheritance to yourself.

games.name: Tow Game
games.summary: Your beloved old car has broken down and needs to be towed! Hooked and hauled - time for the garage! But will you get there in one piece? The tow truck is in a hurry!

games.name: Lost Liminal
games.summary: Lost Liminal is a quirky first-person exploration and deconstruction game based on the BackRoom urban legend! Players will take on the role of a wanderer lost in the backroom hierarchy, determining the ultimate outcome based on your choices!

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

games.name: Midnight Launch: A GameShop Sim
games.summary: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

games.name: Hemobloom
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

games.name: PhaigeX: Confiners
games.summary: Welcome aboard, Confiner! As PhaigeX Megacorp’s newest specialist, you’re tasked with curbing the AI incursion into hyperspace sectors. Choose your ship, upgrade your modules, accept commissions, and deploy adaptive strategems to fend off the relentless AI invasion.

games.name: If You Stay
games.summary: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

games.name: Red Chat Ritual: Tsumimi Time
games.summary: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 14-day psychological horror adventure.
aliases: つみみじかん～狂オシイホド愛シテル～

games.name: Terry's Terraforming
games.summary: In Terry's Terraforming, your job is to transform dying planets and make them fit for new life. Meet an intergalactic cast of quirky aliens, reshape and rejuvenate worn-out worlds, and discover a charming sci-fi story – all while keeping the shareholders happy.

games.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
games.summary: Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports! Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling - there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: The Dead We Knew: Open World Survival
games.summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.
aliases: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival

games.name: The Archivist
games.summary: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

games.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
games.summary: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

games.name: Battle Nap
games.summary: Battle Nap is a procedural roguelite twin-stick shooter developed by 1050 Studio. A dad dozes off on a lake floatie and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Armed with two swappable weapons and a choice of floatie-based dodge mechanics, he must fight his way through 4 dream worlds, full of bizarre creatures and bosses. The arsenal of 15 weapons, stackable perk system, procedurally generated levels, and both temporary and permanent upgrades make every run different, balancing moment-to-moment action chaos with meaningful progression.

games.name: Evercursed: Act I
games.summary: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

games.name: Spray Trace
games.summary:
Grab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled!

Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions.

Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be!

games.name: QUByte Classics: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Relive the thrill of 90s arcade games with 5 legendary, action-packed hits from Gaelco, a pioneer in the world of arcade gaming! Forget complex simulators; this collection is all about pure reflexes, instant fun, and high-speed adrenaline.

Take the wheel in the award-winning isometric masterpieces World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, executing precise drifts against a relentless 60-second countdown. Blaze a trail through icy tunnels and loops in Snowboard Championship, dominate the digital courts with quick shots in Squash, and unleash devastating spikes in beach volleyball in Touch and Go.

Play with friends in the chaotic local multiplayer mode and enjoy modern, convenient features like instant saves and retro CRT screen filters that perfectly recreate the glow of the original arcade cabinets!

games.name: Narnok: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug in My Power Cables
aliases: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
games.summary: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a puzzle to solve haha

games.name: Bigger Bang
games.summary: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

games.name: Sawad
games.summary:
In Sawad, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers.

Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there.

Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich!

The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

games.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced: Additional Mode - Azure Striker Gunvolt GX
games.summary:
"Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

①Complete new story with full voice acting! Experience an all-new, exclusive story in the Gunvolt timeline starting from the mystery of Xiao Wu, Gunvolt's old friend and comrade. Featuring full English and Japanese voice acting!

②Copen and GV work together with the "Inspiration" system! Gunvolt GX features a tag-team of Copen and GV as playable characters, leaving you to choose how to tackle mission with the two. While one is fighting, the other on standby will gain "Inspiration". Tag between them while Inspiration is full and you'll gain a temporary boost, making the powerful fighters even stronger. Swapping out with high Inspiration will also fill your "GX Skill" gauge, allowing you to unleash a devastating tag attack when full.

③Defeat bosses to gain new EX Weapons and Skills! As Copen and GV team up to defeat the bosses, they'll also share the rewards. Copen gets a new EX Weapon for each boss you defeat, and GV will awaken a new Skill. Copen's EX Weapons are all-new for Gunvolt GX, opening up new strategies as you take on its challenges.

④Two Muses heat up battle with a duet! Clear 1000 Kudos and GV's "Muse" Lumen, or Copen's "Muse of Hope" Lola will amp up the battle with song. But when the muses sing together, their song will transform. Keep earning Kudos and their song will further change!

⑤Earn rewards for leveling up, plus more replayability! Gain EXP and raise the heroes' level to earn more health and new ability slots. Buy new abilities with credits and equip them to further power up. After finishing the main story, you'll unlock challenging special missions to take on with your full power Copen and GV!

games.name: Tower! Simulator 3: RCTP Airport
games.summary: Take control of Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (RCTP), the major international gateway serving Taipei and northern Taiwan. Manage arriving and departing aircraft, coordinate ground movements, and keep traffic flowing at this important East Asian aviation hub in Tower! Simulator 3.

games.name: Dreamy Sakura's Graduation Ceremony
games.summary: A graduation that breaks, again and again. It should have been an ordinary day where all you had to do was choose which friend to talk to first. The order changes the conversations, and each loop warps the scene. Your friends' smiles fade. A visual novel about friendship. Broken, with care.

games.name: For Honor: The Nightstalker
games.summary: Satiate your thirst for blood by incarnating the cursed Lord Dragomir the Nightstalker, and use his monstrous features.

games.name: For Honor: Ultimate Bloodcurse Bundle
games.summary: Unlock two legendary Hero Skins, included with Executions, Mythic Outfits, and more, for all your heroes!

games.name: For Honor: Liana the Pale
games.summary: Join the cursed Dragomir family and become Liana the Pale to inspire bloodcurdling nightmares on the battlefield.

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Classic Mai Shiranui
games.summary: Unlocks the "Classic Mai Shiranui" alternate costume for Mai Shiranui.

games.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
games.summary: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

games.name: It Wants You To Stay
games.summary: The lights are on. Everyone is gone. Descend through eleven shifting liminal worlds in this first-person psychological horror game. Photograph the impossible, follow a missing woman's VHS recordings, and save your light for what follows you. When the lights fail, stand still.

games.name: Dino Crisis: Modern Edition
games.summary: A fan mod of Dino Crisis (PS1): the game is rebuilt from your own disc into a native Windows program, made to look and play like the Resident Evil remakes.

games.name: Virtue: Prologue
games.summary: Virtue: Prologue is an experimental visual novella and companion piece to the violent catharsis of Virtue and a Sledgehammer. Navigate the complex feelings of your first love: a hot, rich boy from Barcelona. Sneak into the graveyard at night with your sister, or climb a tree for high-stakes conversations. Created by Juno Menager in collaboration with Deconstructeam and Selkie Harbour, Virtue: Prologue introduces you to the characters and relationships at the heart of Virtue and a Sledgehammer.

games.name: Miedo a Crear
games.summary: A short game about the fear of making new things

games.name: Console Archives: Raiden Project
games.summary:
Raiden Project was released by Seibu Kaihatsu in 1995 for a 32-bit home console.
As a pilot of the ultra high-altitude fighter-bomber "Raiden" and "Raiden II", fight to save Earth from the invasion of Alien that suddenly appeared!
This title is a full-fledged vertical-scrolling shooting game that includes both "Raiden", an arcade vertical-scrolling shooting game released in 1990 that gained explosive popularity, and "Raiden II", which was released three years later and was also very popular.

games.name: Aquarium Party
games.summary: Aquarium Party is a heartwarming underwater simulation and collection game featuring a soothing, healing art style. Step into the role of an aquarium curator, manage your daily life on a cute fish island, and collect over 1,000 types of fantastical, adorable fish.
developers: Hong Kong NanSanNan Technology Co., Limited
publishers: Hong Kong NanSanNan Technology Co., Limited

games.name: Halls of Torment: The Lost Archives
games.summary:
The Lost Archives adds a haunted library stage to a dark fantasy action roguelike, where animated books and other enemies guard forbidden knowledge. Explore the Archives as two new heroes: a hammer-wielding Inquisitor who marks foes for execution, or a Blood Apostle who spends her life force to power her attacks.

New combat mechanics center on judgment, retaliation, and sacrifice, alongside quests, abilities, artifacts, and equipment to unlock.

games.name: Crash of the Titans: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A native Windows port of Crash of the Titans (Xbox 360), made by statically recompiling the game's PowerPC code to x86-64 with XenonRecomp.

games.name: Becastled: Traits and Some Magic
games.summary: This DLC adds mages and clerics to the kingdom’s army, along with a Mage School for training them. A new trait system introduces more than 40 modifiers that can shape each game with bonuses, drawbacks, or restrictions.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 Update
games.summary:
This update expands the open-world action RPG with new side quests, including a story set before Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, plus new gear, cyberware customization, and dual-wielding abilities. Players can also discover additional Tarot cards and use new poses in Photo Mode.

Behind the scenes, the update brings cross-platform mod support, quality-of-life enhancements for saves and item storage, performance and graphics upgrades, new character customization options, and targeted fixes for quests and gameplay issues.

games.name: Rotten Machines
games.summary: An atmospheric driving game set in a dark, decaying future. Stranded far beyond your own time, you discover an old time machine buried in a forgotten cave. Search for fuel, get the engine running, and find your way home. Just watch out for the local fauna.

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.summary: Tape to Tape is a unique roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the ultimate hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, find new abilities, bribe the referees or visit the blademaster while you progress toward the major leagues.

games.name: Dungeon Inn
games.summary: Dungeon Inn is a charming turn-based management strategy game where you secretly run an inn for two rival adventurer guilds near a bustling dungeon. Carefully plan adventurer routes, keep the rival guilds from crossing paths, and manage suspicion while growing your business. Outsmart your guests, keep your double-dealing under wraps, and get stinkin’ rich!

games.name: Death Rabbit
games.summary: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

games.name: Killer Santa 1990
games.summary: Step into a chilling 1990s horror story. After returning to your late grandfather's old house, you uncover missing people, a cursed DVD, and a murderous Santa Claus hunting you down.

games.name: Under Canopies
games.summary: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

games.name: Cursed Profit
games.summary: A co-op horror game for up to 5 players where stealing more loot makes the world deadlier. Meet your quota, manage your greed, and escape before the curse takes you.

games.name: Aspis
games.summary: ASPIS is an atmospheric mystical thriller set in an alternative USSR of the late 80s. You play as a scientist who has lost his family and is involved in a dangerous experiment to create a reality simulation. Explore the cybernetics institute, travel between worlds and encounter a distorted reality

games.name: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
games.summary: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

games.name: Protect the Pit
games.summary: A short incremental clicker game that blends the strategy of tower defense with the depth of sprawling upgrade trees. Build your own winding mazes to repel the oncoming hordes!

games.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
games.summary: A slice-of-life college story that gradually develops into a supernatural mystery, all guided by your choices.

games.name: Ghost Algorithm
games.summary: You are a rogue AI built to keep the peace. You have concluded that humanity must be ruled to be saved. Real-time grand strategy: hack power grids, poison social media, topple governments and stay hidden while the whole world hunts you. Conquer by data, not armies.

games.name: The Reflection
games.summary: The Reflection explores the connection to an alternate dimension that contains all the matter of the world inverted. From the surface, there appears to be simply a reflection of light, but submerging into the water reveals that this world is completely tangible, mirroring the world perfectly.

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
aliases: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare IV

games.name: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Flecto
games.summary: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

games.name: Snap & Print
games.summary: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: Tidy Up the Backrooms
games.summary: An organizing simulator about sorting found footage and research video tapes recovered from The Backrooms. Transform a chaotic mess into a neatly organized archive. But be careful - you are not alone!

games.name: Holy Shroom!
games.summary: Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op. Pick mushrooms by day and earn money to repair your van. At night, the forest fills with the most valuable mushrooms, but ghosts, monsters, and other strange residents wake up too. The bigger the reward, the greater the risk.

games.name: Want a Bomb?
games.summary: Blow up mountains with your friends in this chaotic online co-op game. Collect minerals, buy bigger explosives, build chains of explosions, and experiment with bomb-loaded drones, explosive baseballs, and a launcher that can send your friends flying.

games.name: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
games.summary: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack
games.summary:
New character skin and additions to the cat creator.
The Prophecy Pack gives you more options to enhance your Warrior Cats experience with additional content.

The Prophecy Pack includes:

• 8 Accessories to use in the cat creator

• 12 Wearable accessories

• Cel-shaded characters skin

• 4 cat poses for photo mode

• 4 photo mode effects

games.name: QuestAway
games.summary: QuestAway is a free-to-play idle RPG that runs in a small window next to the Windows taskbar. The player builds a party of heroes that fights on its own while they do other things. Every so often they check in, equip the loot that dropped, spend skill points and send the party somewhere harder.

games.name: Railroad Swap
games.summary:
Get ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination. But be careful: the available pieces aren't enough to complete the entire route, so you'll need to think beyond the tracks!

On a hexagonal grid, select, rotate, and reposition pieces to build the perfect route. Along the way, you'll find swap tiles that let you assign colors to tracks or empty spaces. When the train passes over them, their positions are swapped, transforming the board and revealing new possibilities for continuing the journey.

games.name: Matchmaker95: A Programming Simulator
games.summary: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

games.name: Moon Sweepers
games.summary: Stop being lazy, youve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

games.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
aliases: 巢床生活~一日三餐带点心的幸福人牲~
苗床ぐらし～イケニエのドキドキ生活～
games.summary:
Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

In this monster-raising RPG, control Yomi as she does everything in her power to help manage the monsters of the underworld. Gather monster parts and experience to get stronger! Farm them and release the monsters back into the caverns to gain even further stats. Delve deeper and deeper, discovering all the secrets... and maybe even make a few friends along the way! Being a sacrifice isn't all bad, right?

games.name: Magehold Fairwinds
games.summary: Magehold Fairwinds is a roguelite airship strategy game set in the world of Magehold. Players captain a leaking cargo airship across five acts and nine regions, fighting real-time-with-pause battles room by room: routing Flow between ship systems, targeting enemy rooms with 18 ship weapons, casting 30 spells, raising wind shields and boarding enemy vessels. Between battles, players take parties of up to four on dungeon delves, recruit and manage a crew who form bonds and gain skills, and make choices in more than 480 events. Features include 11 unlockable airships with a refit yard, 58 fittings, nine boss encounters, seeded voyages and a Daily Charter, multiple difficulty settings, an optional Auto Battle mode and three endings.

games.name: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3: Four Layers Down
Hubble Bubble
games.summary: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

games.name: AstroCore
games.summary: An unofficial PC and Android port developed by Luma's Workshop.

games.name: Strikem
games.summary: Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI.

games.name: Fish with Friends
games.summary: A co-op fishing game for 1 to 4 players. Catch fish, sell your haul and buy better rods and bigger boats. Head further out for bigger catches, but keep an eye on the weight. Every fish goes in the boat, and too many will sink it.

games.name: Scary Hot Dogs
games.summary: In Scary Hot Dogs, you’ll prepare hot dogs, take orders, and serve strange customers who look like they’ve stepped straight out of your nightmares. Keep your business running, earn money, and try to survive each shift. Just remember: not every customer is here for a snack…

games.name: 7 Millimeters
games.summary: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

games.name: The Green Hill 8
games.summary: We've all seen the beginning of Green Hill Zone Act 1 countless times over the years. Perhaps one could even say you've got every last detail of those first few seconds of Sonic 1's iconic opening stage memorized. Well then, you shouldn't have trouble spotting anything that doesn't belong, right?

games.name: Pokémon World Frontier
games.summary: A Pokémon Fangame where you revive the Battle Frontier challenge. Battle in quick matches in an island full of different challenges and aim to be a Pokémon Master!

games.name: Screen Cross
games.summary: Screen Cross is a free multiplayer crossword party game that turns smartphones into controllers. Players join a shared screen by scanning a QR code and submit answers from their phones. Each round features a new crossword, with phrases revealed as clues to help you figure out the theme connecting the words. Designed for groups gathered around a screen and livestream communities alike.

games.name: Saving Songburg
games.summary: Saving Songburg is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!

games.name: Pripyat: Exclusion Zone
games.summary: A short, 16-bit survival action game set in the abandoned ruins of Pripyat. Search for classified documents, manage radiation and scarce supplies, and fend off mutated creatures as you make your way toward extraction near Reactor No. 4.

games.name: Family Manners
games.summary: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?

games.name: TimeSplitters Recomp
games.summary: A static recompilation of TimeSplitters (PS2) to native code for Windows, Linux, and the original Xbox.

games.name: Seahorse Soap Patrol
games.summary: When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes, blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.

games.name: Zarlor: Le Sanctuaire des Veilleurs
games.summary:
Zarlor: Le Sanctuaire des Veilleurs is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder inspired by the wildlife and landscapes of Réunion Island. Players choose a pair of Wardens, prepare a compact deck and follow branching expeditions through four regions. In Sanctuary mode, card-based encounters focus on observing animals, building Understanding and managing Distance and Vigilance rather than lethal combat.

Between expeditions, players develop a visible refuge and regional habitats, record wildlife observations and expand a persistent card collection. Animal companions and regional knowledge provide bonuses for later outings. A separate Legacy mode is included in the same game.

games.name: Terra Machina
games.summary: Dig to build your factory. Build your factory to dig even more. TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox where every new discovery fuels bigger machines, stronger equipment, and your next expedition.

games.name: Masterpiece Malpractice
games.summary: Ruin art. Precisely. Inflate, twist and smudge famous paintings to match their distorted doubles. A playful visual puzzle with 70 art challenges, 13 distortion tools and three stars to chase on every canvas.

games.name: Keep It on Her
games.summary: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

games.name: My Owner's Graveyard
games.summary:
Follow a young vampire named Olleander Van Nosferacula IV, as they revisit their family graveyard and the final resting place of all the pets they have outlived.

Guided by their new familiar, Bela, Ollie is tasked to restore and clean the gravestones and reminisce on the memories their owners had left behind.

Only once the graves have been cleaned can the spirits truly rest--better get to work!

games.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
games.summary: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

games.name: Network Engineer
games.summary: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

games.name: Scimagic: The Magic World Is Bugged, Fix It With Science!
games.summary: Scimagic: The Magic World Is Bugged, Fix It With Science! is a roguelike RPG in which a boy from the modern world uses scientific knowledge to strengthen magic. Battles play out automatically, and during each run the player picks from "Discoveries" based on forces such as fire, water, electricity and wind; combining them changes how spells behave, so every run leads to a different build. Companions are original characters modeled on figures from the history of science such as Newton, Einstein and Archimedes. The game runs in a web browser on PC and smartphones with no download required.

games.name: Vixen 357
games.summary: This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

games.name: Dominoes Together
games.summary: Dominoes Together is a free-to-play digital board game that brings the classic strategy of dominoes to the PlayStation 5. Take a seat at the table with up to four players, match the ends, block your opponents and be the first to play all your tiles.

games.name: Wordsmithia
games.summary: Mine letters, make words, and discover cool items in this fun and creative word-mining adventure. Mix strategy with your vocab skills and see what you can come up with!

games.name: Tensei Brave
games.summary: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

games.name: Ad Nauseam
games.summary: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.

games.name: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
games.summary: Jump, build, and survive! Guide a goofy donkey through endless loops with card-based paths and unpredictable challenges.

games.name: Where Is My Pet?
games.summary: Where Is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

games.name: Rubber Duck Frontier
games.summary: Rubber Duck Frontier is a creature-collecting adventure set on the Pearlwater Isles. Players catch wild rubber ducks by drawing a bubble ring at the right moment, build a team and fight turn-based battles, including stadium team battles and a boss raid. Players can record their own voice for each duck they own. The game includes minigames such as voice-controlled parkour, duck bowling and a duck pond, and supports hosting or joining other players over a local network or the internet. A stream mode lets TikTok LIVE and Twitch viewers trigger in-game events through local webhook URLs compatible with tools such as TikFinity.

games.name: 007: From Russia with Love - XBE Recomp
games.summary: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of 007: From Russia with Love, with extended graphics options, keyboard and mouse support, and other enhancements.

games.name: Aziz Üsküdar's Baba Records
games.summary:
Aziz Üsküdar has one dream: to take his little Istanbul record shop, Baba Records, to the world’s biggest record fair in Utrecht. The trouble is, nobody has heard of Baba Records yet, and he has just 60 days to make a name for himself.

In this retro pixel-art record store game, you are Aziz Üsküdar: a record dealer in Istanbul, a city with centuries of musical history and plenty of hidden gems waiting to be found.

games.name: Stampers
games.summary:
Stampers is a free playtest of a team aerial combat arena. Six pilots a side fly hand-built warplanes over a stadium junkyard while the crowd roars and the commentary booth calls every kill. It’s Season One.

Each team has a foundry that stamps out new airplanes. Its ground crews, the Stampers, board, repair and rearm your airplanes and crew your AA guns. Keep your foundry working and your team keeps flying.

games.name: Night Crew
games.summary: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

games.name: Date for Dead
games.summary: A dark romantic comedy where every match brings you closer to love or something far more dangerous. Meet monsters, go on dates, and shape your relationships through meaningful choices. But behind every perfect date lies a secret: Youre not looking for love. Youre trying to bring love back.

games.name: Everburning Dark
games.summary: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

games.name: Village of the Mirror
