games.summary: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

games.name: Homeless Kiosk Simulator
games.summary: You work the night shift inside a small aid booth. People arrive at your window asking for help. Food. Water. Medicine. Sometimes… things that don’t belong in a donation box. Every box you prepare makes the night worse.

games.name: SCP: Project Pneuma
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

games.name: Outcast Tales
games.summary: Assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions , and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!

games.name: Reka
games.summary: Start your life as an apprentice witch to the legendary Baba Jaga and venture across a mysterious, natural landscape with your companion, chicken-legged cottage. Develop your magical powers, customise your home, craft potions, help or hinder villagers find your way in the world.

games.name: Sincognito
games.summary: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

games.name: Timeless Rain
games.summary: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

games.name: Operator: Observation
games.summary: Operator: Observation is a Game based on the "Watch Rooms, and Report Anomalies" Concept of "Observation Duty" but now the Anomalies are way more aggressive and have way more ways to make you lose your Mind. Your Instructor will follow you on the way to becoming a good Operator.

games.name: Calvar: The Darkest Gate
games.summary: First-person horror survival game that plunges players into a dark and disturbing world. As Leonard Valentin, you must fight against supernatural threats while uncovering the mystery behind the cursed piano and the sinister plans of a dark cult.

games.name: Pao Pao
games.summary: Welcome to PAO PAO, a charming seaside town waiting for you. Cook up culinary delights, go fishing, grow crops and create your own cozy home here.

games.name: Cardtographer
games.summary:
Cardtographer is a stylized 3D-Graphics Roguelike Deckbuilder, in which you choose one or more Champions to fight the evil, which has overcome the lands.

During your adventure your chosen champions gain gold and experience during the fights and enhance their deck to overcome their opposing enemy finally.

You also can ally with your frineds in online coop.

games.name: Dig
games.summary: Dig, discover, and compete in this multiplayer digging adventure! Unearth rare treasures, sell your findings, upgrade your gear, and uncover hidden secrets beneath the surface. Who will dig the deepest?

games.name: Giggleland
games.summary: Giggleland is full of adventures and fun! Will you be the next to discover why our guests are always smiling? This game is not suitable for children.

games.name: Breach Signal
games.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 player co-op cosmic horror game. As a recruit of the FNA, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

games.name: Fishing Up
games.summary: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

games.name: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
games.summary: You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil. Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night. Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

games.name: Fangtopia
games.summary: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

games.name: Flipping Phantom
games.summary: Flip your way through this 2D pixel-art, puzzle-platformer with *no dedicated jump button*. As a ghost, navigate through the maze-like levels by phasing into the floor, falling upwards through solid ground, and controlling your fall speed with your float ability in order to avoid spooky obstacles.

games.name: The Mailroom
games.summary:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

games.name: Recycling Shift
games.summary: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

games.name: Deliverance Protocol: Ironrot
games.summary: Atmospheric first-person retro horror. You are a courier — a disposable tool of the System. Sort, deliver, collect archives. Obey… or uncover what lies inside.

games.name: Residuum
games.summary: Residuum is weathered rock that is not transported by erosion, contributing in time to the formation of soil. It is distinguished from other types of parent material in that it is composed solely of mineral, not organic, material, and it remains in place rather than being moved by the action of wind, water, or gravity.

games.name: Night Plane
games.summary: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

games.name: Scramble Knights Online
games.summary: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

games.name: Droste Detective
games.summary: You're stuck in an office corridor with no exit that has a painting of the same corridor on the wall. But then you notice the corridor in the painting is not quite the same. You decide to inspect the painting...

games.name: Veyora
games.summary: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with elements of farming, survival, and adventure. In a vast, stylized world, you decide where to live and what to create – whether near a bustling town, in the lonely mountains, or by a peaceful lake. Each location offers its own resources, challenges, and opportunities.

games.name: Drive With Friends
games.summary: Drive With Friends is a chaotic co‑op driving game where one car is shared by multiple players. As one of the top friendslop games, teamwork and rivalry collide on a mysterious island. Can your crew reach the PEAK of madness and escape together? Only the best bros survive the ride!

games.name: Redast
games.summary: Redast: Define the first-person co-op Horror-Observation genre. Observe 50 unique entities in the world's most unsettling corners and identify the unknown. An experience unlike any other, a hunt like no other. Darkness awaits.

games.name: Punch Upon a Time
games.summary: Punch Upon a Time is the party fighting game where you play alongside your friends. Either solo or as a team, fight as the biggest names from tales and myths to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary: Оne day your life changes dramatically and you become a hostage of your own home. Your task is to survive but to do this you need to get outside.

games.name: Unending Aqua
games.summary: Explore a mysterious tropical island resort. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress. Survive against dangerous enemies. Piece together the story of the hotel and uncover the dark secrets that it holds.

games.name: Sign: Broken Kether
games.summary: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

games.name: Galactic Bounty
games.summary: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

games.name: Eyes Wide Open
games.summary: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

games.name: Possessed Kingdom
games.summary: Defend your kingdom or rush the enemy in this Deckbuilding RTS. Build your base, scale your economy, and draw custom paths for your troops to break enemy defenses. Win battles, steal the king's cards, and build the ultimate deck.

games.name: Space Savory
games.summary: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

games.name: Leikkaus
games.summary:
LEIKKAUS ("The Cut" in Finnish) is a horror game where all you are trying to do is collect your student benefit. Living in a dystopian world might not be easy, but at least something is coming your way. Or... is it her? Little did you know, your benefit is not the only thing about to be cut!

✂ Retro Horror: Explore the pixelated, dark, abandoned corridors of the old University building.

✂ Tense Gameplay: Your hunter will not give up on their prey easily.

✂ Cut for perfection: About one hour of entertainment and you should have your benefit... for now.

games.name: Ecstatica II
games.summary: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

games.name: Ecstatica
games.summary: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

games.name: Hunter's Moon
games.summary: Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical narrative folk-horror set over the course of one fateful night. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, evade capture by the witch hunters, and eavesdrop on a characterful cast of regular folk worn down by war and misfortune. Discover the secrets of this dysfunctional village on the brink as you embody an accused “witch” on the run for her life.

games.name: Scopa Sweep
games.summary: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

games.name: Crack
games.summary: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. Crack is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

games.name: Two-Fifteen
games.summary: A first-person PSX horror game. Your baby is gone, and the things wearing your in-laws' faces are still in the house. Get the lights back on, hide when you hear footsteps on the stairs, and never trust a voice that sounds like someone you love.

games.name: Huntsman: Protect & Serve
games.summary: Huntsman: Protect & Serve is a DLC where you discover a hidden section of Atherton Labs teeming with ravenous creatures. Unlike the base game's evasion gameplay, you're armed and must stand your ground against multiple threats. Combat requires strategic ammunition management, careful reload timing, and awareness that gunshots attract more creatures. Puzzle-solving is essential to escape the facility's depths.

games.name: Boarding Denied
games.summary: A document-inspection game at the end of the world. A meteorite hits in 12 days. At Boarding Window 7 you check tickets, IDs and medical papers, then stamp BOARD or DENIED. Seats are few, the rules change daily, and your family waits at home for a place.

games.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
games.summary: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

games.name: Eternal Chamber
games.summary: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

games.name: Kleromancy
games.summary: Awaken as Unit-01 in the Ark of Theseus. In this roguelike, your cards are 3D dice: roll them, spend energy, and conquer 7 corrupted biomes. Overcome narrative events and minigames, survive multi-phase bosses, and expand your generational station with every victory.

games.name: Split Out
games.summary: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

games.name: Forged Cards
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

games.name: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
games.summary: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

games.name: Stay With Me
games.summary: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

games.name: ShredDead
games.summary: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

games.name: The Halloway Haunting
games.summary: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

games.name: Legacy of Mind
games.summary: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

games.name: Hack and Slash Fury 2
aliases: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
games.summary: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

games.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean Into It.
games.summary: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

games.name: Night Drive: Anomaly
games.summary: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

games.name: Idle Hoops
games.summary: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

games.name: Tiny Fishing Club
games.summary: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

games.name: Wren Falls
games.summary: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

games.name: Gacha Chaos: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and slap capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

games.name: Hirugao
games.summary: A mystery psychological thriller visual novel set in 2000. Follow a serial murder case through many eyes, including the woman, the man, and the detective. With live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters, every choice branches the story, and one wrong move means game over.

games.name: Chimpy Protects
games.summary: At night you feel something ominous, you must be courageous and brave to find Chimpy. Something is watching and spirits are haunting you but Chimpy will protect, the soothing light will guide you and he will finally help you sleep.

games.name: OddBrawl
games.summary: OddBrawl is a free 2D fighting game played in the web browser and linked to Twitch. Players sign in with their Twitch account, answer ten questions and get a unique fighter from one of +13 species, including goblins, ogres, skeletons and mushrooms. Fights play out as animated duels; at key points, Destiny Moments let the player choose how to turn the fight, from playing it safe to risking everything. The game is built around short daily sessions: three fights a day, stat points to assign, equipment to find and forge, a community boss and seasonal rankings. Each partner streamer leads a clan that viewers can join.

games.name: Heavy in the Hand
games.summary: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

games.name: Our Church and Halloween RPG
aliases: Our Church and Halloween RPG - Episode One
games.summary: A Christian-themed, story driven, black and white pixel art, Japanese styled RPG video game in the Our Church and Halloween franchise by Breakthrough Gaming!

games.name: Skullf!
games.summary: You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf action! After another hilarious night terrorizing locals it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

games.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & the Ghost Guitar
games.summary: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

games.name: 3 Switch Problem
games.summary: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

games.name: Mahjong Rush
games.summary: Mahjong Rush is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

games.name: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
games.summary: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

games.name: The Spectacular Evermore
games.summary: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

games.name: Room Zero
games.summary: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

games.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
games.summary: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

games.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
games.summary: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

games.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
games.summary: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

games.name: Towertower
games.summary: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

games.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
games.summary: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

games.name: TV Station Tycoon
games.summary: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

games.name: Your Friends vs. Hidebehind
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

games.name: Wild Heroes: Fight Together
games.summary: Team up with up to 3 friends in an online co-op action roguelite. Carve a path into the living Wild, battle monster packs in bramble arenas, topple three colossal bosses and come back stronger after every expedition.

games.name: Spook & Sell
games.summary: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

games.name: Hot Mic
games.summary: A party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 friends online. Give a museum bust a voice or do your best cockerel, then vote for a favourite before you find out who made it. Free to play. If anyone at the table has VIP, everyone gets the full game, your own pictures included.

games.name: Reunion Fate
games.summary: Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe. Use the flame to guide you through the darkness. Explore familiar and unfamiliar places. Hide from them. No one will tell you what you want to hear.

games.name: Tidy Farm
games.summary: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

games.name: Jarkeeper
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

games.name: Chain of Command
games.summary: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

games.name: Beast Hunt
games.summary: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

games.name: Wake Inside
games.summary: Wake Inside is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious mansion where something is listening. Explore the house, uncover its secrets, and find a way out without revealing yourself to whatever is inside.

games.name: Playable Archive
games.summary:
An archive from an anonymous whistleblower has surfaced containing unexplainable events. Viewing the contents of this material, as well as the exposure to and use of various symbols within have not been risk assessed.

A New England couple stumbles upon a mysterious object during home renovations. The anonymous report claims no such object was retrieved alongside the obtained footage.

games.name: ByeByeObake!
games.summary: “Those who can see can't shoot. Those who can shoot can't see!” An asymmetric online co-op action game for 2-8 players. Exorcists and Spirit Companions call out to banish the evil spirits you can't see. Friendly fire included: yes, you can exorcise your teammates too.

games.name: The Machinist
games.summary: A knock at the door could save a life—or end yours. The Machinist is a psychological horror management game where you must keep a train running, manage its passengers, and survive whatever waits outside.

games.name: Stare
games.summary: You are alone in an unfamiliar place that grows increasingly restless with your every step. Find and break all the seals before you draw too much attention...

games.name: The Gassal
games.summary: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

games.name: Tower 6: Last Signal
games.summary: Alone in a remote forest watchtower, your first night on duty turns into a tense fight to understand the signals coming through the radio. Watch the treeline, respond to unsettling events, and survive whatever is moving in the dark.

games.name: Shopska Salad
games.summary: Shopska Salad is a first-person tower defense game set in the Bulgarian countryside. Players prepare traps and repair defenses by day, then use a shotgun to protect a bowl of shopska salad from creatures inspired by Bulgarian folklore at night. The goal is to keep the salad fresh for seven nights, playing solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

games.name: The Circus That Never Left
games.summary: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

games.name: On My Watch
games.summary: On My Watch is a first-person psychological horror game set during an overnight hospital security shift. Monitor surveillance cameras, patrol empty halls, investigate disturbing events, and question what you can trust as the hospital slowly becomes something much worse.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire: The Discarded
games.summary: DLC for the 2026 horror card game Forbidden Solitaire, adding to the game's 1990s lost-game lore while introducing some new mechanics.

games.name: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D
games.summary: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!

games.name: Munshi Meadows
games.summary: Hatch a Munshi from an egg and raise it your way. Train it on the toys in your garden, get to know its personality, and see which of 34 forms it grows into. Then race it across 70 courses, take on fights, cage matches and puzzle trials, build it a garden, and bring your friends along over Steam or a local network.

games.name: Nitro Nonsense
games.summary: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8 or up to 16 players, locally or online. Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round.

games.name: MemeticBox
games.summary: A physics-driven, voxel-based sandbox game. The gameplay features detailed destruction and dismemberment mechanics where characters are constructed layer-by-layer from individual blocks that can be shot, sliced, or blown apart. Players can manipulate characters and the environment using various traps, environmental hazards, and specialized powers. Additionally, the game includes alternative gameplay scenarios such as police raids, wave-based zombie survival modes, and fully destructible cities.

games.name: Nothing Belongs Here
games.summary: Nothing Belongs Here is a cozy first-person tidy-up game. Six worlds (a cottage, a wizard tower, a sci-fi lab, a modern flat, a western saloon and a haunted mansion) have collided in one town square, scattering 4,899 belongings across the ground. The player picks up objects, works out which world and which house each one came from, and places it on the one shelf row made for it. Placements and finished rows pay coins, which buy upgrades for carrying more, moving faster and spotting matches. Each house hides a small mini game that rewards a new ability. There is no timer and no fail state.

games.name: The Beast Awoke to Eat Your Darlings
games.summary: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

games.name: Cyber Delivery
games.summary: Take high-risk delivery contracts across Neon Spires. Swing, grind, wall ride, defy gravity to find the fastest, flashiest route, then upgrade your gear, build your reputation, become the city’s legendary courier.

games.name: Divine Frequency
games.summary: A bewildering tale of a trashcan hobo's rise to becoming the universe's most effective security software.

games.name: Mimic
games.summary: A multiplayer survival horror game where players must choose their allies carefully to survive imminent danger. In this social-deduction game players won't know who to trust with their lives.

games.name: Something Something Spaceship
games.summary: Explore a malfunctioning spaceship and retrieve the items needed to fix it, while avoiding a colourful cast of enemies. An isometric platform puzzler inspired by games from the 8-bit era.

games.name: Benny's Backrooms
games.summary: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

games.name: RPG Chess
games.summary: A turn-based RPG, except it’s also chess! Instead of capturing, your pieces fight in battles based on stats, levels and abilities. Build your team and battle friends or CPU's in 1v1 matches!

games.name: Empty Box
games.summary: Psychological horror dating sim for women. Navigate a seemingly perfect school life where every sweet moment hides a lie. Why is the rooftop locked? Why is *they* so obsessed? Why only ‘L’? Your choices shape the truth—and every move is watched. Discover chilling endings.

games.name: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
games.summary: In November 755, the An Shi Rebellion broke out, with most Tang Empire's cities falling to the rebels. You will be appointed as Military Governor of Shuofang to confront them. Form legions and strengthen your power to completely defeat the rebels.

games.name: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services
games.summary: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

games.name: Asylium
games.summary: Trapped in an abandoned mental hospital, you are hunted by a deranged doctor. Hide, fight, and outsmart your enemy as you uncover the dark secrets of the asylum. One wrong move, and you won't survive the night.

games.name: Flashbound
games.summary: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: When the Embers Wake
games.summary: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure with a cause to create awareness about the very current and real threats on wildlife. You play as a red panda that needs to survive amidst environmental challenges, threats and also grief.

games.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
games.summary: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

games.name: Prismarch
games.summary: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy while you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities as you construct a juiced up roster capable of surviving the onslaught! Only - seven mysterious prismatic kings stand before you and the one true crown...

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.

games.name: Slop Simulator
games.summary: Make slop out of trash, junk and pretty much anything and serve it to customers! A chaotic multiplayer first-person fast food simulator with barely any safeguards where you use only "local and fresh" ingredients.

games.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
games.summary: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

games.name: Senior Survival Club
games.summary: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

games.name: Girl & Scarecrow
games.summary: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

games.name: Tiny Capsule Collector
games.summary: Run a cozy capsule shop at the bottom of your screen. Attract cute animal customers, collect charming capsule toys, and build a relaxing, ambient world in this idle sim bringing you small moments of joy while you work. Make your desktop a place you’d rather be.

games.name: Coal Duty
games.summary: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, coordinating over proximity voice chat while something in the dark listens in. Spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners get out. The state does not confirm this.

games.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn
games.summary:
Play 8 Hours Till Dawn solo, or with up to five other friends, a survival party game where you plan out your actions and movements ahead of time. Navigate your survivor to the center room to grab a weapon then make it to an outer room with a window and hopefully stop the infected. Can you last 8 hours till dawn?

During each in-game "hour" you will plan your actions using the 8 Action cards you draw under a timer. This timer gives you the same amount of time every round, but as the night goes on, the decisions stack up, the horde keeps growing, and the weight of every choice gets heavier. Harder difficulties give you even less time.

games.name: Anomalous Veil
games.summary: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

games.name: Vampy's Big Day
games.summary: Sneak through the shadows as a clumsy vampire learning to avoid deadly sunlight… with a little help from a sun fairy. Will you find redemption, or embrace the darkness?

games.name: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol
games.summary: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol is a single-player third-person zombie arena shooter with wave survival, cash drops, bullet-time combat, and over 90 upgrades.

games.name: Magical Girl ER
games.summary: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

games.name: Duel: The Game Show
games.summary: Duel: The Game Show is a 2-player party game show with 30+ mini-games spanning trivia, memory, reflexes, and guessing challenges. Matches use a scoring pyramid across several rounds, with online multiplayer via Steam. Match length is adjustable, from quick 6-round duels to full 15-round marathons.

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
games.summary: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

games.name: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate
games.summary: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

games.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
games.summary: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

games.name: Anti-Anti
games.summary: Anti Anti (Remixes) is a single by the band Bonaparte in collaboration with electronic music producer Markus Lange. It offers a collection of electro, techno and minimal remixes of "Anti Anti", from the band's debut album Too Much. The single was released by Freakz Me Out label in 2009.

games.name: Knell
games.summary: Knell is a surname, and may refer to: Eric Knell (1903–1987), English Anglican Bishop Gary Knell (born 1954), American broadcast executive Phil Knell (1865–1944), American baseball player Wiebke Knell (born 1981), German politician William Knell (actor) (d 1587), Elizabethan English actor William Adolphus Knell (1801–1875), British maritime painter William Calcott Knell (1830–1880), British landscape painter A knell is also the sound of a bell when being rung for a funeral: Death knell

games.name: Veyrasol
games.summary: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

games.name: Rolling Stock
games.summary: Kolejové vozidlo je dopravní prostředek způsobilý k jízdě po koleji. Kolej vozidlo nese a vede. Hlavními konstrukčními celky kolejového vozidla jsou: skříň kolejového vozidla včetně tažného a tlačného ústrojí pojezd kolejového vozidla včetně brzdy, případně pohonu Kolej je tvořena kolejnicovým pásem, nebo častěji dvojicí kolejnicových pásů. Kolejnicové pásy jsou vázány pomocí upevňovadel k podpěrám: pražcům, betonovým blokům, prahům, roštům a dalším.

games.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
games.summary: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

games.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
games.summary: Octbuster is a cozy organization game about closing up an 80s video rental store after hours as an octopus. With the help of your kitten pals, scoop up piles of procedurally placed VHS tapes with real tentacle arms and sort over 10,000 of them however you want. No timer, no score, no way to lose.

games.name: Carcelera
games.summary: Carcelera is an exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

games.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
games.summary: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

games.name: Junkpot
games.summary: A roguelike about bidding blind on sealed storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast — the quota doubles every round.

games.name: 1930: Ink & Bullets
games.summary: A turn-based tactical strategy game featuring a 1930s cartoon art style. Face your opponent in a tense tabletop duel, use your perks wisely, manage your resources, and try to survive each round in this suspenseful noir universe.

games.name: Shift Chess
games.summary: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis. It also features a usable notation system and several customizable board rules.

games.name: Ann's Parlor
games.summary: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

games.name: Spooky Land Defenders
games.summary: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

games.name: Screen Stocks
games.summary: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

games.name: Welcome to Sunnybrook
games.summary: Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape. Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unalert residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich"

games.name: Get Outta My Gut
games.summary: A rogue-lite tower defense where you control the horde. Draft randomized bio-turret cards, reshape tissue into lethal killzones, and manually slice open pathogen sacs to unleash fluid swarms on your terms. Evolve across 10 organs, don't let the contagion reach the heart.

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.

games.name: Necromancer: Ash & Bone
games.summary: Raise an army of destruction and carve through massive enemy swarms. Combine powerful abilities and artifacts, experiment with countless build combinations, and transform from a lone necromancer into a force of death.

games.name: Mirror Backrooms
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game about looking too closely. Two mirrored corridors move with you and appear identical, but one of them is always wrong: a chair has shifted, a light burns the wrong colour, a figure stands where nobody remembers one. The player carries no weapon, only a sonic ring that marks an anomaly. Firing it at the wrong thing carries sound through the floor and wakes the nearest Crawler, which then knows where the player is standing. Over 100 Crawlers inhabit these floors and no two of them share a rule, and room laws rewrite darkness, direction, distance, time and the mirrored views themselves. 100 named floors and 1,000 procedurally recombined rooms can be played alone or online with up to three other players.

games.name: Anomaly Center
games.summary: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

games.name: Dark Harvest
games.summary: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

games.name: Pull Me In
games.summary: Pull Me In is a supernatural life simulation where you build a home, form relationships, pursue strange Purposes and survive a town plagued by ghosts, demons, possession and unexplained phenomena. Live an ordinary life in a place where nothing is ordinary.

games.name: Pawnie: Focus Pals
games.summary: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a virtual pet desktop companion built around a mutual care bond that helps you stay productive.

games.name: Way Too Many Fish!
games.summary: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

games.name: Outvote
games.summary: Outvote is a free online party game about the people you play with. Every round asks one question – everyone answers yes or no in secret, then guesses how the room voted: estimate the share of yes votes, or call every single player's answer. The closer you get, the more points. Play with Steam friends or join in any web browser at outvote.de with a room code – crossplay between Steam and browser, up to 20 players. A streamer mode lets viewers play along from the browser and scores them separately, and community question packs or your own custom questions keep every round fresh.

games.name: Abyssal Moonlight: Chapter 1
games.summary: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

games.name: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
games.summary: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum is a first-person jigsaw and tidying game set in a museum where thirty paintings have come apart. Find the pieces scattered around the building and put every painting back on the wall, at your own pace.

games.name: IncrementalOS
games.summary: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

games.name: Sort The Bunnies
games.summary: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

games.name: Tetric
games.summary: Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in Tetric. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.

games.name: Next Station is...
games.summary:
Next Station is... is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly-detection game set aboard a subway train during its final service of the night.

As the train's driver, players must inspect each station for unusual occurrences before deciding whether to open the doors or bypass the platform. Using the driver's cabin window and CCTV cameras installed throughout the train, players must identify anomalies hidden among seemingly ordinary passengers and environments.

Each decision affects the journey. Opening the doors at an anomalous station may allow unwanted passengers or entities to board the train, carrying the consequences into subsequent stations. Players must make their decisions before the station timer expires, as failing to act causes the doors to open automatically.

Featuring PSX-inspired visuals, environmental observation, surveillance mechanics, and psychological horror elements, Next Station is... focuses on identifying subtle abnormalities while navigating an increasingly unsettling subway route.

games.name: Tokyo Wanted
games.summary: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

games.name: Dead Prints
games.summary: PSX style psychological horror where you run an overnight print shop. Identify sinister customers, manage print supplies, make copies, and manage your insanity as your mind gets more and more unstable.

games.name: Sneaky Purr
games.summary: Get ready for a sneaky adventure in Sneaky Purr! Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level. But be careful: escaping with the loot can be much harder than it looks!

games.name: Tsukumo Snap!
games.summary: Tsukumo SNAP! is a spirit-photography RPG in which a flip phone reveals spirits inhabiting everyday objects. Players collect spirits and arrange a six-slot battle wheel, with three active spirits and three resting. The adventure uses a real calendar and includes a 50-floor tower.

games.name: Chronoseum
games.summary: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

games.name: Evoruption
games.summary: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

games.name: The Legend of Celia
games.summary: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.
developers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司

games.name: Fragments of Ember
games.summary: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

games.name: Off Course
games.summary: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

games.name: Formation Builder Idle
games.summary: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

games.name: Deep Frost
games.summary: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

games.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
games.summary: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

games.name: Fly&Goal
games.summary: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

games.name: Fire. Hold. Repeat.
games.summary: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

games.name: The Sin of Ritter
games.summary: The Sin of Ritter is a first-person horror game where the pursuit of justice becomes a journey through guilt, obsession, and consequences. Explore dark and disturbing environments, survive the horrors that await you, and uncover the truth behind the murder of your wife.

games.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
games.summary: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

games.name: Touhou Bansho Cards
games.summary: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

games.name: Lord of the Grind
games.summary: Lord of The Grind is a single-player 2D Action RPG focused on dungeon grinding, resource gathering, loot, crafting and long-term character progression.

games.name: Throughput
games.summary: Wire yourself into a vector-bright city that runs on the beat. The system you built for people develops a pulse of its own. Build the city. Watch it breathe.

games.name: Scuttled
games.summary: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

games.name: Drive Up: Together
games.summary: Co-op climbing for up to 8 friends, built on real driving physics. Thin planks, giant pipes and vertical ramps stand between you and the summit, and there are no checkpoints. A friendly push saves your run. A friendly push also ends it.

games.name: Primal One
games.summary: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

games.name: Spellk
games.summary: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
games.summary: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 21 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

games.name: Hallucination
games.summary: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

games.name: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
games.summary: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings. Free demo: the first 3 nights.

games.name: Move the Freak Out!
games.summary: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

games.name: Pucked Up
games.summary: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

games.name: Anywhere RPG
games.summary: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

games.name: Off Axis
games.summary: An action packed sci fi FPS set aboard a massive spaceship, where reversing gravity changes the way you fight and the environment helps you eliminate enemies.

games.name: Rate & State
games.summary: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

games.name: Re:Draw
games.summary: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

games.name: Bravest!2
games.summary: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

games.name: Ascended Snake
games.summary: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements
games.summary: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

games.name: The Long Dark: Iron Road
games.summary: The Long Dark Survival Expansion. Welcome to Cauldron Island. Lost to history, hiding a mystery. Restore & activate a century-old train to journey deep along the caldera’s spine & uncover a dark secret. What you discover in the end will change how you survive in this Aurora-changed world, forever.

games.name: Broken Soccer
games.summary: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

games.name: Winter Wraith
games.summary:
You are tasked with investigating a mysterious disease in the south west. Armies are moving rapidly in the trench. You don't have much time before more important matters call to your attention. Solve your first task and get back to the Harmonium for the next.

You will play as one of the great heroes of the continent, leading and managing your own minor faction: Ankh among others at the great Fortress of Harmonium.

The game includes everything a classic infinity engine RPG usually does, you will solve quests and gain experience, many times by fighting. It also includes huge field battles (on table top), faction management, romance and friendships, crafting and alchemy, resource harvesting, as well as many many others.

games.name: Happy Propaganda
games.summary: Approve or censor live chat in Happy Propaganda. Balance viewer anger and the host's well-being, choose broadcast topics, and talk off-air. Five days of choices lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Goddle
games.summary: A word race where your whole chat plays against you from their phones. No download, no account, just the room code.

games.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
games.summary: Blast your way onto the leaderboards in a twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasion, kill combos and overwhelming firepower. Fight escalating fleets, merge power-ups and face 20+ unique bosses solo or in co-op. Play roguelike Anomaly runs that stack risk-reward mutations.

games.name: Inkborn
games.summary: You wake inside an unfinished comic, with paper underfoot and ink lines all around. Trace outlines by hand in your sketchbook to create tools and weapons. Every stroke costs ink, and your accuracy matters.

games.name: Special Case
games.summary: You won't win a war as a one man army, But because you keep fighting you are still alive_Mohamed Mostafa Battle the Occupation with unique super powers! Destroy helicopters, drones, and armored vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

games.name: Junkyard Astronauts
games.summary: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online co-op for 14 robots, Mac and PC together.

games.name: Parrygon
games.summary: Deflect energy orbs, land a perfect parry, and survive as the arena collapses around you. Take on 36 campaign missions, chase Steam high scores in endless Arcade, or challenge friends in local Versus for 2–4 players.

games.name: Tainted Tide
games.summary: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

games.name: Undermoon
games.summary: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

games.name: Dribble Basket
games.summary: Bounce your way to the basket in this physics-based basketball challenge. Master your dribble, overcome obstacles, and guide the ball to victory with nothing but timing and control.

games.name: Arctic Roll
games.summary: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

games.name: Inearth
games.summary: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

games.name: Cyberlife
games.summary: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

games.name: Cloud JourneyVR
games.summary: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

games.name: Alembix TCG
games.summary: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

games.name: Labyrinth of Doom
games.summary: A dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon crawler with real-time combat fully playable solo against challenging AI bots. Fight, scavenge, and outwit rivals in procedurally generated labyrinths Battle Royale or Co-op, up to 10 players, with legendary artifacts drawn from world mythology.

games.name: Sack Investigation
games.summary: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

games.name: Demon Rising
games.summary: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

games.name: Stellacore Defense
games.summary: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

games.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
aliases: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator.exe
games.summary: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

games.name: Flipocalypse
games.summary: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

games.name: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
games.summary: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

games.name: Cat Eats Sushi
games.summary: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

games.name: Scrappers Paradise
games.summary: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

games.name: Picofender
games.summary: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

games.name: Romul
games.summary: Romul is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

games.name: Lanelord
games.summary: You ever wanted to feel how a road feels? Now you can! Either team up with a car or try to shake it of. Solo and Multiplayer fun guaranteed!

games.name: Fantasy Idle RPG
games.summary: From the solo developer of Idle Trillionaire, set in a world of knights, dragons, dungeons, and magic. Purchase cards to earn gold and experience, unlock new quests, and watch your character grow. Every card is hand written with a touch of the developers signature humor.

games.name: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage
games.summary: Dive Log is an idle treasure-hunting game driven by a pomodoro timer: every stretch of focus becomes a deep-sea voyage. Collect treasures, upgrade your submarine and hunt the relic hidden in each sea. Play your own music and ambience, and design the sea's treasures to share with other captains.

games.name: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
games.summary: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

games.name: Skysunder
games.summary: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

games.name: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
games.summary: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats is a hidden object game where you race against time to find 100 cats hidden across the world's most iconic locations. Spot the cats, click carefully, use hints wisely, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard.

games.name: Gnomes vs. Knights
games.summary: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

games.name: Tax Empire
games.summary: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

games.name: You Must Sleep: Ravenous Nightmares
games.summary: You must sleep is a First-Person Single-Player Survival Horror game in which you play as John, a man tormented by entities that appear whenever he tries to sleep. Manage your personal needs, stay alert for monsters, and hide when necessary to make it through the night.

games.name: Idle Necronomics
games.summary: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

games.name: Kritsana
games.summary: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

games.name: Medieval Bust
games.summary: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

games.name: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
games.summary: Become a pumpkin on Halloween night! Absolute zen, midnight melancholy, and zero fuss. The perfect evening plan!

games.name: Rogue Links
games.summary: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

games.name: Special Delivery
games.summary: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

games.name: Trash to Cash
games.summary: Trash to Cash a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

games.name: Monmusu Rush
games.summary: A roguelite deck-building auto battler where you gather Monmusu and fight. Place your team and battles play out automatically, and allies left off the field charge in with a Rush! Also includes Auto Battle Rush, an asynchronous PvP mode against other players' teams. One run takes 1560 minutes.

games.name: Tropic Industry
games.summary: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

games.name: Better World
games.summary: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

games.name: Pit Purge
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

games.name: Bathroom Please!
games.summary: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

games.name: Pickie Grappy
games.summary: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

games.name: Cutset
games.summary: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

games.name: Tidy Arcana
games.summary: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

games.name: Idle Demon Lord II
games.summary: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

games.name: Dungeon Cleared!
games.summary: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

games.name: Capsule Arcade
games.summary: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

games.name: Block Battlefield
games.summary: Block Battlefield is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

games.name: GemCremental
games.summary: Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch! It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

games.name: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
games.summary: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

games.name: Dying Patience
games.summary: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

games.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
games.summary: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

games.name: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
games.summary: A cozy organizing sim for 14 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

games.name: Cloud Patrol
games.summary: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

games.name: Shoot & jump
games.summary: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

games.name: Mega Tag Panic
games.summary: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

games.name: Metal Detector Simulator
games.summary: Sweep the coil, listen for the beep and dig up everything from bottle caps to pirate gold. Sell your finds, upgrade your gear, clean up six beaches to bring the crowds back, and hunt for the Captain's Chest in this relaxing first-person treasure hunting game.

games.name: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods
