games.summary: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

games.name: Rubber & Smoke
games.summary: Rubber & Smoke is a free-to-play multiplayer drifting game that runs directly in the web browser. Players drift a tuned JDM-style car around the Smoke Valley Raceway with handling that sits between arcade and simulation: holding the drift angle, linking transitions and getting close to the walls builds chains and multipliers. Rooms with a shareable code let up to five players drift together, made for streamers playing with their community. Timed rounds are scored on the server, and logged-in players (Twitch login) earn XP and levels and appear on a public leaderboard. No download or installation required.

games.name: Kimodameshi Online
games.summary: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

games.name: Mandela Invasion: Alternates
games.summary: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

games.name: Yatır Batır
games.summary: Yatır Batır is a free-to-play mobile okey game played against live opponents at four-player tables. Players climb a trophy rank through ten arenas up to the Okey Throne, turn hands with four okey-specific skills (Tile Read, Track, Blind, Rack Topple), talk at voice tables and bring areas to life by completing tasks. Matches support solo and pair play, including tougher Saddam tables. There is no betting: in-game gold is never staked or lost in a match.

games.name: Project Exhibitionist
games.summary: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

games.name: Smiley Steel
games.summary: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

games.name: Fotografias de um Visitante
games.summary: A spacesim about taking pictures in Brazil. Made for Hensjam 2026.

games.name: Kill Jack
games.summary: In the twenties Jack ran a casino by the sea. The casino is gone. Jack is still dealing. KILL JACK is a first-person PSX horror blackjack roguelike: every chip on your side of the felt is one of your lives, every chip on his side is one of his. Ties go to the shotgun, each ante adds a house rule that stays for the rest of the night, and 35 charms let you bend the odds. Clear all six antes and Jack hands you the shotgun.

games.name: Airport Contraband
games.summary: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

games.name: Grimmlins Tale
games.summary: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

games.name: Sulfur
games.summary: Sulfur is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: A Simple Expurriment
games.summary: A combat-free metroidvania with puzzles, stealth and genetically modified kittens. Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

games.name: Boom! Buster
games.summary: An adrenaline rush is part of a balanced breakfast. Boom! Buster keeps you on your toes with fast paced panic inducing gameplay featuring an over-the-top cartoony art style and soundtrack reminiscent of the early 2000s.

games.name: Rug Cleaning Simulator
games.summary: Rug cleaning simulator is cozy, relaxing first person simulator about running small rug cleaning business. You start as a burned out person that leaves corporate job and open rug cleaning business.

games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

games.name: Sepulchron
games.summary: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

games.name: The Kharzov Effect
games.summary: Welcome to The Kharzov Effect, an immersive first-person puzzle horror game. Explore Dr. Kharzov’s eerie estate as you unravel the mystery behind a series of abductions. Face terrifying creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth of Kharzov's dark history!

games.name: Mega Met
games.summary: A Mega Man fan game which features Metalls (Mets) as the entire cast of characters, enemies and bosses.

games.name: The Charity Shop
games.summary: An adventure game where you must use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered before The Charity Shop, the place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

games.name: House Builder 2
games.summary: In House Builder 2 you build your dream constructions with friends or alone in a vibrant, low-poly open world! Buy materials for work, load it up, and drive to your next job in the ultimate co-op construction adventure!

games.name: DreadMist
games.summary: DreadMist is an open-world role-playing roleplaying sandbox simulation. With the incredible mechanical depth of this fantasy sandbox, you can begin as a lowly beggar and advance to numerous people skilled in crafting, trade, farming, thievery, combat, and many other activities.

games.name: InOut
games.summary: INOUT is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. For years, the locals have been afraid of an old mansion in Madyland. A possessed maniac and an ancient evil have settled here. Become a member of a team of exorcists and expel the evil force!

games.name: Burdock 2
games.summary: Burdock 2 is a single-player action-horror game. Explore a lost place in a post-apocalyptic future, and help the main character's friends, or leave everyone behind and embark on the path of darkness. Find all the clues and open the way to the passage. Solve puzzles and do not lose your composure.

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.summary: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

games.name: Copperfell
games.summary: Journey to Copperfell, a magical land teeming with charming villages, dangerous monsters, and an abundance of natural resources for you to make use of.

games.name: Hypnosync
games.summary: RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC! With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

games.name: The Midnighters
games.summary: The Midnighters is a survival horror game for 1-4 players where you hunt for cursed treasures. Find and seize the treasures claimed by terrifying creatures. But as you do, heed the devil's whispers and never trust your eyes.

games.name: Within His View
games.summary: An observation horror where cameras keep you alive—until they kill you. Hunt anomalies, guard your sanity, and survive a night with the Wendigo stalking behind you.

games.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake
games.summary: In this eco-futuristic farm life sim, you arrive at a moon town as the new hydroponic greenhouse farmer. Then dust storms start to appear, threatening to block the town's precious sunlight. Grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect the wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

games.name: Pesky Orcs!
games.summary: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

games.name: Everlast: Undying Tale
games.summary: On Everlast: Undying Tale’s magical world of Sarkis, the undead have risen. Gather, explore, skill, and craft in this MMO-Lite action RPG adventure. Only by bridging the gap between the living and the dead can you break Death’s curse.

games.name: Neuron Activation
games.summary: A frantic rhythm-puzzle game filled with micro-challenges. Push buttons, flip switches, shoot targets and more in search of high scores to appease your overlords.

games.name: Firestarters
games.summary: As a convicted criminal in the brutal future of this lightning-paced arcade movement FPS, a government-sanctioned bloodsport is your only hope of redemption. Strategize, skate, shoot, and slay against a gauntlet of genocidal androids for the chance to win your freedom.

games.name: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
games.summary: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
games.summary: Hoosegow — a dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths — or leads to death.

games.name: President Simulator
games.summary: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

games.name: Complexia: A Ballet of Blades
games.summary: A manga-stylized, tactical, character action game, where you slash your sword in different directions to activate strings of customizable combos, taking down powerful enemies to save the world from a space cannon that is tearing the planet apart, with friends you make along the way.

games.name: Speed Rivals: Model Trains
games.summary: Build your dream railway. Lay tracks, design stations, decorate every detail - then put your network to the test delivering cargo and passengers across maps you created yourself.

games.name: Terraclysm Survivors
games.summary: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 8 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Deductopia
games.summary: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

games.name: Anomalith: Anomaly Zone Countermeasures DLC Set
Foursavent
games.summary: From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics. No two worlds play the same every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

games.name: Copy Cats
games.summary: Copy Cats, a short-story collection by David Crouse, was awarded the Flannery O'Connor Award for Short Fiction in 2005. Copy Cats was subsequently nominated for the Pen-Faulkner Award in 2006. Copy Cats consists of seven short stories and one extended novella, and takes as its themes issues of identity and alienation. The story "Kopy Kats" is about a world of false images and doubles, as its protagonist—a man who works in a hectic copy shop—seeks authenticity in his life and finds only more and more imitations.

games.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
games.summary: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

games.name: Backrooms: Splatter
games.summary: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Channel13: Rest Stop
games.summary: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

games.name: Probably Stolen
games.summary: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

games.name: No Return Address
games.summary: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just dont make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

games.name: Infinity Bounce
games.summary: Turn the galaxy into a chaotic pinball machine to feed a voracious space cat in this physics-based incremental game. Expand and upgrade your arsenal of various celestial bodies and stuff the cat to the brink of a big bang.

games.name: Portentum
games.summary: The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos using cryptids from around the world like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

games.name: Sambird
games.summary: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

games.name: Annie's Dineinn
games.summary:
DineInn is a cooking game where you manage a kitchen and motel while maintaining a relationship with your daughter and the local communities.
Your choices and decisions show impact in the real world. Work hard through the tough times and restore the building for a grand opening.

The gameplay can be described as a combination of elements from farming, poultry, cooking, cleaning, inventory management, restoration,etc together to make a fun gameplay.

games.name: Bulletjump
games.summary: Bulletjump is a survival shooter where you jump and shoot your way through relentless waves of bullets while avoiding going out of bounds.

games.name: Peach Garden Survivors
games.summary: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

games.name: Intus
games.summary:
You take on extra work over the weekend out of fear of losing your job and rent a cheap apartment so you can work from there.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

games.name: Ironwake
games.summary: A linear single-session psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into an old Soviet robot sealed inside a dead bunker. Stealth in the dark, puzzles inside dying machines, and one voice on the radio guiding you. Find the clues and change how it ends.

games.name: Trivasion
games.summary: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

games.name: The Library Assistant
games.summary: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

games.name: Pack A Plush!
games.summary: Buy batches of plushies, unpack them, and discover all kinds of cute and legendary plushies. Carefully organize them on your shelves, then package and sell your plushies to earn money and expand your collection.

games.name: Heretics Amulet
games.summary: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

games.name: Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition
games.summary:
Build, manage, and expand the city of your dreams in Cities: Skylines – Expanded Edition, the award-winning city-building game optimized for Nintendo Switch 2 with 10 included DLC expansions and content packs.

Start with a few roads and grow your city into a bustling metropolitan hub. Plan neighborhoods, manage public services, shape civic policies, and respond to the ever-changing needs of thousands of citizens. Whether you create a quiet coastal town, a busy industrial center, or a sprawling modern metropolis, your city is yours to design.

Optimized and Expanded for Nintendo Switch 2

Experience Cities: Skylines with upgrades designed for large-scale city building on Nintendo Switch 2, including improved visuals, better performance, expanded building tools, and new ways to play.

10 DLC Expansions & Content Packs included

Expand your city with a collection of additional content included in the Expanded Edition. Watch your city transform at night with After Dark, navigate winter transit networks in Snowfall, build eco-conscious neighborhoods with Green Cities, and manage bustling maritime hubs in Sunset Harbor.
The package also includes Map Pack 3, Country Road, Pearls from the East, Deep Focus Radio, Carols, Candles & Candy, and Match Day.

games.name: Platypus Steps
games.summary:
Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow. Observe the environment, choose the right elements, and build a safe route to reach the objective!

In each level, you begin in planning mode, observing the character's position, the obstacles, and all the available possibilities. Use the cursor to select and place elements such as springs, wind, and platforms, creating the perfect path for the platypus. When you're satisfied with your plan, press Play and watch your strategy come to life!

In execution mode, the platypus runs automatically, and you can no longer change the elements in the environment. It can hit walls and change direction, use springs, be carried by the wind, and cross platforms you placed earlier. But watch out for hazards! Pits, saws, and spikes restart the level, so every element needs to be in the right place.

games.name: Falling Cubes
games.summary: 3D falling sand simulation. Experiment to unlock new materials. Reactions, Temperature, Pressure are your tools to discover over 200 unique cube types.

games.name: Cosmo Corgis
games.summary: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

games.name: Anu: Tablets of Thoth
games.summary: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

games.name: The Roc
games.summary: Venture into the dark realm of the legendary Roc, Run from cover to cover, Be wary of wild beasts and supernatural terrors and use your hand cannon if you have to, Find all ancient tablets and put an end to the Roc's Tyranny.

games.name: Daisy's Dead
games.summary: Tend a cemetery for the dearly departed in this cozy but macabre decorating game. Fulfill final requests, craft personalized graves, shape the grounds your way, and uncover the mystery of Daisys own death.

games.name: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
games.summary: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

games.name: Mafia: Night Falls
games.summary: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

games.name: Glow Arcade Racer
games.summary: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

games.name: Playrooms
games.summary: Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.

games.name: No ESC
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game where movement, combat, and all other actions are performed by typing. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon, evade or fight enemies, solve puzzles, and find what you need to escape. Featuring hand-painted watercolor artwork.

games.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
games.summary: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

games.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
games.summary: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

games.name: Fine Dining Fraud
games.summary: A chaotic co-op cooking game for 1-4 players. Run a fake fine dining restaurant you bought with mafia money: cook badly, serve picky guests, lie your way out of complaints, put out fires and survive the health inspector, all while the Don comes to collect.

games.name: Just One More Coin
games.summary: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

games.name: Drone Arena
games.summary: A survivors-like arena roguelite. Pilot a drone, stack weapons and upgrades into absurd builds, and hold out against waves of mechas until the timer runs out. Every run ends. Every run teaches.

games.name: Blockflow
games.summary: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

games.name: Fractured
games.summary: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

games.name: Zombie Cropse
games.summary: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

games.name: Dugout Dice
games.summary: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

games.name: Emojis vs. Zombies
games.summary: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

games.name: Pointless Climb
games.summary: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

games.name: Westward Dash
games.summary: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

games.name: Timberworks
games.summary: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

games.name: Stonk: Timing the Market
games.summary: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

games.name: Sketch Kingdom
games.summary: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

games.name: The Flesh Beneath
games.summary: A dark-fantasy card-roguelike about giving the cathedral below what it asks for one piece of yourself at a time. Sever your own flesh for power. Press blood-stones into your cards. Permadeath. Every name is remembered.

games.name: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey
games.summary: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

games.name: Qwak Reborn
games.summary: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

games.name: Metal Quadriga
games.summary: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech QUADRIGA and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikesdominate the battlefield with your machine.

games.name: BudMageddon
games.summary: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

games.name: NeoRunners
games.summary: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine Burn, Volt, and Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

games.name: Chako
games.summary: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

games.name: Nonogram Art
games.summary: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

games.name: Tea Party for 4
games.summary: Horror Cozy Anomaly Game

games.name: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
games.summary: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

games.name: Draftfall
games.summary: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

games.name: The Doi
games.summary: A hilarious 18 player co-op puzzle platformer for friends, families, and chaos. Play online or locally with split-screen multiplayer.

games.name: DaDee
games.summary: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

games.name: Pixel Coloring World
games.summary: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

games.name: Beam Inc.
games.summary: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

games.name: Prideblood: Born of Claws
games.summary: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

games.name: Brush Rush
games.summary: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

games.name: Lanternfall
games.summary: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

games.name: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
games.summary: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

games.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
games.summary: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

games.name: Type the World
games.summary: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. Thats it, thats the game. For kids and grownups.

games.name: MMA Tactics
games.summary: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

games.name: A Place for Every Potion
games.summary: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

games.name: Synapse Grid
games.summary: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Green trail is rideable terrain; amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 24 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 1926 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

games.name: Sortalis
games.summary: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

games.name: Coins Must Be Made
games.summary: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins, pay the king's tax, and invest your earnings in upgrades in this active incremental roguelite.

games.name: Zombie Tide Arena
games.summary: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

games.name: Stick a Fork
games.summary: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

games.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
games.summary: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

games.name: Tomorrow Never Comes
games.summary: Tomorrow Never Comes is a choice-driven first-person narrative thriller. Trapped in a time loop, Noah must relive the same day, manage his injuries, use items, unlock new paths, and discover multiple endings in his attempt to finally reach tomorrow.

games.name: What the Cluck
games.summary: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

games.name: Happy Unbreakable Ball
games.summary: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

games.name: Fables of the Kingdom Remastered: Collector's Edition
Fall Adventure
games.summary: Fall Adventure is a 2D pixel art platformer where you must find all the magical orbs to progress. As you descend deeper, the caves become larger and more challenging. All you have is a dash that keeps you in the air for a brief moment, allowing you to reach otherwise inaccessible areas throughout the levels.

games.name: No Man's Sky: Forsaken
games.summary: Meet strange traders, collect haunting mementos, deliver mysterious packages, construct an eerie corvette, jump between star systems with seamless warping and more in update 7.10, FORSAKEN! Introducing new spooky gameplay and bringing the full experience of No Man's Sky to iOS devices.

games.name: Castle of the Zephyr
games.summary: Castle of the Zephyr is a spiritual remake of the classic roguelike Castle of the Winds. Explore procedurally generated dungeons and hand-crafted ruins, master spellbook magic, manage weight-and-bulk inventory, build your classless hero, and race against time to stop an ancient evil from awakening.

games.name: Project Android
games.summary: Project Android, the solution to tomorrow's problems. Perform various experiments and raise the android Femme into humanity's savior.

games.name: Voiceless
games.summary: An interactive live-action slasher. Emma's sister has gone missing. The only lead: a serial killer locked away in a psychiatric hospital. Get in. Find answers. Get out alive.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Prehistoric Isle
games.summary:
"PREHISTORIC ISLE" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1989.
As the protagonist heads to Greenhell Island to investigate a series of shipwrecks off the coast of the Bahamas, prehistoric dragons thought to have gone extinct launch a relentless attack.
The option unit equipped to your aircraft can be repositioned to change its attack method into 5 different types based on its location, such as firing flame lasers upward or dropping bombs diagonally downward. Make full use of your option unit to face various obstacles and uncover the truth behind the mysterious shipwrecks!

games.name: Just Pickin' Apples
games.summary: There are a whole lot of apples to pick. That's about the size of it. Just Pickin' Apples is a relaxing game about cleaning up an old orchard, one apple at a time. Pick 'em up, toss 'em in the barrel, earn a few coins. It's quiet work. No need to hurry. Best not to leave any behind.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Swimmer
games.summary:
"SWIMMER" is an action game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1982.
Take control of the swimmer and see if you can make it to the treasure island.
Use Power Pills and dive underwater to skillfully avoid obstacles and enemy monsters.

games.name: Cop Bastard
games.summary: Cop Bastard - is a сlassic FPS takes place in the early 90s in Japan. Fight against yakuza, and other mobs...

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
In Pardon My French Toast, you play as a Toasty (a talking slice of brioche) who dreams of participating in the new edition of the bread wrestling competition. To be physically up to the challenge, he decides to follow a training program organized by the previous champion of the discipline, which will take him all over the world and make him meet a bunch of wacky weirdos.

Pardon My French Toast is an adventure / platform game in 2D top view in which the player explores different worlds, solves puzzles and meets a whole bunch of fun characters. Bread wrestling is a... special sport. We will introduce the discipline later.

games.name: Into the Crypt
games.summary: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: Heir of the Dog
games.summary:
After a mysterious explosion over Victorian London, Cummerbund Bandersnatch (a likeable, if dim-witted twit) visits his uncle's laboratory and discovers an experimental new formula guaranteeing a "good time" for whoever drinks it. Seduced by the promises in his uncle's journal, Cummerbund decides that it is probably safe to drink and discovers his life will never be the same again.

What may seem like a curse at first, leads Bandersnatch on a thrilling, love-torn adventure through the back alleys of Old London Town as he uncovers a sinister plot involving a secret society, the royal family, copious amounts of dog hair and his uncle at the very centre.

games.name: Tom the Postgirl
games.summary: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: Grim Prix is a multiplayer vertical race where paladins compete from point A to point B in a given racing track in a frenetic melee combat against other players and enemies (NPCs) in a quest for gems to achieve Divine Enlightenment at the finish line by using multiple gadgets and tricks.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own home, where you have been locked in. But be careful, you won't be alone in your captivity. Dive into this first-person mystery thriller, full of secrets and family betrayals. And discover who locked you in and why.

games.name: Milo
games.summary: Fight alone or beside others trapped in the same nightmare. Survive waves of deranged cultists and grow your mischief of rats. The longer you stay, the more you can save, and the more you risk losing before reaching Traang, Milo’s Arcade.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: Phasmonauts
games.summary: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary: A slice-of-life adventure with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in a 2000s Japanese neighborhood! Play as 12-year-old Hoshino, revive a summer festival, reconnect with neighbors, and uncover truths about her grandma living with dementia.

games.name: Monster Hunter Outlanders
games.summary: Monster Hunter Outlanders is an action-packed new installation in the series for mobile, licensed by Capcom and developed by Timi Studio Group.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

games.name: Dark Trip
games.summary:
Dark Trip is a psychedelic VR escape room where the hero is forced to use drugs investigating a sadomasochistic lab.

The game of Escape Room genre features Lavcraftian setting, Psychedelic Trips gameplay mechanics and the goals to collect and investigate evidences. Some event in the game are inspired by David Lynch's and Terry Gilliam's movies.

- Experiences Psychedelic Trips. Use VR to immerse yourself into psychedelic experiences not possible on any other gaming platform.

- Investigate the Sadomasochistic Laboratory. Solve twisted riddles in surrealistic setting of physical and mental torture.

- Collect the Pieces of Horrible Truth. Search for clues, artifacts and diary pieces in each location to discover the dark story behind the events.

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: A chaotic physics-based King of the Hill party brawler for up to 6 players. Punch, dash, and sabotage your rivals using powerful artifacts in deadly arenas full of traps and total mayhem.

games.name: Checkmage!
games.summary: A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements. Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

games.name: CryptidCam
games.summary: Head out into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

games.name: Joe & Mac: Retro Collection
games.summary:
Grab your club/hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever!

For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.

Joe & Mac Caveman Ninja: The original arcade hit that started it all. Rescue the village’s women from a gang of Neanderthals and face off against deadly dinos.

Congo’s Caper: A wacky spin-off full of high-flying action, mischievous monkeys and even more prehistoric madness.

Joe & Mac Lost in the Tropics: A tropical sequel where our heroes get new weapons, face new enemies and must defend the Tiki Village

Three full games, one epic Stone Age experience. Whether you are a nostalgic fan or a curious newcomer, this collection is your ticket to relive or discover the colorful chaos of Joe & Mac.

Welcome to the pre-hysterical jungle!

games.name: Computer Manufacturer
games.summary: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

games.name: Tama In-Between
games.summary: An action-puzzle game where the slime cat "Tama" explores a mysterious, slightly melancholic pixel-art world. Use three unique actions—Absorb to grow, Split to divide, and Swap to switch bodies—to solve puzzles and follow Tama’s hazy, uncertain journey.

games.name: Pionero Capital
games.summary: Pionero Capital is a sandbox business simulator where you build your company from zero to millionaire. Drive around an open world, manage employees, expand into different businesses, and become the richest in the city.

games.name: MeowPower!Yachiyo
games.summary: Team up with the cats and take down the evil humans! A thrilling, cat-dancing Beat-'Em-Up Side Scroller begins!

games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
games.summary: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.summary: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a cozy city-builder, a thinky strategy puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

games.name: Love: Fall in Death
games.summary:
Love: Fall in Death is an FMV (full-motion video) interactive film game developed by SNR Interactive in Istanbul.
The story follows Kutay, whose personality and fate are shaped by the player’s branching choices as he meets Ayşil in a lively Istanbul bar.
Depending on the choices, the narrative shifts between romantic comedy, drama, supernatural encounters, and light horror.

The game features live-action performances, multiple endings, Quick-Time Events, and a dice-based chance mechanic that affects key decisions.
Originally filmed in Turkish, the game is fully dubbed in twelve languages for its global release.

games.name: Hot Wax
games.summary: Hot Wax is a falling-block puzzle game where you place candles and then light them up to create slowly-unfolding chain reactions in a gloomy temple built to some unholy creature.

games.name: Hypnos
games.summary: Hypnos is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream. Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Embrace your destiny.

games.name: Two Dollar Suits
games.summary: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Relics of the Past
Cairn: On the Trail
games.summary: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: Sow. Grow. Throw. Planted! is a chaotic 1-4 player combat game where gardens are arenas, plants are weapons, and grudges are settled one harvest at a time.

games.name: Kowloon's Gate Suzaku
games.summary:
Kowloon’s Gate Suzaku is a single-player adventure game developed and published by JETMAN for Nintendo Switch. It is a non-VR reconstruction of the 2017 PlayStation VR title Kowloon’s Gate VR: Suzaku and serves as a prequel to the 1997 cult classic Kowloon’s Gate.

Players explore the labyrinthine streets of the Yin World version of Kowloon, experiencing its surreal inhabitants, architecture and soundscape through an atmospheric exploration-focused adventure. The Nintendo Switch version features enhanced graphics, new locations, quests, characters and story events, including material that connects directly to the original game.

Gameplay includes a psychic-photography system in which clues found in an album lead the player to locations associated with memories. Players can also collect peeled shrimp scattered throughout the environment to unlock additional events.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

games.name: Hokko Spaces
games.summary: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

games.name: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
games.summary: A New Age Rises in Age of Empires IV. Raiders of the North introduces two full civilizations, deeper Crucible systems, and more.

games.name: Hello Kitty: Party Land
games.summary: Featuring a massive roster of more than 145 beloved Sanrio characters, the game invites players into a colorful world of mini-games and adventures.

games.name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
games.summary: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

games.name: Phantasma Hotel
games.summary: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

games.name: Bumper Bout
games.summary: A multiplayer pinball party! Battle local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique Super Ball move to turn the tides at the last moment.

games.name: Black Lily's Tale
games.summary: A Switch port of Black Lily's Tale that includes all previously released additional scenarios, as well as the additional scenario “The Day We First Crossed the Boundary,” which follows Hana Sasamori and Itsuki Omiya after the main story.

games.name: Knuckle Creek
games.summary:
Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions. Smash your way through chaotic matches with up to eight players in Battle mode (offline/online) or jump into the Single Player campaign to unlock various dress-up items for your characters, bombs, and flags.

The stage is set, the chickens are clucking, LET’S GO!

games.name: Coloratura
games.summary: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

games.name: S.O.N.A.R.: Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
games.summary: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

games.name: Broke Wizards
games.summary: From the creators of Scribblenauts comes a new 1-6 player co-op game where you and your Wizard roommates slay monsters, go racing, play prop hunt or do other crazy jobs to pay rent to a giant Imp Landlord before he eats you.

games.name: Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Boost'n'Slide Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Power & Pace Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Feel the Heat Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Bone Shaker Skeletor Edition
Limerence
games.summary: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

games.name: Hauntasy
games.summary: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

games.name: Rise of the Merchants
games.summary: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

games.name: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
games.summary: Reclaim power and reach beyond-into the unknown.The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.

games.name: Catch Meow if You Can
games.summary: An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players. Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

games.name: The Dungeon Club
games.summary: A fantasy card brawler where every accusation can spark a duel—and getting eliminated unlocks a second way to win. Return as a ghost, sabotage the living, and steal victory from the Underworld.

games.name: Backrooms Insane
games.summary: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

games.name: Spooky Ride
games.summary: Team up in 1–4 player co-op, hop on your bikes, and ride into a supernatural forest in search of bigfoot. Follow strange clues, survive ghostly encounters, solve co-op puzzles, and try to make it back before your crew becomes another forest legend.

games.name: Meiji Tokyo Renka Twilight Kiss
games.summary: "Meiji Tokyo Renka" (also known as "Meikoi") is a historical romance fantasy game in which the main character travels back in time to the Meiji era and meets—and falls in love with—great figures from history.

games.name: Go Dub Yourself!
games.summary:
Go Dub Yourself! is an interactive party game where players re-voice video clips using on-screen timing markers. Players can play straight, go off-script, or improvise, with flexible scoring options including auto-scoring, player judging, and chat voting. Key features include an integrated voice changer with 18 choices, party tournaments, a dedicated Studio mode, dark mode, and Steam achievements.

Using the Clip Studio tool, users can import any video, set timing lines, assign characters, and convert clips into playable dubbing packs. Content can be exported locally or uploaded directly to the Steam Workshop. The game supports local co-op for up to 8 players on a single machine and online multiplayer for up to 12 players via simple room codes with built-in voice chat.

The game includes no pre-packaged copyrighted media; players are responsible for supplying their own video files and ensuring they have the rights to any content they import or share.

games.name: Feedstock
games.summary: A four-player co-op horror game where you loot houses and feed everything to Tally, a creature that grows larger and angrier with each meal. As she swells, she becomes louder and harder to move, attracting hostile entities triggered by escalating noise. You must manage her size by forcing her to regurgitate items and extract her before the situation spirals out of control, coordinating through proximity voice chat.

games.name: Your Way Out
games.summary: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

games.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
aliases: 白日梦猫：梦灵放置冒险
games.summary: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is a desktop idle role-playing game. Players build a team, hatch and collect DreamSpirits, and progress through automated battles. The adventure runs alongside other desktop activities, allowing players to work, study, or watch videos while their team continues adventuring.

games.name: Gloombo
games.summary:
Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion game where a little floating island sits beside whatever the player is working on. Players choose crafting projects and start focus sessions while Gloombo works on her own tasks. Between sessions, they can decorate the island, grow a garden, fulfill orders from distant lands, trade with a traveling vendor, and care for a cat.

The island can be moved and resized on the desktop. Orders have no deadlines, and friendships and the bond with the cat do not fade while the player is away. Ambient sounds and music accompany focus sessions, and the game does not monitor the player’s work.

games.name: Beellionaire Idle
games.summary: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your produce and invest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, speed up production and build a honey empire from a single hive.

games.name: The Last Case
games.summary:
Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth.

See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

games.name: Sift
games.summary: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door then do it again, faster. 85 handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

games.name: FlipBaka
games.summary: Flip floor panels and launch enemies and friends off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round!

games.name: Bombacon!
games.summary: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A bomb about to explode! Bombacon! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

games.name: Balingo
games.summary: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

games.name: Squomb
games.summary: Too close. Too late. You drop a bomb. Boom. You die. They die. Good. Respawn as your squomb and dive back in. 14 players. PvP or Co-op. Fast, explosive 1-bit madness inspired by Bomberman.

games.name: Checkborne: A Chess Adventure
games.summary: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

games.name: Endless Battle: Idle & Build
games.summary: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reachthe Realm of the End!

games.name: Elementys
games.summary:
Elementys Online is a free-to-play 2D pixel-art MMORPG set in an open fantasy world.

Players can explore different regions, choose between four elements (Fire, Water, Earth and Wind), and develop their character through three classes: Warrior, Rogue and Mage.

The game features real-time combat, challenging bosses, dungeons, crafting professions, talent trees, equipment enchanting, guilds, flying mounts and ranked PvP arenas.

Players can team up to defeat powerful world bosses, collect rare equipment and explore a world filled with quests and secrets.

games.name: Find Me
games.summary: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

games.name: Finals Week
games.summary: A co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

games.name: Crown of Time
games.summary: Rebuild a forgotten kingdom in this dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather and craft by hand, command Echoes to work while you’re away, and explore Past, Present, and Future. Fight the guardians by hand, gather the crown’s three fragments, and reach the one place that stands outside time.

games.name: Fiak
games.summary: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

games.name: As Long as She Forgot
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

games.name: EpicSelectly
games.summary: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

games.name: Ship Busters
games.summary: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

games.name: Forgery
games.summary: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

games.name: O2gether
games.summary: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

games.name: Space Travelers
games.summary: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

games.name: Cataclyzm
games.summary: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

games.name: Silly Typing Game
games.summary: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

games.name: Before All Saints Day
games.summary: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 1020 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

games.name: Blight Brigade
games.summary: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

games.name: Feeding Gooble
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

games.name: Ourself
games.summary: Ourself is an online co-op physics platformer for exactly two players who share a single ragdoll body. Each player controls one half of the body: one arm, one leg and their own camera. Walking, jumping, climbing ropes and monkey bars, and carrying a crate all require both players to act together; a jump only works if both press within 0.2 seconds. Players climb 400 m through The Sky Kingdom across 36 checkpoints, from a meadow to the Ruined Keep, past pistons, swinging hammers, cannons and fans, and use a fishing rod as a grappling hook. A fall of 1.5 m or more knocks the character out. The game has a Campaign mode with checkpoints, a Time Trial mode without checkpoints, four secret trials and built-in voice chat. Each player needs their own copy; there is no single-player or split-screen mode.

games.name: Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack
games.summary: Trade thrills for chills with the Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack!

games.name: Leg Day
games.summary: Leg Day is a challenging climbing game where you control each arm with the mouse to pull and launch yourself upward. Scale varied biomes and obstacles, striving to reach the top without falling back down.

games.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
games.summary: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

games.name: Plunder Bay
games.summary: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

games.name: Winnie-the-Pooh Redux: Halloween Survivors
games.summary: Heal instead of harm in this wholesome Halloween bullet heaven! Play as 9 magical versions of Pooh, recruit a Ghost Army, collect Candy Corn, upgrade abilities, and restore peace to the Hundred Acre Wood. Based on the public-domain works of A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard. Not affiliated with Disney.

games.name: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
games.summary: Manage your own card shop, open packs, and collect absurd Grombos. Restock products, set prices, and design your store. Unlock upgrades, automate tasks, and grow your business while hunting for that one card you still need.

games.name: No Death No Life
games.summary: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

games.name: Aniimo: Season 1 - Departure with the Wind: Part 2
games.summary: Aniimo’s Season 1: Departure with the Wind Part 2 has arrived, introducing 32 new species and 51 new Aniimo, fresh storylines, and the Whisperwake Isles region, featuring Crescent Bay, Rosy Mirelands, Wildwater Gorge, and Cloudreach Falls. Players can discover new Prismana forms for Whirlbite, Gachapus, Jabster, and Sugartini, alongside seasonal additions such as Prismana Hypnyto, Prismana Ekrim, Hoptail, and the player-designed Jaguaraun. The update also adds permanent real-time 1v1 duels and a new fair-play PvP mode for Operation: Egg Heist, while limited-time activities include Aniimo Dash racing and new Dark, Earth, and Lightning stages in Holo-Battle Sim. Seasonal events include Night Parade, featuring decorating and fragrance-mixing activities; Magical Night, introducing special crops for your Home; and additional login, exploration, and photography events. Vein Abundance features weekly Prismana rotations, culminating in a Prismana Carnival.

games.name: Ayako's Endeavors
games.summary: A combat-free, casual exploration RPG. Play as a single mother exploring a town, talking to NPCs, and solving their troubles to gather "Faith" and save your comatose son. Enjoy over 190 story events, diverse outfit CGs, and a unique "Inner Thoughts" system to hear inner thoughts and get hints.

games.name: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
games.summary: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

games.name: Move Together!
games.summary: Move Together! is a puzzle game with a clean, simple style. Every move affects all of the little friends at once. Observe how they influence one another, plan each step, solve evolving challenges, and help everyone reach the goal together.

games.name: Escape From Prompt: Rogue Ai
games.summary: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

games.name: Excisa
games.summary: Sit down at a séance table in an abandoned house. Choose a tarot card. Roll the dice. Risk everything to summon the Angel who never lies. Every reach across the table might bring you closer to the truth—or seat something else opposite you. Five chairs. The dead have heard you, too.

games.name: Soul Finders
games.summary: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

games.name: I, Spy
games.summary: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

games.name: Eris One Stand
games.summary: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

games.name: SwapHeads!
games.summary: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddys body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?
developers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
publishers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず

games.name: Worldkampf '72
games.summary: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

games.name: Timber & Fortune
games.summary: Build a woodworking business from a humble camp. Gather timber, craft furniture, fulfill timed contracts, research new techniques, expand your workshop, trade goods, and protect your reputation as you grow from beginner to master carpenter.

games.name: Sacred Land
games.summary: Sacred Land is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an ancient nature spirit defending your island against invading settlers.

games.name: Reoguna
games.summary: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

games.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
games.summary: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

games.name: Tessela
games.summary: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

games.name: Rookie Rook
games.summary: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

games.name: GloveUp!
games.summary: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

games.name: Everest: Survival Simulator
games.summary: Survive a full expedition on a 1:1 satellite-mapped Mount Everest. Acclimatize, manage oxygen, cold, fatigue and supplies, pitch your tent at each camp, cross crevasses in the Khumbu Icefall and push for the 8,848 m summit — then make it back down alive.

games.name: Music Maniaz
games.summary: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

games.name: Smithonion Natural History Museum
games.summary: Smithonion Natural History Museum is an online co-op game about working the night shift at a museum where the exhibits are coming to life. Work alone or bring your friends to put everything back in place before your shift is over!

games.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
games.summary: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

games.name: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
An atmospheric first-person puzzle thriller set inside the Penrose, an isolated art deco hotel where you awaken with no memory of checking in. Solve color-based logic and spatial puzzles, manipulate your surroundings, and uncover the mystery behind your stay.

The Redux edition rebuilds the visuals with enhanced lighting, reflections, and HDR support. It also adds Nintendo Switch 2 mouse controls and HD Rumble 2, enhanced 5.1 surround sound, chapter selection, and gameplay and performance improvements.

games.name: White Box Quiz
games.summary:
Think you know it all? Prove it.

White Box Quiz brings the excitement of a TV game show straight to your couch!

Put your knowledge to the test across 18 categories with thousands of questions. Challenge your friends or team up and play together. And when crazy bonuses and the lucky wheel come into play, even knowing the right answer might not be enough.

Knowledge helps. But anything can happen.

games.name: The Florida Trail
games.summary: Escape Florida for cheaper rent in a choice-driven, pixel-art survival comedy. Pick a questionable vehicle, manage food, fuel and repairs, and gamble on roadside jobs and strangers. Reaching Georgia is one thing. Arriving with enough money to start over is another.

games.name: Sleepytime Village
games.summary: To learn how to be an adult you have to act like a kid. Sleepytime Village is a narrative adventure that tells the story of a neglectful, workaholic father who becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, using the classic point & click interface can you guide Rufus home?

games.name: Lyara
games.summary: In an unknown world, a girl look for answers around her and deal with her inner feelings at the same time. Face numerous challenges to reach answers and grow up with the kid.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

games.name: Memento Dawn
games.summary: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

games.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
games.summary: An emotional story-rich game with an emphasis on exploring the unknown, surviving abuse, dealing with inner demons and disabilities, making a ton of cakes, and dealing with the fact that not everything lasts forever.

games.name: Witchhammer
games.summary:
Witchhammer is a Real-Time Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.
Play as Clovelin, a card reader who was convicted as a witch and made a deal with the devil to avenge her own death. With the powers of her magical tarot deck, you will battle the Inquisition and try to destroy their most powerful weapon: the Witchhammer.
