To master our real time deckbuilding roguelike you will not only learn how to avoid your enemies attacks but also how to play your cards most efficiently.
After every wave of enemies you will improve your deck, making it more powerful and adapting it to your own playstyle.

games.name: Rogue Jungle
games.summary: Rogue Jungle is an Action-Roguelike, where you have to fight & explore your way through a procedurally generated jungle. Find new weapons on your journey and face a Boss Enemy at the end of each run!

games.name: Solar Voltage
games.summary: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!
aliases: Bobo et le Coffre des Cauchemars

games.name: Suri: The Seventh Note
games.summary: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

games.name: Dictocracy
games.summary: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

games.name: Gray Planet
games.summary: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

games.name: Rat Game
games.summary: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

games.name: The Last Tape: Before the Mine
games.summary: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.

games.name: Veinrider
games.summary: Veinrider is a short incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet.

games.name: NodalBastion
games.summary: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

games.name: Fortune x World: Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu
games.summary: Glovety's 3rd project, about game development.
aliases: FORTUNE×WORLD～僕らがゲームを作る理由～
FORTUNE×WORLD ~Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu~

games.name: Tiles of Grimmwoods
games.summary: Every tile you place in this strategic roguelike deck-builder shapes the story of lost kids trying to escape the twisted depths of the Grimmwoods. Outsmart lurking creatures, lay down paths with powerful items, and upgrade your deck to survive a forest that shifts with every step.

games.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
games.summary: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

games.name: Lost Soul
games.summary: Lost Soul is a short atmospheric third person puzzle game. Play as Lost Soul, a soul corrupted by demon magic who suddenly had the last bits of its thoughts and memory sealed outside of its body and now is compelled to chase down the mysterious fae who did it.

games.name: Anvira: Forge Defense
games.summary: Defend Anvilium from endless waves of goblins and monsters! A tower defense roguelite where you deploy mighty golems, unleash powerful spells, and craft crazy builds through deep customization. Adapt your strategy, grow stronger, and see how long you can survive against ever-escalating threats.

games.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
games.summary: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

games.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
games.summary: Silberheim ECG (Evolving Card Game) is a fantasy trading card game. Cards—called Fragments—can evolve based on a player’s actions and playstyle, creating a personalized experience within the expanding world and lore of Silberheim.

games.name: Stray Sheep and Corpse Love
games.summary: The second and last game in the MOONSTONE's Stray Sheep series.
aliases: Stray Sheep to Shinin no Koi

games.name: Plobania 47/B
games.summary: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It’s fun to have fun.” Play with him and your favorite characters in 18 exciting minigames or chase him around the house. Whether you play solo or with friends, your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Custom Romance City 3D3
games.summary: Custom Romance City 3D3 is set to be a new entry in the studio’s “Custom” lineage of games, continuing from the Custom Maid 3D2 and Custom Order Maid 3D2 series. Just like in the previous entries, the player will be able to fully customize their dream girlfriend, but this time, they have the whole open world of Romance City to take her on dates and explore their relationship. Of course, the players will first have to skillfully romance the girl, but once they do, the “paradise city created to liberate people from common sense and reason” will be all theirs.

games.name: Neurospasm
games.summary: A weird first person roguelike horde shooter. Hook your brain into your computer, dive into a game inside a game, unbox and stack unique items, use up to 6 weapons at once, kill weird fleshy enemies, and uncover why nothing here makes any sense.

games.name: NVA: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
games.summary: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

games.name: Through the Manor
games.summary: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

games.name: Project Reprieve
games.summary: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

games.name: Legend of Idle
games.summary: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

games.name: How to Destroy a City
games.summary: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

games.name: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories
games.summary: A fandisk for Da Capo 4 and Da Capo 5.

games.name: Pest Protocol
games.summary: The swarm is infinite—your hands aren't. Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by clicking to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous systems to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

games.name: King in the Mountain
games.summary: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

games.name: Susanoo
games.summary: Susanoo (japonsky スサノオ) nebo Susa no wo (スサノヲ), uctivě nazývaný Susanoo no Mikoto (須佐之男命), je japonské božstvo moří a hromů, také zvané kami (神). Jméno Susanoo je doslova překládáno jako „chrabrý, statečný muž“. Jeho život a činy jsou popsány v posvátné knize šintoismu Kodžiki a kronice Nihongi. Společně se svoji sestrou Amaterasu Ómikami (bohyně Slunce a pramatka všech japonských císařů) a bratrem jménem Cukujomi (bůh záhrobní říše a Měsíce) patří mezi tři vznešená božstva.

games.name: Kuizu! Batounea!
games.summary: This is a visual novel game in which players answer quizzes to progress through the story. One of the game's key features is the unique commentary provided by the characters for most of the quiz questions.

games.name: Mad Ever After
games.summary: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

games.name: Provinces
games.summary: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

games.name: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
games.summary: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

games.name: Shared RC
games.summary: Two players. One RC car. One controls the left wheels, the other the right. Try to reach the top together.

games.name: Argot's Laboratory
games.summary: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in control of a high tech lab. Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job! Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

games.name: Clobbo
games.summary: A gore comedy roguelite about hitting a whole crowd at once. Everything comes apart in pieces and nothing gets cleaned up: blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

games.name: Put Your Toys Away Together!
games.summary: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Crowd Favorites
games.summary: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

games.name: Tengoku no Vinea: Saiyaku no Majo to Nanatsu no Tsumi
Sudokiller
games.summary: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game inspired by sudoku-style logic. Players use clues to place suspects on a grid, reconstruct the crime scene, and deduce who the killer is.

games.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
games.summary:
Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus is a mystery game centering around a classic adventuring party that have returned from their latest quest only to discover the artifact they were sent to retrieve has vanished from their custody.

Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

games.name: Send Them to Hell
games.summary: Demons want Earth. Bad idea. Smash them back to Hell in a chaotic pixel-meets-3D roguelike of absurd, game-breaking builds. With heroes like a holy Knight, a Corn-Launching Robot, or a Wizard Girlie and her ferocious cat. Play solo or 4-player online co-op. Commence the slaughter. Send Them To Hell.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: Zenden
games.summary: Zenden is a relaxing garden-building game where you decorate a peaceful Zen garden and solve puzzles along the way. Place Trees, Rocks, Paths, and many more hand drawn pixel art items for a calming, meditative experience with instrumental music tracks.

games.name: Fairy Forge
games.summary: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

games.name: A Tiny Ghost Game
games.summary: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

games.name: Super Froppings
games.summary: Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players. You are a frog. One button, one move: the humble jump. Pour your heart, soul, and desperate prayers into it, and leap your way up from the depths of the earth.

games.name: Triple Pairing Mini Fandisc
games.summary: After stories for Nono, Eimi and Nazca.

games.name: Towermouth
games.summary:
Towermouth is a roguelite action game with automatic firing, played solo or by two players in local split-screen co-op. Each player controls a puppet climbing a living tower floor by floor; the tower watches the players, talks to them and remembers how the previous run ended.

Weapons fire on their own, so players move, jump and dash to position themselves while enemies swarm each floor. Clearing a floor opens its gate and offers a reward before the climb continues. Level-ups offer a choice of three cards that change the character's build, collecting five copies of one effect transforms it, and a Warden boss guards every fifth floor.

games.name: Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack
games.summary: The Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack cartridge for Evercade brings Rare's classic Nintendo 64 platformers Banjo-Kazooie and Banjo-Tooie to Evercade in newly enhanced native ports, featuring save states, refined controls, improved camera options, a music player with previously unreleased tracks, a cheat menu, and — exclusive to this release — the previously unreleased Banjo-Tooie multiplayer mode "Bottles' Revenge".

games.name: The Doom Collection
games.summary:
The DOOM Collection cartridge for Evercade brings id Software's legendary first-person shooter to the platform, gathering the original games together with all of their classic expansion content on a single cartridge:

- DOOM (1993) — The original game that defined the FPS genre: fight through the UAC's Mars base and the depths of Hell itself.
- DOOM II: Hell on Earth (1994) — The direct sequel, bringing the fight back to Earth against a full demonic invasion, and introducing the Super Shotgun.
- Master Levels for DOOM II (1995) — A set of extra single levels for DOOM II, created by a mix of guest designers and originally sold as an add-on pack.
- TNT: Evilution (1996) — One of the two official Final DOOM episodes, a full 32-level campaign built by the TeamTNT community group.
- The Plutonia Experiment (1996) — The second Final DOOM episode, known for its especially high difficulty and dense monster encounters.
- No Rest for the Living (2010) — A compact 9-level DOOM II mission pack, originally created for the Xbox Live Arcade re-release.
- SIGIL (2019) — An unofficial "fifth episode" for the original DOOM, designed by original lead designer John Romero for the game's 25th anniversary.
- SIGIL II (2023) — John Romero's follow-up episode, continuing directly after SIGIL's story.
- DOOM: Deathmatch Pack — A collection of levels built specifically for multiplayer combat.

Beyond the games themselves, this release adds new gameplay modifiers (Turbo Monsters, Double Monsters, Vampire Mode), adjustable violence settings (including Shotgun Close Encounters and Chainsaw Massacre modes), three new multiplayer modes (Chaosmatch, Instagib, Tag) alongside classic Deathmatch and co-op, widescreen support, multiple soundtrack options, and scanline display effects.

games.name: The Graves Vigil
games.summary: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

games.name: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
games.summary: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

games.name: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
games.summary: A cozy first-person organizing game set in a chaotic Victorian museum. Gather scattered colored cubes, carry them in stacks, and place them into matching slots to reveal pixel artworks and restore charming 3D voxel exhibits.

games.name: Trenchworms
games.summary: Trenchworms is a fast-paced 2D arena shooter featuring fully destructible terrain, 26 weapons and ninja-rope movement. It includes single-player, local multiplayer and online multiplayer, with PvP and PvE gameplay.

games.name: Dead of the Brain
games.summary: Escape from the walking dead in this retro 90's pixel point-and-click adventure from Japan's PC-98 heyday, now playable on modern platforms!

games.name: The Last Station: Baku
games.summary: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.

games.name: WoundWake
games.summary: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption.

games.name: I'm Definitely in a Basement
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in a basement. A chair, camera, voices and a woman in white form part of its unsettling environment.

games.name: Hachikoma: Underground Stadium No. 8
games.summary: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

games.name: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
games.summary: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece

games.name: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
games.summary: A violent storm forces an urban explorer to take refuge in the abandoned industrial district of Baldwin, Wisconsin. What looks like an unexpected jackpot quickly turns sinister. Notes hint at the truth the EPA was sent to cover up. Some places aren't abandoned by accident.

games.name: Dummy House
games.summary: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

games.name: Nightshift; Nowhere
games.summary: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

games.name: Oddments & Offerings
games.summary: A first-person shopkeeper extraction game where you run a mysterious antique store by day and explore dangerous locations by night in search of rare and valuable oddities. Extract with you're loot, grow your shop and decide what is worth selling - and what is worth keeping.

games.name: Roll of Chaos
games.summary: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

games.name: Sky Strike Overdrive
games.summary: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

games.name: Facrobry
games.summary: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

games.name: Krushpit
games.summary: Krushpit is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

games.name: Tidy Tech
games.summary: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

games.name: Scale a Building
games.summary: A game about scaling a building

games.name: Hatch'n'wall
games.summary: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

games.name: District Null
games.summary:
District Null is a cyberpunk city-building simulation set on the colony planet AZ884, a world almost twice the size of Earth. Its northern side lies under a thick blanket of smog, while the unexplored region of Cibola waits in the south. On the General's orders, the player founds a district that is connected to the other territories by a highway.

The player lays roads, zones residential, commercial and industrial areas and watches the city grow house by house. Construction sites have real build times, all the way up to plateaus and skyscrapers. Traffic with commuters, traffic lights and highway interchanges, the power grid with fusion plants, thermal plants and energy relays, as well as fire services, ambulances and police are simulated at the same time. Venues such as a cinema, a stadium, a casino and a concert hall each have their own programme, visitors and income.

A research lab and a university unlock new technology and train skilled workers. Creatures like a giant worm, pterosaurs and slime men attack the city and are fought with defense units and ships from a weapons factory. The colony's long-term goal is drilling through the planet's core.

games.name: Nonogram Detective
games.summary: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

games.name: Jump Bald
games.summary: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! Every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

games.name: All Those Dungeons in Alva's Head
aliases: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
games.summary: All Those Dungeons in Alvas Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alvas mind.

games.name: Garito
games.summary: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines one strike at a time.

games.name: Brokeline
games.summary: Brokeline is a story-driven text game with a messenger-style interface. Play as Ivan Savin, a resident of Tikhovsk: chat with friends and strangers, choose your replies, plan your day, and make time for meetings beyond the screen.

games.name: Worjong
games.summary: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words. Play against the CPU or online with up to four players.

games.name: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
games.summary: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush fuses match-3 puzzles with physics-based Pachinko action! Match tiles to drop bouncy balls through pegs into multiplier slots for massive combos. Unleash powerful boosters, buy permanent upgrades, and dominate global leaderboards!

games.name: Stellar Wing
games.summary: A space fighter shooter about taking a carrier apart. Fly as a flight of four, burn down the turrets, crack the shield generators, then kill the core. Rebuild your fighter from 200 parts across 12 campaign missions and 30 hunts against 10 machine leviathans.

games.name: Slythe
games.summary: A snake made of heroes. An arena full of things that want it dead. Steer, stack classes, build something broken, and dive past the final boss into endless depths, New Game+, and a global leaderboard. The snake never stops - can you keep up?

games.name: Underpaid
games.summary: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

games.name: Sweep Protocol
games.summary: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

games.name: Underdeep
games.summary: Underdeep is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

games.name: Hover Raid
games.summary: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this very short, linear incremental action game.

games.name: Megashootsplosion
games.summary: A fast, physics-drunk arena shooter that never stays the same. Throw your gun to reload, wall-jump to stay alive, and stack chaotic upgrades until fights get gloriously out of hand. Duel 1v1 or brawl up to 4 players across 8 modes.

games.name: Body Kounts
games.summary: Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death. Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

games.name: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
games.summary: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces youll want to return to after a noisy day.

games.name: Tiny Garden Café
games.summary: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glowenjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

games.name: Gore Grind
games.summary: A first-person roguelite horde shooter for 1 to 4 players in couch co-op. The city mutated, the internet is down, and dying costs money. Shoot the horde, bank the cash, and keep working for the only pizza place still open.

games.name: Scarlet Beret: Murder at the Orphanage
games.summary: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

games.name: Cat Pipes: More Meow
games.summary:
Cat Pipes: More Meow is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game about guiding warmth to sleepy cats. Rotate the pipes to connect the flow from the main source to every cat in the room, then watch each one light up and purr.

With 51 handcrafted levels that ease you in and slowly grow into satisfying brain-teasers, portals that bend the path across the board, and a warm lo-fi atmosphere, it's the perfect little game to unwind with.

games.name: The Wizard's Assistants
games.summary:
The Wizard’s Assistants is a single-player exploration adventure where you traverse a chaotic collapsing tower, help the assistants stranded within it, and gather quarks to gain magical augments as you search for a way upward to the moon.

Something has gone awry in the Wizard’s tower. As one of the assistants, explore a strange and increasingly chaotic world of magical experiments, scattered clues, and fellow assistants in need of help. Follow your curiosity, collect quarks, and earn new magical augments as you unravel what happened and find out how to escape.

The Wizard's experiments have left the tower in a state of magical disarray. Assistants are scattered throughout, continuously performing the last task they were assigned. You play an assistant whose eyes are on the moon and making your way through it all: lending a hand where you can, examining the Wizard's questionable notes, unraveling your past, and following a trail of quarks that charge Nexus points along the way. Above it all is the moon.

Explore places within the tower ranging from the tower’s pipes to the Wizard's workshop, reaching as high up as the rafters. Run, climb, jump, and glide, all at your own pace. Talk with the assistants you encounter, and investigate the oddities the Wizard has left behind. Collect quarks to charge Nexus points to unlock magical augments that you can use to bounce, traverse ledges, teleport, ride beams of light, and puzzle your way through the tower, revealing paths that were previously out of reach. Along the way, examine notes, scrolls, and glyphs that gradually unveil the workings of the Wizard and the assistants who need your help to escape along with you.

Every place you visit invites another question, every assistant has another situation to resolve, and every augment leads to new experiments. Keep exploring, keep helping, and keep following the quarks upward to find out for yourself if the moon really is made of cheese.

games.name: Pokémon GS Vitro
games.summary:
Experience Johto like never before in Pokémon GS Vitro, a remake of Pokémon Crystal—now with an open world!
A game for all fans of the second generation, featuring an expanded Pokédex, new Mega Evolutions, and modernized mechanics for the best experience these games have to offer.

games.name: Kill or Be Killed
games.summary: Kill or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

games.name: Mogumogu! Poop Battle
games.summary: Control a , gather , and feed them to with your teammate! Eaten turn into and get SHOOT at the enemy! 2v2 online battle for up to 4 players. Play solo or with friends!

games.name: Halloween Poppp
games.summary: Halloween Poppp is an easy, Halloween-themed connect-and-match puzzle. Space keeps shrinking — plan each move and pick the best option under pressure. Master 10 tools, chain combos for multiplied scores, and earn richer gems. Level up, then prove yourself on the Steam leaderboard!

games.name: Back Together
games.summary: Back Together is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

games.name: Making Room?
games.summary: An unpaid-rent argument leads Var to a house book that changes her housemates whenever they cross the kitchen threshold. A short psychological horror visual novel about living together, resentment, and making other people easier to bear.

games.name: Axe Descent
games.summary: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

games.name: Desktop Cleaner 98
games.summary:
It's 1998 and lighting hit some family's PC. Every file survived... just not in the right places. It's up to you, the IT professional, to put it all back.

Navigate ~3,000 files across a deep, branching tree of folders, each themed around which files belong there. Games in games, taxes in taxes, and "homework" in homework.

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

games.name: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
games.summary: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

games.name: God Is Not Here
games.summary: FREE THRILLING FIRST-PERSON HORROR! You will find yourself in a house haunted by ghosts, and there is no help from above. Fear, darkness, and real danger await you, hidden within the walls of the mansion. If you dare to enter, prayers will no longer save you.

games.name: Postal Adrenalin
games.summary: Adrenalin is a massive single-player mod for Postal 2, featuring two total conversions and separate story campaigns set in the shared city of Rockwood. Set after the events of Apocalypse Weekend, it combines Postal 2’s style and redesigns levels, weapons, characters, and vehicles.

games.name: Alice in Pumpkinland
games.summary: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

games.name: Scared Puppies
games.summary: In Scared Puppies, you dive into the paws of adventurous puppies on a mission to find their lost owner. Set in a vibrant world, the game blends puzzle-solving with light adventure elements, promoting teamwork and clever strategy.

games.name: Talaire
games.summary: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

games.name: Temple of Your Mom
games.summary: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

games.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
games.summary: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

games.name: Last Lawn Standing
games.summary: Shape enemy paths with towers and barricades, then fight alongside your defenses as a garden gnome armed with auto-firing weapons and powerful potions. Protect bonus-granting shrines, upgrade without limits, unlock permanent rewards, and survive solo or in 4-player local co-op.

games.name: Hospital Rhapsody
games.summary: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

games.name: Stonestorm
games.summary: Stonestorm is a free-to-play idle MMORPG set in an East Asian fantasy world. Your hero hunts, levels up and gathers loot for up to 8 hours while you're away, but you set up every battle: the gear, the skill and the opponent. Choose one of three kingdoms (Bonghwa, Horang or Miru) and one of four classes (Warrior, Ninja, Mage or Shaman), each with two paths from level 5. Push your armour to +9 at the blacksmith, clear six lands with their own lords, run forays and dungeons, climb the forty floors of the Stormcatcher, fight other players' heroes in the Arena, and build a fortress with your guild. One account works in the browser and on mobile, in 30 languages.

games.name: Rune Delvers: Idle RPG
games.summary:
It's a game where you're an explorer traveling through different dimensions. During your journey, you'll encounter enemies that you defeat by getting close. These enemies drop a strange silver coin, which you can use the power of runes to convert into a gold coin. This allows you to upgrade your equipment chest and summon better gear.

Equip yourself with the best gear you can and enter different dungeons to obtain souls in the form of colored orbs from each boss. Use these orbs to access and upgrade a skill tree, boosting your stats and unlocking the magic of your runes.

Unlock various artifacts that will aid you on your journey by reducing currency conversion costs, upgrade costs, increasing your stats, and providing other bonuses you'll discover as you play.

Unlock new dimensions where you can obtain more resources and unlock new features and mechanics.

Explore a new world under construction...

games.name: One More Lawn
games.summary: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

games.name: Chrono Cards
games.summary: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

games.name: Cascabel
games.summary: Cascabel is an online western role-playing game set in a valley in the Brazilian countryside, played in the PC web browser with no download. Players arrive as travelers and choose their own path: learning trades, fishing, hunting, raising a ranch with crops and livestock, and riding between villages. Goods are sold and traded with other players in the village Market, and duels in the street only start when both players accept.

games.name: Tide of the Depths
games.summary: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

games.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die
games.summary: Run a supernatural supermarket for zombies, vampires, werewolves, and cyborgs. Stock your shelves, grow your business, gamble at the bar, hire muscle, and sabotage rival stores. But be ready when they strike back. Explore the strange neighborhood, uncover its dark secrets, and remember: sell or die.

games.name: Thyranya
games.summary:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

games.name: Dancing Wings: The Aerobatic Simulator
games.summary: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

games.name: Bot Colony _redux
games.summary: Bot Colony _redux is a story-based sci-fi adventure game. You advance in the game by speaking to robotic characters who answer intelligently or execute commands. Interacting with characters who understand you and have unique personalities and emotions is a new, immersive game experience.

games.name: Crystallium
games.summary: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

games.name: Hypernet Explorer
games.summary: Roguelite immersive sim set in post Y2K Europe.

games.name: The Golden Caravan
games.summary: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

games.name: Phosphor
games.summary:
Phosphor is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer roguelike where you descend into procedurally generated cyberpunk biomes, battling waves of drones, mechs, and biotech horrors.
Master dynamic combat blending gunfire, melee, dashes, and cyber spells. Stack elemental effects like Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Poison to unleash powerful reactions, then take on massive, pattern-heavy bosses.
Forge devastating builds from hundreds of weapons, passives, and abilities that synergize across runs. Unlock upgrades with persistence cores, tackle daily/weekly challenges, and push deeper with every attempt.
A high-mobility, challenging 2D action game inspired by the intensity of Dead Cells and the emergent chaos of Noita. Currently in active development and beta testing ahead of Steam launch.
Get to the core. The Phosphor still lives.

games.name: Kinetiks
aliases: Kinetiks - Jeu de combat en arène compétitif
games.summary:
Kinetiks is a futuristic competitive arena sport game combining fast-paced action, tactical teamwork and physics-based gameplay.
Players compete in intense matches where movement, precision and strategy are essential. Control the energy disc, outmaneuver opponents and use teamwork to dominate the arena.
Designed as an esports-oriented experience, Kinetiks focuses on skill-based competition, dynamic gameplay and memorable team battles.

games.name: Hauntworks
games.summary: Hauntworks is a dark comedy haunted house management sim where you build an automated scare factory. Your undertakers harvest human reactions like screams, vomit, and laughter as physical resources, which you pipe through production chains to appease otherworldly patrons and escape limbo. Releasing in Early Access Halloween 2026.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Eternal Blade
games.summary: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

games.name: Company Tycoon
games.summary: A cyberpunk-styled business simulation and tycoon game where players build, scale, and manage their own tech empire.

games.name: Harvest Exit Plan
games.summary:
Harvest Exit Plan is a first-person collect-a-thon set in an orchard the player has inherited from their grandparents. Fruit is picked up by hand at first, later with a grabber and a fruit vacuum; each tool can be upgraded for reach, speed, yield per grab and basket capacity, paid for from the proceeds of what was sold before.

Six gardens open one after another, each with its own fruit type and an automated harvester that keeps collecting while the player is elsewhere. Collecting without pause builds a streak that raises the pace in stages and culminates in a Frenzy state. Clearing a quarter of a garden keeps it clear and pays a bonus for the rest of the run. Rare fruit variants, per-garden mastery goals and a records screen track how thoroughly a run was played. Emptying the orchard ends the first season rather than the game. Each following season runs faster than the last and opens card slots; cards dealt between seasons modify the next run, for example larger baskets, longer reach, more productive harvesters or cheaper upgrades.

games.name: Fire Up Together
games.summary: Fire Up Together is a physics-based co-op platforming adventure for up to four players. Use pressurized water to launch yourself into the air, extinguish fires, overcome chaotic obstacles, and climb as high as possible with your friends.

games.name: Lumisar
games.summary:
Lumisar is a PvP-focused fantasy MMORPG set in a persistent, seamless world without loading screens. Players choose from six races — Arin, Lumir, Shadir, Gorgar, Krahtar and Lumisari — each tied to its own kingdom, culture and class paths.

The core loop is built around kingdom building, territory control and warfare. Players form clans and alliances, contest castles and regions, and defend them through sieges. Combat is target-based and party-oriented, with dedicated support, buff and crowd-control roles rather than solo-focused action.

The game is built in Unreal Engine 5.8 on a custom authoritative server architecture, designed for large-scale battles within a single contiguous world.

games.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
games.summary: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.

games.name: Oktoraid
games.summary:
Oktoraid is a base-defence roguelite for one or two players with local split-screen co-op. The players control two operators, joined by a power cable, who defend a core against an invading machine army.

Each wave starts with a preparation phase in which the players build turrets, helper-bots and pallet walls before a siren starts the siege. During the siege the operators' weapons fire automatically alongside the turrets and bots, and the run ends if the core is destroyed. Staying close along the power cable raises both players' damage and lets the cable shock robots, while a market between waves offers items that can be rerolled or locked and weapons that can be upgraded and combined.

games.name: Day 31
games.summary: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

games.name: Backrooms Blocks
games.summary: Mine the walls. Build a shelter. Keep the almond milk. Backrooms Blocks is a first-person voxel survival game filled with strange creatures, tiny clown familiars, dangerous lucky blocks, and doors into impossible places. You were only going to the grocery store.

games.name: Fart Together
games.summary: Fart Together is a physics-based parkour game where 1–4 players steer the same boat using fart power. Play alone or with friends and coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

games.name: The Boo Club
games.summary: A 1–4 player co-op horror-comedy about amateur ghost hunters with terrible ideas. Complete rituals, unleash ridiculous gear, and mess with your friends. Gain superpowers, take flight, and fight Satan himself. Teamwork gets the job done. Taking all the glory is tempting.

games.name: Unrivaled
games.summary: Unrivaled is a single-player collectible card game set in Card City, where you're aiming to win tournaments and become the Unrivaled Champion. Along the way you battle 12 bosses and an evil team that's trying to scalp all the card packs in the city. Win battles, rip packs, and build decks from over 400 cards.

games.name: OpenTricky
games.summary: SSX Tricky (Xbox, 2001), running natively on Windows.

games.name: BalenaScape
games.summary: BalenaScape is a free, browser-based MMORPG in early access, designed for a PC or laptop with a mouse and keyboard. Players explore a fantasy world, train 17 skills to level 99, complete 13 quests, face 18 bosses and play 9 minigames. Activities include gathering resources, crafting, trading and fighting monsters. The Deepdiving skill opens an underwater region reached by diving bell, with an air meter, resources, shipwrecks and bosses.

games.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike
games.summary: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

games.name: Jiggle or Physics
games.summary: An unofficial Windows x64 static recompilation of the US PlayStation 1 release of Dead or Alive, created by 3DGE.

games.name: DriftyLands
games.summary: Buy an island, clear it, automate it, then find the hole underneath. A first-person co-op base builder for 2-4 friends: gather, craft, build machines, and take your tools down into the dungeon below every island you buy.

games.name: The Cake Mistake
games.summary: After being shipped the wrong form of 'YellowCake', a pastry chef bakes his creations, to find himself surrounded by nuclear cakes, ice cream sandwiches and other delicious desserts. Survive and navigate your way out of this Sugary Factory.

games.name: Haunted: Escape the Dollhouse
games.summary: One player investigates a mysterious dollhouse while their friends are trapped inside it. A chaotic and highly replayable co-op paranormal investigation for 2–4 players. Share clues, solve occult puzzles, and try not to panic when your friends give terrible directions.

games.name: Re:Integral
games.summary: Metal Gear Solid Re:Integral is a Windows x86 source port of the original PlayStation Metal Gear Solid Integral, built from FoxdieTeam's recovered C and the PsyZ platform library.

games.name: Celestial Sentinel
games.summary: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.
developers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio
publishers: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio

games.name: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
games.summary: Run a neon-lit roadside motel with an arcade next door. Haggle with guests, upgrade rooms, play eight fully playable arcade games, cook burgers for hungry players and manage it all from your retro tablet, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: Jet Combat Simulator
games.summary: Three brothers made the jet game they always wanted to play. Fly fast and low over an endless world you can blow apart. Mouse-aim flight with real aircraft numbers, 31 planes from the Me 262 to the B-52, low-pass streaks that score big, and a career that fills your hangar.

games.name: Tales of Symphonia: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Tales of Symphonia: Definitive Edition is a large fan-made mod for the game's Steam version. The project aims to combine the best of the different versions released since the GameCube debut in 2003, restore features lost in later ports, and modernize aspects that have aged.

games.name: AstraCube
games.summary:
AstraCube is a voxel survival game where every planet is a cube. You crash on an alien world with a wrecked ship, a journal, and not much else. Mine and craft your way from bare hands to stone tools, metal, power and machines, then rebuild your ship and fly between the planets of your solar system, and beyond.

Every world is generated from its seed: its own ground, plants, weather, animals and ores. Walk over the edge of a cube and the ground becomes the wall. Live with the people of each world: villages of six different races who work, sleep, talk in their own alphabet (your suit translates) and trade from what they gather. Farm, hunt, build a sealed base, run power, and fly ships you built yourself. Play alone or co-op with friends, on your own dedicated server if you like.

games.name: SSX Reconstruction
games.summary: This is a reconstruction of the PS2 game SSX in Rust and Bevy.

games.name: Grimhold
games.summary: A dark fantasy roguelike tower defense. Hold the wall against endless legions across ten acts, command 23 unique heroes and forge runs that never repeat. Every wave you survive is a choice; every choice reshapes the siege. How long can Grimhold hold?

games.name: Tahúr: A Blackjack Adventure
games.summary: Tahúr: A Blackjack Adventure is a blackjack roguelike. Instead of playing against the house, the player plays twenty-one head to head against rivals, using powerups that bend the rules and permanently marked cards that change how a card counts. Each district is run by a kingpin who breaks their own table's rules once pushed to match point. The game includes a story campaign, an endless Ladder mode, a seeded Daily Deal, and online duels in which both players draft powerups of the same tier and play a shoe of randomly marked cards.

games.name: Reactor Zero
games.summary: Reactor Zero is a fast-paced multiplayer browser co-op action game where players choose classes and defend a core against waves of enemies.

games.name: Urine Trouble: Pee V Pee
games.summary: Urine Trouble: Pee V Pee is an asymmetrical multiplayer stealth shooter where the pissers must empty their bladders across the city without being detected, while the police will do anything they can to stop them.

games.name: Magical Ascent
games.summary: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

games.name: Kaput
games.summary: Kaput is a chaotic co-op horror comedy game for up to 6 players. Explore abandoned places, repair failing machinery, and salvage high-value scrap while avoiding terrifying anomalies. Work together, handle hazardous breakdown events, and escape with your loot before everything goes kaput!

games.name: Clawstral
games.summary: A charming claw machine-themed roguelite! Never underestimate the claw!

games.name: My Gaming Shop
games.summary: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

games.name: Inn Kreeper
games.summary: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

games.name: Subspace Brawl
games.summary: Subspace Brawl is a top-down space battle that a streamer's Twitch chat plays. Viewers type !join to get a ship that flies and fights on its own in the streamer's arena, then steer the fight from chat: firing missiles and mines, raising shields, ramming and retreating to their base. Cheers call orbital strikes on random ships and channel point redeems drop nukes, black holes and other calamities. Modes include team Factions, Free-For-All and Boss fights where the whole chat teams up against a giant boss, with time or stock (lives) win conditions, results boards and seasonal cosmetics. Free to play on Windows or in the browser.

games.name: Kur: Endless Descent
games.summary:
KUR is a free to play idle dungeon crawler set in the underworld of Mesopotamian myth. It runs in a small window you can resize, switch to a minimal view or shrink to a tiny progress tracker in the corner of your screen while you work or play something else.

Your party of three heroes explores and fights on its own. You decide who descends, what they carry, how they grow and how deep to push. Choose from eight classes, each with a male and a female version, and combine skills, a passive tree for every class and party synergies to face what lies below.

Descend through seven Domains, each with its own monsters and a guardian waiting at its Gate. Break the last Gate and the descent begins again under the Mark, deeper and harder, with no bottom. Fight more than 80 creatures drawn from Mesopotamian sources, loot hundreds of named items across nine rarities, forge and fuse gear at camp and grow a Seal that never resets.

Monsters drop Ash, which can become Artifacts, numbered, limited and never sold. Player trading through the Steam Inventory is coming soon. Free to play, and you never pay to win.

games.name: Tie Down
games.summary: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

games.name: Cinderwake
games.summary: Cinderwake is a dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees: the Arcanist, Ravager, Huntress, Gravecaller and Oathsworn. Players fight through acts of randomly generated maps alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players. Items have random affixes, sockets, runes and sets. Every hero has a pet fox that picks up loot and sells the junk in town. After the story come harder world levels and an endless endgame dungeon.

games.name: Know Your Ánima
games.summary: A cozy farming sim with a mystical, introspective soul. Tend your inner garden over a 12-day cycle, make choices and bond with the spirit animals who visit you. Everything you do, and everything you don't, reveals your personality through your dominant Ánimas. Do you dare to know yourself?

games.name: Wild Spirits Era
games.summary: Wild Spirits Era is an online multiplayer social survival game for up to 50 players. Explore a newly generated world, gather Vital Energy, build, fight, form alliances, and stay protected by a Relic when the 28-minute Era ends.

games.name: Call Me, Liar
games.summary: Call Me, Liar is a social deduction party game show for 4 to 8 friends, played online with voice chat. Everyone plays from their own room, makes deals and tells lies over private phone calls, and then watches the truth come out on live TV. Ten games, eight in every show, and only one winner.

games.name: Soul Tides
games.summary: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

games.name: Television Dynasty Manager
games.summary: Take over your own station at the dawn of television and turn it into America’s greatest TV dynasty. Produce your own series, shows and films, secure the best programs, build studios, expand your broadcast area and plan the perfect schedule. But the competition never sleeps.

games.name: The Trivia Show
games.summary: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, axe-wielding gnomes, revolvers on the table and much more.

games.name: Me vs. You
games.summary: You play a normal Match3 game but this time, you can actually battle others. Attack them directly, weaken them, buff yourself, manipulate the board to your liking or to your enemies disliking. Prove that you are better than anyone else on the battlefield.

games.name: Terran Dawn
games.summary: An isometric sci-fi RTS of fleet command and orbital industry. Mine asteroids, grow a station from a single command core, research new technology and design your own ships module by module, then wage war across 84 branching missions, survival runs and online battles.

games.name: Steins;Gate: Octet of Shifting Space
games.summary: A non-canon extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. Although non-canon, the game contains many easter eggs and references that connect Chaos;Head and Steins;Gate together.

games.name: RPG Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: A traditional JRPG developed by Kemco for mobile devices based in a world where people are connected with ancient creatures called "artifacts".

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Boku Boku
games.summary:
Boku Boku is a Cozy Building sandbox game.
You can build houses, create your own worlds, and make new friends.
Explore a wondrous world, and leave your mark in this pixel paradise.

games.name: Yomawari: Midnight Shadows
games.summary: The dark is no place to be alone. After a beautiful show of summer fireworks, two young girls begin to make their way home. However, a mysterious attacker separates them, and both must brave the haunting night filled with unspeakable terrors and survive the darkness.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Mission Pack 1 - Extra Challenge
games.summary:
This is the road to hell.
The extraterrestrial life forms the Primers slam this challenge down to any elite EDF soldier: A mission pack of over 10 incredibly difficult missions. Enemies that only appeared in the hardest missions of the main campaign now appear in droves. Aliens with gear they didn't have in the main campaign will assail you. Are you brave enough to take the first step on the road to hell?

Over 30 new weapons!

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, or share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive...

games.name: Destruction AllStars
games.summary:
Stars and cars collide.

Dominate the glittering global phenomenon of Destruction AllStars – the spectacular prime-time sport for dangerous drivers!
Master the art of intense vehicle-based combat through timing, tactics and skills to cause colossal amounts of damage, destruction and devastation in vibrant arenas across the globe.

Pile-on the destruction from behind the wheel or leap into the arena with a breathtaking reel of parkour action by dodging attacks, taking over vehicles or using abilities to disrupt the onslaught of incoming vehicles.

Cause enough mayhem to power up your AllStars game-changing hero vehicle fueled with special abilities.

A roster of 16 blockbuster Destruction AllStars are revved up and ready to compete in the name of entertainment and demolition. So, strap in for intense, explosive and unpredictable levels of free-flowing action and fight to be crowned the Global Destruction Federation Champion.

It’s time to run, ram and slam. See you in the arena.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
aliases: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Noble Fates
games.summary: A 3D Fantasy Kingdom Sim driven by intelligent characters with a rich simulation of opinions and memories. Build, Craft, Farm, Mine, Hunt, Defend, and more! Command from the sky or take control in third person as your story goes where the people, your actions, and their reactions take it.

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

games.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
games.summary: A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop.

games.name: Light: Black Cat & Amnesia Girl
games.summary: "Light" is a 3D adventure puzzle game, in which you play as a cat. You will help a little girl who has lost her memory escape by leading her through four-level mazes with different style.

games.name: Witch on the Holy Night
games.summary: Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

games.name: We are Eva
games.summary: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling between them whenever you like! Doesn't it sound fun? My name is Eva, by the way, I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at, and I promise we'll have fun. If you add me to your wishlist, of course. *wink wink*

games.name: GeoJelly
games.summary: Born within unknown you instinctively seek for freedom as an experiment defect. In GeoJelly you have to find your way out of dystopian laboratory through platforming while avoiding traps and collecting keys necessary to push forward. Are you gonna find a way out?

games.name: Below the Stone
games.summary: Below the Stone is a pixel-art roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Stellar Blade
games.summary: Stellar Blade is a third-person action-adventure game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Players control Eve, an elite soldier deployed from an orbital colony to reclaim the planet from hostile creatures called Naytibas. The combat system emphasizes timing-based parrying and evasion, with skill gauges that unlock powerful attacks and buffs. The game features exploration across ruined environments, side quests from NPC survivors in the last human city of Xion, and a narrative with multiple endings based on player choices.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
aliases: Project Re Fantasy: A Fool's Journey Begins
メタファー：リファンタジオ
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: Thronefall
games.summary: A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity, just some healthy hack-and-slay. Build up your base during the day, and defend it ‘til your last breath at night.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
games.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ delivers the ultimate, feature-complete, randomized dungeon-crawling experience, now enhanced with full online co-op for up to four players. It integrates all previous DCs and content updates, featuring 700+ items and over 300 enemy types. Key features include new online leaderboards, an emote wheel, and refined multiplayer systems.

games.name: Pit of Goblin
games.summary: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

games.name: The End of the Sun
games.summary: The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-based game, embedded in the Slavic world. This is a series of mysterious events that ordinary people dealt with, as they were living in a small village where the line between myth and reality became to fade perilously.
developers: The End of the Sun Forge
publishers: The End of the Sun Forge

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

games.name: The Slormancer
games.summary: Fight hordes of enemies lead by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Featuring loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary: Spirit Crossing is a beautiful cooperative life-sim about building friendships and community. Sign up for our Closed Alpha playtest and discover a world where you can connect, escape, and belong.

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS

games.name: Wobbly Life
games.summary: Wobbly Life is a lively open world physics based sandbox. Play with your friends in Online and local co-op, discover a variety of minigames and objectives to earn cash to spend in the world!

games.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Set in a new fantastical world, Ages of Cataria is a cozy-friendly town sim. Watch as your village evolves from humble beginnings, with just one family, to a community of multiple families living together across generations of time.

games.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

games.name: Leaf Blower Co.
games.summary: Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

games.name: Project Afterfall
games.summary: A dark, strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore. Set in the wolrd of Thea, but thrust 1000 years into an urban future. Rebuild your colony, explore the post-apocalyptic wasteland, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Immerse yourself in a story-rich adventure with branching narratives.

games.name: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
games.summary:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

games.name: Sintropia Fruits Together
games.summary: In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary:
Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity!

Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

Take the role of a soldier tasked with locating a hidden laboratory, use firearms and melee strikes to fend off undead hordes and work with your squad as you navigate the urban sprawl. Cycle between upgradeable weapon types like semi-automatic rifles, handguns and more, pick up ammo wherever you can find it and make contact with human survivors to gain information or supplies. Complete mission objectives and survive at all costs, then push your skills even further in New Game Plus.

games.name: Cat Mirror
games.summary: A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at once, navigating intricate levels where every move is mirrored. It looks easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection?

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

games.name: Makai City Chi-Ba
games.summary: Four high school students and the spirits of Chiba fight monsters that suddenly appear in their hometown. A fantasy RPG where modern Japan meets local legend, built on real Chiba folklore. One developer, ten years. Turn-based, 3-6 hours. Japanese & English.

games.name: Hozy
games.summary: Transform abandoned spaces into cozy havens in Hozy!

games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
games.summary: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
games.summary: The Sergeant is back. Ready to turn unqualified recruits into fearless war machines. Manage your camp and prepare your squad with tougher training and new challenges, will they be ready for a real battlefield? New skill tree, more abilities and a reworked battle system. Start you deployment now.

games.name: House Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique cleaning simulator.

games.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
games.summary: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!?

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary: Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

games.name: Everything Is Crab
