games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.summary: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: Vem, Exu
games.summary:
Vem, Exu is a narrative adventure game about anger, memory and reconciliation. After losing his kite during a fight with his brother, Exu falls asleep carrying his rage and enters a storm where dreams, memories and imagination merge together.

Players progress through the story by interacting with symbolic environments and completing simple activities such as connecting stars, bursting bubbles and rebuilding objects. Inspired by Brazilian culture, cordel art and Afro-Brazilian symbolism, the game focuses on visual storytelling and emotional progression.

games.name: Path Defenders
aliases: Path Defenders: More Than Just Tower Defense
games.summary: A single-player MMORPG fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, Build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.

games.name: Ice Cream Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

games.name: Bowling Alley Simulator
games.summary: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

games.name: The Count is Down for Blood
games.summary: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.summary:
Manala: Equinox War is a LARP world where you build your combat deck and fight other players. Pick up your foam sword, put on your wizard hat and let's go kill the bad guys.

Depending on your point of view, that's either the person in the orc mask or the dwarf with a glued-on beard. The player characters are modeled on real LARPers' costumes.

If you're losing badly, you can always cheat. Just ignore the rules for a bit and be prepared to live with the shame.

games.name: Young Suns
games.summary: Young Suns is a narrative life sim set after a successful revolution on Jupiter. Explore fantastical planetoids, derelict ruins, and converted stations with a crew of up to three friends or on your own. Help the friendly citizens of Jupiter rebuild!

games.name: Fjordal
games.summary: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

games.name: Alderun
games.summary:
Alderun is a free-to-play fantasy strategy RPG that blends real-time strategy with MOBA-style hero combat. Players choose a hero, such as a holy knight, a dark summoner, or a marksman with a wolf companion, then level up, learn skills, and buy gear from merchants while leading an army across a variety of battlegrounds.

Solo modes include defending a fortress against waves of enemies and bosses, building towers to stop an enemy advance, and one-on-one duels in the Arena. In 5v5 matches, teams push three lanes toward the enemy citadel, farm creep camps, and contest a pit boss and runes. Large-scale 10v10 and 20-player battles take place in a frozen valley, where teams capture graveyards and bunkers to push their front line forward.

Matches can be played against AI or real players, with cross-platform multiplayer across PC, mobile, and browser. Players can host public or private games, join friends by code, or use quick match. A map editor is also included.

games.name: Bombanana!
games.summary: Bombanana! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: Just Volleyball
games.summary: just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve. (taken from Steam page)

games.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
games.summary: Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs and drones. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI. Get ready for a Silicon Sprint.

games.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
games.summary: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights is a Sudoku game set in an observatory at night. Every day all players get the same Nightly puzzle, and each solve adds a star to the player's sky, where the stars gradually join into constellations. A cat sits on the observatory's window ledge and walks along the top of the board, reacting to mistakes and to streaks of correct answers; it can be petted and given one of eight coats. The game also includes 5,000 offline puzzles across four difficulties, ten switchable background worlds, an in-game lo-fi radio with optional ambient sounds, and an optional account for Nightly leaderboards.

games.name: Moonlight Knight
games.summary: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

games.name: Laser Lightshow
games.summary: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

games.name: Exitus
games.summary: You woke up, and you have no idea where you are. What a coincidence, you don't remember anything at all; could you have been kidnapped? There is only one way to find out.

games.name: Pozionista
games.summary: Creates potions with plants gathered in the woods, discover new ways to make potions and sell those potions to stores

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Observe. Think. Decode.A first-person adventure game focused on code-breaking and puzzle-solving. Lost in a maze of memories, can you find the path to save the future?

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
games.summary: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

games.name: Eona
games.summary: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

games.name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.name: Magic Kingdom
games.summary: Magic Kingdom je jedním ze čtyř tematických parků tvořících Walt Disney World Resort v oblasti Lake Buena Vista nedaleko Orlanda na Floridě v USA. Park byl poprvé otevřen 1. října 1971. Struktura parku i atrakce jsou podobné, jako v Disneylandu v Kalifornii. V roce 2006 navštívilo park zhruba 16 640 000 návštěvníků.
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

games.name: Of the Devil: Episode 3
games.summary: Morgan finds herself centerstage as the State conducts a witch trial to exorcise itself of one of its most outspoken critics, but she refuses to play the fool in the oncoming torrent of political theater.

games.name: Alchemortis
games.summary: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

games.name: Parralysis
games.summary: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

games.name: Infinity Ship
games.summary: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Wheel Make It
games.summary: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.name: Too Hot to Be True
games.summary: “Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!" Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?

games.name: Wanderdawn
games.summary: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

games.name: Graveyard Orbit
games.summary: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

games.name: Locked in Love: The Office
games.summary: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

games.name: Green Inferno
games.summary: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

games.name: Slotbound
games.summary: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: Love D3ath Love
games.summary: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

games.name: Tiny Survivors
games.summary: Tiny Survivors is a chill top-down autobattler with lots of enemies and randomly generated synergies.

games.name: Agebound
games.summary: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

games.name: It's About Pirates
games.summary: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

games.name: Build & Putt
games.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: Plum
games.summary: Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

games.name: Meltdown
games.summary: Meltdown is an isometric action-adventure game for the Amstrad CPC published by Alligata in 1986. There are two versions: a 64k version with basic speech synthesis and a 128k version featuring much more speech synthesis. A version was also released in French called Le Syndrome.

games.name: Desiderium
games.summary: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

games.name: Drawmi: Card Shop
games.summary: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.

games.name: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
games.summary: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

games.name: Find All 10: Greece
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

games.name: Spell Unbound
games.summary: One spell. It is a circle. Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite where you bind beasts by looping them with the mouse - no sword, no staff, nothing else in your hand. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

games.name: FFFF: Fatal Five Finger Fillet
games.summary:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

games.name: Jester Under Pressure
games.summary: Diskarte is a Filipino-inspired visual novel where you play as a nonbinary jester trying to entertain a queen who explodes heads. With 33,000+ words, 60+ Filipino terms, and four branching routes (including romance), it blends humor, danger, and vibrant storytelling. Can you survive her wrath?

games.name: Tarot Tokens
games.summary: The Fools Journey

games.name: DinoBox
games.summary: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

games.name: Carnor City
games.summary: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKUltra agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

games.name: Resettle
games.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

games.name: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
games.summary: A short incremental tower defense game with a massive skill tree! Recruit a team of cute and deadly animal friends, shop for powerful hats, construct buildings, assign workers, and unlock powerful upgrades to Feed The Frog King!

games.name: Heirs of the Fountains
games.summary: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

games.name: Ezalm: Magic's Memory
games.summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.

games.name: The Idle Shard
games.summary:
The Idle Shard is a free, classless MMO inspired by Ultima that runs in your browser. Grow any of 40 skills, from Mining and Blacksmithing to Magery and Animal Taming. Your character keeps working for up to 8 hours after you close the tab, and the ore, hides, kills and skill gains are waiting when you return.

Everyone plays in one shared world. Raise 14 towns together, battle 13 bosses across 13 dungeons solo or in a party, trade on a player-run market, build anything from a cottage to a castle, found a guild, sail the High Seas, or follow the 8 Virtues.

games.name: Silent Noise: The Park Shift
aliases: Silent Noise Chapter 1 : The Park Shift
games.summary:
Silent Noise: Chapter 1 – The Park Shift is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. It combines cinematic storytelling, immersive atmosphere, and unique mechanics that challenge both mind and heart.
You play as David, an 18-year-old scarred by tragedy. At age five, his father died from chemical exposure at a factory, leaving David emotionally broken and unable to continue his education. His mother, weakened by grief and illness, depends entirely on him. To support her, David takes a job as a night security guard and caretaker in a park that was abandoned for years but has recently reopened.

games.name: Ablation
games.summary: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

games.name: Spell Code SlingerZ
games.summary: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

games.name: Anomaly Archives
games.summary: Trapped within shifting liminal spaces, you must rely on keen observation to survive. Inspect your surroundings, detect subtle anomalies, and make the right elevator decisions to break the loop and escape.

games.name: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
games.summary: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach! is a first-person beach cleanup and restoration simulation. Collect and sort 7,621 items across the beach, ocean and pier, tidy clothing stores and surf rentals, put beach chairs and toys back in place, and restore the coral reef while helping turtles. Earn money to buy cleaning tools and skills, use an auto-sorter, and hire a dog to carry trash. Play alone or with friends in online, LAN and local split-screen co-op. Character customization unlocks as stores are sorted, and players can use water guns, throw coconuts and crabs, and play with a seagull gun.

games.name: Akgwi Slash
games.summary: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
games.summary: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

games.name: Defense Front
games.summary: Take command of routes and firepower in a fresh take on classic tower defense. Deploy towers, seal off key junctions, and reshape enemy routes on the fly. Turn the tide with branching upgrades, customizable targeting priorities, and direct target designation as you defend humanity across the globe.

games.name: Sneak & Snitch
games.summary: Sneak & Snitch is an online social deduction game for 4 to 8 players, set in a museum. A team of thieves hides among the museum visitors and swaps the real paintings on the walls for forgeries they painted themselves. One player is the guard, riding a Segway through the halls and hunting them. When time runs out, a forgery report shows exactly who fooled whom.

games.name: Welcome Back to Aeris
games.summary: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the traces of a strange presence stirring beyond the screen.

games.name: Obolus
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

games.name: Deadly Match
games.summary: Deadly Match is a singleplayer thirdperson murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

games.name: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
games.summary: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

games.name: Gimbap Heaven
games.summary: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

games.name: Disk-Y
games.summary: Show Yuu—a transfer student struggling with psychological issues—around the school and become a source of emotional support for her. This is a minimalist retro visual novel featuring elements of psychological horror.

games.name: Chief? About That File...
games.summary: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

games.name: Dirtborn: Colony Rising
games.summary: Ants are fascinating insects, and they have taught mankind what the power of teamwork can accomplish. Develop your own colony of ants, dig every tunnel, and protect your queen from the numerous enemies you'll encounter! No two games will ever be the same and online PvP ensures fun to the thorax!

games.name: Manual Teller Machine
games.summary: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

games.name: Arms Race
games.summary: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.summary: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: Boost Vector EX
games.summary: Run fast. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.name: Brotato: Primal Dread
games.summary: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

games.name: MyDear.exe
games.summary: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short 2 hour experience.

games.name: Survive the Apocalypse
games.summary: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

games.name: Caaahr!
games.summary: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

games.name: Bolariki
games.summary: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

games.name: The Ice Is Watching
games.summary: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.summary: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
aliases: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Season 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
games.summary:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield.

Phoenix Cyclops arrives in Fall 2026. Stay tuned for more details on his gameplay and abilities.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!

games.name: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
games.summary: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.summary: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

games.name: Mafia Hotel
games.summary: Mafia Hotel is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

games.name: Blobby and the Milkshake
games.summary: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

games.name: Heroll: If
games.summary: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

games.name: Drum Incremental
games.summary: Drum Incremental is an incremental game built around real percussion rudiments. The player taps patterns on a practice pad using the left and right mouse buttons (with keyboard keys for flam and drag ornaments), earning Rhythm Points that unlock new rudiments and upgrades. The game features 40 rudiments from the PAS list across five progression phases, each gated by a boss exam judged by an on-screen teacher; a metronome with four speed tiers; a Study Companion that generates points passively, including while the game is closed; golden notes that fall during play; and a jam mode that recognizes the rudiments the player performs. The soundtrack is original and synchronized with the metronome tempo. Single-player, with full controller support and localization in ten languages. A free demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in October 2026, and the full game releases on Steam for Windows on November 2, 2026.

games.name: Dread Line: Metro
games.summary: A time sensitive horror collectathon where you avoid getting ripped to pieces by mutant monsters

games.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
games.summary: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

games.name: Critical Ward
games.summary: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

games.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation game where players organize hundreds of bottles in a mysterious cellar, place them on the correct shelves, and restore the collection to its former glory. Completing shelves grants Skill Points that can be used to unlock abilities, while a drunkenness system introduces a balance between increased power and reduced control. The game also features realistic physics based bottle handling, breakable bottles, scoring, and online leaderboards.

games.name: Chair Chase
games.summary: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player online party game set in a big house full of living chairs that do not want to be sat on. They run, hide and parkour away from you, and they panic more the closer you get. Catch one, then win a quick balance fight while everyone else tries to knock you off. Grab jetpacks and glue guns between rounds to chase chairs and stop your friends. Seven rounds, most points wins. Play in private lobbies with friends or join public matches.

games.name: Blastlane Racers
games.summary:
Blastlane Racers is a top-down arcade combat racing game inspired by classics of the genre.

Race across 24 hand-crafted tracks, use powerful weapons to take out your rivals, and upgrade your vehicles and equipment between races.

Choose from 10 unique vehicles and compete in championships, quick races, time trials, and challenges in the Blastlane Academy. Play solo or challenge your friends in local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players.

Fast racing, explosive combat, and plenty of chaos – cars and guns. What else do you need?

games.name: Perfectly Folded
games.summary: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game set in a clothing store turned upside down. Fold, hang and shelve every last shirt, hat and shoe, design your own fashion, and enjoy turning the mess into a perfectly folded store at your own pace.

games.name: On Your Own: Survival Inventory
games.summary:
Rotate the grid and break groups of boxes to move your character, loot items and avoid enemies.
Explore places with different loot and levels.
Recycle items to get materials and craft new ones until you fix the radio and ask for help.

games.name: Highway Station Simulator
games.summary: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

games.name: 20 Floors Down
games.summary: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

games.name: Verdant Requiem
games.summary: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

games.name: Figure Me Out
games.summary: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

games.name: Verdreamia
games.summary: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

games.name: Sapu: Reborn
games.summary: Sapu: Reborn is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art platformer. Master jumps, dashes and wall jumps, avoid deadly traps, defeat enemies and collect fireflies across 25 handcrafted levels.

games.name: The Arcane Archive
games.summary: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

games.name: Nightcup
games.summary: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

games.name: Shin'ai Rewritten
games.summary: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

games.name: Make the World Great Again
games.summary: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

games.name: Sort A Lot
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

games.name: Bastion Rivals
games.summary: Bastion Rivals is a fantasy strategy game in which players control a builder, develop an economy and construct buildings that produce troops automatically. Armies move and fight across two lanes toward the opposing stronghold. Four factions provide different units, structures and counters, with spells, items and upgrades supporting army composition. The game includes solo battles against AI; ranked and unranked online modes are planned for launch.

games.name: Age Breaker
games.summary: Mine gold, train an army and evolve your fortress from bone clubs to plasma blades in this one-lane strategy game. Lead four peoples and eight Leaders through a 36-battle campaign with boss fights, or set up your own skirmish on six maps.

games.name: The Omega Strain
games.summary: The Omega Strain is a retro-inspired 3D arcade shooter featuring physics-based spacecraft flight, intense combat, and eight explorable polygon worlds. Inspired by classics such as Zarch and Virus, the game is powered by RetroMesh, a custom-built 3D engine, with an electronic soundtrack by Swedish artist 047.

games.name: Habet
games.summary: Habet is a management game about running a gladiator school in Pompeii in 73 BC, with real-time arena fights. The player, a freed gladiator turned lanista, buys, trains and sells fighters, sets their terms and sends them into the amphitheatre, where bouts play out in a stylized voxel style with wounds, lost limbs and deaths. Fights range from duels to mass battles with dozens of men a side, watched by a reactive crowd.

games.name: The House Before
games.summary: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

games.name: Heart Abyss
games.summary: In a world where there is an eternal war between the unions of the human race and beastmen, accidental deaths and slave trade are not rare. But what happens if two slaves by chance unite and survive together, being wanted? Leon and Ray are one of those.

games.name: Backdraft
games.summary: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.summary: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

games.name: Havker-Man X
games.summary: Havker-Man X is an open world, post-apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Radiant Starlets
games.summary: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Death at Fleming Manor
games.summary: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a grand British manor, 1959. Explore eerie scenes and complete forensic documents like death certificates and medical reports. Stylish 1960s detective comic art. Perfect for fans of vintage whodunits.

games.name: Iron Colony
games.summary: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Sortilège
games.summary: A dice duel with someone on the other side of the table. Roll, hold what you like, and commit. Both players reach into the same pool of powers each turn, so every one you take is one your opponent can't have. Climb a ladder of ten rivals in a solo run, winning their dice as you go, or duel a friend online.

games.name: Aetheris Core
games.summary: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Let's Sing Presents: Abba
games.summary: Let's Sing Presents: Abba je videohra pro Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4. Termín vydání: 3. 11. 2026.

games.name: TCG Card Chaos
games.summary: TCG Card Chaos is a first-person casual simulation game in which players explore a chaotic card shop and sort more than 5,000 collectible cards. Players inspect card types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and return every card to its correct place.

games.name: Pocket Adventurer
games.summary: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

games.name: Light Source
games.summary: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

games.name: PeeVPee
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

games.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
games.summary: This is a first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles.

games.name: The Wake Event
games.summary: The Wake Event is a first-person science-fiction psychological horror and puzzle adventure set aboard the abandoned ARGUS research station. Awakening alone with no memory of what happened, the player must restore station systems, solve interconnected technical puzzles, and uncover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's autonomous intelligence, and their own presence aboard the facility.

games.name: Traffic Architect
games.summary: The city is the easy part. Making it move isn't. Lay out roads, shape junctions and time the lights, then watch thousands of simulated cars find every flaw you missed. Take cars off the road with buses, trains and metro — or build the whole city yourself in Creative mode.

games.name: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
games.summary: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.

games.name: Hold My Wheel
games.summary: HOLD MY WHEEL is a 5-player online co-op action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You and your idiot twin brothers must visit grandma, living in a bus you can never leave thanks to the collars she put on you. Keep the bus running, fire junk from its roof-mounted Scrap Cannon, lift, flip and throw it with a magnetic gun, and build bridges from scrap. Go hungry too long and you start eyeing your teammates; get bitten or irradiated and you turn into a zombie. Death is not the end: keep playing as a ghost, zombie or floppy ragdoll until a Hell-Kitty restores your human form.

games.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
games.summary: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

games.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
games.summary: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

games.name: One More Floor
games.summary: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

games.name: 4:12 AM
games.summary: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

games.name: Spark of Tales
games.summary: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

games.name: How Empires Work
games.summary: An incremental strategy game about history, expansion and development. Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

games.name: Hold the Levee
games.summary:
Hold the Levee is a strategy simulation game focused on real-time fluid dynamics and water physics. Players must dig trenches, raise levees, stack sandbags, and build dams, then watch how the water reacts to the structures.

The gameplay simulates realistic water behaviors such as seepage, undermined walls, flood waves, and ice jams across 24 unique missions. The campaign ranges from defending a town from natural disasters to flooding enemy villages guarded by the AI. The game also includes a sandbox map editor, local or online co-op, and a unique 1v1 "Water vs Defender" PvP mode.

games.name: Kitties on Planets
games.summary:
Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.

games.name: Terminidle
games.summary: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

games.name: BrouHaHa
games.summary: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

games.name: Cat Secretary
games.summary: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

games.name: Lost Host
games.summary:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.summary: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: Hull Rupture
games.summary: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

games.name: Theos: Cities of Myth
games.summary: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

games.name: Cleanup On Aisle 3
games.summary: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, six failing stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

games.name: Old Man's Sushi
games.summary: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

games.name: Armory Keeper
games.summary: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

games.name: On The Hook
games.summary: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

games.name: Node Crown
games.summary: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

games.name: Cardsharp
games.summary: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Forever
games.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

games.name: Kokuhaku Confessional
games.summary: Just as you’re finally ready to ask library crush Shiori out on a date, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: Kokuhaku Confessional! Can you resist their charms and stay true to your beloved? Survive to Day 5, and maybe—just maybe—you’ll win Shiori’s heart.

games.name: Wildixir
games.summary: Wildixir is a single-player action roguelite set in enchanted lands. Combine automatic weapons and alchemical reactions, restore shrines, and face each region's boss. Between runs, spend seeds on permanent upgrades and unlock new characters and locations.

games.name: Imouto Choukyou Nikki
games.summary: A censored port of Imouto Choukyou Nikki.

games.name: Rip It! Card Collector
games.summary: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

games.name: Spellchain
games.summary: A first-person action fantasy RPG where you create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events, grow your magical power, and ultimately slay the king.

games.name: Break the Piñatas
games.summary: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

games.name: Yukizuki no Seisou
games.summary: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream…

games.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
games.summary: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

games.name: Compactor Baron
games.summary: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
games.summary:
Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing's hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor's palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city!

Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing!

Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music.

games.name: Prigod Idle
games.summary: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

games.name: Tirade
games.summary: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: "I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Build the perfect, chaotic rocket engine in this numbers-go-up space roguelite. Load your ship with wacky fuel items, chase the right synergies and pray that it’s enough to get you to Pluto. Push it as far as you can before it all falls apart. Chaotic. Glorious. Human.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: Psycho-Sleuth
games.summary: Psycho-Sleuth is a mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. 13 players, each with a strange condition — like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game. These disorders are contagious, and the killer hides behind abnormal logic.

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

games.name: In Full Bloom
games.summary: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

games.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
aliases: 蒼藍魔導士露娜　～天才魔導士與傳奇魔導士～
苍蓝魔导士露娜　～天才魔导士与传奇魔导士～
games.summary: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

games.name: Underkeep
games.summary: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
games.summary: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
aliases: Zelda no Densetsu Toki no Ocarina
games.summary: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.
series: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Manic Miner
games.summary: Manic Miner je plošinová počítačová hra vytvořená Matthew Smithem v roce 1983 původně pro ZX Spectrum. Úkolem hráče je vyvést horníka Willyho z 20 jeskyní obsazených příšerami. Postava může pouze chodit do stran a skákat. Hra se původně měla jmenovat Miner 49'er a původní myšlenka hry nepocházela přímo Matthewa Smithe, ale od jeho partnera ve společnosti Software Projects Alana Matona.

games.name: Just A Dice Game
games.summary: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

games.name: Ashen Legacy
games.summary: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

games.name: AJ's Anomaly
games.summary: First-person anomaly horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.summary:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: Dialshift
games.summary: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

games.name: TerraLounge
games.summary:
Players decorate and spend time in a terrarium, and play match-3 puzzles to earn currency to use in the terrarium. This currency is used to buy toys, decorations, music, and floors.

The game features 3 game modes: Endless, with procedurally generated boards; Story, hand-crafted levels across 5 worlds; Terrarium, where players decorate and spend time with slimes.

The intent of the game is to be a second screen, fish tank kind of game, where it exists with the player as a companion, but not draw attention to itself.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

games.name: Soulstack
games.summary: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

games.name: Scrolls of Alexandria: Tidy up the Lost Library
games.summary: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, reading the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Every cat guards one and won't let go until you pet it! Eat a golden apple for optional magic, or take a quiet afternoon in the stacks :)

games.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
games.summary: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

games.name: The Goddess Told Me: Steal That Loaf of Bread
games.summary: A fantasy adventure about a five-millimetre ant sent by the goddess Kona to steal a seventy-two-centimetre loaf of bread. Players navigate a world built around differences of scale, crumbs and narrow passages.

games.name: Rules of the Inn
games.summary: A Japanese horror-mystery. In an inn room at the edge of the afterlife, you follow a rule added nightly and judge what slips in; by morning, open the ledger for the truth. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is. Obey, or doubt? Mouse only.

games.name: Last Inspection
games.summary: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

games.name: Derail
games.summary: Derail is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with you holy camera to escape the loop.

games.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
games.summary: A 14 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

games.name: Zone L.O.S.T.
games.summary: Your body is your weakness. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

games.name: Continuum
games.summary: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

games.name: Drain the Galaxy
games.summary: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

games.name: Spice Pound
games.summary: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

games.name: A Little Faraway
games.summary: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

games.name: Prehistoric Pit
games.summary: Prehistoric Pit is a bullet heaven roguelite with voxel graphics. The player controls one of nine dinosaurs in an arena that fills with waves of Ice Age mammals, while weapons fire automatically. Between waves the player picks upgrades, limited to four weapon slots per run. Every weapon evolves into a second form at level 30 with its matching relic. A run lasts about 30 minutes across volcanic stages. Each dinosaur has its own exclusive starting weapon, active ability and passive; eight of them are unlocked through in-run challenges.

games.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
games.summary:
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

games.name: Mono Chameleon
games.summary: Mono Chameleon is an online hide-and-seek game for 2 to 10 players, drawn in four dithered shades of olive and cream. Hiders sample colors from walls and floors with an eyedropper and paint their own bodies with brushes, down to the thin mortar lines between bricks, to blend into the scenery. Seekers search in first person with no radar, relying on their eyes, a five-shot catch-gun and a whistle that sounds late in each round. The game has five modes (Normal, Infection, Double, Tag and Prop Hunt), and bots fill empty slots.

games.name: Grim Guild
aliases: グリムギルド～冒険者ギルド経営～
games.summary: A management game about sending other people into danger. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: write each contract (the pay, how plainly the danger is written, whether they may turn back), never see the fight, read the report, and count who comes back at the door. Monsters, grief, trust and ale. A year ends at the old quarry and is bound into a book. Optional asynchronous shared towns of up to 100 halls over Steam.

games.name: Manus Sors
games.summary: A puzzle and mystical horror game in which Grandma's cozy house hides dark family secrets. Explore every room, solve the puzzles, and stay alert: every detail counts here!

games.name: Escape: The Cabin
games.summary: Trapped, alone, and hunted by a captor who knows your past. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover the truth, and escape before the cabin breaks you. With 70+ randomised puzzles and solutions, every nightmare changes as you fight to get back to your family.

games.name: Afterpub
games.summary: Grandpas in wheelchairs, a pub full of games and a mountain to race over. Bet on the chaos, throw everything you grab, and play with friends online in Mountain Run, 1v1 Duels and many party games.

games.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
games.summary: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: Wretched
games.summary: Wretched is a turn-based tactical game focused on strategic positioning, skill combinations and devastating attacks. Play as an ancient being of immense power. Move into range, kick enemies away and slip behind others. Chain your skills and make every turn count.

games.name: Homepage
games.summary: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

games.name: Number Machine
games.summary: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

games.name: A Dogs Dream
games.summary: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: Gem Beasts
games.summary: Gem beasts is a creature collector, rogue-lite, where you become the leader of your own crystal clan. Fight and collect other creatures to play as, and explore different build combinations between their abilities.

games.name: Eye of Syn
games.summary: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Deathly Delights
games.summary: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: Pith
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.summary: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

games.name: Boneyard Bounce!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: Ubai Ending
games.summary: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

games.name: American Gold Rush
games.summary: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

games.name: High Voltage
games.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

games.name: Grimoire of Blanks
games.summary: Grimoire of Blanks is a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for 1 - 4 players. Players build spells during combat by filling blanks on cards with collected words, combining effects, modifiers and conditions. It features single-player and online co-op, with multiple playable mage classes and procedurally structured runs.

games.name: Siege of Akanor
games.summary: Siege of Akanor is a third-person medieval tower defense game in which players prepare a castle's defenses, command troops, and fight directly on the battlefield. Between waves, players can deploy and upgrade defenses before joining the battle with melee and ranged weapons. The game features a single-player campaign, cooperative multiplayer, progression systems, multiple enemy types, siege weapons, and fantasy elements including dragons.

games.name: Mind the Clown: Reborn
