games.summary: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

games.name: Cozy Corner Cafe
games.summary: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

games.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
games.summary: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

games.name: Sora: Oasis Treasures
games.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago.

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight.
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together.

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

games.name: Trap Testers
games.summary: Traps Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

games.name: Tank Mates
games.summary: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

games.name: Hidden Cat Islands
games.summary: Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

games.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
games.summary: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

games.name: Nutshot Simulator
games.summary: Throw things at people. Aim low. Nutshot Simulator is a physics comedy set in Kumquat Cove, a perfectly ordinary town with a doctor's office, a church, a frat house and a moon base. Every hit gets a slow-motion replay, the town has a life of its own, and if you can see them, you can hit them.

games.name: Silver Service
games.summary: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

games.name: My Lovely Nurse
games.summary: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

games.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
games.summary:
Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a single-player action roguelite built around an incremental power curve. The knight's corrupted sword drains his own health for as long as he stays in a level, so the health bar doubles as the level timer and there is no separate countdown; upgrading maximum health buys survivability and time in the same purchase.

Attacks fire automatically as a 360-degree pulse, leaving positioning as the only moment-to-moment decision, and every kill shortens the player's ability cooldowns. Death is the progression system rather than the fail state: banked gold and the permanent skill tree both survive it, so each run funds the next. Five biomes end in boss fights, and an elemental infusion system lets the player commit to fire, frost or lightning — or to the corruption itself, which is stronger and changes the ending.

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: Ubai 0
games.summary:
A visual novel following Gen, the founder of Ubai, and his recounting of the events leading up to Ubai's creation together with his partners Keiji and Shizune.

One day on a shift together with Gen, Ryousuke suddenly wondered about the origins of Ubai. Upon popping the question to Gen, all Ryousuke got was the usual cold shoulder. However, Gen suddenly found himself feeling nostalgic as he recalled the events leading up to him creating Ubai together with his partners Keiji and Shizune.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Casualties: Unknown
games.summary: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
games.summary: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

games.name: Fraga
games.summary: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

games.name: Seferia Matrix
games.summary: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

games.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
games.summary:
Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn is a first-person organizing game set in a two-story medieval armory with 50 rooms. Players collect scattered weapons and place them in their assigned racks and displays. Completing rooms awards skill points that unlock abilities to help locate and organize weapons.

The game supports single-player and online multiplayer for up to four players, with cooperative and competitive modes. There is no countdown to failure; dawn arrives when the final piece is in place.

games.name: Towers of Babble
games.summary: Towers of Babble is a tower defense game where you play words to create towers with powerful synergies.

games.name: Evenicle: Next Fragment Medica
games.summary: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

games.name: Metro Anomaly
games.summary: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

games.name: Cards of Bellum
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder of strategy, dice, and luck. Master suit-based combat, turn defeat into glorious victory with a roll of the dice, and recruit unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights. Build your deck, storm the capital, and claim the throne

games.name: Waifu Curator
games.summary: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!

games.name: Menthal
games.summary: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

games.name: ExoFlora: First Seeds
games.summary: A cozy sci-fi farming sim. Run a greenhouse on an alien world: grow strange plants, discover reactions between neighbors (fire, frost, crystal and light), breed and name your own hybrids, survive seasons and pest swarms, and restore a dying valley through a campaign. Includes a Relaxed mode where plants never die.

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.summary: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Swipe a credit card through an ATM, bills land on a table, and the breaker shreds them for money. Electric bills arc to the bills next to them, explosive bills blow up the stack around them, and burning bills set their neighbours on fire. Over 240 upgrades are spread across upgrade panels, a skill tree and a prestige tree. Ending a shift turns the money destroyed into Prestige Points for permanent upgrades, so the next shift starts stronger. Mr. Buck, the player's boss, calls in with instructions and opinions.

games.name: Annihilated
games.summary: Annihilated is a story-driven roguelite about a long walk home with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: One More Plate
games.summary: One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you'll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

games.name: Shadey's Quest
games.summary: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

games.name: The Devil's Due
games.summary: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

games.name: Shock
games.summary: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Iceland
games.summary: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.

games.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
games.summary: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

games.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
games.summary: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

games.name: Deiity
games.summary: A dungeon crawler about working smart, not hard. As a fallen god, climb a buried Antarctic temple to use humanities own weapons to destroy the earth. Use magic abilities to manipulate physics, enemies, and the environment as you fight man-made biological creations. The temple's secrets await.

games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
games.summary: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: 1999Tokoyo Building
games.summary: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

games.name: Fragments
games.summary: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
aliases: TORAWASE ～被囚禁的偽妃夢寐以求的幸福～
TORAWASE ～被囚禁的伪妃梦寐以求的幸福～
TO･RA･WA･SE ～囚われの偽妃が夢みる初夜～
games.summary: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.summary: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

games.name: Rebirth TD
games.summary: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.summary: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

games.name: Pray Your God!
games.summary:
Pray Your God! is a retro-styled comedy game about founding a cult and guessing numbers.

The player names a cult, recruits a flock and then prays: they pick a number from one to a hundred, and an Inquisitor picks one after them, with a die that does not cheat.
A wrong guess costs a follower and earns a fresh piece of paperwork; a correct one triggers one of 16 endings, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, assigned at random. Runs last two to four minutes.

The whole game is played through a text interface drawn in a Commodore-era palette.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Dustbloom
games.summary: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

games.name: The Sea Is Our Stage
games.summary: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

games.name: Warpack
games.summary: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Clogwork
games.summary: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

games.name: It Thinks!
games.summary: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: Rense
games.summary: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

games.name: Football Manager 27
games.summary: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

games.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
games.summary:
A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.

The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.

What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.

games.name: Protocell
games.summary: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

games.name: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary:
Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!

Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to Marvel Cosmic Invasion for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt!

games.name: Last Chance: Birth
games.summary: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

games.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
games.summary: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

games.name: Hamster Wheel Isekai
games.summary: Hamster Wheel Isekai combines incremental progression with role-playing mechanics. Players power a wheel, change gears and time shifts to build speed and advance.

games.name: Ashen Swarm
games.summary: Ashen Swarm is a single-player gothic arena roguelite in which abilities are based on the seven deadly sins. Players combine skills during each run and choose between keeping an Oath or gaining powers through Corruption. Decisions in recurring narrative events grant lasting artifacts. A gathering court culminates in a battle against the Collegium.

games.name: Rigged
games.summary:
RIGGED is a free browser party game for friends, streamers and their chat. It borrows the poker table, but it plays more like a social deduction game than a card game.

Every round, the dealer is allowed to cheat. Players can secretly rig hands, sabotage each other and bluff their way through, and anyone can "Call the Cheat" to expose them. Get it right and the cheater gets MUCKED. Get it wrong and the table lets you hear about it.

On the Streamer Table, chat joins the streamer's game and tries to rig their hands live while the streamer tries to catch them. Every stream turns into a battle between the host and their community.

games.name: Amusement Factory
games.summary:
Amusement Factory is a cozy theme park builder with a bright, stylized look.

You start with an empty field, a bus stop and a bank balance, and you lay out everything else: roads, queues, rides, shops, arcades, and a lake with boats running laps of a route you painted yourself. Guests arrive by the busload with their own energy, hunger, thirst and patience, and their mood is blended from everything the park does to them, so a filthy path costs you as surely as a broken ride does.
Play the ten campaign locations in order, each with its own land, budget, wage bill and goals, or take free play and build for the pleasure of it.

games.name: Grazed: Incremental Arcade
games.summary: Grazed is an incremental arcade game where every kill means getting within range of death. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

games.name: Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space
games.summary: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
games.summary: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

games.name: Please, Tell Me Why?
games.summary: You live alone. Or so you think. Stream live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal… until the little details stop making sense. A first-person psychological horror film about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of facing the truth.

games.name: Expiration
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.

games.name: The Guestbook of the Otherworld
games.summary: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

games.name: WildBonds
games.summary: Play as a little fox and help the forest animals find what they've lost! Each request hides three items in random spots, and a mischievous fox may run off with one. Dash through the woods, beat your best time, and climb the global leaderboard in this charming 3D exploration time-attack game.

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
games.summary: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

games.name: Table Game World CCFolia
aliases: テーブルゲームワールド CCFOLIA
games.summary:
A virtual tabletop for playing TRPGs, board games, and murder mysteries online with up to eight people. Use digital cards, pieces, dice, and maps while players set their own rules and decide how each game unfolds.

Nintendo Switch 2 features include GameChat, handheld play, and GameShare, letting a group play together with one copy of the software. Additional compatible games and scenarios are planned.

games.name: Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition
games.summary:
A chaotic coin-pusher roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins and items to trigger powerful combos.

The Chaos Max Edition introduces new playable characters, each with themed coins and a distinct playstyle. It also features 150 coins, 150 power-up items, coin plating to enhance effects, endless runs, and eight difficulty levels.

games.name: Imperial Grace
games.summary: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

games.name: Reality Drift
games.summary: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Springs, Eternal
games.summary: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.summary: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

games.name: Bottled by Bears
games.summary: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: John Gleep
games.summary: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

games.name: Headshot Holdout
games.summary: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

games.name: Thronefall: Craaghelm
games.summary: Conquer the mountain in Craaghelm, the first expansion for Thronefall.

games.name: Grab Your Deck
games.summary: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

games.name: Lost Hope
games.summary: Lost Hope is a short, First person Atmospheric walking simulator set in the distant future, in the deep space, a lone man tries to survive and get a cure for mankind.

games.name: Lilifel
games.summary: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

games.name: Skygrid Courier
games.summary:
Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision!

Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.

Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?

games.name: Tattie Bogle
games.summary: Tattie Bogle is a roguelite action-strategy game for 1-4 players, played solo or in online co-op. A Tomte, a gnome from Scandinavian folklore, brings a farmer's scarecrow to life, and the player defends the farm's crops from waves of pests across four shifts of the day - deer and rabbits at dawn, bears in the afternoon, and ghouls and mushroom goblins at night. Players fight with garden tools and a fear ability, build trenches, lures, stinging nettles and spook stones during waves, and leave notes that tell the farmer which seeds and tools to buy. Crops left in the field are sold to keep the farm running, while crops the scarecrow harvests become crafting materials. Buried folklore relics grant powers with drawbacks. When the farm is overrun the run resets, and advancement points buy permanent upgrades.

games.name: Phantom Gear
games.summary: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

games.name: Portabellows
games.summary: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

games.name: Vitavania
games.summary: The most vibrant Metroidvania about a catgirl! Sandbox elements, divinity, and mysticism!

games.name: Lost Zion
games.summary: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Moomin Midsummer Madness
games.summary: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary: Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

games.name: PlanetOrbit
games.summary: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.summary: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

games.name: Hordia
games.summary: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

games.name: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
games.summary: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary: Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

games.name: Desktop Plinko
games.summary: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio: Etrian Odyssey Class Costumes (7) & Battle BGM Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 2 Seven Sisters High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 3 Gekkoukan High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 4 Golden Yasogami High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 5 Shujin Academy School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona St. Hermelin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei IV Samurai Garb (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei V Jouin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Princessfall
games.summary: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

games.name: Carmilla: Crimson Moon
games.summary: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

games.name: Procedure Zero
games.summary: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information and take over the prison before they come for you.

games.name: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Beyond The Blight
games.summary: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

games.name: Tick & Tired
games.summary: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

games.name: PocoDoro
games.summary: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives in a little handheld device on your desktop, next to whatever you're working on. Hatch a squishy slime, poke it, stretch it and throw it so it splats against the walls. Feed it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It grows up in real time, even while you're away.

games.name: Fakin It XL
games.summary: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

games.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
games.summary: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of new additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup.

games.name: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
games.summary: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Brewing the best drinks and retake the town... or, you know, kneecap the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

games.name: Not My Dad
games.summary: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

games.name: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
games.summary: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

games.name: Wizzy the Wood
games.summary: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

games.name: Terrahold
games.summary:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

games.name: Tiny Havoc
games.summary: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

games.name: All Eyes on Me
games.summary: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

games.name: Tidyspell
games.summary: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

games.name: Spin Tactics
games.summary: Spin Tactics is a roguelike engine-builder set inside a slot machine. Each spin fills the board with coloured symbols, and connecting three or more of the same colour makes a combo. Gems change a symbol's colour, timing or effect for the rest of the run. Over 100 Companions can be equipped in eight slots, and their order matters, since some boost or copy the Companion next to them. Unwanted Companions, symbols and Gems can be sold in the Black Hole for gold. Each encounter has a score goal and a limited number of Actions, and bosses work against the player. Between runs, credits unlock Chips and Portals that change the starting hero. Runs take 30 to 60 minutes and end on an online leaderboard. There is no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

games.name: Pawn Shop Days
games.summary: Run a pawnshop: inspect goods, haggle with unusual visitors, repair your finds and sell them on. Spot fakes, decide whose story to trust and invest your profits in the shop. Between questionable deals, take a moment to pet the kitten.

games.name: Snow Worries!
games.summary: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

games.name: King Dies Rich
games.summary: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

games.name: Vizier
games.summary: The king holds the power — but the words are yours. Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

games.name: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
games.summary: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz is an online 1v1 multiplayer game in a PS1-inspired low-poly style. One player is a granny with a shotgun driving a fuel tanker across a bridge, fending off attacks with a smoke screen and an electronic jammer. The other player pilots an FPV kamikaze drone and tries to stop the tanker from reaching its destination. Players swap roles every round, while random weather and match modifiers change every run. The game supports keyboard and mouse, gamepads and real FPV radio controllers, and can also be played solo against bots.

games.name: Derelikt
games.summary: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

games.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker
games.summary: Embark on a perilous journey as Menes, an angel with no memory, sent to free a mysterious prisoner from a forgotten realm. Uncover dark secrets, face relentless enemies, and shape the fate of a universe on the brink of collapse. A platformer adventure awaits, with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver .

games.name: UnderMire
games.summary: UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, master evolving tools, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

games.name: Netherwake
games.summary: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

games.name: Cannon Keep
games.summary: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

games.name: Rasen
games.summary: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters.

games.name: Powerfuel
games.summary: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: Satelital
games.summary: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

games.name: Warrior Quest
games.summary: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

games.name: Extract Survivors
games.summary: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

games.name: 10 Million Pixels
games.summary: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.summary: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator
games.summary: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

games.name: Zombie Crawlers
games.summary: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

games.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
games.summary: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

games.name: Escape Your Boss
games.summary: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Blowhole
games.summary: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

games.name: Business Tycoon
games.summary: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

games.name: We March as One
games.summary: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

games.name: Hellterns
games.summary: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

games.name: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
games.summary: Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline. Click to earn cash, upgrade your Click Power and work your way through 20 locations, from parking lots to banks and museums. Your goal? Stealing The Legendary Game the whole world has been waiting for. Apparently, asking nicely wasn't an option.

games.name: Letter Schmetter
games.summary:
In this game you have to form words from an anagram in German. The individual letters bring different points, whereby the rounds become more difficult after each solved turn. The game is available for Twitch and is intended as a community game, since the entire chat is involved.

The name "LetterSchmetter" is a mixture of the English word "Letter" and the German word "Schmetter" (means to bounce something at high speed on a surface).

games.name: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Stella Splendens
games.summary:
The second and last append for Fate/Empire of Dirt, taking places after Made in Heaven and adding new routes for Morgan and Musashi.
Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu are also upgrated from sub-heroines to heroines roles.

games.name: IWA Fighting Adventure
games.summary: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

games.name: World 23
games.summary: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

games.name: Scopecreep
games.summary: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Clicky Islands
games.summary: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

games.name: Tekken 8: Roger Jr.
games.summary: The Season 3 Pass includes the following content: 4 additional playable characters, 1 additional battle stage, and the Character Costume: Aurora Outfit Pack.

games.name: Topdeck Automat
games.summary: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

games.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
games.summary: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

games.name: Trafficity
games.summary: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

games.name: Rock and Found
games.summary: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

games.name: Of Dice and Minions
games.summary: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

games.name: My Little Ranch
games.summary: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

games.name: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
aliases: AURORA REQUIEM: The Lullaby of Calvaris
games.summary: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

games.name: Dungeonbound
games.summary: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

games.name: Night of the Idle Horde
games.summary: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

games.name: One More Claw
games.summary: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

games.name: Watermellionaire
games.summary: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

games.name: Dreadgence
games.summary: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

games.name: Feed the Vessel
games.summary: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

games.name: White Christmas
games.summary: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

games.name: Barn Rush
games.summary: Barn Rush is a top-down time-attack collectathon roguelite set on a pixel-art farm. Gather food in 15-second rounds, haul it back to the barn, and bank it before the buzzer. Rounds come in sets of five, each with a Harvest Goal, and every fifth round is a 45-second Gauntlet with a game-changing challenge. Pick upgrades between rounds and build a different run every time.

games.name: Mizi No!: Hobby Time
games.summary:
We all have hobbies, and so does Mizi! Her favorite hobby? Lovingly undoing whatever you just spent hours creating.

Assembled a miniature mech? Finished a beautiful scrapbook page? Spent all evening crocheting something cute? Haha... yeah, we hope you loved it enough to do it all over again. ;)

The "Hobby Time" DLC adds 20 more items for you to put together all over again.

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
games.summary: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

games.name: Okurek
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.
aliases: L'École des licornes : L'Île de la Magie
Academia Unicornio: La Isla de la Magia
Academia Unicórnio: A Ilha da Magia
独角兽骑士队: 魔法之岛
獨角獸學院: 魔法之島

games.name: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
games.summary: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

games.name: Monkeys!!
games.summary: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

games.name: Steel Gullet
games.summary: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

games.name: AsterMaster
games.summary: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

games.name: Game Shelver 99: I must organize my Steam Library and defend it against pirates with a shotgun
games.summary: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

games.name: Pluck Em!
games.summary: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

games.name: Dravora
games.summary: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

games.name: Futa: Beer & Sex
games.summary: Futa: Beer & Sex is a fast adult arcade game. The player catches beer to unlock three futa bartenders and an uncensored animated sex gallery. The game contains explicit sexual content.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

games.name: Mr Mageboy
games.summary: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

games.name: Frog is Crime
games.summary: good criminal open world game of 2026. drive cars, commit crime, kill peoples and become crime king in world of humans as frog

games.name: Whitopia
games.summary: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

games.name: Please Confirm the Deceased
games.summary: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

games.name: Strato Alto
games.summary: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

games.name: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
games.summary: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator is a first-person store management simulator about an alcoholic who opens a liquor store. Players stock shelves, manage supply, set prices, hire staff and expand the store in a dynamic market where prices change daily and trends shift overnight. Holidays, festivals, inspections and market rumors change demand, and the store's reputation on social media affects customer traffic, premium buyers, events and police inspections. Players can run a legal business or break rules such as skipping ID checks for bigger profits at the risk of an inspection, and can drink their own stock, which affects their judgment, reputation and performance.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI je připravovaná videohra ve vývoji od společnosti Rockstar Games. Bude osmou hlavní hrou série Grand Theft Auto, navazující na Grand Theft Auto V (2013), a celkově šestnáctým dílem série.

games.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
games.summary: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Will Axyn discover the secrets of the ancient civilization and will he find the prince?

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Shrike
games.summary: Pickpocket rival birds to build a deck. A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about a tiny bird's grim migration north through a wretched medieval kingdom. Steal abilities, chart your migratory route, survive.

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: Vintage Vice City Pack
aliases: Grand Theft Auto 6: Vintage Vice City Pack
GTA VI: Vintage Vice City Pack
games.summary:
All Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack, a collection of items that flash back to when the neon burned brightest.
Featuring a timeless '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.summary: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Hold the Dawn
games.summary: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

games.name: Let Me Die
games.summary: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

games.name: Tilemancer
games.summary:
Tilemancer is a strategy roguelite deckbuilder where every battle plays out like a tactical board puzzle.

Build two parts of your army: a deck of units that determines the soldiers available to you, and a deck of cards that supplements your units. Different unit types, terrain types and card effects interact through simple rules that can combine into increasingly complex situations.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings.

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?
Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.

games.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
games.summary: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

games.name: Spinful
games.summary: A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

games.name: Neo Light
games.summary: Every room wants you dead in Neo Light. A brutal precision platformer where you master 9 short-burst powers while Glitch, your sarcastic assistant, guides, judges and mocks your failures in real time.

games.name: Widget Idle
games.summary: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness.

games.name: Kuroshio: Neon Blood
games.summary: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi returns to Shinbashi and walks straight into a war between yakuza families. An open-world crime saga: brawls, katana and gunfights, police chases, mountain-pass races and a shinkansen to the old capital.

games.name: Crumple Toss
games.summary:
A very difficult game of precise throws, dozens of misses, and world records.
The goal is simple: land the shot in the bin. But every level will make you miss again and again.
The timer is already running. Beat the level faster than anyone else and set a world record.
Build your own level, beat it twice, and challenge everyone else.

games.name: Football Survivors
games.summary: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

games.name: Nightmare Conquest
games.summary: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary: Tanks Sweet Tanks is a sugar sweet yet intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

games.name: The Debtician
games.summary: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

games.name: Meifu Kanshiki-Ka: The Underworld Forensics Division
games.summary: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

games.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
games.summary: Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer. Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

games.name: Stellaris: Willpower
games.summary: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Hoard
