games.summary: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

games.name: ArcaneBound
games.summary: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

games.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
games.summary: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

games.name: A Drop of Magenta
games.summary: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

games.name: Last Watchtower
games.summary: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Fireworks Incremental
games.summary: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

games.name: A Sector Darkly
games.summary: Experience an epic story in this open-world space exploration RPG. Stranded far from home in a region torn apart by war, you must scavenge, research, and craft what you need to survive as you chart a course through dangerous sectors, uncover rival alien agendas, and search for a way home.

games.name: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
games.summary: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: An intense top-down shooter roguelite inspired by pinball mechanics. Master every shot with precision in the heat of the battle, and protect your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment and conquer spaceships to win the war!

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Sands of the Damned
Reshine
games.summary: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: The Pogo Witch
games.summary: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

games.name: Happy Weekend
games.summary: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

games.name: Fool's Trigger
games.summary:
Fool’s Trigger combines Russian roulette and card tactics in a deadly multiplayer game for up to six players.

Inspired by Buckshot Roulette, it puts a different spin on the formula: everyone acts simultaneously. Each player has cards, chips, and a revolver — the tools to outsmart opponents and knock them out of the game.

Bet on the outcome of other players’ shots, then spend your winnings on new cards and ammunition. Combine your actions, strike deals across the table, and betray your allies when the moment is right. With overlapping decisions and unexpected outcomes, every match can take a different turn.

Your goal is simple: be the last player at the table.

games.name: Night Concierge
games.summary: Night Concierge is a short first-person horror game with a retro PSX look, set in a Soviet-style apartment block in November 2003. The player works the night shift as a concierge: residents come home one by one, and the task is to let them in while keeping out the "others" — impostors who only pretend to be residents. To decide, the player uses lobby security cameras (including a mirror that does not always show what it should), a video intercom for questioning visitors, a resident logbook with photos and apartment numbers, and a phone for calling apartments to check who is already home. The campaign spans five nights and an epilogue with several endings. An optional streamer mode connects to Twitch chat, letting viewers vote on whether to open the door and trigger events during the shift.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Doinaka Girls Utopia
games.summary: Doinaka Girls Utopia je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia DESSERT Soft pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: One Night After
games.summary: One Night After je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia Smee pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: You Can Sort It!
games.summary: A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.

games.name: Sort My Pigs
games.summary: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

games.name: Sorcerous 2: City of Cults
games.summary: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

games.name: Iskra
games.summary: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

games.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
games.summary: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! is a first-person organizing game set in a two-floor perfume archive containing 3,240 bottles. Players inspect bottle labels, locate the correct shelves using an archive map, and complete collections that illuminate cabinets and fragrance-family signs. The game supports solo play and two-player online co-op. Its four modes are Cozy, Speedrun, Duo, and Hardcore. Cozy mode includes unlockable carrying, movement, and search skills, while Hardcore adds breakable bottles and time penalties.

games.name: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
games.summary: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

games.name: Vibe Train
games.summary: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

games.name: Hit The Buzzer
games.summary: Stop the clock – to the hundredth of a second. One press starts it, the second stops it. But at some point the display goes dark, and from then on only your sense of time counts. From 1 to 60 seconds: how close can you get?

games.name: Mukimuki Nyankos
games.summary: Mukimuki Nyankos is a 3D party game about cats training in a gym. Up to eight players compete to gain muscle through exercise minigames, disrupt rivals and grow into giants before the in-game clock reaches 11 p.m. It includes three gyms, random events, a cooperative season mode, proximity voice chat and solo play against bots.

games.name: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
games.summary: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

games.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
games.summary: Aposis is a minimalist retro JRPG/Roguelike about fighting enemy androids while uncovering the truth about what happened to the world 3,000 years ago.

games.name: PixelHeroScramble Plus
games.summary: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

games.name: Paint Gang
games.summary: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

games.name: The Previous Owner
games.summary: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

games.name: Collapsle
games.summary: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: DiscPods
games.summary: Fly your DiscPod robot and compete by being the ultimate and only winner of the arena! PvP your way to the championship!

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

games.name: Roselle Hunt
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

games.name: Kingslayers
games.summary:
Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn-based and real-time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills, then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

Once you get your bearings, you can conquer ever-increasing ascension difficulties in single-player mode or enter multiplayer and try to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Singleplayer- Relax and Enjoy the ride

Theory craft and min-max to your hearts content in this chill mode. See how high you can go in the ascension ranks or just create some cool unique builds. How about a build where you constantly have a Dragon die to make use of its on-death true damage dealing fireball passive? Or one where each shot from the archer fires 30 arrows? There's thousands of builds waiting for you to explore.

Multiplayer- A turn based game where speed and reaction time actually matters.

The multiplayer is designed for fast-paced, chaotic action. You and your opponent will traverse an identical run and meet at different stages to showcase your builds and outwit each other. This isn't your regular turn-based strategy - speed, quick decisions, and quick reactions are going to play a major part in you climbing to the top of the rankings.

games.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
games.summary: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
games.summary: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

games.name: County of Fortune
games.summary: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

games.name: Phantom Vice Auto
games.summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Phantom Vice Auto and Phantom Vice Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for Phantom Vice Auto Online players.

games.name: Fool King
games.summary: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat.

games.name: Arctic Drive
games.summary: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

games.name: Vehicle Construction Kit
games.summary: Vehicle Construction Kit is a vehicle building sandbox game that allows building vehicles and other complex machinery from a collection of simple base parts alone or together in multiplayer.

games.name: Agromatic
games.summary: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

games.name: Sound System
games.summary: Soundsystém (také jako soundsystem), známý také jako Tribes kmen/y je uskupení lidí, společně vlastnící techniku a další instrumenty, potřebné k pořádání Freetekno parties, jako je například známý teknival CzechTek. Technikou se rozumí zejména: Nákladní automobil, autobus, nebo dodávka pro převoz materiálu a zásob. Naftový agregát potřebný k výrobě elektřiny, jelikož drtivá většina parties se koná mimo dosah jakékoliv infrastruktury. Výkonné reproduktory, jejich celkový příkon často přesahuje 10 kW.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed from the start?

games.name: Survival of Runt
games.summary: The truth belongs only to those who survive." 50 players bet their actual lifespan (Time) to enter the DEADZONE, or write a grand epic in CONQUEST. In a world where order has collapsed, what will define you? Death is not the end. Rise as a Zombie to hunt survivors and reclaim your lost time.

games.name: Alteredblood+
games.summary: A blood-soaking movement-FPS platformer where you splatter walls and floors with your foe’s blood. Stand in that blood to [alter] yourself and your weapons. Soak up blood to replenish and keep fighting. Mother created you to stop them. Beckon our extinction.

games.name: Near Mint
games.summary: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Tears Apart
games.summary: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built around consecutive dash attacks called Tear. Upgrade each one of them to create devastating combat cycles, and defeat creatures of the Void.

games.name: Crown's Trial
games.summary: Crown's Trial is a fantasy souls-like boss rush where you step into a different world with each battle, fighting against legendary heroes from across time.

games.name: Ship Miner
games.summary: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

games.name: Pig King
games.summary: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Ashes of Alice
games.summary: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

games.name: Plucked
games.summary: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.summary:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

games.name: Procession Engine
games.summary: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.summary: Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

games.name: Gravhounds
games.summary: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

games.name: Echo Harvest
games.summary: Build settlements, command the Echoes of former lives, and race against a corruption consuming the world. Echo Harvest is a colony roguelite where every failed timeline becomes part of the history that shapes the next.

games.name: Derby Dynasty: Horse Racing RPG
games.summary: Horse stable management and realistic race simulation in one. Draft, lane position and energy management run on real physics — and you ride the race yourself. Buy, train and breed horses to build a bloodline that lasts for generations.

games.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
games.summary: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York underworld of crime. Collect protection money, trade, and expand your criminal empire while leading your crew in brutal tactical combat. Rule the city with cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

games.name: Too Hot to Hold
games.summary: Grab the Ember and RUN! Too Hot to Hold is an up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

games.name: To Be Besieged
games.summary: Defend the war torn civilians with allies against the 1 hour siege until rescue helicopter arrives

games.name: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
games.summary: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

games.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
games.summary:
A guild-management simulation where every league fixture is a procedurally generated dungeon and every
hero can die in it. You lead an adventuring guild through a six-tier pyramid of 72 rival houses: sign
delvers, train them, kit them, set the standing orders they will fight on, and send four of them into the
dark. You never click an attack. Heroes age, form friendships and grudges, are scarred by what they
survive, retire and die permanently, and the whole history of your guild is written back to you as prose
the simulation generated rather than an author wrote.

games.name: ShootyCraft
games.summary: Massive online space battles with building and crafting. Up to 100 players in an arena. Solo and team game modes.

games.name: Desert Echo
games.summary: You are Echo, an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Deploy turrets, gas barrels, farm energy fragments. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op. The desert doesn't forgive hesitation.

games.name: Blackout Route
games.summary: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, scavenging, and extraction. Venture into dangerous zones, disable Signals, rescue survivors, gather resources, and make it back to camp alive.

games.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
games.summary: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

games.name: Spell Death
games.summary:
An art deco-inspired roguelike deck-builder where the alphabet is the deck and the only power you have are the words you can spell.

Use stocks to add effects to your letters, spell words to awaken their power, discover enemies' true name to banish them and free the illiterate world from the demons that rule since humanity lost "the word".

games.name: Dust & Diamonds
games.summary: Humans are extinct, and Goblins proudly stand at the top of the food chain! Take over a mine, expand your surface base, and automate logistics. Manage workers, trade, avoid cave-ins and lava, and above all – try to endure your father's constant grumbling!

games.name: Bannerlings
games.summary: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

games.name: Supercar Collection Together
games.summary: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

games.name: Football Academy Simulator
games.summary: Football Academy Simulator is a single player sports and management simulation where players build and run their own football academy. Create personalized training programs, develop players across five core attributes, manage equipment and facilities, operate a sports store, and build a squad from the academy’s best talents to compete in the Fantasy League.

games.name: Journey TD
games.summary:
Journey TD is a single-player tower defense game with roguelite progression and pixel art graphics. In each run, players draft towers from six elements – Fire, Ice, Storm, Darkness, Poison and the unlockable Astral element – and place them on procedurally generated maps, where the towers form the maze the enemies have to walk through. A builder character walks across the map and constructs every tower. Three identical towers can be merged into a higher rank, and power-up cards drafted during the run strengthen towers and elements. At fixed waves, a DPS arena tests the damage output of the current build.

The game offers three modes (150 waves, 300 waves and endless) and six difficulty levels. Between runs, progress carries over through builder equipment, skill trees, power runes, unlockable skins, achievements and a collection album of tower cards. Runs are ranked on Steam leaderboards. The game is available in English and German at the moment.

games.name: Muster
games.summary: A roguelite autobattler where every dig shapes your next fight. Build, equip, and position a five-digger warband from eight roles, then watch your plan play out in automatic real-time hex battles. Read the buried grid to uncover recruits and loot—or wake a pocket of monsters.

games.name: Deal Flipper
games.summary: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

games.name: Double Skunk
games.summary:
Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite built on the real game played by the book. Between hands, players add powerups that change what the count pays and collect one-use pocket cards that bend the rules once, such as shoving the rival's peg back down the board or taking the crib whoever dealt. A short guided warm-up teaches cribbage to newcomers before the first match.

The campaign follows a traveling player up the Long Tally, a tournament tour of twenty-one named rivals running from a back-room parlor to a national championship, with house rules such as a chess clock and muggins at the higher tables. Outside the campaign, a weekly duplicate-cribbage challenge deals every player the same hands for a shared leaderboard, and players can face the AI at four difficulty levels or play one-on-one online.

games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Costs
games.summary: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

games.name: Death Dealer
games.summary: A multiplayer horror party game for up to 6 players where the losers of a card game are hunted by their friends.

games.name: Reel Adventure: The Autobattler Journey
games.summary: With every battle, the slot machine spins, randomizing your enemies and rewards. Adapt your strategies on the fly, collect rare and powerful items, and guide your team through a journey fraught with danger. Each run is a fresh adventure where skill, luck, and strategy combine to determine your fate.

games.name: Tomider
games.summary: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.

games.name: StackOn
games.summary: StackOn is a card-based strategy game that combines town building with dungeon exploration. Players stack cards to gather resources, produce items, construct buildings, craft equipment, and develop their settlement. They can also assemble a party, explore dungeons, fight enemies, and bring valuable loot back to support the town.

games.name: No Sunrise
games.summary: Survive the night in No Sunrise, a 2.5D zombie survival shooter for solo play and co-op with up to 8 players. Barricade windows, open new routes, upgrade your weapons and rescue your team as each wave turns up the pressure.

games.name: Horror Game Creator
games.summary: Horror Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiencesfrom quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

games.name: KYC: K Stands for Killing
games.summary: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

games.name: Phone Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

games.name: Bar Owner Simulator
games.summary: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

games.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
games.summary: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

games.name: Camping Resort Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

games.name: Malignus
games.summary: Malignus is a 2D dungeon colony sim and emergent story generator. Play as a boss monster and their underling minions and creatures, expanding your underground dominion, building traps, and defending your prisoners and treasures from invading adventurers.

games.name: Caramel Creek
games.summary: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

games.name: Kachow Kart Racing
games.summary:
Kachow Kart Racing is an arcade kart racing game featuring drift-based boosts, chaotic races, and power-ups. Players can customize their karts, race against AI opponents, challenge friends in local split-screen, or compete in online multiplayer with ranked competition and leaderboards.

Use rockets, smoke bombs, shields, and oil to disrupt rivals and take the lead. Join or create a clan, grow your team, and compete together.

games.name: Cubic Earth
games.summary:
In Cubic Earth's Early Access release, you can fly, walk and hang glide around a 1:1 scale voxel recreation of the planet we all call home! You can go anywhere you'd like: your hometown, old workplace, New York City, Mount Everest, or somewhere you've never even heard of.

Across the entire planet, there are millions of locations to discover and (re) experience. Pick a random place and see where you end up, look for somewhere specific, or wander until you find something interesting. Either way, you're sure to come across something worth discovering!

Additionally, the game includes a freecam Photo Mode, enabling you to take epic screenshots of your surroundings and share them with your friends! Reminisce on an old memory, plan a trip, or create content with ease.

Cubic Earth makes use of voxel technology to ensure a street level which remains coherent across the planet. Roads, trails, forests and more remain legible and navigable, unlike many planet-scale games. From places as iconic as Times Square to your local neighborhood, street level is accessible!

Familiar places can bring back memories you've long since forgotten, and new places can make for an amazing adventure. One of the most fun parts about Cubic Earth is not knowing what you'll find around the corner!

games.name: Just One Bite
games.summary: A 1~4 player co-op horror game. Your mission is to gather as much food as possible for the humans. But not all food is normal. Can you complete this mission to the very end?

games.name: Knight's Party
games.summary: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

games.name: Not in My House
games.summary: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.

games.name: Beat Ten
games.summary: Rhythm action sandbox that lets you use your local audio files or streaming apps to fuel the Beat!

games.name: Flopball
games.summary: Flopball is a physics-based football party game for up to 6 players online. Players compete in team-based matches, combining passing and shooting with slide tackles, punches and ragdoll collisions. Power-ups and arena-specific hazards can change the course of a match. The game features extensive character customisation, adjustable match settings, a shared locker-room lobby and offline play against bots.

games.name: Dungeon Munchies 2
games.summary: Who in their right mind would even WANT to eat cosmic monsters? Find out in this side-scrollin', action-fightin', level-grindin', treasure-lootin', dungeon-munchin' grubapalooza!

games.name: Rally Point
games.summary: A strategy roguelite set in a galaxy that fights back. Draft 90+ heroes, mechs, and support cards. Campaign solo or co-op — between your missions, enemy factions reinforce, counterattack, and contest your ground. In solo, pause to replan.

games.name: Overspray
games.summary: OVERSPRAY is a tactical 4v4 first-person paintball shooter. Short rounds, precise aim and one flag in the middle of the map: hold E for 6 seconds to raise it, or soak the whole enemy team. Nobody dies - everybody gets soaked. Paint builds up on the body until 100 and knocks you out until the next round; fresh paint glows for 30 seconds and then dries, leaving a trail. Buy markers, vests, masks and paint, smoke and flash grenades every round. Modes include Casual, Competitive, Deathmatch, Marker Race and Training, on dedicated servers. Developed by Fazay Games in Brazil.

games.name: Arcade Warlord
games.summary: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

games.name: Voxmons
games.summary:
Voxmons is a creature-collecting action RPG in which the collection does the fighting. Creatures hatched from eggs are equipped into a squad that orbits the player in rings, choosing its own targets and attacking while the player explores. The route runs across four worlds of floating islands - forest, snow, lava and graveyard - linked by bridges and sealed portals, each world ending in a boss, and each island holding its own hatch station with its own egg pool and its own published odds.

187 creatures are spread across seven rarities, each with rarer Large and Huge variants that hit harder and stand taller, and a permanent archive grants lasting bonuses for every species registered in it. Further systems open as the player advances: fusing duplicates into higher tiers, overclocking the rarest creatures, sending reserve creatures on timed expeditions, and leaving the squad to farm while the player is away. It is free to play, with no ads, no currency packs and one optional VIP membership. The artwork was created with generative AI; the game does not generate content with AI while it is played.

games.name: Stack & Brew
games.summary: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

games.name: Bokosuka Wars II
games.summary: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Mission Pack 2 - Super Challenge
aliases: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 - Mission Pack 2: Super Challenge
games.summary: This is pure hell. Bottomless despair, all just for the EDF elite. Unseen despair awaits in the second additional mission pack, with ten impossibly difficult missions.

games.name: Floral Flowlove
games.summary: On that day, I saw an angel.

games.name: DayZ
games.summary: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game with only one rule: stay alive, no matter what. How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ, this is your story.

games.name: Lurkers
games.summary: Lurkers is a chaotic 2D multiplayer sandbox where you can build, battle, and survive! Fight zombies, conquer game modes like Bedwars, and unleash your creativity in a world that’s yours to shape and destroy.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.summary: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a single-player survival game played from a third-person view and set in an open world. Players control a member of a hominid clan and manage its needs by eating, drinking, and sleeping while facing predators and other dangers in the wild. Exploring new places and being hunted can trigger a state of fear, which is offset by rewarding actions such as crafting tools and making discoveries. As the clan learns and grows, players unlock new skills through a neural development system and can switch between clan members, passing acquired abilities to future generations. The game has no structured narrative campaign and instead lets players shape their own experience.

games.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts
aliases: さよならワイルドハーツ
Sayonara Wild Hearts（さよならワイルドハーツ）
games.summary: Sayonara Wild Hearts is a euphoric music video dream about being awesome, riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: Cut the Rope Remastered
games.summary:
Wake up and smell the cake: today is Om Nom's Birthday! The world’s favorite sweet tooth is having a birthday party, and everyone’s invited!

Om Nom is back in the glorious 3D remaster of the legendary Cut the Rope puzzle game!

Cut ropes, avoid obstacles and use boosters to deliver candy to Om Nom, the little green monster that loves sweets. Addictively fun physics based-gameplay, an adorable main character and exciting adventures await. Join more than 1 billion players who enjoyed the original titles. And if you're an old fan, be ready for some some sweet new treats!

games.name: Bike Baron 2
games.summary: Bike Baron 2 is a wild motorbike racer packed with monster jumps and explosive hazards. It mixes platforming and puzzle elements with over-the-top physics and pixel-perfect controls. There's no better way to unleash your inner daredevil than to crash your bike from the safety of your room.

games.name: Mingle
games.summary: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.

games.name: Dungeon Ward
games.summary: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 6
games.summary: Earth Defense Force 6 is the sixth main entry in the Earth Defense Force series and the direct sequel to Earth Defense Force 5, picking up three years after that game left off. EDF 6 is set on a dying Earth where the alien Primer civilization invades once again.

games.name: Call of Duty: Warzone
games.summary: Call of Duty: Warzone is a free-to-play combat game with multiple modes and new gameplay updates. It includes Fortune’s Keep, Endgame (limited time), Battle Royale, Black Ops Royale, and Resurgence, each offering different match types and objectives.

games.name: Castle of Alchemists
games.summary: Defend your castle in this fast-paced tower defense/action hybrid game with stunning pixel art graphics! Play as alchemically enhanced warrior Bellator, set traps, build towers, craft powerful weapons, and defend your home! The fate of the castle lies in your hands!

games.name: Endlight
games.summary: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos and whatnot. Dodging is for cowards - start smashing.

games.name: Gothic Classic
games.summary:
For the first time, relive this amazing RPG on a handheld console and enjoy the game that revolutionized roleplaying games on the go. Dive into dark times and adventures with great performance and a well adapted UI and controls.

War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore. You are thrown through the barrier into this prison colony. With your back against the wall, you have to survive and form volatile alliances until you can finally escape.

games.name: Lyssa: Goddess of Rage
games.summary: Various battlefields with random obstacles and different heroes with unique bonuses to hone your strategy skills. Explore the map, defeat powerful bosses, build your story line, accept quests and embark on a journey! Assemble your forces and lead your party to Victory!

games.name: Residiuum: Tales of Coral
games.summary:
Explore a universe rich in personality and full of mysteries.

After the sun went mad and exploded, all that was left of the world was the Auric Earth. A region divided between the Elite with their suited men and their experiments and technologies with the multi-purpose gas Sig, and the less fortunate who must deal with gangs of criminals of various kinds and a hostile environment full of toxic and poisonous substances.

games.name: Palia
games.summary: Palia is a free-to-play life simulation MMO where players take on the role of humans who have mysteriously appeared in a world primarily inhabited by a species called the Majiri. Gameplay centers on village life activities including fishing, foraging, hunting, mining, insect catching, cooking, furniture making, gardening, and ranching. Players work to become members of Kilima Village by gathering and crafting materials, with the adjacent Bahari Bay area offering higher-level resources and server-wide events.

games.name: Sanctuaries
games.summary:
The conquistadors just landed, and they are coming for your treasure!
Lay down traps and lead your Heroes in this unique tower-defense game.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.summary: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

games.name: Beast: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the cosmic adventure of BEAST! A unique 3V3 online shooter designed for all ages. BEAST combines charm and excitement with intuitive controls.
aliases: B.E.A.S.T.: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team

games.name: The New Denpa Men
aliases: New Denpa Ningen no RPG Free!
games.summary:
Scour radio waves for the Denpa Men: small creatures that call these invisible signals their home.

The New Denpa Men is a free-to-play RPG where you can collect these Denpa Men for your party and adventure with them as your companions. In addition to the main adventure, you can decorate your island, fish, participate in limited-time events, and play against other players.

games.name: Agent Simulator
games.summary: If you are a sharpshooter, you would be a great fit for us. Within a short period of time, select 3 options from the list and deal with your enemies. Do not forget that the ability of using time efficiently and aiming your targets are crucial. Complete each mission and earn an agent certification.

games.name: Little Kitty, Big City
games.summary: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

games.name: Doll Defenders
games.summary: You were teleported to Male Doll's multiverse with one goal: to meet some of our heroes. However, you may find them having private moments. Can you complete the challenges, or will your attention be on their sexual performances? Don't lie to yourself! THIS GAME CONTAINS A TRANS MALE CHARACTER!

games.name: Squad Busters
games.summary: Build a vast collection of Supercell characters, each bringing their own special ability to the battle. Wrestle enemies with Brawl Stars' El Primo, or spray bullets with Boom Beach's Heavy. Harvest Trees with Hay Day's Greg, or summon Skeletons with Clash's Witch!

games.name: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
games.summary: The Shadow of the Erdtree is a fully-fledged expansion that features an all-new story set in the Land of Shadow. It adds a whole new map with 70 new weapons, ten new shields, 39 new Talismans, 14 new sorceries, 28 new incantations, 20 new Spirit Ashes, 25 New Ashes of War, 30 new armour sets, and new consumables and craftables.

games.name: Archa
games.summary:
As Archa, fight enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and get the Interdimensional Pumpkins or Carrots in this upcoming Bullet-Hell Platformer!

Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

games.name: Baradroid: A Gay Visual Novel
games.summary: A choice-driven, high-tech, gay visual novel with elements of dating-sim! Choose your baradroid, Live with him, and... Can you teach a robot the meaning of human love?

games.name: Wilder World: Super Early Access
games.summary: Interdimensional refugees known as the Wilders flee Our Base Reality, which has become an AI-controlled dystopia to Wiami, a digital sanctuary in Wilder World. When the authoritarian FORUM attempts to conquer Wiami, the Wilders strategize a defence.

games.name: Zero Hour
games.summary: Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
games.summary: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

games.name: The Tag-along Obsession
games.summary: 《THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION》 is a first-person horror puzzle game. You will play Hui Ting and enter the long-abandoned resort to explore the truth of everything. The props survive as much as possible and solve all the mysteries and connections to her own past.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Portrait of a Torn
games.summary: As a young soldier returning to an eerily deserted home, you'll explore enigmatic rooms and uncover a haunting, tragic story. Experience an atmospheric journey filled with suspense, mysterious encounters, and a deep narrative.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.summary: Pursue your dream of an aviation career with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This brand-new simulator is designed to take advantage of the latest technologies in simulation, cloud, machine learning, graphics and gaming to create the most sophisticated, immersive and awe-inspiring flight simulator of all time. To achieve this unprecedented level of accuracy, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is powered by the significantly evolved Asobo Studio engine.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary: Luma Island is a casual life simulation and farming game where players explore a peaceful island, grow crops, care for animals, and interact with a small community of characters. The game focuses on day-to-day activities, resource gathering, and simple crafting mechanics in a relaxed, open-ended environment.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

games.name: Cookie Run India
games.summary:
Enjoy a colorful running game—invite friends to play, laugh, and relax together!

Welcome to CookieRun India, the ultimate running game that combines fast-paced action, colorful graphics, and endless fun! In this exciting runner game, you’ll guide your Cookie characters through thrilling races, all while competing against friends and players from around the world. Are you ready to experience one of the most exciting running games on the market?

With smooth gameplay, no ads, and plenty of rewards and giveaways, CookieRun India brings a new level of excitement to the world of runner games. Get ready to immerse yourself in a game running experience like no other!

games.name: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death
games.summary:
A completely new title from Imagineer and Toybox Inc., Mystery Walk is the first in a three-part serial drama series!

The game is set in Narumisawa, a charming, fictional summer getaway town that feels familiar, as though you have seen it somewhere before…

The story alternates between the present and the past to uncover the truth behind an unsolved case from 30 years ago.

Told through a prologue, 10 episodes, and a mysterious “?” episode, the mysteries deepen with each chapter.

The fully voiced dialogue, brought to life by a talented cast, will make you eager to continue to the next episode. And there are some unexpected names among the voice actors…

Please immerse yourself in the world of Mystery Walk to the fullest!

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Sottaku
games.summary: Sottaku is a multiplayer video game in which players compete against each other, Geoguessr-style, in order to quickly read or fill in the blanks in cloze or reading sentences, across Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
aliases: モンスターハンターワイルズ
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Iron Saga VS
games.summary: Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as "Mazinger Z" and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

games.name: Eternal Fate: A Journey Begins
games.summary: Old-school style RPG to enjoy a nostalgic tale with difficult and fair gameplay that is fully voiced.

games.name: Hollywood Animal
games.summary: Make movies, even if someone has to die. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

games.name: Pirate Royalty
games.summary: Pirate Royalty is a free-to-play fantasy pirate MMORPG set on Saltbreak Isle. Players choose from four classes, build their own stats and skills, hunt rare gear, forge gems into equipment, and team up for timed dungeons. It includes PvE, PvP, trading, and a cosmetics-only shop—combat power has to be earned.

games.name: Frog Legs
games.summary: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

games.name: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
aliases: FANTASY LIFE i: Guruguru no Ryuu to Toki wo Nusumu Shoujo
FANTASY LIFE i: La voleuse de temps
FANTASY LIFE i: La pequeña ladrona del tiempo
FANTASY LIFE i: La ragazza che ruba il tempo
FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time is an RPG life-sim game and the long-awaited sequel to the 3DS classic Fantasy Life. This game will expand on what the original did, blending simulation with traditional action RPG combat mechanics.

games.name: Automate It
games.summary: Automate It is a factory building game that requires clever solutions to its size, power, and time constraints. Solve challenges, build and share your own levels, or open things up in sandbox mode. If you want to build it - Automate It.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
aliases: 埃里克斯霍姆：被偷走的梦
games.summary:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

games.name: Earthion
games.summary:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

games.name: PhotoLoop
games.summary: PhotoLoop is a casual game about editing photos using an outdated editing software that only has the lasso tool. Make sure to make your edits clean and concise, or you might not be able to pay your rent due in five days!

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: A cozy foraging adventure for anyone who loves the outdoors or wishes they knew it better. Every plant is real: learn to identify 100+ wild plants and fungi and cook 200+ real recipes, while helping a storm-struck town find its feet again.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: Shape and lead your own fully customisable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city. Unlock unique abilities, hang out with eccentric nobles, learn the secrets the city holds while occasionally delivering ice cream!

games.name: Chark
games.summary: CHARK is a chess roguelike about risk, synergies, and precise calculation.

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.summary: Little Witch in the Woods tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Lost Skies
games.summary: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary: Loot, shoot, and mow down zombie hordes in this bullet heaven fever dream. Embark on a deadly roadtrip, fuel your bus, decide when to extract – and get that sweet inventory management kick when that new slot in your backpack fits just right.

games.name: King of Meat
games.summary: Compete in a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against community-built dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight. Progress through chaotic dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate contender!

games.name: Huggy & Friends
games.summary: Huggy & Friends is an upcoming Poppy Playtime-themed DLC for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.

games.name: Microvania
games.summary: Explore a tiny world, find upgrades, discover hidden paths, and battle bosses in this retro-style metroidvania action platformer.

games.name: Mannequin Mayhem: Physics Ragdoll Shooter
games.summary: Get ready for a wild ride in "Mannequin Mayhem," the craziest shooter this year! Say goodbye to zombies and aliens; it's time to blast creepy mannequins. Survive endless waves, customize your arsenal, and embrace the chaos. Let's laugh and blast our way through the weirdest enemies ever!

games.name: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars
games.summary: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments.

games.name: Final Formation
games.summary: Equipped with the Fusion × Transformation “PELL” System! Free Map Side-Scrolling Shooter

games.name: Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG
games.summary: SYRUP 2: CANDY ALCHEMY RPG is a direct sequel to Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet. As the title implies, the series has evolved into a fully featured RPG! Synthesize candies, battle monsters, and complete quests while discovering more about the world beyond Atelier Sweets!
aliases: Sirope 2: El RPG de la alquimia caramelística

games.name: Aeruta
games.summary: A bread revolution across the world now begins! Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!
aliases: 亞路塔：狐狸狐途的麵包冒險
亚路塔：狐狸狐途的面包冒险

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
aliases: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remastered
games.summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Embark on an adventure, exploring a million subterranean floors of a fallen Earth. Trace the remnants of humanity that once dwelled below, all in search of "YOU". Utilize a crafting system that transforms your drawings into weapons to survive the challenging underground world.

games.name: Cleared Hot
games.summary: CLEARED HOT is a nostalgic helicopter shooter with satisfying physics and light tactical elements. Shoot, dodge, move your squad around the battlefield, and pick up almost anything with your rope and magnet.

games.name: Leaks In Space
games.summary: Build your own spaceship. Protect ship's core, manage Hull & Pressure to survive. Fight pirates. Explore themed sectors of the Syntar System. Uncover the mysterious of the Syntarian Empire!

games.name: Two Point Museum: Zooseum
games.summary: Now hiring for Wildlife Experts to heal, raise and re-wild some wonderful wildlife in our brand new museum location!

games.name: Rhythm Doctor
games.summary: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

games.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
games.summary:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

games.name: Heavy Duty
games.summary: Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

games.name: Low Effort Romance
games.summary: Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports. Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

games.name: Panzer Planet
games.summary: Fast-paced, twin sticker, top-down arena shooter with roguelite elements, where you pilot a powerful tank on spherical mini planets to fight hordes of zombies and monsters. Collect your bounty for killing your enemies to get new weapons and powerups to improve your skills.

games.name: Puzkin: Magnetic Odyssey
games.summary: Enter PUZKIN: Magnetic Odyssey, a family-friendly sandbox MMORPG where you build, explore, and battle in an epic anime-inspired world. Capture creatures and collect cards, customize your characters, and unleash creativity in dynamic PvP, PvE, and collaborative building adventures!

games.name: Oh Demon! Fix my TV
games.summary: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

games.name: Bomboban
games.summary: Bomboban is a classic Sokoban-style puzzle game with an explosive twist: instead of pushing crates, you push enemy robots into bombs to defeat them and clear each stag

games.name: Folklore Hunter
games.summary: You’re a world-renowned hunter of supernatural beasts. Track down urban legends from all over the world, set traps, solve disturbing puzzles, and defeat the beasts before you succumb to their otherworldly presence.

games.name: Kuky Adventure
games.summary: Help Kuky, a curious character who gets lost in the Candy World and must travel through colorful environments to find the way back home. Along the journey, collect candies and face strange sugar-made enemies such as marshmallows, cookies, and other living, dangerous sweets.

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Race across open oceans and uncover a kingdom’s dark secrets. Expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear and modifying your move-set every step of the way!

games.name: Rager
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled excitement of this melee combat rhythm game! Master weapon of your choice – sword, mace, claws, hammer, axe, your own fists and many more! Stunning visuals and spatial audio technology puts you right in heart of the action.

games.name: Chicken Rescue
games.summary: Retro-inspired 2D platformer packed with traps, secrets, and challenging levels.

games.name: Out of Sight: Stage Fright
games.summary: Uncover the story of a tormented Unseen, a spirit child who reaches out to Sophie for help with their final performance. Together with Teddy, they reveal new perspectives, a chilling history, and a need to overcome their greatest fears.

games.name: Egypt Frontiers
games.summary: In the game Egypt Frontiers, players explore ancient Egypt, constructing authentic pyramid and making strategic decisions. The game offers the opportunity to learn about real history or create their own vision of civilization in both strategy and first-person modes.

games.name: Stellar Wanderer DX
games.summary: Stellar Wanderer DX is an old-school space combat sim set in a vast open-world universe. Follow the story or choose your favorite side missions as a mercenary fighter pilot. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your ship and weapons, trade resources and fight outlaws.

games.name: Versus One
games.summary: Chaotic Party Action with Dark Witch Characters! Jump into a party game for up to 4 players, starring characters from The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4! Play locally or online and compete in 6 fast-paced mini-games, where magic isn’t just for winning — it’s for messing with your friends.

games.name: In Their Shoes
games.summary: From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

games.name: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.summary: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: Dead Patrol
games.summary:
Prepare for the collapse of civilization in Dead Patrol, an intense and visceral action shooter where every shot counts. In a city consumed by chaos, you take on the role of an elite patrol officer sent into the most dangerous zones to face relentless hordes of the undead and reclaim overrun sectors.
With fast-paced, tactical combat, extremely responsive controls, and a powerful arsenal, Dead Patrol delivers a brutal and straightforward survival experience. Strategic movement, fluid weapon switching, and smart use of the environment are essential to stay alive amid the urban chaos.

games.name: Town of Zoz
games.summary: Fight with flavor! As Ito, a young shaman chef adventurer, you'll hunt critters, gather ingredients, and rebuild bonds by cooking for the townspeople. A shaman chef always aims to lend a helping hand, but the more Ito gets involved, the more he'll learn about the town and its ancient secrets.

games.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
games.summary:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

games.name: Relic Abyss
games.summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with 💪might, 🪄magic, and 🎡lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...🦑🌎

games.name: Nekopara Sekai Connect
games.summary: A heartwarming Neko comedy that connects these felines from all across the globe! With over 7 million copies sold worldwide, the latest entry in the popular adventure game series NEKOPARA is here!

games.name: Replaced
games.summary: Replaced is a 2.5D sci-fi retro-futuristic action platformer where you play as R.E.A.C.H. - an artificial intelligence trapped in a human body against its own will. Replaced combines cinematic platforming, pixel art and free-flow action combat set in an alternative 1980's.

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: OPUS: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where you play as a weary photographer stranded in the Dusklands, traveling with a girl who's lost her memories. Together, you'll uncover the mysteries of this land through your camera and find your way home.

games.name: The Amusement
games.summary: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

games.name: Just One Man
games.summary: JUST ONE MAN is a VR hack-and-slash game where you are the OVERPOWERED VILLAIN. Stylishly slaughter enemies with weapons, combo attacks and devastating abilities while listening to banging beats. Choose your own playstyle and invent the wildest combos to achieve the highest scores imaginable.

games.name: Drowning Song of the Stagnant Sea
games.summary: A dark fairy tale set in the deep sea. The fated encounter between a sea monster and a human forever changes their lives in this yuri visual novel.

games.name: Bylina
games.summary: Embark on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG rooted in Slavic folklore and myths. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

games.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.summary: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turnbased deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the Turboturn with your own hand of cards!

games.name: Revenger2
games.summary: The second installment in the Revenger series: a retro RPG from the feature phone era!

games.name: Forefront
games.summary: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

games.name: Kyra The Hunter
games.summary: Take control of Kyra, a skilled hunter with golden hair and a blue cape, on an epic journey to reclaim lands overrun by dark creatures. Armed with her trusty sword, Kyra must traverse devastated regions, facing hordes of monsters and deadly challenges to restore peace to the world.

games.name: FIFA Heroes
games.summary: FIFA Heroes is an arcade-style video game developed by ENVER Studio in partnership with FIFA. It is FIFA's first licensed game announced since its agreement with EA Sports came to a close in 2022.

games.name: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
games.summary: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

games.name: The Shore: Enhanced Edition
games.summary: The complete experience unfolds in The Shore, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure that blends exploration and puzzles in a world shaped by ancient gods and forbidden knowledge.

games.name: For the Glory of Wilson
games.summary: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite focused on ally-based combat and dungeon exploration. Players recruit companions with different combat roles while progressing through randomized runs featuring melee and ranged combat.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6: Treasure Map
games.summary:
Need some help finding all of the Bonus Boards, Barn Finds, Regional Mascots, Treasure Chests and Treasure Cars hidden around Japan?

Get the Forza Horizon 6 Treasure Map today to reveal the exact location of these collectables in the main game and Expansions, once they become available.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6: Welcome Pack
games.summary: Discover Japan with everything you need to get started and accelerate your racing journey to Horizon Legend with the Forza Horizon 6 Welcome Pack.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6: VIP Membership
games.summary: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership is your permanent ticket to even more rewards at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy a 2x Credit boost to race rewards, 3 VIP-Exclusive Forza Edition cars, a weekly bonus Super Wheelspin, and special Vanity Items including the Crown Flair, Emote and Car Horn. You’ll also be handed the keys to the lavish Tokyo City House, a classic Japanese home in the suburbs that includes a Customizable Garage with a space to show off your favorite cars. Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership can be purchased separately and is included with Premium Edition and Premium Upgrade. This lifetime membership is a single purchase and will always be yours to enjoy in Forza Horizon 6. Join the Horizon VIP Club today!

games.name: Thick as Thieves
games.summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
games.summary: The Deluxe Edition Upgrade is for existing owners of LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. Upgrade your experience and suit up with new gear, vehicles, and more, with the Deluxe Edition Upgrade.

games.name: Restore the Luminous
games.summary:
Restore the Luminous is a free-to-play digital trading card game in which every card is unlocked the moment the game is installed. There are no booster packs, no gacha and no cards for sale; the only purchases planned are cosmetic.

Two players duel one on one with decks of 40 to 60 cards, built from a single card pool shared by every leader, with a limit of three copies of any one card and no colour restrictions on deckbuilding. Cards are paid for with LP, a resource that comes in five colours: red, blue, green, yellow and black. LP grows and fully refreshes every turn, and its colours are set by discarding cards from your own hand, so deciding what to throw away is as much a part of the game as deciding what to play.

Damage is not a life total that ticks down.
