It moves cards from the top of the defending player's deck into a damage zone, and a card with a Turnover ability fires that ability for free as it lands there. A player loses when their damage zone fills up. On turns 4 and 7 both leaders evolve at the same time, each drawing an extra card and unlocking the next stage of their own ability.

All four leaders draw from the same card pool, but each has a different innate ability and a different set of numbers: a different opening hand size, a different number of unit slots and a different number of counter slots. The same deck therefore plays differently depending on which leader is holding it.

The game includes solo matches against AI, online 1v1 matchmaking, private friend matches by room ID, and community-run round-robin and bracket tournaments.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

games.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
games.summary: House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

games.name: NBA the Run
games.summary: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

games.name: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary: Explore alien worlds and launch Offensives against the Void as a member of the ESS Starseeker crew. Embark on timed Expeditions to investigate alien flora and fauna, upgrade your gear, and complete missions to save the Universe.

games.name: Skinwalker: First Blood
games.summary: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

games.name: Bravest!
games.summary: The “Braveast” series—a retro RPG from the feature phone era—and its landmark first installment!

games.name: Super Dev Quest
games.summary: When a young game developer is unexpectedly pulled into one of his own creations, he must survive in a dangerous game-inspired world filled with traps and deadly enemies.

games.name: Dodo Duckie
games.summary: Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With the help of your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D to uncover hidden paths, outsmart aliens, and rescue your kidnapped chicken friends in this wholesome puzzle platformer adventure.

games.name: Ungodly
games.summary: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Bravest! Side Story: Kurimoto Quest
games.summary: Read your enemy’s next move and find a winning combination of weapons and armor! Discover merchant Kurimoto’s past in a one-on-one, turn-based RPG. This Bravest! side story returns from Japan’s feature phone era with modern usability improvements.

games.name: Ikarus
games.summary: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

games.name: Nightmare Delivery
games.summary:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

games.name: Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock is an action-horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
games.summary:
Turn a quiet patch of land into your own little farm, complete with crops, animals and pets, and watch it flourish.

Start with just a few planting beds and some basic tools. Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for them, wait for the right moment and then sell the harvest for a profit. As your farm grows, you can unlock more space, upgrade your equipment, increase production and become more efficient every day.

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Survive on the edge of space! Craft and upgrade tools, scavenge resources, and save a galaxy gone completely off the rails. Can Ordinary Man save the galaxy with the help of the immortal Chicken and some duct tape?

games.name: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
games.summary: Aegis Force is a story-driven tactical RPG that blends turn-based strategic combat with full world and town exploration. It captures the essence of genre-defining JRPG classics with colorful pixel art 2.5D visuals, a morally complex story, and an intricately detailed world with secrets to discover.

games.name: Hozy Hideaways
games.summary: A free DLC for all Hozy players, invites you to explore three new levels - each with its own unique atmosphere and personality. Meet the characters who call these spaces home, discover the little details that make each place unique, and take your time turning them into something special.

games.name: Rushcremental
games.summary: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

games.name: Knucklebones Neon
games.summary: Knucklebones Neon is a turn-based dice game in which two players place rolls into columns, combine matching dice to increase their scores, and remove matching dice from opposing columns. It includes computer opponents with three difficulty levels, local two-player play on one device, and online ranked matches. Collectible runes and alternate game modes introduce abilities and variations on the scoring rules.

games.name: Monowave
games.summary: MONOWAVE is a whimsical puzzle-platforming adventure about the power of emotions. Explore beautiful worlds and empathize with quirky spirits to restore harmony.

games.name: Exaverse
games.summary: Extinction of the Exaverse is a mobile roguelike where evolved dinosaurs fight back against invading AI machines. Players progress through biome-based runs, choosing powerful upgrades and building unique combat styles each attempt.

games.name: Penguin Festival
games.summary: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

games.name: Cute & Dead
games.summary: You might look like a typical nerd, but even a zombie apocalypse won't stop you from asking the girl of your dreams out on a date. All you need to do is find and rescue her from hordes of the living dead.

games.name: Knights Province
games.summary: Real-Time Strategy game focused around town-building and resource management

games.name: Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories
games.summary: Immerse yourself in The Neverending Check-In, a pixel RPG filled with mystery, quests, cats, humor and life universe. Rebuild a once-glorious hotel and uncover its secret past in this captivating journey of deep plots, lively characters, and abundant quests.

games.name: Shadow Mate
games.summary: A horror action adventure game in which you work with Belial, a life form that has possessed the body of a young girl named Cynthia, to escape from a mysterious laboratory.

games.name: Black Mesa: Classic
games.summary:
This is a GoldSource project aimed to recreate Black Mesa: Source feel within Half-LIfe 1 and its assets.

Our main goals for this project is to give a new feel, look to the original Half-Life, with adding more features, improved level design that many people love from Black Mesa remake but with additional things, to make it a bit more unique. Black Mesa: Classic aims to be capabile on any PC without high requiremnts, with better visuals and effects to make your Half-Life 1 campaign experience the best!

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Former Dawn
games.summary:
After a failed terraforming mission on an exoplanet light years from Earth, humanity dies out but leaves behind a child species(called the “Formers”) that forgets its own origin. You play a common hunter who rediscovers the truth and struggles against the faceless Organization which will stop at nothing to defeat you. Along the way, you recruit a motley crew of brave Formers who are willing to risk everything for Justice.

Former Dawn is, in a nutshell, a story of discovery, resistance to evil, and exploration of the human condition. The world is rich, the plot complex, and the characters dynamic and multi-dimensional.

games.name: Rise of Fati
games.summary: Step into the mythical world of "Rise of Fati," an epic adventure game where ancient African folklore and legends come to life. Embark on a journey with Fati, a young and brave warrior destined to restore peace and harmony to her homeland. Explore rich landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and battle formidable foes as you uncover the secrets of your heritage.

games.name: Blitzpoint
games.summary: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

games.name: SweetCanvas
games.summary: An untimely transfer. An unexpected encounter. A chance meeting between two students sets in motion a chain of events that will fundamentally change both of their lives... Or, perhaps, just their love life!

games.name: Silicone Heart
games.summary: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

games.name: Slide Soldiers
games.summary: Slide Soldiers is a cozy sliding puzzle game where you aim for the enemies instead of reaching the exit. Play at your own pace and discover the perfect path in 5,000 levels. Pick your targets and plan your moves, cause once you start sliding, there’s no stopping!

games.name: One More Tower
games.summary: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Patricide
games.summary: Patricide (or paternal homicide) is the act of killing one's own father. The word patricide derives from the Latin word pater (father) and the suffix -cida (cutter or killer). Patricide is a sub-form of parricide, which is defined as an act of killing a close relative. In many cultures and religions, patricide was considered one of the worst sins. For example, according to Marcus Tullius Cicero, in the Roman Republic it was the only crime that led a civilian to death penalty.

games.name: Chronal Chain
games.summary: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

games.name: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
games.summary: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

games.name: Omertà: Mafia Novel
games.summary: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.summary: "Merry Crisis" or "Merry Crisis and a Happy New Fear" is a slogan that appeared as graffiti in Athens during the 2008 Civil Unrest in Greece. Earlier, a picture of such graffiti appeared on the cover of Vavel magazine's 2007 Christmas special. The British anarchist publication Occupied London states that it was "one of the main slogans of the 2008 revolt."

games.name: Cats Hidden in Advent Calendar
games.summary: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advents calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this cute HOG by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cats game creator!

games.name: Hag's Hand
games.summary: A tower defense game that blends Brazilian folklore myths with card management. Protect the forest by summoning the creatures that dwell within the wilds. As invaders push deeper into the untamed woods, the witch Cuca merely watches their movement, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

games.name: Swifty
games.summary: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

games.name: They Are Rising
games.summary: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

games.name: Liminal Cage: Gin no Youkakutei
games.summary: Liminal Cage: Gin no Youkakutei je hra z kategorie Indie / Vizuální novela pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: Dec 2026.

games.name: You Will Fall
games.summary: A parkour climbing game where gravity is your enemy, fire is your only friend, and the ground keeps winning. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just you and your poor life choices.

games.name: Bold: Networked Newt Action
games.summary: Bold: Networked Newt Action redefines multiplayer stealth action for the modern day, with a return to classic Spies vs Mercs style 2v2 asymmetrical gameplay in a dark Sci-Fi world with anthropomorphic animals. 3rd person stealth is pitted against 1st person action in maps set across exotic locales!

games.name: Oogies Chicken Quest
games.summary: A short, quirky 3D action adventure where Oogie sets out to find his legendary chicken, Cluck Cluck, who lays diamond eggs. Explore small open worlds , solve puzzles, battle odd enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in vibrant levels!

games.name: Fishing Fever
games.summary: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 70 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

games.name: Moto Trial Turbo
games.summary: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

games.name: Salmon
games.summary: Salmon is a surname. Notable people with the name include: Adam Salmon, American researcher and professor Alex Salmon (born 1994), English footballer André Salmon (1881–1969), French writer Barnett Salmon (1829–1897), co-founder of Salmon & Gluckstein, by 1900 the world's largest retail tobacconist Benoît Salmon (born 1974), French road racing cyclist Cecil Salmon (1885–1975), American agronomist Chris Salmon, British banker, Chief Cashier of the Bank of England (2011–2014) Christine Salmon (1916–1985), American architect and educator Christopher Salmon (born 1978), Welsh politician Colin Salmon (born 1961), British actor Cyril…

games.name: Pistol Cat
games.summary: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

games.name: Skate Mates
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

games.name: SpringTale
games.summary: SpringTale is a 2D action platformer indie MMO where you explore the changing seasons in a massive endless world alongside your friends.

games.name: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
games.summary: Dive into a world consumed by the biblical apocalypse. As a fallen priest seeking redemption, battle demonic horrors, cleanse the tormented, and gather what remains to rebuild the Sanctuary of Ash - the faint light in a dying world.

games.name: Affictionate
games.summary: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.

games.name: No Elevator
games.summary: A claustrophobic guy refuses elevators and climbs a massive building.

games.name: Goodnight, B
games.summary: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

games.name: Wizalign
games.summary: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

games.name: Hacking Into Erebus
games.summary:
Hacking Into Erebus is a hacking game centered on taking control of a spacecraft named USS Erebus.

The ship is stranded on a remote alien planet. The crew is in cryogenic sleep. The player physically navigates inside the ship using robots while simultaneously gaining access to its network systems. The ship's central operating system, ARIA, protects the system but operates aggressively against the player.

The player must manage robots and interact with panels and terminals to successfully take control of the ship's systems.

games.name: Kaperfahrt
games.summary:
Kaperfahrt is an open world pirate sandbox set in a simulated Caribbean during the age of sail. Around 200 AI captains sail, trade and wage their own wars independently of the player, so conflicts and trade routes exist whether the player takes part in them or not.

Players engage in naval combat, board and capture enemy vessels, and command a fleet of up to four ships that fight in formation. Trade runs between five rival houses whose economy reacts to player actions, so blockading a harbour shifts prices across the map. A bounty list of 23 named pirates, each with their own crew and fighting style, forms the long term goal.

Kaperfahrt is developed by Kleinod Games, a one person studio from Germany, and is built in Godot.

games.name: Groundwork
games.summary: You're a robot sent ahead to ready an uncharted planet for the humans on their way. Chart the world, salvage old landings, build machines and power, and wake the derelict robots scattered in the wilds — each one becomes a neighbor with a voice and a job. No combat, no game over. Just groundwork.

games.name: DNA Nemesis
games.summary: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

games.name: Graven
games.summary: A Frankenstein-inspired Gothic RPG. You’re an eccentric physician’s apprentice whose unique skills (and shortcomings) shape every conversation. Explore the city, follow leads, and find your missing mentor and the man you helped raise from the dead. Save them, condemn them, or alter death itself.

games.name: Tinker's Nook
games.summary: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

games.name: Last Train to Yotsuya
games.summary: Last Train to Yotsuya is a short first-person narrative experience. Explore different locations, observe your surroundings, and interact with the objects around you to gradually uncover a personal story through the details and events of the journey.

games.name: Meltdown Crew
games.summary: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

games.name: Call of Blood
games.summary:
The game takes place in 2009-2011.

Call of Blood is a cinematic single-player first-person shooter that immerses you in a gritty survival experience. The world is engulfed in a zombie outbreak, but the walking dead are far from your only problem.

You became the most wanted target after eliminating an influential politician who launched three dangerous reactors that could kill half of humanity.

Now, regular groups of enemies and elite operatives from the (Vurs) are hunting your head. A group of scientists is the only key to salvation. They offer you the dangerous deal of a lifetime: break through the cordon and blow up the sinister reactors from the inside.

games.name: Snackrifice
games.summary: Feed a hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. Adapt to perilous curses, craft powerful relics and overcome the many faces of Purgatory.

games.name: The Sky Project: Land of Noris
games.summary: Hand-drawn monster collector where every creature lost might be gone forever. Explore four unique planes and train 200+ mana creatures.

games.name: Books & Blood
games.summary: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

games.name: Void Skirmisher
games.summary: Void Skirmisher is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the gate before the front line even exists, and face down hostile fleets as the first wave out where nobody's been before.

games.name: Elf Shift
games.summary: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

games.name: Desktop Rave
games.summary: Desktop Rave is an audio-reactive desktop companion and idle management game. Use your own music to drive the in-game economy and create your own unique club.

games.name: That Corridor in the Backrooms
games.summary: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

games.name: Zaploopa 4040
games.summary: Zaploopa is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

games.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
games.summary: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

games.name: Trash to Trees: Tidy Up the Forest!
games.summary: A cozy first-person nature restoration game. Explore a polluted forest, collect litter, sort it at the recycling station, and watch the world come back to life, one piece of trash at a time. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: Super-Type
games.summary: Super-Type is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

games.name: Echoes of Another Sky
games.summary: Echoes of Another Sky is a fantasy action role-playing game about a boy and a talking bell exploring thirteen skies. Combat combines action combos with tuning-fork magic.

games.name: Noël Macabre
games.summary: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

games.name: Ink and Lore
games.summary: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who—

games.name: GigaStriker
games.summary: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

games.name: The First Pixel
games.summary: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

games.name: Senti Metrica
games.summary: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

games.name: Rejoin Me After Brexit
games.summary: An adult romance visual novel about Owen Pascoe, a struggling English coach operator sent across the Channel on a civic errand. Choose one of three distinct routes as a herring fair, a hungry local paper, and two watchful towns turn private romance into public news.

games.name: Room Movers
games.summary: Room Movers is a cozy two-player online co-op game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces such as a café, a flower shop and a dentist's office. Small boxes can be opened alone, while big boxes and heavy furniture need both players to grab an end and pull together. There is no grid and nothing snaps into place: every item is moved by hand with physics. There is no score, no timer and no fail state. When both players press Done, the camera circles the finished room and hands them a polaroid that is added to an album on the menu wall and can be saved to the desktop.

games.name: Bloom & Dine
games.summary: Bloom & Dine is a cozy chaos cooking game on a match-3 board. Match ingredients to fire up the stoves, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your guest's patience runs out. Work your way through a few kitchens over 99 in-game days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea, with bonus puzzle days and hidden object levels along the way.

games.name: Drop Dead Party
games.summary: Drop Dead Party is a chaotic 2-4 players PvP arena of a bomb tag. Pass the ticking bomb before you explode, drop dirty power-ups on your friends, and survive fast-paced chaotic circus rounds. Invite your Steam squad and ruin your group chat!

games.name: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
games.summary: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: My Snake Likes Apples
games.summary: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance. The snake moves on its own to reach apples. Players collect apple seeds to upgrade its speed, bite strength, and intelligence, helping it progress through harsher places.

games.name: Carrot Count Sheep
games.summary: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into sheep's dreams, solves puzzles, and wakes them up to join their adventure. But when Carrot wakes up, their journey is just beginning... Whose dream is this, anyway?

games.name: Abandoned Below
games.summary: Abandoned Below is a first-person cooperative zombie survival game set in an abandoned underground bunker. Play alone or with friends, fight increasingly dangerous waves of zombies, rebuild barricades, and unlock new areas as you explore the complex.

games.name: Night Machine
games.summary: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

games.name: Sheeple
games.summary: Cast cards to turn the tides of the battlefield, gather your army, and fight to regain The Original Sheep! Sheeple is a grand real time Auto battler with roguelike and deck-building elements.

games.name: System 21
games.summary: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

games.name: Tidy up the Backrooms
games.summary: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back. Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

games.name: Fieldmade
games.summary: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

games.name: Akashic Slingshot
games.summary: One weapon. One health. One ███.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

games.name: Freestyle Football 2
games.summary: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.name: Vanguard Valiants
games.summary: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

games.name: Step Theater
games.summary: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

games.name: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
games.summary: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.
aliases: Dragon Quest Monsters 4: The Withered World
DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
Dragon Quest Monsters : Le royaume de Boisflétri

games.name: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Apple Crumble
games.summary: Its your grandmas 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and dont worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

games.name: Sombras: Negative Frames
games.summary: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

games.name: Dumpster Gang
games.summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.name: Click Bait
games.summary: Click Bait is a rhythm roguelite where the worst monsters of the internet finally face justice, requiring you to master the art of timing your clicks around a continuous spinning wheel to defeat these online threats.

games.name: Defenders of Cinderkeep
games.summary: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Death and Tactics
games.summary: A post apocalyptic turn-based strategy game. Permanent death is a primary mechanic, with unique events being unlocked based on how you play the game. And there are many ways to play! Such as: selling the organs of party members you don't like, turning your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

games.name: King's Haven
games.summary: Build your deck, expand your kingdom, and defend your Haven! Recruit citizens, construct landmarks, and build powerful combos in this roguelike deckbuilder where each card is a citizen and each season brings new rewards, new threats, and new choices.

games.name: North Pole Workshop
games.summary: Play as one of Santa’s elves to create, gift-wrap, and deliver toys. This 1-4 cooperative toy-making game can be completed at your own pace in easy difficulty(1 star). For more challenge and to test your team's coordination, you can attempt the harder timed difficulties (2-3 stars).

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.summary: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

games.name: Town of Tinysville
games.summary: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

games.name: Space Industry
games.summary: Space industry refers to economic activities related to manufacturing components that go into outer space (Earth's orbit or beyond), delivering them to those regions, and related services. Owing to the prominence of satellite-related activities, some sources use the term satellite industry interchangeably with the term space industry. The term space business has also been used. A narrow definition of the space industry typically encompasses only hardware providers (primarily those that manufacture launch vehicles and satellites). This definition does not exclude certain activities, such as space tourism.

games.name: The Last Ninja & IK Collection
games.summary:
The Last Ninja & IK Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together two of System 3's most celebrated series across their original home computer platforms (ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, Atari ST):

- The Last Ninja — Take command of Armakuni the last ninja, seeking to avenge the assassination of his clan, in the original 8-bit release.
- Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance — Armakuni's action-adventure continues in modern-day New York.
- Last Ninja 3 — The trilogy's conclusion, as Armakuni chases the evil Kunitoki through time to a final confrontation.
- Ninja Remix — A remixed version reimagining the first Last Ninja game with new gameplay.
- International Karate — The original one-on-one martial arts fighting classic.
- IK+ — The sequel adding a third combatant for free-for-all three-way karate battles.

Each title is included across its original ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari ST versions.

games.name: James Pond Collection
games.summary:
The James Pond Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together four classic 16-bit games starring the underwater secret agent:

- James Pond: Underwater Agent — Agent Double Bubble Seven dives beneath the waves to take on the dastardly Dr. Maybe in this environmentally-themed action game.
- James Pond 2: Codename RoboCod — Armed with a new Robosuit, James Pond leaps into action to rescue Santa's toy factories from Dr. Maybe in this colourful platformer.
- James Pond 3: Operation StarFI5H — James Pond blasts off on a lunar adventure to thwart Dr. Maybe's plan to mine the Moon's cheese.
- The Aquatic Games Starring James Pond and the Aquabats — James Pond and the Aquabats compete across 10 crazy events in this cartoony multi-sports title.

games.name: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
games.summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.
series: A Game About Digging A Hole

games.name: Gemheart Valley
games.summary: Grow crystals instead of crops. Crack geodes with the most satisfying tap in cozy games, fill a museum with one-of-a-kind gems, befriend a mountain village (and one very determined rival), and bring a sleeping valley back to life, season by season.

games.name: Cult Crasher
games.summary: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

games.name: Planet No More
games.summary: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

games.name: Mik
games.summary: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Witch War I
games.summary: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelite. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

games.name: The Industrial Council
games.summary: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

games.name: The Comyths
games.summary: Stop, slow, and rewind time in a bullet-hell action game. The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven game where you wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover story logs.

games.name: Squid Hunt 1923
games.summary: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

games.name: Did You See That?
games.summary: A 2 player psychological horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

games.name: Abductables
games.summary: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

games.name: shatAAAAp!
games.summary: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

games.name: Unharvest
games.summary: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows and upgrade your plagues as the land slowly dies. How far can the decay reach?

games.name: Slickwave
games.summary: Slickwave is a dark-fantasy top-down action roguelite in which players shape a six-spell build while surviving 14 escalating waves inside the Moonlit Observatory. Spells branch at higher levels and can evolve when paired with the right relics, creating increasingly dense combinations against swarms, elite enemies, and bosses.

games.name: Desktop Drill
games.summary: Every keypress fires up your drill! Desktop Drill turns your typing into a mining adventure that lives on your desktop. Blast through blocks, unearth rare resources, and unlock new drill parts as you dig deeper with every key you press.

games.name: The Edutainment Vortex Diner
games.summary: It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner, in retro PC game style! Take classes from ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Unpack the mystery of this cosmic eatery and perhaps you'll inherit their burdens.

games.name: Tidy Town
games.summary: Tidy Town is a third-person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio, and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

games.name: The Glued
games.summary: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

games.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
games.summary: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.name: Guns of Eschaton
games.summary: The world’s first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

games.name: The Cardian: Light the Shrines
games.summary: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

games.name: Diorama Tactics
games.summary: Diorama Tactics is a strategic roguelite auto-battler inspired by fantasy board games. Players build a team of unique units, place them on a grid-based battlefield, and watch them fight automatically. Each unit has different strengths, roles, and abilities, while positioning and team composition determine the outcome of battles. Players progress through increasingly difficult encounters, collect new units, and face different enemy factions and powerful bosses.

games.name: Pond Thing
games.summary: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It mainly tells the story of the narcissistic youth Shen Qingheng who, after being drawn into a sacrificial ritual, gradually becomes numb and collapses mentally, only to be ultimately saved by his familys love.

games.name: Punch Through
games.summary: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

games.name: Tiny RTS
games.summary: Tiny RTS is a 2D Pixel Real time Strategy game revolving around multiple factions that all have different Playstyles

games.name: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
games.summary: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

games.name: Iwanu ga Hana
games.summary: Iwanu ga Hana is a school-life role-playing game spanning a school year and seventeen social bonds. At midnight, unspoken words become monsters, connecting daily relationships with supernatural encounters.

games.name: Aftermath: Bunker Trader
games.summary: A simulation game where a bunker becomes a bustling trading hub. Players trade and craft items - they organize them in storage. They scavenge the surface themselves and hire personnel to send on expeditions.

games.name: Adventures in tower defence land
games.summary: go on an epic tower defence adventure collecting rare parts and craft the ultimate combination of towers while meeting silly characters on your way

games.name: Ultracapitalism
games.summary:
Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where corporate greed is weaponized into deterministic combat.

Pick a founder, survive fiscal years of questionable business decisions, and assemble a 10-slot Board of Assets — unpaid interns, offshore tax havens, union busters, automated server racks, AI agents, and more. Then sit back and watch your corporate engine auto-battle rival corporations to the death.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is an upcoming puzzle-adventure game by Level-5. It is the eighth main game of the Professor Layton series, set one year after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future. The game is scheduled to be released on December 10, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Windows via Steam.
aliases: Professor Layton and New World of Steam

games.name: 4:AM
games.summary: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. In a near-future dystopia ruined by the Yellow, Aila must rely on observation and ingenuity to escape a world where light is lethal. Copy objects from the environment, adapt under pressure, and create your own way forward in this dark cinematic stealth adventure

games.name: Hakuoki Ibun: Berezinskii no Majo
games.summary: A new Hakuoki game for Nintendo Switch, set in 19th century Europe.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.name: Railway End
games.summary: This is a spot-the-difference game with a railway theme. By comparing photos, find the anomalies in the scene to guide the protagonist to the end of the railway. There is no text in the game.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Dice Mice
games.summary: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

games.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
games.summary: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.

games.name: Caladrius 2: Dark Element
games.summary: A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

games.name: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
games.summary:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

games.name: Find Kittens 13: Cave Town
games.summary: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

games.name: Dorifto!
games.summary: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive!

games.name: Just Until Morning
games.summary: Just Until Morning is a first-person horror game set during a single night shift at a 24-hour rural gas station. From 23:00 to 07:00 the player serves customers at the register, restocks shelves, takes out the trash, resets a faulty pump and watches four CCTV feeds that sometimes show people who are not there in person. There is no health bar: unanswered calls and ignored camera intrusions put the station's lamps out one by one, and a station left too dark ends the shift early. A full night takes about 80 minutes and can end in seven different ways.

games.name: That Mountain Needs to Fall
games.summary: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

games.name: Down to Floor Zero
games.summary: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor intact.

games.name: Dibaro: CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
games.summary: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

games.name: Parasite Core
games.summary: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

games.name: GreeDrill
games.summary: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

games.name: Ladder Knight
games.summary: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

games.name: Ruff Day
games.summary: Owners drop off their pups in the morning with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, walking, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$$!

games.name: MMOS: MMO Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. Design the world, classes, loot and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, form guilds and chase rare drops. Keep them happy, keep them subscribed, and decide what your MMO needs next.

games.name: Carpet Daddy
games.summary: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

games.name: Narnok: Little Bean Glandoid
games.summary: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

games.name: Talk Of The Tavern
games.summary: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.

games.name: Mystic Cleaver
games.summary: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive. The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action. Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

games.name: Fall off Reach
games.summary: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

games.name: Whispers From Below
games.summary: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

games.name: Sort Inc.
games.summary: Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.

games.name: Hunter From Hell
games.summary: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

games.name: Demon With a Candy Crisis
games.summary: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

games.name: Hexwell
games.summary: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where players fight hordes of arcane machines with auto-firing magic spells. Between floors, players choose their route through the dungeon and build an arsenal of spells and artifacts. Leveled spells can be fused into new combinations, and permanent Power Ups carry progress between runs. The game supports solo play and local co-op for up to four players on one screen.

games.name: Sakura no Uta: To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms
aliases: Sakura no Uta -To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms-
games.summary: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.summary: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

games.name: Sakurairo Prism: Beyond the Bloom
games.summary: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

games.name: Sunsoft is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
aliases: SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
games.summary: The "bad game" classic is back! Mysteries to unravel! The second installment in the “Retro Game Selection” series is here. Includes four classic titles ranging from major Sunsoft hits to hidden gems. New save and rewind features! Find rare never-before-seen game materials in Gallery Mode!

games.name: Tekkai Jousai no Haika
games.summary: Written by novelist Koji Dogu and illustrated by chibi, takes place 100 years after a fictional “great fire” which left a cluster of mysterious illegal structures now known as Tekkai Jousai (fortresses) burnt to crisps. Yuuma Kuze, an archeologist commissioned to investigate the place, discovers a girl named Haika among the ruins. Progressing through the story, you will have to uncover the mystery of the forest, investigate the “treasure for death” which Haika is looking for, and find out the truth about Haika herself.

games.name: Summer Pockets Sunnyside Stories
games.summary: A VN adaptation of 15 previously released short stories with the addition of one completely new episode.

games.name: Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.10
Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.9
DeckTerra
games.summary: A Medieval 4X Deckbuilder. Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent.

games.name: Gnom
games.summary: Build and defend a settlement with an increasing number of gnomes. Gnomes chop wood, build things, and fight. Some become giants. Some become nanognomes. There are 52 buildings and 900 tech tree perks. The gnomes have options.

games.name: Power Racing Bundle 4
games.summary: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

games.name: Wishknot
games.summary: You've fallen into an endless wishing well, with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum. Swing, snare and squash to survive in this difficult physics platformer with roguelite runs and secrets worth falling for.

games.name: Rest Stop
games.summary: "Rest Stop" is a short story by the American writer Stephen King, originally published in the December 2003 issue of Esquire and collected in King's 2008 collection Just After Sunset. In 2004, "Rest Stop" won the National Magazine Award for Fiction.

games.name: Infinitesimals
games.summary: Infinitesimals is a story-driven, 3rd person action adventure where you play as tiny aliens who stand only 1mm tall. Though a diminutive species, they are technologically advanced and space faring.

games.name: Port Valley
games.summary: Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click game where a certain choice changes everything. Witness 3 points of view of the same story and find out what's really going on during Port Valley's Election Day!

games.name: The Way of Wrath
games.summary: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

games.name: Last Moon
games.summary: Last Moon is an action RPG which embraces the vibes of classic titles from the 90s. Explore a mesmerising, vast, ruined world riddled with dangers, face tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities to regain peace. The Moon is falling. Will you bring harmony back to the world?

games.name: Rune Fencer Illyia
games.summary: Traverse a massive, ruined and beautiful world in this intense, atmospheric action platformer. Steal enemy abilities and fight them back with their own runic magic and deadly swordplay, as you attempt to find your lost twin sister in the sunken kingdom of Ithos.

games.name: The Lewd Knight
games.summary: Help the girl - a superhero in the fight against evil

games.name: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
games.summary: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

games.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
games.summary: Trade, traverse, and earn coins in this strategy merchant game set in a handcrafted world shaped by secrets and volatile markets. Join Viia, the fox merchant, as she defies the mighty Basilisk Company in the hunt for the truth behind the Golden Merchant.

games.name: Neverlooted Dungeon
games.summary: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

games.name: The Pope: Power & Sin
games.summary: Take on the role of the Pope, strengthen the authority of the Church State, fight for spiritual and political independence from pagans and the renewal of church structures. The rule of Pope is a torrent of numerous scandals, excesses and signs of moral corruption in the authorities of the Church.

games.name: RevenBlade
games.summary: RevenBlade is a 5v5 third-person hero shooter with a focus on melee combat, mechanical outplays, and mobility with lots of verticality.

games.name: The Cabbage Effect
games.summary: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

games.name: Skyclimbers
games.summary: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

games.name: Divided Land
games.summary: Join the fight for survival in a vast medieval open world. Explore, hunt, craft powerful gear, raid and plunder enemy villages, or forge your own path. As darkness falls, the dead awaken - prepare your defenses or seek shelter. Team up with allies in co-op PvE or face the wilderness alone.

games.name: Your World
games.summary: Your World is a VR open-world survival game with building and crafting. Explore a stylized world, gather resources, and create your own unique world. Survive in the wilderness, manage resources, and expand your domain. Can you turn chaos into a thriving world?

games.name: Heart of Muriet
games.summary: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

games.name: Treasure Islands
games.summary: Treasure Islands: Tax Havens and the Men who Stole the World (2011) is a non-fiction book about the secretive role of offshore banks and tax havens in global economic affairs. The book was written by Nicholas Shaxson, a political analyst and associate Fellow of the Royal Institute of International Affairs. It was first published on 6 January 2011. The publication is promoted by the Tax Justice Network.

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Pocket Wheels
games.summary: In Pocket Wheels, anything is possible! Well, almost anything. In this 3D precision platformer, jump through barrels, fly like a bird, and land... Well, hopefully not in the lava.

games.name: Gravity Blasters
games.summary: Gravity Blasters is a fast, fun and addictive multiplayer artillery action game that is recreating the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power.

games.name: Eternity Guards
games.summary: The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

games.name: Meteora
games.summary: Meteora jsou monastýry na vrcholcích slepencových skal v oblasti Thesálie v Řecku, poblíž města Kalambaka. První lidé osídlili skály v místě dnešní Meteory až v průběhu byzantského období. Mniši a poustevníci se tu začali usazovat až od 11. století, ale teprve o tři století později začaly vznikat první byzantské monastýry (správný český výraz pro klášter východní [tj. pravoslavné čili ortodoxní] a řeckokatolické církve).

games.name: Insect Worlds
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a sci-fi mystery adventure game featuring hand-drawn animations and narrative devices only possible in a video game format. Investigate a locked laboratory cut off from the rest of the world. Depending on what you find out, you may change the very nature of the game itself.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons. The adventure begins!

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Experience life as a house in this silly adventure game! Play as a building as you roll, jump, and wave-dash across a cozy island. Meet eligible structures, romance them, and experience a bizarre, yet oddly familiar story.. or go fishing instead (though we replaced fish with cars to make more sense)

games.name: HeartLinks: A Puzzle Called Love
games.summary: Solve puzzles with the power of friendship! Each student you befriend gives you a unique item that lets you unlock new areas and explore a wacky anime school! To deliver a confession to your crush, can you clear every obstacle? Can you overcome your feelings? Can you solve the puzzle called love?
aliases: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

games.name: Synthalgia: Retro Arcade Racing
games.summary: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

games.name: Mad Chess
games.summary: Mad Chess is a turn-based strategy game that vastly expands on the classic game of chess. Explore a colorful fantasy world, recruit up to 20 unique factions, fight-off an alien invasion in a single-player story mode or battle your friends online!

games.name: Yuha's Nightmares
games.summary: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

games.name: Midnight Laundry
games.summary: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

games.name: Jury Trial
games.summary: Start your legal career in a law simulation RPG set in a divided and often unjust fictional country. Create your own attorney, study case files, uncover evidence, shape the jury, and fight for the verdict in court. Play the campaign or create, share, and download cases with the in-game Case Editor.

games.name: Explory Story
games.summary: Run around on the surface of many different stories. You can interact with the text, and the text can interact with you! There are boss battles, collectibles, a song, puzzles, and much more!

games.name: Check x Mate
games.summary: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

games.name: Super/Human Identity
games.summary: An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid where your choices affect both your own fate and the fates of your companions. Dynamic relationship system, LGBTQIA+ inclusive romances, and Quick Time Event superhero action.

games.name: The Mysterious Cat Tower
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

games.name: Rules of Alchemy
games.summary: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

games.name: Wandering Wolf
games.summary: Survival-Action experience in a dead world destroyed by civil war. You have to complete your own story, fighting for survival with monsters and nature.
aliases: S T R I B O G

games.name: Determinant
games.summary: Realistic physics-based open-world survival game set in the future. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. Hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. Combat is possible, but more defensive in nature.

games.name: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
games.summary: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

games.name: Island of Winds
games.summary: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

games.name: Potata: Foxy Tale
games.summary: Potata: Foxy Tale is a fairy tale themed platformer adventure game in a beautiful world of dark forests. Your goal is to restore the balance and assemble the fragments of the Woodland Spirit.

games.name: Fragile Existence
games.summary: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.

games.name: The Inspector
games.summary: Explore the mind of your loved one trapped in a coma and recover her memories across shifting moments in time to bring her back.

games.name: Townseek
games.summary:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

games.name: Crystals of Irm
games.summary: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

games.name: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
games.summary: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen who desires a girlfriend by year's end. Is there hope in his future or endless despair?

games.name: Recursor
games.summary: An action rogue-lite inspired by platform fighters

games.name: Showa American Story
games.summary: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

games.name: Killbot General
games.summary: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

games.name: Mars Tactics
games.summary: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

games.name: Ardenfall
