games.summary: Ardenfall is an immersive RPG set in a world of intricate politics and ancient cultures. Explore flowing plains, rain drenched wetlands, and forgotten dungeons full of danger. Meet countless interesting characters with unique dialog and quests, and leave your mark on this mysterious world.

games.name: Dagada's Story
games.summary: A 16 bit inspired adventure awaits! Explore a mysterious mountain with Dagada and Naou and solve the puzzles of ancient ruins to help Dagada find his way home. But a dangerous climate threatens the mountain. Can they restore its lost harmony?

games.name: Droid Escape
games.summary: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

games.name: Candela
games.summary: Candela (Pugliese: Cannéla) is a town and comune in the province of Foggia in the Apulia region of southeast Italy. It sits on 2 hills: San Rocco and San Tommaso.

games.name: Christine
games.summary: Christine is feminine given name of Greek origin. It is a name in regular usage in French, English, German, Scandinavian, Dutch, Irish, and Scottish cultures, and it is often associated with the meaning "Follower of Christ." Variants include: Christina, Kristin, Kristina, Kristine, Kristen, Kirsten, Khrystyna (Ukraine), Krystyna (Poland), Kristiina (Estonia & Finland), and Cristina (Italy, Spain, Portugal, Central & South America). In Estonia and Finland, the cognate is Kristiina. It is a popular name; for example, in 1968, it was the 14th most frequently-given name for girls in the United States.

games.name: Abyss Delvers
games.summary: Abyss Delvers is an Online Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

games.name: The Bornless
games.summary: Welcome to The Bornless, an action horror FPS. Face off against other players, summon demons, and build factions in a Lovecraftian world. Use Black Magick, acquire powerful weapons, upgrade your Safehouse, and strategize to survive.

games.name: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter
games.summary: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

games.name: Mirai #167
games.summary: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity as AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

games.name: Critias Empire
games.summary: Turn-Based 4X-like Strategy: Build the peaceful kingdom of Atlantis into a flourishing civilization. Plan carefully or be ready to adapt as the ancient Gods of Olympus rain down floods, earthquakes, volcanoes and all types of disaster.

games.name: Hero Chest
games.summary: In a role reversal in Hero Chest, take control of a chest tired of being looted and frighten the heroes back to their guilds! Create your way with the cards, ally with the monsters, save the chests and earn gold Have fun with the perfect combination of Roguelike, Dungeon Crawler and Card Game!

games.name: Astrolander
games.summary: Astrolander is a revolutionary action-packed reimagining of platformers. Embark on a thrilling adventure featuring innovative 2.5D fused with 3D environments and gameplay, unique mechanics, and breathtaking worlds. Take control of a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on a quest to save the Most Valuable Programs (MVPs)!

games.name: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
games.summary: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.
aliases: Mira: The Legend of the Djinns

games.name: Multi Idle
games.summary: An idle RPG featuring a large focus on the customization of your play style to make every run unique. Create unbreakable skill combinations and advance your fighter to the point that even boss monsters will fear their strength!

games.name: Cursed Dungeon Raider
games.summary: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

games.name: Death Ring
games.summary: This is a fun casual shooting game where players will need to control the Pea Shooter to fire from an appropriate angle and defeat enemies from all directions. Some of them have exceptional combat power, while others have very fast movement and attack speeds.

games.name: Echoes of the Stars
games.summary: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

games.name: The Walker
games.summary: The Walker is a single-player survival horror game. Find out the truth behind what is happening while surviving the zombies. Feel the tension and fight your fear because they await you!

games.name: Tales of the Death
games.summary: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

games.name: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
games.summary: D.A.D. is a dungeon crawling game were alchemy skills play crucial role. Young witch ominous plans were destroyed when she was put in a jail. But she founds ancient laboratory full of secrets and new shining perspectives behind the broken wall.

games.name: Abyss Fantasia
games.summary: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

games.name: Summer Road
games.summary: Summer Road is a new RPG based on the concept of playing RPGs more casually. It targets people who are tired of AAA RPGs and want to play in a short time, and want to immerse themselves in nostalgia.

games.name: Magnetic Bonds
games.summary: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

games.name: Almost My Floor: Duality
games.summary: The killer elevator took you to endless floors - what do you do? Almost My Floor: Duality - horror stealth action with a variable story about monsters inside you. What's going on? A parallel world, a curse, psychiatric experiments, or you are crazy?

games.name: Paws and Leaves: A Last Tale
games.summary: Life flashes before your eyes when you die. Help Me Fox by finding his memories beyond life and experiencing a touching, cute, and scary tale.
aliases: Paws and Leaves: A Thracian Tale

games.name: Dimakerus
games.summary: Dimakerus is a social deduction combat game for up to 4 players. Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in procedural catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

games.name: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
games.summary: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

games.name: Glaciered
games.summary: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

games.name: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
games.summary: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

games.name: Bloody Hell Hotel
games.summary: Renovate, upgrade and expand your hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

games.name: 34Everlast
games.summary: "How many times do I have to end the world before I can see you again?" This is a super-concentrated action entertainment for busy working adults, in which one game loop can be as short as 10 minutes and your discoveries and actions unravel a complex and intertwined world.

games.name: Kvlt
games.summary: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

games.name: Wonderland Quest
games.summary: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

games.name: Farm Renovator
games.summary: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

games.name: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
games.summary: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

games.name: Snowtracked
games.summary: Feel like a kid again. The door is open to a beautiful winter landscape. Wrestle your way over rocks covered in thick snow. Build anything you want, stick by stick. Play solo or with your friends (1-4).

games.name: Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder
games.summary: Lead the Horde and siege human castles! Build your orc war machine, harvest resources from the rubble, and upgrade your warriors. Smash walls, conquer fortresses, and fuel your rampage in this action-packed incremental game with an orcish soul.

games.name: Daomei Village
games.summary: You have been banished to Daomei Village for your offense. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

games.name: Feudums
games.summary: Lead your noble house through brutal wars, shifting allegiances and economic strife in an asynchronous multiplayer 4X strategy. Shape the narrative with or against real players in a medieval world where diplomacy isn't binding, there is NO pay-to-win, and only strategy determines your legacy.

games.name: Furcifer's Fungeon
games.summary: An autoscrolling roguelike where everything you do impacts your talent options. Become a necromancer goose, or a berserker wielding a thunder blade! Collect legendary items in each run, and bring them back home for even more build options in the future.

games.name: Kaiju Catastrophe
games.summary: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

games.name: Bunker Builder Simulator
games.summary: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

games.name: ChaseTag
games.summary: Come participate at ChaseTag ! A tag competition where athletes are candy ! Face your friends in intense Player-versus-Player matches, that will make you sweat !

games.name: Littlelands
games.summary: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.name: RunMan Turbo
games.summary: The Indie Legend Returns: Bounce, slide, and run fast as heck through high speed levels in five unique zones. Each time you run a level it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts to beat record times, earn medals, unlock secrets, and be the world's fastest! Wishlist Now!

games.name: Astromeda
games.summary: Astromeda is a story-driven RPG about a human returning to an Earth ruled by intelligent bacteria. Explore a mysterious world, meet strange and expressive characters, and fight through battles that blend turn-based combat with real-time action as you uncover the truth behind humanity's return.

games.name: Nowhere Manor
games.summary: House of stolen devil bargains and indolent angelic aristocracy: Nowhere Manor is doomed to disappear. You can leave if you’ve got a soul … but that’s not an option for an artificially created servant such as Liber. Just how far are you willing to go escape?

games.name: Red Rebellion
games.summary: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

games.name: Total World Liberation
games.summary: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

games.name: Hyper Drill
games.summary: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at hyper speed. Drill through any obstacle, master your timing, learn level layouts, and jump between different galaxies.

games.name: Twin Jet Racer
games.summary: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

games.name: Murder on the Stella
games.summary: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

games.name: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
games.summary: A 2D platform game about the ancient stories of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, who live in the Brazilian Amazon. The entire game was produced in collaboration with the Huni Kuin communities of the Jordão river, in Acre.

games.name: Anomalistic Revolution
games.summary: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

games.name: In Stone
games.summary: A sculptor is confined in a monastery asylum.

games.name: Loot List
games.summary: Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though — here, every heist has to have a list.

games.name: Tsurugihime
games.summary: 『TSURUGIHIME』is a side-scrolling action RPG. The last battle is in 100 days. It is up to the player to decide how to live until the day. Battle, ikusei, exploration, story, and even "Imouto (sister)". "Craft" everything. An RPG that "crafts" fate.

games.name: Vocaless
games.summary: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

games.name: Nuclear Sub
games.summary: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

games.name: Xanniban
games.summary: Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.summary: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: Life After End
games.summary: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

games.name: Space Scavenger 2
games.summary: A fast-paced, top-down action roguelite about building outlandish modular spaceships and discovering broken synergies. Scavenge resources, craft absurd builds, and hone your abilities in a paradoxical time loop.

games.name: Captain Disaster and the Two Worlds of Riskara
games.summary: A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Wishlist this game. It is your destiny...

games.name: Timeless Heart VR
games.summary: Timeless heart VR is an action VR roguelike game, As the second work of Timeless Stories series, this work further simplifies and enriches the unique sword skill system of the series. Advancing in the unknown labyrinth with Lycanea, and break through this blockade from fate!

games.name: Unwound
games.summary: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: Zwaard
games.summary: Explore a post-apocalyptic world overrun by dangerous technologies and whatever is left of humanity. Scavenge for parts to upgrade your modular sword and uncover why you are here.

games.name: Quadremor
games.summary: A first-person shooter where you play as one of the last human mercenaries, driven by vengeance for the annihilation of humanity. Dive deep into a dark and unforgiving realm fueled by cruelty.

games.name: Rina to Akumu no Kan
games.summary: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

games.name: Valley of the Old Masters
games.summary: You are an inspiration-seeking wandering artist who mysteriously ends up in a faraway Valley. Will you find the inspiration you crave, or will you be lost to the mysteries of the Valley?

games.name: KaiJu Girls
games.summary: Kaiju Girls is a role-playing game filled with Monster Girls. The protagonist, who has lost their memory, becomes a KaijuTamer after an unexpected event.

games.name: Four Hundred Catapults
games.summary: A large-scale survival strategy game with up to 3000 units on the battlefield. Build and manage your settlement, produce resources, research weapons and technologies, and recruit your army to survive in the war against the Half Dead Legions.

games.name: Tails of Fate
games.summary: Fulfill this tale, as darkness swarms the fantasy lands of Fauna. Venture epic kingdoms and treacherous dungeons in a 2D action-RPG, with Metroidvania elements in a hand-crafted pixel art world filled with souls-like boss fights, dungeon platforming, and dynamic enemy combat design.

games.name: HexLands
games.summary: Forge an island kingdom one card at a time. Each card you play raises a farm, mill, or harbor on procedural hex islands. Crack the challenge each new shore gives you before setting sail, carrying your relics and upgrades onward. No combat. The land, the weather, and your own draw are the challenge.

games.name: Moki: The Escape
games.summary: Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: the own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a occasionally emotional story.

games.name: 99 Fails
games.summary: 99 Fails is an impossibly difficult roguelite platformer featuring 3 mechanics in Zeebo's surreal nightmare with bizarre monsters & music by legendary David Wise!

games.name: Bloody Horror Plant
games.summary: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

games.name: Goblin's Journey
games.summary: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

games.name: Legends of Castile
games.summary: Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It follows a village girl who must investigate the region’s folk legends to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

games.name: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
games.summary: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all the colors of dread.

games.name: Laws of Nadragia
games.summary: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

games.name: Cosmic Holidays
games.summary: In an unknown world, help Cibo reach his vacation resort. Through a stunningly rich fauna and flora, Cibo can glide, bounce, propel himself, get stuck, absorb shocks, or roll all simply by inflating his head. Tame this unfamiliar nature and turn it into your ally

games.name: Starship Colony
games.summary: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

games.name: Back to the Collis
games.summary: Back To The Collis is a story-rich, fully hand-drawn 2D Point & Click adventure puzzle. Embark on a journey alongside the main character, Benjamin, to solve lots of engaging puzzles and explore the town of Collis, outstanding by its memorable populace.

games.name: Snap Quest
games.summary: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

games.name: VICCP 2 Core
games.summary: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

games.name: 3 Last Chances
games.summary: 3 Last Chances is an Action RPG game with challenging combat and progression system that allows to create your own unique playstyle. You get 3 chances to replay a year, complete quests and find just the right method of weakening and overcoming the seemingly unbeatable final boss.

games.name: Corr
games.summary: Corr is a difficult Souls-lite Boss Rush Action RPG where you Run-n-Gun & Hack-n-Slash your way through challenging boss encounters. To endure the strange, dark and whacky world of Corr, level up and customize your warrior build with berserk powers, tonics, talismans and more.

games.name: 5 Star Fishy
games.summary: Rampage, explore, bite, talk, and swim to the bottom of this aquatic metroidvania! Tear down creatures and machines alike as you traverse a mysterious underwater trench.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary: Experience the journey of Bogdan, a shepherd turned legendary Templar knight, in Bogdan's Cross. Traverse stunning landscapes, battle fierce foes, and uncover the hidden tale that shapes the destiny of the Templar Order. Become the hero of your own legend in this action-packed adventure!

games.name: Rich Dad Simulator
games.summary: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

games.name: Alien Boom Boom
games.summary: In Alien Boom Boom you will send your enemies flying utilizing a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades. The game features a fully voiced story campaign, several distinct levels, several enemies, bosses and frequent player/weapon upgrades that are customizable at the start of each level.

games.name: Danger is Near
games.summary: Dive into a captivating atmosphere with 'Danger is Near,' a session-based hardcore multiplayer first-person shooter that combines various genres including survival, weapon and combat simulation, RPG, and MMO.

games.name: Elder's Grace: Rise of the Mobley
games.summary:
Join this epic battle to take back a magical homeland. Help Mobley heroes explore, build, raid and defend in an effort to regain & hold what's rightfully theirs.

Build and protect customized strongholds while creating specialized teams to explore and plunder others.

games.name: VISK
games.summary: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

games.name: Enlightened
games.summary: Enlightened is a survival horror game with strong focus on puzzle solving. Explore the hotel in which you woke up, find clues about what happened, solve puzzles and find a way out, while surviving horrors that awaits you there.

games.name: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
games.summary: Wild animals are disappearing, the mysterious Temple of the Order is on the rise, and shadow voids are suddenly populating the land. Gather six heroes and their Octopus companions and work together to save a world consumed by the secrets of its past.

games.name: Spaceman Memories
games.summary: Spaceman Memories is a retro JRPG that takes place in a distant future but draws inspiration from ancient Japanese folktales. A story full of wonder and nostalgia as you take on the role of Ichiro 94, an astronaut who wakes up from hypersleep to go on a journey to find the remnants of his past.

games.name: Haruka: Beyond the Stars
games.summary: HARUKA: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

games.name: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Margh, an undead private detective, in this hilarious and bizarre adventure that combines classic point-and-click gameplay with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what’s left of it) to solve strange and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

games.name: April '86
games.summary: April ’86 is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror about returning to Pripyat, where the past never truly died. Explore the abandoned city, uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of children, and confront what was hidden behind the Chernobyl disaster.

games.name: Telluria
games.summary: Telluria is a genus of Gram-negative soil bacteria.

games.name: Ebola 4
games.summary: You open your eyes, it's dark all around. Are you in an underground bunker, alone with your thoughts... or are you not alone there? Fear, apocalypse, darkness swallowed the world, most people are infected. You are at the epicenter... And can you change something?

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Surviving Deponia
games.summary: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!
aliases: 德波尼亚求生 - Surviving Deponia

games.name: Dread Pilots
games.summary: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

games.name: Mearcair/System Pulse
games.summary: A psychological action JRPG about control and collapse. Play as one of the ACP’s experimental supersoldiers and battle the Afflicted, humans warped by supernatural phenomena. Uncover the truth and question what remains of your humanity.

games.name: Overhours
games.summary: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!

games.name: Specters of the Sun
games.summary: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

games.name: Death the Guitar
games.summary: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".
developers: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

games.name: Exodus: Sunflower on the Horizon
games.summary: An original sci-fi RPG like you've never experienced before...

games.name: Rebirth of Arcadia
games.summary: Rebirth of Arcadia is a story-rich turn-based tactics JRPG. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, and harness the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

games.name: The One Who Stands Behind
games.summary: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

games.name: Dreadwinter
games.summary: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

games.name: Little Monster
games.summary: "Little Monster" is a song by the English hard rock duo Royal Blood. Written by both members, it was released as their second single on 10 February 2014. It marked the band's first release under Warner Bros. Records after signing with the label in 2013. The song later appeared on the band's debut extended play Out of the Black, and on their first full-length album Royal Blood.

games.name: AI Kills All Humans
games.summary: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

games.name: Cyber Paradise
games.summary: Revive Mini-the-dog digitally in an atmospheric, neon-drenched cyberpunk world of roguelite action and cafe stories. (Pls dont change my tags🥺🙏)

games.name: System Purge: Hollow Point
games.summary: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a massive expansion which adds a surreal new campaign, challenging new gamemodes, and more.

games.name: Save My Human
games.summary: This is the story about a little girl who is taken to an evil world inside a video game, and her dog embarks on an adventure to save her. The dog will not be alone, he will encounter other pets who are also searching for their owners.

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

games.name: LightSup!
games.summary: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

games.name: Lazy Jiangshi
games.summary: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

games.name: Black Box LSS: The Merciful Savior
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art AVG that blends love, crime, and romantic comedy. A story of a young man forges connections with his online friend, and gradually falls in love. If you're a fan of love story, yandere, and don't mind a touch of thrill and crime, you will greatly enjoy this game.

games.name: Doubumon
games.summary: Doubumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Doubumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Doubumon champion.

games.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Re-Mustard!
games.summary: The million-selling cooking sim is BACK in this all new re-imagining of a classic! An all new campaign, expanded music, new foods and art, and new gameplay modes round out a celebration of the ten year anniversary of this massive series.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: Soul Devourer
games.summary: Parry, Slash and Survive! Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a striking anime horror art style. Explore the cursed Sakuradoki High School, master powerful abilities, battle twisted monsters, and uncover the long-buried dark secrets hidden beneath the school.

games.name: Water Me & You
games.summary: A cozy co-op adventure in which you play as a water or seed-like character, changing states and rebuilding a world left behind by humans.

games.name: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
games.summary: On a small, snowy skerry somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, where he is or why he is there. A point-and-click mystery where atmosphere and unusual puzzles are at the heart of the game.

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary: Meet high schooler Haruka and her classmates as they find themselves trapped in an eerie, abandoned hospital connected to an urban legend called “Ayame’s Mercy.” Try to escape, or face a multitude of gruesome ends that will leave you begging for mercy in this all new Corpse Party story.

games.name: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
games.summary: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

games.name: Psychotic Bathtub
games.summary: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

games.name: Ardent Passions
games.summary: Ardent Passions is an adult visual novel where Heroman uncovers his girlfriend and her friends' vigilante secrets on a camping trip. With the fate of these relationships at stake, the game unfolds through decisions that determine if these vigilantes become allies or enemies.

games.name: To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora
games.summary: Delve into the captivating realm of Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy RPG game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable.

games.name: Escape from the Collector
games.summary: In "Escape from the Collector", you will be trapped in an old house full of puzzles and secrets. Explore its rooms searching clues that will guide your adventure. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to freedom or dooms you to be trapped in the Collector's sinister game. Will you be able to escape?

games.name: Conquest of Eldinar
games.summary: Conquest of Eldinar is a Action Combat / Real Time Strategy hybrid game where you choose from one of 16 different Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in large scale battles. The game supports both single-player campaigns and online multi-player matches.

games.name: Janet DeMornay is a Slumlord (and a witch)
games.summary: RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

games.name: Summer Sprint
games.summary: Ride your bike across beautiful landscapes. Overcome obstacles. Help Lisa catch up with the thief.

games.name: Small Kingdoms
games.summary: Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with procedurally generated campaigns. Build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals.

games.name: DollHouse: Survive or Death
games.summary: "for that child's future." "I must ...... I must to do this. The eight children who came to the mansion were waiting for a series of horrible dreams... A series of horrible nightmares... Who did this? and for what? And who did this for whom...? Only by entering the DollHouse can we find out.

games.name: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets dark fantasy: Choose one of seven unique classes, explore the vast nether, and fight for salvation - solo, in co-op, or PvP!

games.name: On a Summer Night
games.summary: "Today, I would like to tell you about one night. One night that changed my life." On a Summer Night is a short point-and-click visual novel.

games.name: Alpine Lake
games.summary: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

games.name: Ascent Quest
games.summary: Enter the world of Aelys in this incredible online RPG made for virtual reality ! Meet hundreds of players, form your party of adventurers (or go solo) and fulfill your destiny in this high-fantasy story-driven universe … or hang out laughing in the local tavern with your friends!

games.name: Archetype Blue
games.summary: Meet more than 60 companions, laugh and fight alongside them, and become entwined in each other’s stories. Who will stay in your heart? Combine your companions’ strengths and cards to build a party of your own and continue your expedition.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: A Master murdered. A dying wish: "Kill La." Nine suspects. One killer. All named 「La」. Valhalla hunts the truth by diving into their memories — in a world beautiful and cruel as a doll. Which 「La」 pulled the strings?

games.name: Fishing Echoes
games.summary: Fishing Echoes is a fantasy fishing game where you catch elemental fish to save the realm from a world-devouring maelstrom.

games.name: Ghost Vanguard
games.summary: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness and reclaim a hero's stolen soul.

games.name: Mayhem Brawler II: Best of Both Worlds
games.summary: A perfect fuse of '90s arcade vibe and modern rogue-lite / RPG mechanics in a time transition-themed beat 'em up. Play solo or online with friends and shape the story through your choices. Be amazed by the hand-drawn comics-inspired art, frame-by-frame animated characters, and kick-ass soundtracks.

games.name: Paver Simulator
games.summary: Design and craft stunning pavements with precision and style. Choose from various materials, earn money, and build your reputation as a master paver. Are you ready to pave your way to the top? Test your creativity skills and create a masterpiece in Paver Simulator!

games.name: Angry Mother Earth
games.summary: Angry Mother Earth offers a one-of-a-kind strategy experience within an fully simulated world. Wield and merge a variety of abilities to release cataclysmic forces—ranging from hurricanes and earthquakes to blizzards—upon the world of humans. But be warned: humanity won't go down without a fight!

games.name: Hollow Home
games.summary: Hollow Home is a narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. Learn to adapt, choose who to trust and make decisions that carry real weight. No weapons, no battles and no easy answers.

games.name: Swordeye
games.summary: A hardcore MMO slasher with brutal directional combat. Explore massive, persistent PvPvE dungeons where every fight matters. Fight your way to the top, or die trying.

games.name: Kosmocean: The Endless Sea
games.summary: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

games.name: Infernae
games.summary: Where you walk, death follows. Duel those who resist in challenging, adrenaline-filled boss battles. In this hack-n-slash bullet hell, don't run from bullets — weaponize them. Fear is no shield.

games.name: The Journey Home
games.summary: A VR interactive story about family, dreams, and the meaning of life. You will be an astronaut who failed the mission, gets stuck in space and haunted by past memories.

games.name: Folder Dungeon
games.summary: Dungeon crawler roguelike inside computer folder!

games.name: Fantastic Haven
games.summary: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

games.name: The Lab Thing
games.summary: The lab thing is a first-person phycological horror game. Explore the mysterious life of an architect through a series of his nightmares. Gather all the mind notes, upgrade backpack items, solve puzzles and try to go deeper and deeper in the psyche of the lab thing!

games.name: Kardashev
games.summary: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

games.name: 500 Caliber Contractz
games.summary: A 3D-Platformer where you play as a contract killer and your eyes glaze over.

games.name: Tower of Tears
games.summary: A 3D Survival-Horror Metroidvania in a vast, interconnected tower ruled by cryptic systems, strange residents and esoteric mysteries...

games.name: Rogue Mech
games.summary: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

games.name: FrostFire: Battle Frenzy
games.summary: This is FrostFire -Battle Frenzy-, a 2D anime fighting game perfect for new and experienced players of the genre.

games.name: Exploration: Light
games.summary: Experience large space ship battles. Uncover the secrets of the mysterious alien race. Upgrade your ship or even start a fleet. Survive

games.name: Codename Incubus
games.summary: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

games.name: Power Line Rider
games.summary: It's time to ride! Dodge colorful animals and Defeat Bosses to conquer the Power Lines in this Retro Arcade game with a short Story Mode. Complete the Story to unlock Endless Mode and explore the infinite "NegaZone". You'll enjoy simple controls, classic 8-bit visuals, and an energetic soundtrack!

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Hexrite
games.summary: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

games.name: Dead Meat
games.summary: Lucia's just killed her husband... probably. Can you get a confession before her lawyers arrive? Use your own words to manipulate, persuade, threaten, or even seduce her into 'fessing up. This billionaire has a terrible secret. And time is running out.

games.name: Blood & Chaos
games.summary: Ancient sacrifices saved the world, but their legacy is unraveling. A party based roguelike inspired by classic '80s RPGs, where every descent into cursed dungeons carries permanent consequences.

games.name: Music Power Up
games.summary: As a musician in the 1980s, create music for early video games. Make your own sounds and melodies from scratch, or use pre-composed patterns. Play games, upgrade the music app, meet programmers, editors and musicians, find your next music job, in the crazy decade that started the digital revolution.

games.name: Owlet's Embrace
games.summary:
An owlet afraid of flight sets off to explore a vibrant mysterious world and rediscover itself. On this heartwarming adventure, you'll confront the owlet's deepest fears as only the greatest challenges can lead to the most profound growth.

Owlet's Embrace is an action exploration platformer, blending fast paced grappling hook manouvers with combat and emotional discovery.

games.name: Sligga Trigger
games.summary: Suit up and sling some shells at sadistic, superpowered sci-fi slugs. Snag some secrets, suffer some shrapnel, and shoot the shit out of some Sliggas in this one-of-a-kind twin-stick shooter.

games.name: Cavern
games.summary: Experiment, Explore, and Swap in Cavern, a roguelike sandbox. All objects in the world can be swapped out at will. Swap slimes into harmless pots, turn enemy projectiles into countless health potions, and discover hidden interactions to conquer the ever-changing depths of Mirror Cavern.

games.name: The Bugs Manor
games.summary: The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment. Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

games.name: Fat Goblins
games.summary: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

games.name: Five Day Detective
games.summary: Five Day Detective is a point and click style adventure game featuring multiple murder cases and a twisted sense of humour.

games.name: Isolation One
games.summary: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

games.name: Soul Blade
games.summary: "Soul Blade" is a 2D platform action game with classic hand-drawn 2D animations that provide a smooth and immersive visual experience. The combat system is built around the "swordplay" mechanism, delivering intense and exhilarating battles.

games.name: Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder
games.summary: EXCALIMURDER is a nonlinear murder mystery game inspired by the sword in the stone legend. Explore an orphanage, meet weird people and solve logic puzzles, all in a colorful pixel art world. Bonus: Excalibur is the murder weapon.

games.name: Bendy: The Cage
games.summary:
Test your sanity as you take control of Henry in this third person horror experience taking place during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival.

Condemned to the Keeper prison known as "The Pit", Henry must survive the horrific inmates and mangled experiments set loose to devour him. A labyrinth of steel industrial dread lay before him as his mind is invaded by the past.

Discover the hidden blood-stained truth behind the monsters as you explore the dark levels of The Pit, slowly making your way to the very top of the facility.

Take on the darkness with your axe in brutal melee combat: Unleash fast and heavy strikes, block and parry incoming attacks, shove foes away, stomp on enemies with a vengeance, and time dodges to avoid being torn apart by the things that hunt you. Dive into the shadows for limited supplies as you embark on a twisted tale of Henry's self discovery while facing down new and familiar creatures of the ink.

Find the maestro. Escape the prison. Fight the madness.

games.name: Rewind And Reclaim
games.summary: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

games.name: The Lumenites
games.summary: Build a cozy village on your flying turtle. Land on floating islands, recycle, upgrade your village, repeat! There's no combat, or wrong answers - just explore and go from chaos to control as you shape your perfect paradise.

games.name: The Hydra Experiment
games.summary: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

games.name: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room
games.summary: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room is a community run experimental story game. With the end of the world fast approaching, Dr. Gumphrey Finklestein announces his plans for a groundbreaking scientific experiment. What will it entail? Does even he know?
aliases: La Maravillosa Habitación Del Dr. Finklestein

games.name: Dungeons Deep
games.summary: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the plagued lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

games.name: England in London
games.summary: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

games.name: DDS x Narcos
games.summary: This is a spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, and you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. In this story-driven simulator about the life of crime, you will run your business in Mexico and the US.

games.name: Rise & Reign
games.summary: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, it's up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or form alliances. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

games.name: Northanda Chronicles
games.summary: Master role-based deckbuilding in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build a party around the RPG holy trinity from countless hero combinations, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

games.name: Digested
games.summary: Strapped to a bodycam, you must escape a giant snake across isolated environments. Use various power‑ups to formulate an escape strategy, rely on the map and compass to locate your extraction pod, and don't get digested.

games.name: Ink of Fate
games.summary: Helena is trapped in her own story—and her author is trying to erase her. Solve puzzles, recover lost pages, and change the ending written for her in a world of living books, where ink is your weapon against fate.

games.name: Greed Realm
games.summary: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.
aliases: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree

games.name: The Milgram Experiment
games.summary: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

games.name: Kitty Cat Combat
games.summary: A unique tactical military simulation RPG that fuses fantasy with modern warfare. Unite under the pawprint banner!
aliases: ミュゼットとネコ耳の歩兵隊 ～にくきゅうの旗のもとに～

games.name: Meat-Grinder
games.summary: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

games.name: Growth
games.summary: Journey to a place where even DEATH doesn’t stop your GROWTH…

games.name: Trade Tales
games.summary: Trade Tales is a cozy rags-to-riches life sim about building your dream business in a living fantasy town. Start with nothing as you forage, farm, craft, trade, and run your own shops, deciding what to sell while forming friendships, finding love, and helping your town flourish with your choices.

games.name: Moonshire
games.summary: Embark on a journey to save MOONSHIRE as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

games.name: L.OD
games.summary:
A 2D exploration adventure.
The main character, Yoi, receives a letter from his dead sister, Chitose, saying that she wants to tell him a secret.
In order to find out the truth, Yoyi heads to an abandoned laboratory.

games.name: Wildsite
games.summary: Crash-land on a sci-fi planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic AI companion, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons in this survival-craft adventure solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

games.name: Match Tree
games.summary: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

games.name: GameChanger: Episode 1
games.summary: Take on the challenge to close the four Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with shoot 'em up elements! Explore the open Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through the hordes of counter viruses and stop the dragon!

games.name: 100 Cats Greece
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all?

games.name: Enginefall
games.summary: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

games.name: Knights of Fresco
games.summary: Raise your own band of Knights and fight beasts from medieval paintings. Knights of Fresco is an open world party building RPG with auto-battling combat that tries to emulate medieval depictions of battles and wars.

games.name: Hellfire Poncho
games.summary: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck...

games.name: 100 Cats Argentina
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: 100 Cats Pakistan
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: Algolemeth
games.summary: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

games.name: Backrooms Game No. 999999
games.summary: Backrooms #999999999 is a singleplayer/4 player co-op horror exploration game. Unlock the puzzles, survive the entities, escape the deadly geometry and try to reach the final level in one piece. Good luck, wanderer!

games.name: Sunkissed City
games.summary: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Junklands is a 3D action-platformer that thrusts Rahr, a brave paper fledgling, into a polluted world ruled by its toxic overlords. Forced from home, Rahr must navigate smog-filled lands and sludge-choked rivers on a perilous quest to cleanse the Junklands and restore life.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.summary: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

games.name: Decurion
games.summary: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

games.name: Neon Auto Party
games.summary: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its deck of cards that determines its performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

games.name: Lost Hellden
games.summary: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

games.name: DI: Debt is Inevitable
games.summary: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

games.name: Wiblu
games.summary: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

games.name: Red Snow
games.summary: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

games.name: Ascent: Rivals
games.summary: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

games.name: Suspended Animation
games.summary: Suspended animation is the slowing or stopping of biological function so that physiological capabilities are preserved. States of suspended animation are common in micro-organisms and some plant tissue, such as seeds. Many animals, including large ones, may undergo hibernation, and most plants have periods of dormancy. This article focuses primarily on the potential of large animals, especially humans, to undergo suspended animation. In animals, suspended animation may be either hypometabolic or ametabolic in nature. It may be induced by either endogenous, natural or artificial biological, chemical or physical means.

games.name: Skyblivion
games.summary:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

games.name: Akaku Forest
games.summary: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

games.name: Nerd: Tracing Dayline
games.summary: A communication-themed adventure game starring a self-conscious teenage girl. Set in the quiet after-school hours of an ordinary high school, you’ll collect “topics” and use them to deepen your conversations.

games.name: Entwine
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest lay the death of Man, and inside, a tortured mind. Explore disturbingly real environments and solve intricate puzzles in a hand-crafted nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil”.

games.name: Stratagem Lost
games.summary: Brave perilous turn-based strategy encounters and uncover dark conspiracies in a broken world. Draft your team of unique characters and have them learn skills from each other. Welcome to hard times—can you recover what's been lost?

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Ten Ten
games.summary: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

games.name: Killer Chat: Extended Edition
games.summary: Killer Chat is a dark satire romance chatsim where you date serial killers. Pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love, and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. Who knows? You might find your happily ever after... or headline the news as a gruesomely lovesick corpse. It's honestly up to you.

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Master time control with Looppip in a challenging platformer puzzle game! Rewind 3 seconds into the past to overcome traps, save beehives, and restore the balance of nature.

games.name: Problem Solver Club
games.summary: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

games.name: Alex's Journey to the Grave
games.summary: Two people meet in a strange, critical moment; changing their lives forever. An intimate visual novel exploring the nature of love, fate, tragedy, and the will to live on.

games.name: Owl Force
games.summary: Lead the legendary Owl Force and your wingmates on an epic journey defending the galaxy against the nefarious Darktail Order. Take on missions, upgrade your ship, and engage in heart-pounding battles to uncover the hidden secrets of the universe.

games.name: Wild Haven
games.summary: A short, relaxing nature builder about restoring a broken world. Start with a small shrine, clean up the pollution, and expand your powers as you build. Strategically place wildlife and plants to restore the ecosystem and watch your forest grow!

games.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
games.summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

games.name: Animal Use Protocol
games.summary: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

games.name: Nonolith
games.summary: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

games.name: Manipulus
games.summary:
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.

As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.

It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Dress up your hero and dive into chaotic co-op dungeon runs. Void Dungeon is a 2D hack & slash ARPG where you battle relentless monsters, craft powerful builds, and explore dangerous rifts solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: Rottenroots
games.summary: In this haunting visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty. Make split-second decisions that transform his personality in a solarpunk dystopia. With multiple paths and endings, your choices define who Salem becomes in a world where being different is dangerous.

games.name: Haunted by Femboy
games.summary: In this sandbox visual novel, you unexpectedly inherit a mysterious mansion from your estranged father. After discovering an ancient book, you find that you are now haunted... by a Femboy?! Build your relationship with him while discovering the mysteries kept within the mansion.

games.name: Nox Mortalis
games.summary: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

games.name: HitTube
games.summary: HitTube is an open-world roguelike looter shooter, play solo or in 2–4 player co-op! You're a post-apocalyptic streamer who fights for donations while streaming your survival. Shoot, loot, trade and use magical cards to gain superpowers in a procedurally generated world!

games.name: Scorched Warfare
games.summary: This is a strategy action war game set in a fictional fantasy world. You play as a warmaster, commanding troops in battles. Use the roguelite system to customize your gameplay style: will you be a one-man army, standing against thousands, or a mastermind tactician controlling the battlefield?

games.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
games.summary: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

games.name: Chi Project
games.summary: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

games.name: Pebbles Quest
games.summary: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

games.name: Karting of Banban
games.summary: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

games.name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
games.summary: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.
aliases: 孤独的独立游戏开发者的一生
孤独的獨立遊戲開發者的一生

games.name: Steampunk Shinobi
games.summary: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

games.name: Pararecords
games.summary: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

games.name: Pinbleton Park
games.summary: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

games.name: Cosmorons
games.summary: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

games.name: Feltopia
games.summary: Feltopia is a cozy, cinematic platformer set in a fully wooly world. Objects can be needle-felted and manipulated to solve puzzles and traverse through whimsical landscapes.

games.name: Flexible Frosty
games.summary: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

games.name: Snake in the Dark
games.summary: Sure, you've played Snake. But this is Snake like you've never seen before? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake, Sokoban, and Boulder Dash. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twists than you expect!

games.name: Iseikan Renai Guide: Interplanetary Love Guide
games.summary: This PC game is a love simulation game set in the distant future where interstellar travel has become commonplace. Slavery, crime, violence... Interact with unique aliens and form close relationships with them in a world where anything is possible, where high technology and low technology coexist.

games.name: Ask Gear Re:Boost
games.summary: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game where you are the subject of a classified mental manipulation experiment. Explore environments distorted by memories and trauma, survive a system that adapts to your personal fears, and endure traumatic threats.

games.name: The Patient: Can You Escape?
games.summary: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

games.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
games.summary: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

games.name: Already Dead
games.summary: Classic 90's style survival horror, reimagined for VR.

games.name: Work In Progress
games.summary: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

games.name: Unearther
games.summary: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Dream Bar Simulator
games.summary: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

games.name: Star Life
games.summary: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

games.name: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
games.summary: Drift across magical worlds of dreams and wonder as Froggo 🐸, who can jump, run or tongue his way through the obstacles. Drifting Sky is not only a simple, yet magical 2D platformer, but also a strange and bizarre videogame where you never know how things would progress.

games.name: Bat Galaxy
games.summary: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

games.name: Elflock
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a fairy tale, where your actions shape the story! Become a princess, navigate the murky political landscape, forge an alliance with the Fae, or turn your back on them. Make decisions that could save your kingdom, or destroy it if you misjudge the circumstances.

games.name: Catfall
games.summary: Taking a cat on a spaceship? Great idea, as long as everything goes according to plan. It's a short road from fun adventures to sudden problems. And who knows? Maybe now the fate of the entire crew depends on one little fluffy hero... After all, cats always land on their paws, don’t they?

games.name: Nightmare Circus
