games.summary: The Last Poem is a third person Action RPG set in the mid-1800s that sends the player into the shoes of Edgar Allan Poe. Travel through the worlds of his stories and experience the magic in The Last Poem.

games.name: Faro
games.summary: Faro je hlavním městem portugalského regionu Algarve a sídlo obce s 59 000 obyvateli (z toho 41 000 žije v samotném Faru); je největším městem Algarve, avšak lidnatější obcí je rozlehlá sousední Loulé. Faro leží na pobřeží Atlantského oceánu a má mezinárodní letiště.

games.name: Gothic Scythe
games.summary: An high-difficulty action game where you must slip past your enemies attacks and crush them. Take back the city controlled by homunculus with your scythe.

games.name: Spectral Report
games.summary: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

games.name: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
games.summary: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

games.name: Athelan Battlegrounds
games.summary: Athelan Battlegrounds is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics game with no meta progression and no pay-to-win. It's a game made for players who thrive in a skill-based competitive environment. A game that promises to be easy to learn but incredibly difficult to master! Build your team of champions and engage in unique matches against players or AI!

games.name: Doomed Crew
games.summary: Co-op Horror for 1-4 players. Dive into a brutal corporate environment, complete deadly objectives for your promised freedom. Trust nothing.

games.name: Shardpunk 2
games.summary: The Empire may have fallen, but humanity continues the fight. Shardpunk 2 puts you in command of a human outpost in this potent mix of turn-based tactical strategy, RPG, survival and resource management as you gather your team, scavenge for resources and prepare for a new, evolving threat.

games.name: Brightfall
games.summary: Brightfall is an isometric open-world survival-craft for 1-4 players where light is your last defence against a living darkness. Explore a cursed Celtic island, craft powerful weapons, build a safe haven, and fight to keep your flame alive - because when it dies, your sanity follows.

games.name: Strigoi Town
games.summary: Combine your potions and refine your deck to withstand waves of vampires in a Compact Deck-Refiner where every card matters. Draft your starting deck, discover powerful effects by mixing flasks and recruit allies to uncover the dark mystery threatening your home.

games.name: Paccarat
games.summary: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

games.name: Vision Quench
games.summary: An online co-op dark fantasy adventure game set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

games.name: BunnyOps
games.summary: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.summary: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Vena
games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

games.name: Momolitos
games.summary: Explore vibrant zones, collect ingredients, and feed adorable Momolitos to help them evolve into hundreds of unique forms. A cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends exploration, discovery, and the joy of caring for your own lab full of curious life.

games.name: Beyblade x Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Metal Coat
Beware of Dog
games.summary: Beware Of Dog is a fast paced Action Adventure game with RPG elements set in eclectic insane world where our heroes grandpa Domkrat and his faithful Dog embark on their journey to buy some meat.

games.name: Flap de Clap
games.summary:
Take on Mount Snoepje by flapping your way up with up to three friends. Be careful not to bonk too much or you might end up at the very bottom again.
Hunt for highscores in the endless runner mode, dodging and defeating various enemies and bosses.

games.name: Noble Steed
games.summary: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

games.name: Nia and The Abyss
games.summary: Nia and The Abyss is an Underwater Creature Collector, Cleanup, Farming, and Ecosystem Sim. Clean pollution, cultivate plants, attract and evolve marine life. Restoring balance to a responsive ocean.

games.name: The Abyss Break
games.summary: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

games.name: Amelorn
games.summary: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

games.name: Elemency Island
games.summary: Elemency island is a cozy farm coop game. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

games.name: Sublustrum
games.summary: Step into the space between subconscious and reality. Explore strange liminal worlds, solve sound-driven puzzles, and unravel the secrets behind the enigmatic device left by a vanished scientist.

games.name: Alea
games.summary: Basically, you are in control of an Eight-ball that gets thrown on different platforms and needs to achieve a certain goal. Now, the platforms are consisted of smaller dice blocks, each dice block has a certain value of numbers on it and a certain color.

games.name: Resequence: The Orchard
games.summary: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

games.name: Fri: The Unforgettable City
games.summary: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

games.name: Kindling Hour
games.summary: A brief, atmospheric text adventure of flickering candlelight, forgotten memories, and a quiet search through the dark.

games.name: Robot Recycler Ryn
games.summary: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

games.name: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
games.summary: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.
aliases: Haishin Shoujo no Ura Aka Meikyuu

games.name: D
games.summary: A new game from Parco Games.

games.name: Avemary Rocket: Captain Patchwork
games.summary: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

games.name: Blast Racer
games.summary: "BLAST RACER" is an arcade-style bullet hell game.You’re humanity’s last hope. Drive an upgradable, transformable battle race car. Blaze through deadly tracks, dodge waves of bullets, and save the world in flames!

games.name: The Rusted
games.summary: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

games.name: Jinni 2: The Ritual
games.summary: JINNI 2: The Ritual is an atmospheric, high-tension horror game based on a dark Anatolian mythology tale. Are you ready to face the entity lurking in the depths of the house?

games.name: Chrono Seoul
games.summary: Chrono Seoul’s unique Turn Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

games.name: Shy Cats Hidden Tracks Collection
games.summary: A new musical hidden object game where you need to find musician cats and their instruments. When you find them, they will play songs for you. They are shy and cute, but very talented. Find them all!
aliases: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 - The Return

games.name: Adventures of Caine McDowell: The Porkian Encounter
games.summary: Tap into your space pilot intuition as you explore an alien world, fighting monsters and fleeing from a vicious bounty hunter in this retro, puzzle-based, sci-fi epic!

games.name: Age After Age
games.summary: Age After Age. Build a thriving settlement, shape society across multiple eras, and dominate a living world economy. Choose your path — classic history, Steampunk, Gothic, and more — in a deep city-building strategy with evolving logistics, citizen classes, diplomacy, and research.

games.name: Rostov
games.summary: Rostov, feminine: Rostova is a Russian surname. Notable people with the surname include: Anna Rostova, Ukrainian former volleyball player Mira Rostova, Russian American actress turned acting teacher Polina Rostova, Russian singer Characters in Leo Tolstoy's novel War and Peace Natasha Rostova Nikolai Rostov Petya Rostov Sonya Rostova

games.name: Biryado
games.summary: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

games.name: Boundless Evil: Awakening
games.summary: A first-person horror experience set in a desolate highlands village. Track your missing archaeologist sister, unravel her clues through exploration and puzzles, scavange for loot and face the dark force she accidentally unleashed.

games.name: Shadow Hills Manor
games.summary: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

games.name: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
games.summary: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

games.name: The Gas Station: Graveyard Shift
games.summary: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

games.name: Everhome
games.summary: Become a sky architect in this relaxing, cozy, building and management sim. Meet charming characters and design unique houses just for them! Go shopping for new decorations, renovate their homes and discover the keys to their hearts.

games.name: Pingbert's Snow Ride
games.summary: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, endless platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

games.name: Pizzapocalypse 2
games.summary: A 3D platformer with a pizza moveset that's accessible & engaging to all skill levels! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the evil corporation ruining Pizza!

games.name: Ceaseless
games.summary: 'Ceaseless' is a top-down action game designed with minimalist pixel graphics, where you must guide Tiny Knight to victory. Each level is complete with unrelenting enemies, enticing potential items, and a uniquely crafted score. Are you ready to brave the tower?

games.name: The Remains
games.summary: The Remains (sometimes referred to as "Barry and the Remains") are a mid-1960s American garage rock group from Boston, Massachusetts, led by Barry Tashian. Although the Remains never achieved national success, they were very popular in New England, and were one of the opening acts on the Beatles' final US tour in 1966. The Remains broke up in 1966, but their music eventually attracted a strong international cult following. They began performing and recording again in the late 1990s, and have continued to play regularly since then.

games.name: Ad Iterum
games.summary: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

games.name: Neath
games.summary: Neath (; Welsh: Castell-nedd) is a market town and community situated in the Neath Port Talbot County Borough, Wales. The town had a population of 50,658 in 2011. The community of the parish of Neath had a population of 19,258 in 2011. Historically in Glamorgan, the town is located on the River Neath, seven miles (eleven kilometres) east-northeast of Swansea.

games.name: About Fishing
games.summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

games.name: Do Crimes!
games.summary: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

games.name: Guardians Planetfall
games.summary: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

games.name: Console War Giant
games.summary: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The year is 1980, and the gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Opona
games.summary: The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game.

games.name: Gap Year
games.summary: A gap year, also known as a sabbatical year, is a period of time when students take a break from their studies, usually after completing high school or before beginning graduate school. During this time, students engage in a variety of educational and developmental activities, such as traveling, working, volunteering, or taking courses. Gap years are not limited to a year-long break and can range from several months to a few years. The activities undertaken during a gap year vary widely and depend on the individual's interests and goals.

games.name: Better Than Us
games.summary: Better Than Us is a sci-fi narrative game about secrets, deception, and what happens when a few people hoard most of the world's wealth. By maintaining a complex web of lies, you'll convince the freakishly ultra-rich you belong among them long enough to take what they treasure most: their stuff.

games.name: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
games.summary: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

games.name: The Dark Curiosity
games.summary: First-person sci-fi psychological horror set on a secret corporate station. Left alone to secure it, you navigate oppressive corridors where every sound, shadow and choice punishes. "Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

games.name: FireFly
games.summary: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

games.name: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
games.summary:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

games.name: Astromine
games.summary: Astromine is a co-op survival game about scavenging fully destructible voxel planets. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

games.name: Safo and The Moon Warriors
games.summary: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

games.name: PinKeep
games.summary: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

games.name: Where Winds Meet: The Imperial Palace
Memoware
games.summary: Memoware is a term originally coined in 1996 for data formatted for the Memopad application that was shipped with the original USRobotics Pilot (now Palm) Personal Digital Assistant. The MemoWare website was started shortly afterward by Craig Froehle as a central repository for memoware, and now hosts thousands of documents (in various formats) for Palm OS devices and other handhelds.

games.name: Elevator
games.summary: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

games.name: Dyadem
games.summary: Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

games.name: Shibuya Sushi Master
games.summary: Cyberpunk sushi master adventure

games.name: Beandejo
games.summary: BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

games.name: Dungeon Gambler: All In, No Out
games.summary: Hit the jackpot in this gambling-infused dungeon crawler. Pay what you owe. Survive the dungeon. Play your cards close to your chest and defeat Skelly.

games.name: RadCity: a post-apocalyptic adventure
games.summary: Scavenge for food and escape a dead city in a broken, post apocalyptic world. Gather enough food for 40 days and prepare for a train journey to a place of refuge. Featuring a top-down perspective and a finely crafted 3D world.

games.name: Pollinate or Die
games.summary: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite set in the hazardous wastelands left behind by humanity. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth's flora. Fight through swarms of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

games.name: Loco: Rails & Tails
games.summary: Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
games.summary: Voyage across and beneath the salt-stricken seas in this thrilling nautically-themed expansion of Hollow Knight: Silksong, free for all players in 2026!

games.name: Feast of the Beast: Unleashed
games.summary: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampire clans as you advance towards the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that consumes the world."

games.name: Orium
games.summary: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.

games.name: Nick's Recursive Videogame About Deciphering Word Puzzles to Discover Your Identity and Redefine the Universe!
games.summary: A recursive word game for (mostly) clever people! Use your imagination to define things that define things that define things...in an unpredictable reality where there are NO wrong answers & your mistakes pile up (and up and up)! Playful, lighthearted, and charmingly offbeat.
aliases: nick¹s recursive videogame⁴ about deciphering word¹⁶ puzzle⁷⁹s to discover your identity²⁵ and redefine the universe³¹⁸!

games.name: Neidfyre
games.summary: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

games.name: Factory Time
games.summary: 2D automation game set in a time loop. Only time anchored factories and knowledge can be carried through multiple loops, until a way to escape time is discovered. Manage factories, production, research and bonuses to reach the end. What will you carry an what will you leave to the mercy of time?

games.name: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
games.summary: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

games.name: Mr. Grin's Final Act
games.summary:
Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio.
Now you're back... and so is Mr. Grin.
In this first-person survival horror, scavenge badges, rewire circuits, crack safes.
Stay out of sight. One sound and you die.
He's not hunting you. He's directing you.
His script. Your survival.

games.name: Ashes: Undertow
games.summary:
Ashes Undertow is a semi linear 7 map campaign that tells the story of the nascent scavenger Porcelain as she searches for the mythical Northern Line, a way to bypass the worst of the irradiated ruins of Atlanta. Navigate new faces in a familiar but changed world, and beware: some choices have consequences!

Porcelain has a new set of agility focused movement options and an arsenal that includes 6 new guns including but not limited to: the deadly semi automatic Riot Gun, the stylish .357 Magnum, and the makeshift soda can grenade launching Popgun. Get ready to blast a new set of enemies as well... and potentially a much more serious nemesis who stalks in the shadows.

games.name: Nebula Veil
games.summary: Only tiny, fragile shuttle between you and open space. Beyond it, wreckages drift in blood-red fog. The longer you’re alone, the less dead the cosmos around feel. Survival isn’t enough. Seek answers, analyze data, examine anomalies. To unveil fog’s secret, every detail matters.

games.name: Abracademia
games.summary: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Insanity Path
games.summary: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

games.name: My Little Sister Is an Angel
aliases: Kanojo wa Tenshi de Imouto de
games.summary: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

games.name: Jigrift
games.summary: Leap and swing around the lost tropical paradise of Jigrift as you assemble the island like a massive jigsaw puzzle.

games.name: Absolute Cinema
games.summary: Build your movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining 44 topics and 22 genres, hire star actors through auditions, develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and tons of humor. Prove you're the best director!

games.name: Blindfold
games.summary: Páska na oči je oděv, zpravidla z látky, který se váže kolem hlavy, aby zakryl oči, a tak znemožnil přístupu světla. Přes správně ušitou pásku se nedá vidět.

games.name: Backroom Cleaners
games.summary: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

games.name: Tiny House Finds
games.summary: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

games.name: Soul Hunter
games.summary: "Soul Hunter" is the second episode of the first season of the science fiction television series, Babylon 5. The episode concerns the arrival of a member of an ancient order, the Soul Hunters, on the Babylon 5 station; and reveals a mystery surrounding Commander Sinclair's missing 24 hours during the Earth-Minbari War. It first aired on 2 February 1994.

games.name: Trapped on the FlipSide
games.summary: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

games.name: Game Company Simulator
games.summary: A weary ex‑developer, tired of pay‑to‑win and toxic workplaces, creates a simulation where you play as a game company boss. Recruit staff, push their potential, battle rivals, and aim to dominate the market with blockbuster hits to reach the pinnacle of success.

games.name: Tiny Tree Talk
games.summary: Find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk – a wholesome old-school bonsai forum. Decorate miniature scenes, grow & shape bonsai trees, and bring people's diorama requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and embark on a chill and vibey journey across mid-2000s Japan.

games.name: Ether Void
games.summary: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

games.name: Void Raid
games.summary: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

games.name: From Basement with Love
games.summary: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

games.name: The Beginner Investor
games.summary: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

games.name: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
games.summary: Help a mighty dragon break a terrible curse in this incremental game. Hire workers, collect resources, construct buildings, unlock upgrades, and become a powerful king.

games.name: Martyr
games.summary: Mučedník (řecky: μάρτυς, mártys; doslova: svědek) je osoba, která byla umučena nebo zemřela za svojí víru nebo ideu.

games.name: Campus Confidential
games.summary: An LGBTQ slice of life/supernatural dating sim

games.name: Sweep Squad
games.summary: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

games.name: Poolside Vigil
games.summary: Based on a true story. Navigate through ever-changing pools where the path can never be memorized. Solve puzzles with physics-based interactions and survive the entity on your trail. Experience the grim consequences of phone addiction. Can you solve the mystery of that fateful day?

games.name: Shadow of the Moonlight
games.summary: A dark fantasy visual novel set in a medieval world. You are the privileged son of a wealthy family, seeking revenge, even if it means becoming an outlaw. Will you dare to face your weakness and strength? How far will you go to find your true enemy? Uncover your roots' secrets. Survive… if you can.

games.name: Attack of the Astrals
games.summary: Cosmic warriors invade! Command a champion trio in tight grid battles where every turn is a movement puzzle and every skill and spell is positionally targeted. Adapt your team to each realm's challenges and rewards to thwart the Attack of the Astrals!

games.name: Rise of Chi
games.summary: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies and haunted by self-doubt, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

games.name: Legacy of Ashes
games.summary: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

games.name: The Other Order
games.summary: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

games.name: Mechborn
games.summary: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

games.name: Abyssal Merge
games.summary: Merge fish to blast horrors! Abyssal Merge is a Suika-shooter roguelike where every merge scales your power. Shoot fish down to grow, and auto-fire up to survive eldritch waves. Featuring boss fights, unlockable ships, and a unique coin-shooting shop. Hold the line!

games.name: Lydia Was Here
games.summary: A horror RPG about how not to handle grief, identity, and the delusions of bringing someone back.

games.name: Wiz Hunter
games.summary: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

games.name: Toxoplasma
games.summary: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

games.name: One Last Sacrifice
games.summary: PvP Autobattler meets character progression. Draft your board from a rotating shop. Build a semi-persistent deck and refine it through crafting. Discover powerful synergies. Outwit your opponents in sync or async duels and ascend the Arenas of Naskarr. A card battler without pay-to-win mechanics.

games.name: Kitty Haven
games.summary: A cute and cozy logic puzzle game about cats.

games.name: Remnants of Sin: Deck & Puzzle
games.summary: This is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards become tiles. Place shape-based cards onto the board, clear rows and columns, and turn every decision into damage, defense, or special effects. Fight through creatures of the underworld, refine your deck and relics, and see how far your strategy can go.

games.name: Nano Dash
games.summary: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

games.name: The Dreadthorn Therapist
games.summary: A mysterious black fog covers the skies, plunging Dreadthorn into endless night, corrupting some residents. In this horror therapist-sim, run your business, decide your clients’ fate, and survive what seems like end times.

games.name: Rudravati: Curse of Bhankilla
games.summary: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

games.name: Wish Of Hers
games.summary: Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams. Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions. Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

games.name: Drunken Hog
games.summary: Drunken Hog is a story-driven pub management game focused on brewing, running a bar, and narrative depth. It is set in a small open city where you are free to explore, meet locals, and uncover the story at your own pace.

games.name: My New Paranormal Life
games.summary: My New Paranormal Life is a story-rich, erotic visual novel focused on its dating-sim and sandbox aspects.

games.name: Sushi on Wheels
games.summary: Run your dream sushi truck in Sushi on Wheels! Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals. Upgrade your gear, discover new recipes, and build your reputation in this cozy management game set in a charming Japanese town.

games.name: Send In The Vampires
games.summary: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

games.name: TreasureTails
games.summary: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

games.name: Wild Terrain
games.summary: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: The Curator
games.summary: The audioguide to the exhibition of Polish design is AI. However, being a non-material entity, she does not understand the field she is supposed to be guiding. Go on a surreal journey through her peculiar mind, solve dozens of unique puzzles and let her find out what it's all about.

games.name: Liv
games.summary: Liv je ženské křestní jméno vytvořené ze staroseverkého slova hlíf, což může znamenat úkryt, ochrana. V moderní norštině, švédštině a ďánštině znamená život, živá. Islandská podoba je Líf.

games.name: I Can Offer You Flowers
games.summary: A cosy puzzle and bouquet game, which will appeal to all fans of problem solving in a cosy and aesthetic universe. As a florist, you carefully select the flowers that match the requests... and explore the many emotional combos to touch people in your own way!

games.name: Another Hero's Adventure
games.summary: A pixel-art RPG rooted in modern wuxia novels. This spin-off continues the spirit of the original, letting you embark on an untold tale of the jianghu where your choices shape the chaos and forge a new heroic saga.

games.name: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged
games.summary: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged is a massive technical overhaul of Wargaming’s hit MMO action game. Rebuilt from the ground up on Unreal Engine 5, it introduces next-gen graphics, dynamic lighting, and advanced physics. Experience intense 7v7 tank combat with stunning PBR textures and enhanced environments, while maintaining full cross-platform progression in the most visually advanced version of Blitz to date.

games.name: Zombie Craft
games.summary: Try your hand at exciting survival and prove that you are not afraid of any challenges! Defeat all the evil dead and free the virtual world from danger. You need to confront these monsters by any means. Be the bravest!

games.name: Path of Glory
games.summary: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

games.name: Comeback
games.summary: A Visual narrative about overcoming the status quo, Fight in a series of different Arenas Levels, In your downtime cook different meals with unique effects and craft equipment to increase your chances.

games.name: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
games.summary: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

games.name: Dadum The Dice
games.summary: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

games.name: Gargoyle Garden
games.summary: Sit back, relax, and grow many magical and mystical plants in your very own greenhouse! Collect rare plants, upgrade your tools, and earn enough money to unlock new greenhouses.

games.name: CaraVanguard
games.summary: A rogue-lite action RPG with co-op for up to 7 players. Choose from 7 classes, master 70+ weapons and 100+ skills, and battle through a world where elemental interactions can weaken—or empower—your enemies. Inspired by traditional action RPG's and classic titles.

games.name: Doomtrain
games.summary: Hell has gone CORPORATE! DemonCorp's evil executives force demons into eternal overtime. Armed with the powerful DOOMTRAIN, unionize Hell and free the demon workers. Build a medieval steampunk town, upgrade your train and turrets, unionize demon workers, and defeat DemonCorp's corporate overlords!

games.name: Train Goes Right
games.summary: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

games.name: Cardoom
games.summary: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

games.name: Ravelle: Last Draw
games.summary: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

games.name: Inganock of the Raging Flame: What a Beautiful People
games.summary: A remaster of Inganock ReBORN with upgraded resolution and new features.

games.name: Towerlings
games.summary: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

games.name: Barely Alive
games.summary: Barely Alive is an American electronic music production and DJ duo composed of Matthew Meier and William "Watt" Watkins founded in Great Barrington, Massachusetts, U.S. The duo is well known for their songs on British-American and Los Angeles based electronic music record label: Disciple Records. Similar to some EDM groups such as Bassjackers and Dash Berlin, William's primary role is the headliner (as Watt) for the duo's tours whereas Matthew's primary role is the music production and "behind-the-scenes".

games.name: Ghost Scout
games.summary: Identify invisible ghosts using mundane and strange objects. Find the Anchor without getting killed, reveal the ghosts true form and attempt to get out alive.

games.name: Resolute Bay
games.summary: Forelegs are better than two as you journey across mountains, thickets and plains in search of your lost herd. Master Fight, Flight and Freeze responses to fend off foes in snappy, turn-based battles of wits, then take in the scenery and have a good roll before trotting on.

games.name: Fate’s Loop
games.summary: An upcoming souls-like RPG game. It is a stylised medieval fantasy adventure where you play as Thalor, a retired hero who must save their village from a time loop curse.

games.name: After the Wane
games.summary: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

games.name: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
games.summary: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

games.name: Typeoids
games.summary:
Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by the classic Asteroids.
Wield your keyboard to protect yourself against the incoming asteroids threatening to crush your ship, and get performance statistics and track the progress in your typing journey.

games.name: Making Lovely
games.summary: A romantic comedy where you play as a “love advisor” at the counselling office Making Lovely for a group of quirky, romantically challenged heroines. You, The protagonist becomes a “temporary boyfriend”. As you comment on their every move, you help them discover their true charms.
developers: Ramune Games / ラムネゲームズ
publishers: Ramune Games / ラムネゲームズ
aliases: Love Advisor -You're a mess and I adore you!-

games.name: Broom Broom
games.summary: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

games.name: Party Pop Bubblyz
games.summary:
Jump into the Ultimate Penguin Party!
Break the ice and have fun at the Park! Join the 20-player party to be the star!
Explosive Fun in Just 10 Minutes

games.name: InterViolence
games.summary: Wander through a secret lair. Help a young supervillain move out of his lifelong home. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. The third entry in the Violence series.

games.name: Bumpers & Dragons
games.summary: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.

games.name: Petrichor
games.summary: Petrichor is a JRPG about a space cub going on a quest to find the perfect houseplant. Make friends, defeat monsters, help people, save the stars and maybe get his plant. Maybe.

games.name: EVO Card
games.summary: EVO Card is a roguelike card game in which players evolve creatures by assembling biological components through deck-building mechanics. Each run features randomized encounters and progression, encouraging strategic adaptation across repeated playthroughs.

games.name: Asylum 1966
games.summary: Asylum 1966 is a first-person psychological horror experience set within the decaying halls of a long abandoned mental institution. Players step into the role of an investigator drawn to the asylum by a series of unexplained events, only to uncover a place where time fractures, memories distort, and reality becomes unreliable.

games.name: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
games.summary: When renowned P.I. Clair V. Is called to a Louisiana town on reports of a ghost, what they find is a mystery cloaked in a nightly calamity. With spirit abilities and the gift of foresight, Clair must loop through futures to uncover the roots of the haunting and stop a curse.

games.name: Wingmine
games.summary:
Wingmine is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

games.name: Shadowstone
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where survival comes down to what your heroes can do together. Choose your heroes, build your power, chain your skills, and break the run. Play solo or co-op, up to 4 players.

games.name: Manifesto
games.summary: Manifest je veřejné slavnostní nebo programové prohlášení, významný ústní nebo písemný projev. Může být zveřejněn jednou osobou, skupinou, politickou stranou nebo vládou. Manifest navazuje buď na společenský konsenzus nebo propaguje novou myšlenku, v které autor věří, že by měla vyvolat změny. Většinou se jedná o politické nebo sociální myšlenky. Občas revoluční, ale může se jednat i o životní postoj autora. Manifesty týkající se náboženských vyznání se nazývají kréda.

games.name: Hellcard II
games.summary: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

games.name: Essomenic
games.summary: You are the surgeon navigating patients' memories via crude, retro machinery, under the command of a strange, occult organization. Keep your patients alive long enough to uncover your exact role in this surreal mess of an operation.

games.name: Fortune Teller Simulator
games.summary: Step behind the curtain of an occult salon on a Victorian street of London. Play as a Fortune-teller who decides fates with Tarot readings.

games.name: Dungeon Treaders
games.summary:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

Create your character by choosing a name, selecting from five races and eight classes, and form a party of up to six members.

In addition, you can freely replace face icons and full-body portraits with your own images. Build a party that truly reflects your style.

Dungeon Treaders is a classic-style dungeon crawler RPG based on the original web novel Dungeon Settlers (2022 to present), written by the same author.

games.name: Final Orbit
games.summary: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

games.name: Death a Live
games.summary: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

games.name: Escape Tsunami: Take Brainrots!
games.summary: Dive into a chaotic arena where brainrots are scattered everywhere, just waiting to be taken and brought back to safety.

games.name: You Remembered
games.summary: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

games.name: Late Night Duty
games.summary: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.summary: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

games.name: Don Memo
games.summary: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

games.name: Bloomies
games.summary:
Bloomies are cute little creatures born from seeds and eggs, growing while you go about your day on your PC. But peace doesn’t last forever because Shadow Bloomies are waiting for the right moment to invade and take over your taskbar world.
In Bloomies, you plant seeds, grow eggs, and hatch over a hundred unique Bloomies, each with different ranks. Raise them, collect rare Sparkle Bloomies, and watch your tiny companions live their lives.
When Shadow Bloomies attack, your Bloomies automatically jump into battle. Defeat powerful bosses in order to unlock new seeds and items.
Prefer a calmer experience? Cozy Mode lets you disable combat entirely and simply enjoy collecting, decorating, and customizing your Bloomies at your own pace. You can even automate your experience through the skill system.
Bloomies is a cozy monster-collector with light farming and idle elements that runs directly on your taskbar . But it doesn’t have to stay there. Resize it, move it anywhere on your desktop, and create multiple profiles to match your mood. Decorate your world with tons of items, dress your Bloomies with adorable hats, or even turn Bloomies themselves into hats.

games.name: Isekai HKV
games.summary: “Isekai HKV” is a 2D top-down pixel-art roguelike themed around VTubers traveling to another world. Players take on the role of the hero “DD,” gain the cheat skill “Unlimited Gacha,” and adventure with VTubers to defeat the Demon King!

games.name: Drift Market
games.summary: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

games.name: AlterMage
games.summary: AlterMage is a first person metroidvania that combines spell-slinging action with a cerebral exploration experience. As an aspiring mage seeking to learn sorcery, you find yourself upon the shores of a forbidden island fortress. Take up your staff and set out on a journey that will challenge your mind, body, and spirit as you uncover the truth behind the citadel's origin.

games.name: Prison Fury
games.summary: Prison Fury is a 2 player co-op puzzle platformer game. Pair up across mirrored prison stages to solve interdependent puzzles—door sequences, platform chains, patterns, levers and more. Runs are intense and can take 16–45 minutes.

games.name: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
games.summary: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

games.name: Bullet Time Agent
games.summary: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Thread laser gauntlets with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death again, and again...

games.name: Veros Veros Veros
games.summary: Maybe a waitress simulator. Maybe an arcade game where you play as a waitress, but in reality, it doesn’t really matter.

games.name: Jibbers
games.summary: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

games.name: Killing Things With Your Friends
games.summary: A chaotic first-person co-op game about surviving lethal experiments with your friends. Work together, dismember your enemies, steal their limbs and escape before time runs out.

games.name: Less Miserables
games.summary: A point-and-click parody of 'Les Miserables', set in the French Revolution

games.name: Void Diver: Escape From the Abyss
games.summary: Manage 'Balusha' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.
aliases: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: A first person horror survival game. You control four drones in separate locations to diffuse a cataclysmic situation. Armageddon is in your hands.

games.name: Dwarven Mining Company
games.summary: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

games.name: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
games.summary: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

games.name: The Whispering Bones
games.summary: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Speak to him, unravel his secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Land of the Dead Trees
games.summary: Land of the Dead Trees is a roguelike extraction RPG. Walk the thin line between life and death as you struggle to restore a shattered world. Lands of the Dead Trees draws you into a breathtaking realm beyond your wildest dreams - where danger lurks at every step, and survival demands courage.

games.name: The Ashen Oz
games.summary: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

games.name: OS95 Plus!
games.summary: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

games.name: Helenland
games.summary:
Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it.
But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

Helenland is a single-player, first-person psychological horror.
The game features deep narrative, exploration and puzzles.

games.name: Crosstown
games.summary: Crosstown is an unincorporated settlement situated in Salem Township in Perry County, Missouri, United States, near the Mississippi River.

games.name: Slopeside Kings
games.summary:
Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racing game.
In Slopeside Kings you shred down the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost then use chaotic items to battle your way to the finish line.

games.name: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
games.summary: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

games.name: Mira: Shadow of the Past
games.summary: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

games.name: 4Below
games.summary: A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota—together.

games.name: Masackra
games.summary: A tactical game with grid-based combat, classes, and synergies. Assemble your squad, strengthen it through events, and make decisions that determine the outcome of each battle.

games.name: Kingdom Heroes
games.summary: Kingdom Heroes 2 is a 3D Fantasy MMORPG renown for its focus on massive Siege Warfare; granting players access to catapults, battleships, massive ground armies, and more.

games.name: Tome Improvement
games.summary: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

games.name: Heartseers Grove
games.summary: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

games.name: Tsukiyo ni Karen
games.summary: Tsukiyo ni Karen je hra z kategorie Adventura / Indie od studia おんねんちゃんねる pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Reroll Routine
games.summary: Reroll Routine is a rolling clicker inspired by autobattler-style shop systems. Buy ROUTINES, earn R€COINS, win the ROLLYMPICS and REROLL your life. One of the past champions, Relder, is here to help you achieve it.

games.name: Watch Eye
games.summary: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

games.name: Peglotto!
games.summary: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

games.name: I Never Late for Work
games.summary: This is a life-simulation roguelike card game. Harness item and skill cards to shorten your commute, continuously boost yourself through diverse events, forge connections with different friends to help each other out, and become the best employee who never arrives late.

games.name: Fractaloid Attacks!
games.summary: Fractaloid Attacks! is an arcade mix of pinball and brick breaker set inside a living digital world. Bounce, glide and blast through fractal caves, unlock powerful technologies, survive chaotic hazards and build your own collection of strange fractaloid creatures.

games.name: Static Shift
games.summary: A Lovecraftian, psychological co-op horror where the powers from above are tormenting you and your co-workers, warping reality with anomalies and using any means necessary to stop you from leaving or finding out the truth: Can you do it?

games.name: Cozy Farm
games.summary: Welcome to Cozy Farm, a charming farm sim where you play as Cozy the Cat, a hardworking feline with a love for the land! Plant crops, raise animals, and build your dream farm—all while managing your day in this somewhat realistic, heartwarming farming simulation.

games.name: Dead 4 Now: Escape Together
games.summary: A 4v1 asymmetrical horror where survivors escape by solving shifting puzzles. Use always-on proximity voice to manage sanity, but speak too loudly and the monster will find you.

games.name: Diskette Dungeon
games.summary: A magical diskette opened a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adaptation, destruction, and corrupted data collected to reach the next world.

games.name: Ever Flip
games.summary: Ever Flip is an incremental coin-flipping game where consecutive 50% chance wins create powerful streaks, bigger rewards, and increasing automation.

games.name: Soundscapes
games.summary: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

games.name: Dreamera: Figment of Dreams
games.summary: Point-and-click puzzle adventure about exploring surreal dream worlds, solving layered environmental puzzles, and navigating between realities through a central Dreamgate.

games.name: Whispers of Appalachia
games.summary: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

games.name: No More Pesticide
games.summary: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs, building a farm, and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

games.name: The Last Wizard: A Goblin Detective Mystery
games.summary: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

games.name: DishDash
games.summary: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

games.name: Rogualik
games.summary: Rogualik is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you uncover dark, scary secrets of a surrealistic sweet-filled world. Use ridiculous makeshift kitchen weapons, upgrade your croissant with "Mise en place" assets and defeat all the crumbs that stand in your way!

games.name: BattleBoat X
games.summary: BattleBoat X is a combat roguelike where you command a heavily armed gunship through a chain of hostile islands. Fight dangerous enemies, upgrade your vessel, and save the world from certain doom!

games.name: Avernoth
games.summary: Sealed away in an ancient alternate dimension, you must find a way to break free. In this fantasy action rogue-lite, uncover a variety of spells to cast your way through waves of hostile magical apparitions. Discover the secrets of Avernoth to make escape possible. Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Chronicles Meteorfall
games.summary: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

games.name: Deluge: Raintime
games.summary: Some things don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

games.name: Aelwater
games.summary: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

games.name: The Day That Wasn't
games.summary: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

games.name: Wong
games.summary: Wong is the Jyutping, Yale and Hong Kong romanization of the Chinese surnames Huang (traditional Chinese: 黃; simplified Chinese: 黄) and Wang (Chinese: 王), two ubiquitous Chinese surnames; Wang (Chinese: 汪), another common Chinese surname; and a host of other rare Chinese surnames, including Heng (traditional Chinese: 橫; simplified Chinese: 横), Hong (Chinese: 弘), Hong (traditional Chinese: 閎; simplified Chinese: 闳), and Hong (Chinese: 宏) Note that, while 汪 (Wang/Wung) could be distinguished by its tone, 黃 (Wong/Huang) and 王 (Wong/Wang) are homophones in Cantonese.

games.name: Kubika
games.summary: Guide charming cubes through a dreamlike world in Kubika, a Sokoban-inspired 3D puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity to your will to solve thoughtful, elegant three-dimensional puzzles. Bring your vision to life with the built-in Level Editor, and share your creations with the Community.

games.name: Become
games.summary: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

games.name: DoDoon
games.summary: Defend your castle from approaching monsters! Upgrade your defenses and survive all 30 fast-paced waves in this addictive defense shooter.

games.name: Scicry
games.summary: A first-person sci-fi action-horror. After a catastrophic event, the station’s crew has mutated, turning its corridors into a deadly labyrinth. Explore the station, scavenge resources, and fight monsters to survive.

games.name: World Without Time
games.summary: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

games.name: Michael Test
games.summary: Michael Test is a point-and-click adventure game where you uncover hidden truths within classical paintings and follow faint traces of sound to deduce and choose the final ‘sin.’

games.name: Santa's Burnout
games.summary: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

games.name: Dream Village
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

games.name: Kafak
games.summary: KAFAK – Survival Card-Building & Base Management Game Build your deck with 150+ unique cards, upgrade characters and your base, craft Thai dishes, hunt and farm to survive, and face 10+ powerful bosses in a post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Sepium
games.summary: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

games.name: Lounge Café
games.summary: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

games.name: Delucid
games.summary: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

games.name: Wing-It
games.summary: Wing It is a relaxing simulation game where you build and manage a bird sanctuary. Discover, care for, and unlock diverse bird species, customize your haven with unique decor, and explore new locations to expand your sanctuary. Create a paradise for your feathered friends!

games.name: Chop Chop for the Old God
games.summary: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.
aliases: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD

games.name: Kiosk 199X
games.summary: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

games.name: Loot And Defend
games.summary: A short, relaxing incremental game about slaughtering millions of attacking zombies. Take a load off, the end of the world doesn't have to be stressful.

games.name: SkyRen
games.summary: Race, climb, and free-run through dynamic cityscapes! Build your character, master movement, compete with players, earn gear, level up, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate free-runner in this anime parkour MMO!

games.name: Mount Noire
games.summary: Get cash, get meds, get home. Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

games.name: Only Tactics
games.summary: You lead a tactical group in a series of turn-based battles with other groups. A limited number of actions and rules create an infinite number of tactical combinations. The levels are balanced so that the one who finds the right tactics wins. Get ready, that will not be easy

games.name: Deep Hunger
games.summary: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

games.name: Don't Drive Dead
games.summary: Drive, shoot, and survive huge zombie swarms in a top-down roguelite where you build a squad, upgrade your car, and create wild hero synergies. Procedurally generated characters, weapons and levels.

games.name: When Voices Died
games.summary: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

games.name: The American Dream of Gunther Aims
games.summary: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

games.name: Donnie's Delicious Nuclear Funeral
games.summary: A point-n'-click choose-your-own-adventure game about Susie, a kind girl in the post-apocalypse who must arrange a funeral for her dearly-departed brother Donnie in the town that hates his stupid, dead guts!

games.name: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals
games.summary: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals is a horror pazzle game. A late-night delivery goes horribly wrong, pulling you into the city's supernatural underbelly. Saved by Nuo mask, you enter a hidden world where Nuo Masters against unspeakable horrors. But you'll soon discover this mask didn't choose you by accident.

games.name: MioAquaria
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

games.name: Neural Drive
games.summary: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

games.name: Death Pong
games.summary:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

games.name: NPC Simulator
games.summary: NPC SIMULATOR is a game where you can finally become that boring NPC! No swords or spells. Your job is to give out quests, fix crooked textures, and do whatever it takes to keep players from reporting bugs. Hang in there!

games.name: To Be Connected
games.summary: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game where you shape the land, connect your sites, and maintain a balanced, harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or craft real-country layouts by shaping land and connecting important locations.

games.name: Stillwell
games.summary: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

games.name: CoinClave
games.summary: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

games.name: Fast & Fractured
games.summary: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

games.name: Undergone: Before
games.summary: Explore the story of Kale Vortex in a world where nature thrives — until every step begins to change it.

games.name: Mystic Tavern
games.summary: Mystic Tavern - co-op simulator tavern and farm with a mystical twist. Build your homestead, explore multiple map regions, harvest and mine resources, cook dishes and brew potions. Customize your character, bond with charming NPCs, and face subtle horror after sundown as you uncover hidden truths.

games.name: Starburst Fever Night
games.summary: Enjoy fast-paced match-3 puzzle battles! Quickly move star blocks and aim for chain reactions!

games.name: Idle Garden
games.summary: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

games.name: The Last Mothership
games.summary: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

games.name: Frog Up!
games.summary: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don't fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

games.name: Tidewake
games.summary: Enter the uncharted seas of TideWake in this single player naval roguelite. Explore uncharted oceans and defend your vessel from dangerous foes. Collect and customize your ship with powerful parts and mystical trinkets to become the most powerful pirate in history! Sink into chaos. Rise a legend.

games.name: Logistics Simulator: America
games.summary: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

games.name: Deg
games.summary: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

games.name: Ghosts With Hats
games.summary: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

games.name: Girl of the Ruins
games.summary: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

games.name: Orbrix
games.summary: Orbrix is an incremental idle breakout game. Break endless layers of bricks, purchase powerful upgrades, and unlock visual themes. Play actively or as idle as you want. Create a swarm of upgraded bullets to defeat your enemies. Can you grind your way to level 1000 to escape the Orbrix prison?

games.name: Iris
games.summary: Kosatec (Iris) je rod jednoděložných rostlin z čeledi kosatcovité (Iridaceae). Latinský název rodu pochází od řecké bohyně duhy pro svou pestrobarevnost květů.

games.name: Floating Frontiers
games.summary: A minimalist strategy game about growing your infinite floating town. Combine wacky 3D blocks to optimize synergies, build idyllic scenery, and chase your high score.

games.name: Captain Speedfin
games.summary: Ahoy, matey! The clock is ticking for Captain Speedfin. Trapped with an hourglass that never stops, this pirate has only one choice: run. Your mission is simple but brutal: navigate 60 intense platforming levels to reclaim your chests before the last grain of sand falls. There are no special powers here—just pure skill. Every jump, slide, and dash is a test of your reflexes. In this world, the slightest mistake is fatal.

games.name: Posse of 3
games.summary: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

games.name: Friends of a Feather
games.summary: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

games.name: TomaDo!
games.summary: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

games.name: Royal Verdict
games.summary: A medieval court simulation where every verdict matters. Hear cases, uncover lies, and balance the King, the People, and the Church as your reputation shapes the fate of the kingdom.

games.name: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
