games.summary: Ending Tau is an action roguelike where you morph your body parts with curses that completely change the game. Walk, fly, teleport, or dig your way across the jungle. Explore unique mechanics with endless mix-and-match upgrades, unravel a beautiful pixel art land, rebuild your village, and End Tau.

games.name: Goman: Stuck in the Avici Hell
games.summary: Goman is a Infinitely looped scroll style battle action game.

games.name: Ascendant.com
games.summary: Ascendant is a squad-based tactical FPS with serious balls. Each match is different, with game-changing events and adrenaline-fueled battles. Set in a dynamic BioPunk world where everything wants to kill you; fight to extract resources, and get out with more than just your dignity.

games.name: Nanovoid
games.summary: NANOVOID is a 2D tactical space shooter that puts you in command of your own modular spaceship. Engage in intense, physics-driven battles, strategize with ship customization, and outsmart your enemies

games.name: Ascendance
games.summary: Ascendance is an upcoming space strategy game in which the player takes control of a civilisation taking its first steps into into space. It features a massive game world, a deep simulation of civilisations, and real-time strategy space battles.

games.name: Containcorp
games.summary: An absurd Corporate Horror & Logistical Management Sim where you contain & milk anomalies for tremendous profit. Construct your facility across multiple floors, design containment areas, employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Contain, Research, and build a machine of Profit.

games.name: Dragonscale Monastery
games.summary: Discover the secrets of dragon breeding. Survive harsh winters, limited resources, hunger, cold, and many other adversities. Experience unique survival city-builder in the world of Dragonscale Monastery.

games.name: Ardem
games.summary: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

games.name: Arcane Arena
games.summary: Arcane Arena is an intense multiplayer action game chosen from diverse spellcasting classes, each with unique abilities. Engage in team-based combat, and dominate the battlefield. Unleash devastating spells, manipulate time, summon creatures, and harness elements to emerge victorious.

games.name: Draculesti
games.summary: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

games.name: Drinkrime
games.summary: Jin, a talking liquor bottle with supernatural powers, has given you a mission. Face DRINKRIME's cast of unique characters and force them to confess their crimes. Interrogate them together and make those wrongdoers come to terms with their guilt!

games.name: Lost Isle
games.summary: Castaway on an island built upon the corpse of a dead god. Build settlements, master melee, archery, and magic. Choose your fate in huge multiplayer PvP and PvE conflicts to begin your story of survival, betrayal, and conquest.

games.name: Level Up Your Body
games.summary: LUYB - Hit objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Elevate in a virtual world.

games.name: Elodya
games.summary: Explore the continent of Elodya and unravel its mysteries, alone or with friends, as you gather, craft, battle, learn about its inhabitants, flora and wildlife, and send your discoveries back to your homeland!

games.name: Mana Quest
games.summary: What can you do when you've been isekai'd by mistake and you're just a regular person? You become an entrepreneur! Take over a shop and get rich while building up your harem of monster girls in this comfy +18 hentai RPG!

games.name: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
games.summary: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

games.name: Kiosk Simulator
games.summary: Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed, comedic take on the hustle of running a big-city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.

games.name: Healthy Hero: Tower Defense
games.summary: Healthy Hero is a Tower Defense game with roguelike elements, where the player protects a hero from attacking junk food. You need to build and upgrade defensive towers to stop the enemies. The levels become increasingly challenging with new types of junk food and waves

games.name: Poly Beats
games.summary: Poly Beats is a 5K vertical-scrolling rhythm game where you don't need to be perfect to have fun. Dive into our OST, decorated like they're animation, or jump into multiplayer for Tug of War, Free-For-All with power-ups, or ranked async 1v1s - where you compete at your pace, not by the clock.

games.name: War Trigger
games.summary: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: Wandering Cat
games.summary: Guide a cat on a culinary journey in "Wandering Cat": explore, make friends and tackle adventures with humor. Are you ready for a meowtastic cat adventure?

games.name: Hours After Midnight
games.summary: Dive deep into a roguelike survival quest against Rettam'diov, the Consumer of Worlds. Progress, earn experience, refine characters, and uncover potent tools. Face relentless hordes alone or amplify the thrill, teaming up cross-platform in our distinctive co-op mode.

games.name: Korga's Arena
games.summary: We combined a Roguelite Deckbuilder, a Turn-Based RPG, and a bloodthirsty orc battle-mage, to create Korga! Craft your Deck, enhance your Weapons, and forge your Gladiator Emblem to customize your playstyle.

games.name: Dungeons and Diners
games.summary: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

games.name: Elderwood Online
games.summary: Dive back into the essence of MMORPGs with Elderwood Online, where we pay homage to the beloved classics of the late '90s and early 2000s, infused with a touch of today's innovation. Elderwood Online marries the nostalgia of golden-age MMOs with fresh adventures and discoveries.

games.name: Watch Out For Goblins!
games.summary: The world's most accurate goblin simulation! Run and jump a ragdoll goblin through this hilarious physics adventure! Gobland is in trouble! Find the lost cogs, restore power, and become goblin royalty! Alone- or with a friend in split-screen, there's no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

games.name: Pool of Madness
games.summary: A Lovecraftian roguelite pool. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

games.name: Paper Play VR
games.summary: Experience creative minigames as the world's biggest paper playground unfolds right in front of your eyes! We have crazy games, difficult challenges and a heartwarming story for you and your friends, so come and join the party!

games.name: The Whims of the Gods
games.summary: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

games.name: Croakwood
games.summary: Welcome to Croakwood, a relaxed town-building and management game where tiny frogs settle into life in the wild woods. Design and create structures, plan and decorate your town, explore an ancient forest filled with secrets, and guide a charming frog community as it grows.

games.name: Stormforge
games.summary: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

games.name: Meowmentum
games.summary: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and prove yourself worthy of wielding Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

games.name: Fate Trigger
games.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

games.name: Detective of the Dead
games.summary: You are a dead detective in the Mexican afterworld trying to find your killer. Undercover you prepare unique tacos to make suspects confess. Find clues and solve puzzles. Step into the shoes of your dog, Xolo, and do magical things. Save the Día de los Muertos.

games.name: Tartaros
games.summary: Jump into 3D retro-stylized adventure full of puzzles and mysteries that needs to be uncovered in story inspired by greek myth of Persephone and her escape from the Underworld.

games.name: Into the Fire
games.summary: Race an exploding volcano in this high-risk extraction survival. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you.

games.name: PACS: Post Apocalypse Courier Service
games.summary: Can you build delivery vehicles to survive the post apocalypse? Go it alone or with up to 4 friends as you navigate treacherous environments, make deliveries, customise vehicles, scavenge for parts, and grow your delivery business!
aliases: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service: Co-op Delivery Simulator

games.name: Blackfrost: The Long Dark 2
games.summary: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

games.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
games.summary: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

games.name: Uncursed
games.summary:
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.

Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.

Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable items and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.

games.name: Train World Driver
games.summary: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.

games.name: Steel Runner
games.summary: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

games.name: Hexiv
games.summary: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and feed your crew while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

games.name: Colonisator
games.summary: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

games.name: Valerie
games.summary: Valerie is generally a feminine given name, derived directly from the French Valérie (a traditionally female name). Valéry or Valery is a masculine given name in parts of Europe (particularly in France and Russia), as well as a common surname in Francophone countries. Another, much rarer, French masculine form of the name is Valère. Both feminine and masculine forms of Valerie have derivatives in many European languages and are especially common in Russian and other Eastern European languages. The masculine form is not always a cognate of the feminine; it can have a distinct etymology.

games.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
games.summary: Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players? Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

games.name: Order of Renewal
games.summary: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

games.name: Leaforia
games.summary: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Gear Up Einstein!
games.summary: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

games.name: Creature Containment
games.summary: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

games.name: The Mirrion
games.summary: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

games.name: Bitgun Survivors
games.summary: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

games.name: ApocaShift
games.summary: ApocaShift is a solo-developed extraction looter that throws you into high-stakes expeditions across the wasteland, where survival hinges on the gear you carry, the base you build, and the few allies you can count on.

games.name: Bully Ball Brigade
games.summary: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
games.summary: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

games.name: Spectral Protocol
games.summary: Spectral Protocol is a psychological horror game where you’re trapped in a mysterious facility. Play solo or in two-player co-op, find hidden buttons, and escape terrifying creatures. Danger is everywhere ! will you survive or become another lost test subject?

games.name: C.L.U.C.K.
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Explore surreal, monster-infested realms and interact with fully physics-based objects. Grab the chickens and bring them back to the train. Survive and complete your quota - or face the Colonel’s wrath.

games.name: Block Beast
games.summary: Build the strongest Beast and claim your title as "King Of The Jungle!" With thousands of possible combinations, which Beast will reign supreme in this fast paced Auto-Battler

games.name: Gluttony
games.summary: Nestřídmost či obžerství (Gula) je v nejužším slova smyslu systematické přejídání, v širším významu (ve kterém je v rámci křesťanství bráno jakožto jeden ze sedmi hlavních hříchů) pak nadměrná konzumace nejen jídla, ale též dalších požitků. Zahrnuje pak i různé nežádoucí závislosti: závislost na drogách, počítačových hrách, workoholismus atd. Jako její protějšek mezi ctnostmi je uváděna střídmost. Na počátku 14.

games.name: BoB: Battle of Bots
games.summary:
Are you ready for a bot-breaking battle?
Dive into the world of BoB - Battle of Bots and test your skills against an endless tide of robotic foes. How long can you survive? How powerful can you become? There's only one way to find out. Download now and join the battle!

games.name: Magnavis
games.summary: Set in the depths of the Red Seas, Magnavis is a 1-4 player co-op submarine horror survival game. Manually operate grotesque ship systems powered by living organs, weld catastrophic leaks, and survive with your crew in an abyss where unknown terrors lurk in the absolute dark.

games.name: Destiny Code
games.summary: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

games.name: Trade Anchor
games.summary: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

games.name: We Build Below
games.summary: A roguelite, co-op factory builder that is set on an alien planet. You're part of an rag-tag mining team trying to get rich. Meet the daily quota to keep your mining permit and defend against dangerous parasites to stay alive.

games.name: Loopstructor 2: Skyspine
games.summary: Build intricate rail networks, deploy and upgrade unique Battle Trains, and harness Turret Enchantments to forge mobile fortresses. Fend off endless abominations from the deep earth. Every layout is a battle of wits, every adjustment decides survival.

games.name: The Tavern at the End of the Road
games.summary: A souls-like deckbuilder in first-person 3D where each run is a new life told by a mysterious innkeeper. Journey to the north, Errant, and travel the Road to become Legend. A replayable mystical experience with tactical combat in a world that remembers your choices.

games.name: Delve Down Under
games.summary: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.

games.name: Hips N Noses
games.summary: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

games.name: Oedo Developer
games.summary: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!

games.name: Eastwynne
games.summary: Play as either Ester or Sye as they navigate college and life in Eastwynne. A city filled to the brim with magic, high society life, the best of the best businesses, and real estate. Maybe not the best people, but you got everything else.

games.name: Cybrid: Survivor
games.summary: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

games.name: Sombie
games.summary: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

games.name: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty
games.summary: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty is an independent game with a fantasy fairy tale theme, and the core gameplay focuses on "identifying fakes and identifying monsters". Every decision you make is not only about the safety of the people in the city, but also about the profound impact on the entire city

games.name: Relentless Dark
games.summary: I'm just a dude who got bored and wanted to make a fun but scary coop zombie game. If I can do it you can too! It's always been my dream to develop and release a game one day - even if it sells just one copy 😊 Thanks again for all of the amazing feedback so far! Can't wait to play this with you all

games.name: Protocol Paradox
games.summary: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

games.name: Cold Steel
games.summary: Cold Steel, Inc., is an American retailer of knives/bladed tools, training weapons, swords and other martial arts edged and blunt weapons. Founded in Ventura, California, the company is currently based in Irving, Texas, after an acquisition by GSM Outdoors in 2020. Cold Steel products are manufactured worldwide, including in the United States, Japan, Taiwan, India, Italy, China, and South Africa.

games.name: The Mortal
games.summary: 《下凡》是一款模拟经营游戏。因为不同的困境，从未到过大城市的“你”，带着希望孤身一人来到陌生的环境里打拼。

games.name: FriendOS
games.summary: FriendOS is a singleplayer/online bullet-hell RPG set within a virus-infected computer. Customize your Friend and team up with others to fish, socialize, and explore the depths of a dying operating system.

games.name: Ruin and Rebirth
games.summary: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

games.name: Ittzy Fearless
games.summary: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

games.name: Tabula
games.summary: A mind-bending, level-based puzzler about overlapping computer windows to create traversable, top-down landscapes. Delve into the heart of an unusual operating system, one folder at a time!

games.name: World In The Abyss
games.summary: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

games.name: Time to Die
games.summary: Time To Die is a strategic roguelike dice-builder. Choose your heroes to fight relentless enemies in turn-based combat where time is your enemy.

games.name: Furry Defenders​​
games.summary: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

games.name: Crimson Freedom
games.summary: A classic RTS with modern look - Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game featuring a thrilling campaign experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet.

games.name: SteelGuard
games.summary: Pilot customizable mechs in an epic battle against hordes of enemiesor dive into intense PvP battles where precision aiming can turn the tide, or let your mech's auto-firing system handle the heat of combat. With rogue-lite elements, each run offers a unique challenge and opportunity for growth.

games.name: Last State
games.summary:
Last State is a hardcore wilderness survival simulation where every decision shapes your fate. You're alone in the post-collapse wilderness with nothing but your skills and determination.

Scavenge abandoned settlements. Craft tools from raw materials. Hunt for food. Build shelter against the elements. Trade with strangers or fight them. Every action drains your resources. Every mistake can be fatal.

The wilderness doesn't care about your plans. Storms will destroy your shelter. Wildlife will compete for resources. Injuries will slow you down. Starvation, dehydration and freezing temperatures are constant threats.

games.name: Treasure Rush: Phantom Infiltration
games.summary:
After you save your friends from the Tower Cave, things in Chairwood don’t calm down at all. People start going missing, whole houses turning quiet overnight, and nobody knows what’s going on. Every clue you follow keeps pointing back to Phantom Corp. They’re acting like nothing’s happening, but everyone knows they’re involved.

So now it’s up to you and your friends to go inside their facility, figure out what they’re doing, and stop it before the whole town ends up gone.

games.name: Realms at War
games.summary: Realms at War is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, where fantasy factions clash in PvP and PvE battles. Equip your forces, adapt to rogue-like challenges, and conquer diverse realms filled with ever-changing foes and environments.

games.name: Tattered Banners
games.summary: Lead your mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a living, simulated world shaped by your actions. Raid, bribe, steal, spy, assassinate, lay siege, and more - and watch the consequences ripple through and change a realm at war.

games.name: Breezevale
games.summary: Start a new life in Breezevale! Blend cozy farming with thrilling action in this unique RPG. Cultivate crops, unlock the potential of your animals through evolution, and explore dangerous dungeons to gather rare resources. Decorate your home, befriend locals, and find romance at your own pace!

games.name: Sakura Arms: Radiant Duels
games.summary: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponents tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides selections.

games.name: Backseat Champions
games.summary: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

games.name: Atlanta TD
games.summary: Atlanta TD is a roguelite tower defense game where the armies of the underworld descend onto the Four Spectacular Realms in waves as it falls unto the remaining Gods to protect the city of Atlanta!

games.name: Goojeegoop
games.summary: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

games.name: Keybort
games.summary: Keybort is a clean and fluid idle / clicker game where you progress by pressing keyboard keys.

games.name: Riff Hammer
games.summary: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

games.name: Heartlines
games.summary: Heartlines: A choice-driven FPS. Under an angel's threat, you have 10 days to kill the demon hiding among 5 friends. Who is the victim? With 10+ endings, every choice leads to salvation or hell. Will you obey the light or find the truth?

games.name: Distant Visitant
games.summary: Survive the alien arrival in Distant Visitant, a top-down open-world sandbox. Master talents from marksmanship to cooking while managing hygiene and hydration. Adapt to seasons where winter freezes crops and lakes. Craft, build, hunt, and find survivors. Prepare for them, this is just the start.

games.name: Signal Hill
games.summary: Signal Hill is a city 2.2 mi2 (5.7 km2) in area in Los Angeles County, California, United States. Partially high on an eponymous hill, the city is an enclave completely surrounded by the city of Long Beach. Signal Hill was incorporated on April 22, 1924, roughly three years after oil was discovered there. As of the 2020 census, the population was 11,848, up from 11,016 at the 2010 census.

games.name: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
games.summary: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

games.name: Santa's Legacy
games.summary: Step into Santa's boots and manage the most magical workshop on Earth! Build, craft, and deliver gifts before Christmas morning in this cozy holiday management adventure. The spirit of Christmas is in your hands!

games.name: Papy Panic
games.summary: Papy Panic is an indie driving game where players control quirky vehicles, navigating through chaotic environments with physics-based jumps and obstacles. It includes a standard single-player experience and a dedicated interactive Twitch Mode designed for live streamers.

games.name: Project Damascus
games.summary: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

games.name: Chronia: The Rotcore
games.summary: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

games.name: Genderman
games.summary: A short, intense psychological horror. Tear up the notes before Genderman finds you — between dark humor, madness, and fear. Meme or nightmare? You decide.

games.name: Bloodfront
games.summary: Bloodfront is a top-down dark fantasy survival game where you build a village by day and defend it from endless demonic hordes by night. There are no second chances. When the village falls, the run ends.

games.name: Banana Keeper
games.summary: One Banana Keeper, and up to seven friends as Evil Monkeys hiding among NPC monkeys. A multiplayer hide & seek game about blending in, eating bananas, and avoiding being revealed. Will you fool the Banana Keeper or reveal all evil monkeys around NPCs?

games.name: Trucker 2056
games.summary: Trucker 2056 is a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Origin and MicroProse.

games.name: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
games.summary: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

games.name: Dawn Girl
games.summary: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

games.name: D' Mär Lucidium: Grimmgart
games.summary: Begin your journey amid the chaos of the newly reignited War of Divinity and write your own story in this first-person open-world RPG. Express your personality, choose your combat style, and explore the dangerous, living world of Grimmgart.

games.name: Starboys
games.summary: Third-person arena shooter where gravity is a weapon. Run on walls, fight on ceilings, and flip mid-air to outplay friends in fast 1v1–4v4 matches (up to 8). Customize your Starboy and build arenas with the in-game editor.

games.name: Slendyjan
games.summary: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

games.name: Field of Heroes
games.summary: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

games.name: Hexistence
games.summary: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

games.name: The Legend of California
games.summary: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.

games.name: Seed
games.summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.summary:
Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike arcade shooter where your body is the controller. You physically lean to surf a hoverboard through neon faster-than-light transit tunnels. No thumbstick needed, no motion sickness, nothing between your intention and the lane. Kill enemies, build combo, go faster. Die, come back stronger.

You are a Way Rider: a sponsored celebrity operative clearing rogue AI constructs from the galaxy's collapsed FTL network. Every run is a live broadcast. Every death is a media event. Between runs you spend Sponsorship Credits on permanent upgrades in your Ship Hub, ensuring the next ride starts stronger.

Strategic depth comes from a deep roguelike build system. Dual-wield energy weapons and shape each run using 40+ randomised Sponsor Mod cards, stacking synergies like chain lightning, explosive rounds and shield reflection. Mid-run slow-motion Pitstops let you buy, sell or recycle upgrades via rival corporate faction vendors before re-entering the chaos. Killing enemies builds a heat combo that physically increases your travel speed. Skill directly controls pace, rewarding aggression without punishing casual play.

games.name: Vaunted
games.summary: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

games.name: Kodas Nereus
games.summary: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

games.name: Liar's Lift
games.summary: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

games.name: The Void
games.summary: Only brought to life by scarce sparks of Color, the bleak, grey Void is a peculiar place. The player gets to explore it, get to know the Sisters, Brothers, and other weird creatures inhabiting it, and learn the ways of Color, harvesting it and drawing sigils that change the world around them.

games.name: Ecliptica
games.summary: Ecliptica is a first-person open-world colony survival simulator with a fully dynamic economy. Set on a hostile alien planet, you'll found corporations, fight for resources, and build a sustainable future—or be wiped out by ruthless nature, politics, and competition.

games.name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
games.summary: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

games.name: EasyCraft Online
games.summary:
EasyCraft is an online idle RPG set in the world of Valoria, where players take on the role of adventurers tasked with rebuilding a fragmented civilization. Choose from three classes: Warrior, Mage, or Archer, each with three advanced subclasses, and embark on a journey of battles, exploration, and conquest.

The game features real-time turn-based manual combat, automated resource gathering battles, over 200 items with random rarities and attributes, item crafting, resource gathering, equipment enchanting, and durability systems. Explore the Crypt, dangerous dungeons filled with monsters and rare rewards. Interact with NPCs like Doll, Mira, Thalos, and Varen in a village that serves as your base of operations.

Features include guilds with collective abilities, a PvP arena, a player marketplace, a pet system, quests, competitive rankings, real-time chat, daily rewards, and appearance customization. Play directly in your browser or through the desktop application.

games.name: Iron Inc.
games.summary: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.

games.name: Revenant Maze
games.summary: A first person, action-roguelike that centers around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes intent on defeating you. Only to turn the tides and become the monster yourself.

games.name: Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon
games.summary: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon is an emotional VN where choices shape the fate of four characters. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

games.name: Beards vs. Claws
games.summary:
Beards vs. Claws is a fun, chaotic first-person sandbox shooter set in a fully destructible world environment where the battlefield is never static, and every match reshapes the map.

Everything in the world can be destroyed, mined, or built upon in real time - from the ground below to the walls and towers above.

Dig tunnels to flank your enemies, carve out trenches for cover, or build bridges and platforms to gain the high ground. The terrain is a tool, a weapon, and a strategy all at once.

As players fight, dig, and build, the environment is constantly reshaped by rocket explosions, bridges and newly carved tunnels throughout the map.

games.name: Deckzin
games.summary: Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.

games.name: Hollowed Oath
games.summary: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis. Players assume the role of an Oathsworn, choosing three classes to define their own path customizing each ability they choose. Adventure, explore, collect, craft, and battle to uncover the truth behind your Oath.

games.name: Stick N' Sheep
games.summary: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

games.name: Terminal War
games.summary: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

games.name: Catacomb
games.summary: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

games.name: Creovia
games.summary: Creovia is a 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build your own worlds, craft powerful gear, trade with other players, and carve out your place in a persistent, player-driven universe.

games.name: Saw: Genesis
games.summary: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

games.name: Voxenvale
games.summary: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, decorate, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

games.name: The Guild Manager
games.summary: Recruit your team, forge a legendary guild! In this unique management simulation, you won't play as a lone hero—you'll become a Guild Master, leading a group of flesh-and-blood, distinct personalities from rookies to conquerors of epic raids.

games.name: Cargo Crush Zero
games.summary: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. Cargo Crush Zero is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Eidol
games.summary: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

games.name: One More Dig!
games.summary: Grab your equipments and dive deep! One More Dig is a pirate-themed mining adventure. Master your stamina, unearth cursed treasures, and upgrade your gear with dubloons. The greatest haul is always just one more dig away—how deep will you go before the tide turns?

games.name: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
games.summary: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

games.name: Sakimori
games.summary: "Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary." Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

games.name: Incog-Confine
games.summary: Identify. Plan. Scavenge. Repair. Escape or die, alone or with allies. Survive the dystopian lands and brutal storm till your last breath.

games.name: Castles & Castellans
games.summary: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

games.name: State Z
games.summary: State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

games.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
games.summary: Turn-based dwarf puzzle crawler: Solve tricky mechanics, explore mysterious dungeons, and survive the depths.

games.name: Basement Server Simulator
games.summary: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

games.name: Skye
games.summary: SKYE is a relaxing explorative game where you venture into a world inspired by the Western Isles. Fly around the captivating islands, help the locals with their troubles, and set the fastest time in races while absorbing everything around you through the painterly environment.

games.name: Evons
games.summary:
Evons is a strategic collectible card game where two players clash on a 7x7 grid to seize control of the battlefield. Build your 60 card deck, summon monsters forged from six elements of fire, nature, earth, water, electric, and dark, and aim your arrows to flip your rivals to your side.

Spend your credits wisely. Unleash devastating abilities like Firestorm, Resurrection, and Shockwave, then chain reaction after reaction into game breaking combos. Every arrow is a threat, every cell a battleground, every turn a gamble.

Fill the board. Break your enemy. Rule the grid. Easy to learn, hard to master, impossible to put down.

games.name: Paddle Cats
games.summary: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

games.name: A.S.S. (Amazing Slot Survivor)
games.summary: Spin the slot machine. If luck is on your side, your power explodes. Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

games.name: Market Manager Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

games.name: Sails
games.summary: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

games.name: Aquaculture Simulator
games.summary:
Aquaculture Simulator is a management simulation in which the player operates an indoor recirculating aquaculture facility. Two parallel economies run in the same hall: rainbow trout are raised to weight and sold by the kilogram for thin but predictable margins, while koi are valued by grade based on pattern, colour and body conformation.

A young koi does not reveal its final quality. The game presents a range of possible outcomes that narrows as the fish matures, forcing the player to decide whether an animal is worth feeding for up to two years before its value is known. Fish consume feed daily, so keeping low grade stock erodes profit.

Water chemistry underpins both operations. Oxygen must be held within a corridor, as insufficient levels suffocate fish while excessive levels cause gas bubble disease. Ammonia rises with overfeeding, and a single temperature control separates the two species. Customer orders arrive as email on an in game terminal with a calendar and banking application, and missed pickup dates cost both money and reputation.

games.name: Liminoid
games.summary: Liminoid is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

games.name: The Tram
games.summary: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

games.name: On Love, On Monsters
games.summary: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

games.name: Card Make Arena
games.summary: Create. Build. Duel you CardMakeArena is a next-generation card game where you craft your own cards from scratch—then face a real opponent across the table. Design everything freely: effects, targets, timing, even the artwork. Then bring the deck that's yours alone… and it's you and me.

games.name: Endless Bounce
games.summary:
Endless Bounce is a roguelite pinball game where you build the table yourself.

Between stages you buy bumpers and marks in the shop and place them on the playfield by hand. Drag two bumpers together to combine them into something stronger, find the synergies, and reach the score target before the clock runs out. There are 50 stages across 5 worlds, with a boss every ten that steals your bumpers, and an endless mode once you clear stage 50.

Every run is different: randomized shop offers, over 40 items with as many combinations, and 6 unlockable balls that each change the rules. Between runs, 40 talents in 10 branches make the next attempt stronger.

games.name: Limp Mode
games.summary:
Limp Mode is a driving survival game with simulation-leaning handling, deep tuning and an OBD diagnostic scanner as its central tool. Cars wear out, leak and fail in ways that can be diagnosed and repaired: when a warning light comes on, the player reads the fault codes to find the failing part, clears them to limp on a little further, or disables systems outright to trade reliability for power. Handling is built on slip-based tire physics, weight transfer and drift behaviour, and the workshop that serves as the player's base includes a proving ground with a track editor for shaking down a build before taking it out.

Beyond the solo campaign - a thousand-kilometre drive down the highway to reach the player's grandfather - the game offers drift servers for up to twenty players, with a public server browser and a festival pit lane where players build and decorate their own pit box. Cars are persistent across every mode and keep their condition, damage and odometer reading, with a service history recording every repair. Parts can be stripped from wrecks, and the world persists after a death, so abandoned wrecks and emptied containers stay where they were left. The dead still hold the cities and are dangerous to meet on foot, but they are weather rather than the subject. It can be played solo or in co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Ocean Cargo Manager
games.summary: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

games.name: Dadi Kingdom
games.summary:
You are the king. Pass judgment on your people, ride into your own realm sword in hand, and decide who hands you the power to do it. You will not rule forever. Father an heir before your time runs out, and leave behind a dynasty worth remembering.

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval action RPG where you rule and fight. Every day new cases land before your throne: release, gold fine or dungeon. Your verdicts follow you. Outside the walls, the kingdom waits: the Far Lands, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen and dark mages stand in your way.

games.name: Calpria
games.summary: Calpria is a 3D arcade space shooter . The game combines fast-paced bullet hell combat with deep progression, wingman system and strategic partner customization. Developed by Lunakardo Games and released exclusively for Google Play Games for both PC & Android Devices

games.name: The Final Witness
games.summary: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

games.name: Claim Denied
games.summary: Co-op comedy horror, where you are a special department of Quark.Inc corporation investigating a series of mysterious incidents on a spaceship.

games.name: Fluxgates
games.summary: A roguelike where every run is a factory you wire together on a canvas. Draft nodes, connect them into a production line, then press Run and find out. Each room demands more than the last - build the combo engine that keeps up, or stall three ticks from the target.

games.name: Trenchblocks
games.summary: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

games.name: Valdrys
games.summary: An isometric MMORPG you buy once. No subscription, one live server for everyone. Five classes, ten specialisations, keyed dungeons for one to five, world bosses, a ranked team arena, and the Bloodgrounds, the one zone where dying costs you everything you carried.

games.name: Starforge Pirate
games.summary: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

games.name: Genius Simulator
games.summary: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

games.name: Beautiful Freaks of the Desert
games.summary: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the beginning of the trip...

games.name: Debauchery & Magic
games.summary: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

games.name: Valenya Online
games.summary: Old-school 2D MMORPG, played in French. Real-time combat, dungeons and raids of four to eight, six professions where crafting takes real time, an auction house in every village and trading companies run by guilds. Free, no daily limits, made by one person.

games.name: Ranger Commando
games.summary: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

games.name: Naberon
games.summary: Naberon is a real-time space 4X strategy game. The player explores a galaxy under fog of war, colonizes planets and manages their population, food, energy and taxes, researches technologies without a fixed tech tree, and designs ships and tanks from modules. Wars are fought on two levels: real-time fleet battles in space, and real-time ground battles after carriers land tanks on a planet's surface, where the terrain divides the planet into build zones. Random events such as pirate raids, refugees, distress calls and a market with timed deliveries shape each game. It can be played solo against AI empires, or online with other players, cooperatively or against each other.

games.name: Potions Galore
games.summary: Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize 2500+ potion bottles in their respective shelves. Read about every unique set in the Potion Encyclopedia, deduce the correct placement and tidy up the mess you made when your sorting ritual failed!

games.name: Blades & Trades
games.summary: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

games.name: Barnburners
games.summary: Barnburners is a 5-on-5 arcade hockey game featuring 24 fictional clubs, body checks, one-timers and player-controlled fights. Players can compete against the CPU, share a team or play against friends with up to four people locally, or play online head-to-head. Franchise mode includes line management, trades, free-agent signings and a rookie draft across multiple seasons. Other modes include outdoor games, 3-on-3 Pond Hockey, Training Camp and arcade competitions.

games.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
games.summary: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

games.name: Goodly Trials
games.summary:
Goodly Trials is a tactical auto-battler with roguelite elements.

Hire a peculiar company of knights, sell-swords, merchants, and wizards, arm them as you please, arrange the line, and trust in your leader to survive your journey home. Victory belongs to preparation.

games.name: Sponge Bridges
games.summary: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.

games.name: Survivecraft
games.summary: Survive ten minutes of pure horde in the dark fantasy world of Valdrath! 13 heroes, evolving spells, boss fights in blazing arenas and epic loot. Rebuild your ruined Sanctuary between runs – solo or in local co-op.

games.name: Paint the World
games.summary: A casual, first-person painting simulator with multiplayer, timelapse, and unlockable colors, tools and worlds!

games.name: Paperworks: Paper Shredder Inc.
games.summary: Shred paper, scan books, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade your machines, automate the paperwork, and uncover the dark secrets behind an AI-driven future.

games.name: Oboro no Ichi
games.summary: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

games.name: Alignment: An Engineering Odyssey
games.summary: Route a road through real mountain terrain, build it with curves, earthworks, bridges and tunnels, then drive it to test the design.

games.name: Alien Agent X
games.summary: Players can obtain materials and exchange them for corresponding characters, costumes, weapons, actions, etc. Supports body adjustment, taking photos, scene scanning, player chain connection.All multiplayer online. Currently in the early access most Unreal the scene will be changed later.

games.name: Solar Nations 2
games.summary: Rise beyond humanity's cradle and begin the long struggle to dominate the solar system. Lead a nation through political turmoil, technological upheaval, and interplanetary conflict as the future of civilization unfolds among the planets. Build colonies on distant worlds, develop revolutionary technologies, and decide whether humanity will unite among the stars… or destroy itself in nuclear fire.

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: Slime Rancher 2
games.summary: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys across the Slime Sea to Rainbow Island, a land brimming with ancient mysteries, and bursting with wiggly, new slimes to wrangle in this sequel to the smash-hit, Slime Rancher.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Cemo-Summoning Adventure Game

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.summary: Forza Horizon 6 je závodní hra z roku 2026, kterou vyvinulo studio Playground Games a vydalo Xbox Game Studios. Jedná se o šestý díl série Forza Horizon, navazující na Forza Horizon 5, a čtrnáctý hlavní díl franšízy Forza.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6: Italian Passion Car Pack
games.summary: Embrace your passion for 4 great new Italian cars in Forza Horizon 6, perfect for cruising, racing, or exploring (available as released).

games.name: Kloa: Child of the Forest
games.summary: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

games.name: Name of the Will
games.summary: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

games.name: Idle Casino Empire
games.summary: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Turn casino psychology into upgrades. Play blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to cheat: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, read marked cards. Eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary: A rock-and-roll management RPG where you guide a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Set up gigs, manage egos, and navigate the music industry in an alternative America inhabited by larger-than-life anthropomorphic characters. Make it big without selling out.

games.name: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
games.summary: "Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a Touhou fan-made roguelike action game.Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

games.name: Cellscape
games.summary: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

games.name: Built by Force
games.summary: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

games.name: Wizard 64
games.summary: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

games.name: CyberQuest
games.summary: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

games.name: Crash and Conquer
games.summary: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
games.summary: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

games.name: Stinker Golf
games.summary: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

games.name: Polymorphite
games.summary: Polymorphite is a rhythm-adventure hybrid game that fuses keyboard-and-mouse rhythm dodging gameplay with a deep narrative following three concurrent Tokyo residents as a bizarre serial murder case unravels the fabric of reality; and the question of what it means to be “human” becomes more important than ever before.

games.name: Cytokine Storm
games.summary: Cytokinová bouře, také nazývána jako hypercytokinemie, je fyziologická reakce, při které dochází k nekontrolovatelnému uvolňování prozánětlivých cytokinů. Za normálních podmínek jsou cytokiny důležitou součástí přirozené imunity a uplatňují se jako signální a regulační molekuly. Nadměrné množství cirkulujících cytokinů v oběhu však může vést k orgánovému selhání a smrti.

games.name: One Billion Ducks
games.summary: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

games.name: Joint Venture
games.summary: Joint venture (též joint adventure, joint enterprise či česky společná firma) je forma spolupráce dvou či více osob, které spolu realizují nějaký projekt. Charakteristickým rysem této spolupráce je smluvní základ (ať již výslovný nebo implicitní), všemi členy této skupiny sdílený společný zájem, dělení zisku nebo podílení se na ztrátě rovným dílem mezi členy a rovnost všech členů co do výše hlasovacího práva.

games.name: Long Shadow
games.summary: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

games.name: Hellcrown
games.summary: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

games.name: Brave Billiards
games.summary: 《Brave Billiards》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelike building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

games.name: Virtual Encore
games.summary: VTuber業界を舞台にしたビジュアルノベル。事務所マネージャー・若葉として、担当タレント・月宮エリカの初ソロライブまでの6日間を支えよう。選択肢によって物語は分岐する。その6日間の先に待つものを、あなたはまだ知らない。

games.name: Ruptured Floor
games.summary: Ruptured Floor is a puzzle horror game set in surreal office spaces. It tells a story about depression and work. The protagonist needs to find a way to escape, and uncover dark secrets in the process.

games.name: Hardcore Cyborg
games.summary: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

games.name: Roll or Die
games.summary: The roguelike dicebuilder. Build your dice bag and go as far as you can in this underground casino! Earn chips, place your bets, combine unique dice, and create absurd synergies as you advance through increasingly exclusive rooms. Bet it all, challenge your luck, and reach the top — or die trying.

games.name: Burger Smash
games.summary: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced singleplayer cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock unique playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

games.name: Kill the Thing
games.summary: Kill The Thing is a challenging roguelike turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

games.name: Clean Tides
games.summary: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

games.name: Kristi Sky Islands
games.summary: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

games.name: Last Man Running
games.summary: Last Man Running is a physics-based parkour party game in which players race across procedurally assembled rooftops while escaping a zombie horde. Players can tackle, grab and throw rivals in free-for-all or team elimination matches, cooperate to survive, or chase high scores solo. It supports local and online multiplayer, including mixed couch and remote players.

games.name: Count on Chaos
games.summary: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

games.name: Hephaestus Protocol
games.summary: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

games.name: Blood Covenant
games.summary: Blood Covenant is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror job-sim. Players are a hazmat cleaning crew taking night jobs at farmhouses, barns in the woods and an abandoned psychiatric hospital. Each shift they scrub blood, bag remains, seal breaches and repair fences, then return to the van before the entity that has moved in comes for them. Players spot anomalies, read messages written on the walls under UV light, and must identify the entity before lighting the ritual altar; naming the wrong one turns it against the crew. Can be played solo or with up to three friends.

games.name: Stranded in the Abyss
games.summary: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

games.name: BrokenLore: Ascend
games.summary: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Midgardr
games.summary: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

games.name: Stellarch
games.summary: Stellarch is a deterministic, provably-fair trading-card game on the Hive blockchain. Draft a seven-card team of Fighters across eight elemental affinities and let a seeded combat engine resolve the battle; every match replays byte-identically from its seed, so any result can be verified. You own your cards on-chain, and a smart deck beats a deep wallet. Fair, not free. The alpha is ongoing at stellarch.io.

games.name: The Hambagu Shop
games.summary: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

games.name: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
games.summary: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

games.name: Flask
games.summary: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: Everfront
games.summary: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Sturmjäger
games.summary:
Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up for everyone who wants to skip the cinematic fluff and dive straight into unadulterated, chaotic, and adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op.

Every single stage features its own distinct visual theme and a custom-tailored soundtrack, taking you from the deepest corners of outer space straight to the bottom of the ocean, merciless boss fights included.

With three different game modes and three difficulty levels, maximum replayability is guaranteed, no matter how fast your reflexes are.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... shoot it anyway, just to be safe.

Genre veterans are in for a treat: The deep, finely-tuned scoring system rewards aggressive and flawless gameplay. Rack up massive score multipliers with quick kills, kill chains, risky proximity close-quarters attacks, no-death runs, and much more. Perfect your strategy, climb the global online leaderboards, and test your mettle against the best pilots in the world!

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Echoes of Agony
games.summary: A dark turn-based roguelite where you are hunted by your own inner demons. Master the dynamic turn economy, collect loot and push your limits. The more you suffer, the greater the rewards. How much are you willing to endure in the pursuit of power?

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of the U.S.A.
Fit Boxing: Touken Ranbu - Shutsujin! Exercise Honmaru
Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Third Bloc
games.summary:
Third Bloc is a text-based political strategy game set during the Cold War. The player founds a small, fictional republic in 1945 and steers it through 45 years of superpower pressure, six months at a time, until 1990. The state is run from a single operations terminal: every order is a numbered line, typed or clicked, and every consequence arrives in print, from parliament votes and bank offers to letters at the State Telegraph Office.

Caught between Washington and Moscow, the player can stay a client state, switch patrons, or call a congress and found a third bloc of their own, while climbing the nuclear and space ladders from the first rocket to a crewed landing on Mars. The whole game, including its animated films, is drawn in ASCII characters.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

games.name: Demra: Rifts of War
