You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

games.name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

games.name: Ignitement
games.summary: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

games.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
games.summary: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

games.name: Kwad
games.summary: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

games.name: Rebel Roar
games.summary: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

games.name: Elysium
games.summary:
Elysium is a next-generation third-person mmorpg featuring a seamless open world, multiplayer gameplay, survival mechanics, crafting systems, AI companions, and player-driven progression; created by Mercenary Games, Elysium combines the best elements of mmorpgs, rpgs, open-world adventures, strategy games, and social multiplayer experiences into a living universe shaped by both players and artificial intelligence.
Explore vast lands, discover hidden secrets, build your legacy, participate in large-scale events, develop professions, engage in trade, battle powerful enemies, and influence the evolving world around you.

games.name: Jawed
games.summary: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

games.name: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
games.summary: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

games.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
games.summary: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

games.name: Incyanspace
games.summary: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

games.name: Most Scuffed Golf
games.summary: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

games.name: Gods Play Dice
games.summary: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

games.name: Deepward
games.summary: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

games.name: Protocol Bound
games.summary: Bound is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

games.name: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
games.summary: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

games.name: Souq Boss Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Baqala in a nostalgic 2002 Gulf neighborhood inspired by old Dubai and Riyadh. Stock iconic childhood products, serve familiar faces, complete quests, unlock special items, make deliveries with friends, and use your BB Gun to stop thieves as you build your way to becoming the Souq Boss

games.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
games.summary: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

games.name: Billionaire Life Simulator
games.summary: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

games.name: Seasons of Books and Keys
games.summary: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

games.name: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
games.summary: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

games.name: Dance of the Butterflies
games.summary: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

games.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
games.summary: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

games.name: I Want to Play the Villain!
games.summary: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

games.name: Capitol Diktatoria
games.summary: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

games.name: Me and You
games.summary: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

games.name: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
games.summary: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

games.name: The Ignition Protocol
games.summary: The Ignition Protocol is an incremental, top-down mining game set in space. Mine and haul asteroids in zero-g, build and automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

games.name: No Clean, No Exit
games.summary: A 1-6 player co-op horror comedy about cleaning. Mop the filth out of a procedurally generated house while roaches, bedbugs, and ceiling-crawling spiders try to drag you off. The truck doesn't leave until the place is spotless.

games.name: Deadline: Afterlife Processing
games.summary: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

games.name: Armed-Mageddon
games.summary: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

games.name: HopScout
games.summary: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

games.name: The Necessary Evil
games.summary: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

games.name: Kayak Photography Sim
games.summary: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

games.name: Vital Decisions
games.summary: Take charge of a chaotic emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

games.name: Diss Diss Discussion
games.summary: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

games.name: Silent Mainland
games.summary: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.

games.name: Find The Needle
games.summary: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

games.name: Blight Doctors
games.summary: Discover, diagnose, exorcise. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

games.name: The 7th Shift
games.summary: A psychological horror game about working overnight shifts alone in a grocery store. Stock shelves. Clean. Do your job. But you soon realize something sinister is watching. Survive seven shifts to discover why you were really hired and face a choice that will seal your fate.

games.name: Fleshgrinder
games.summary:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic action-rpg where every decision has weight.
Set in 2053, six months after the Fleshgrinder virus outbreak transformed 70% of augmented humanity into a hive-minded techno-organic collective.

Features three distinct characters with their own skill trees, optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 100+armors, augmentations, consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes. NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices, dialogue choices and overall behaviour. Battle 11 unique enemy types through seamless mission areas in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it - all to stop the evolution of the Fleshgrinder and save humanity from extinction.

games.name: Dino Cleanup
games.summary: Toxic goop has spread across the dinosaur land! Use the power of the vacuum to clean your way through multiple levels, being rewarded for fully cleaning. Make new dinosaur friends you save along the way and uncover the ancient secrets around the source of the goop.

games.name: Hollow Crew
games.summary: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

games.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
games.summary: Race friends, crush rivals, and master five chaotic minigames! RoboSquare: Recharged is a fast-paced 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump, and slam opponents off the map. Customize your bot, climb the leaderboards, and claim the crown!

games.name: Team Hero Coder
games.summary: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle, learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

games.name: Unexpected Tasks
games.summary: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

games.name: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

games.name: Family Time
games.summary: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

games.name: Deck Breaker
games.summary: Deck Breaker is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder in which players choose a hero, build a deck during branching quests, combine spells, characters, and artifacts, and preserve selected foil cards across runs.

games.name: Open Land
games.summary: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

games.name: Seaside Wash
games.summary: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

games.name: Fox Stamps
games.summary: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

games.name: Still Breathing
games.summary: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

games.name: RingOut
games.summary: Grab a weapon and blast your rivals out of the arena. RingOut is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter with 23 fighters, 13 weapons and 29 arenas. Play solo against bots or battle online — team up or go free-for-all across 6 explosive modes.

games.name: Astrocraft
games.summary: Open your own shop on a space station: stock the shelves, serve space travelers, and grow from a lone miner into a space tycoon. Mine asteroids for goods, hire a crew of robots, found outposts, and take to the stars in your own ship, solo or with up to four friends.

games.name: Infant God
games.summary: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

games.name: Really Illegal Golf
games.summary: A stealth golf adventure in places nobody dared to take golf. Slip past security and line up risky shots. Tee up in cities, beaches, ski resorts, military sites and more. Keep quiet and sink it under par.

games.name: Graveheart
games.summary: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

games.name: No Truce With The Groceries
games.summary: No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure set in the decaying hinterland of a declining America.

games.name: Too Many Clankers
games.summary: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: too many clankers. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the clankers to scrap.

games.name: Bloom Control
games.summary: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

games.name: Cursed Gas Station
games.summary: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

games.name: Shiki Tea House
games.summary: Shiki Tea House is a single-player cozy life-sim game. Open a little cozy tea shop and take part in farming, running tea business, exploring the town and more.

games.name: Night at the Fun Park
games.summary: A horror game set in an abandoned amusement park. Players search for exit keys while avoiding a giant spider, using noise to distract it and freeing captured teammates from cocoons.

games.name: Cards after Midnight
games.summary: A dark roguelike card adventure where a deadly curse controls the clock. Become a savage werewolf at midnight and a weapon-wielding survivor by day while escaping the villagers hunting you down.

games.name: The Wrong Ones
games.summary: The Wrong Ones is a dialogue-driven social deduction game where players must unmask Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight among innocent townspeople. Stripping away action and visual giveaways, the experience challenges players to rely entirely on logic, active observation, and critical reasoning to catch the monsters through what they say—and what they leave out.

games.name: The Final Lane
games.summary: Realistic bowling meets deckbuilding roguelike where the balls are the cards! Draft a synergistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle the fellow damned as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

games.name: Theoria: A God Simulator
games.summary: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

games.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
games.summary: Idle Incremental MMORPG Simulator where you start grinding manually, then gradually unlock Bot Modules until the game plays itself. Setup combat behavior and farming routes to find the most optimal configuration.

games.name: S.O.V.A.
games.summary: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history. What happens when the AI finds a way to survive?

games.name: Photoncytosis
games.summary: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation in which a tiny organism feeds on the light of the screen and grows while the player works. Each cell stores energy, and absorbed colors influence the organism's development. Players can inspect cells under a microscope, research mutations, move creatures toward light, and confine them to an application window. Specialized cells support harvesting, perception, movement, energy storage, and repair. Organisms can split, regroup, and compete for resources in a changing desktop ecosystem.

games.name: Contract Terminated
games.summary: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

games.name: Martial Art's History
games.summary: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

games.name: Mise en War
games.summary: A multiplayer cooking brawl for 2 to 8 players. Race to finish your recipe by chopping, frying, and baking while slapping rivals, stealing their prepared food, and deploying hilarious sabotage traps in a shared, chaotic kitchen arena!

games.name: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
games.summary: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

games.name: Curse of Cards
games.summary: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

games.name: The Facility
games.summary: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

games.name: Jubaku
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

games.name: Rondo's Romp
games.summary: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

games.name: Lemony Fresh
games.summary: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

games.name: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
games.summary: Wonder Air: Lunaras Adventure is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

games.name: Dronefall
games.summary: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

games.name: Gamble Hunters
games.summary: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

games.name: Dave the Diver: Subnautica 2
games.summary: Dave the Diver dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.

games.name: Frostmason
games.summary: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

games.name: Synapse
games.summary: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

games.name: Freshly Caught
games.summary: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

games.name: Tiny Patisserie
games.summary: Run your own cozy pastry shop. Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

games.name: Taskbar Chickens
games.summary: Taskbar Chickens is a cozy desktop companion game where a tiny chicken farm lives on top of your Windows taskbar while you work or play other games. Pet your chickens, toss them around and let them wander across your desktop. Breed them to hatch new chickens with unique looks and outfits, grow crops to keep them fed, clean up after them, and sell eggs to unlock new tools, structures and skills. Grow your collection and turn a small taskbar farm into a thriving chicken empire at your own pace.

games.name: Dungeons of Destiny
games.summary: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Loot! Dungeons of Destiny is an action-packed anime 3D dungeon crawler. Explore perilous dungeons, defeat formidable fantasy creatures, master powerful skills, and gather valuable loot to strengthen your character.

games.name: We Don't Exist
games.summary: Lasers, spikes, gas, scalding steam: every room has its own way of killing you. Survive, room after room, under the gaze of someone who records everything. But the worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Here, survival has a price. You choose which one.

games.name: Hit the Anvil
games.summary: Strike the anvil, forge rare gear, and build your legacy in a pixel-art incremental crafting game.

games.name: Hex Party
games.summary: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

games.name: Project: Null Hypothesis
games.summary: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

games.name: Massively Singleplayer
games.summary: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

games.name: Laylines
games.summary: Laylines is a sailing management game set in the world of the oldest trophy in sailing. The player runs a challenger syndicate competing against five rivals for the right to face the defender. Off the water, the game covers crew scouting and contracts, training, sailor careers and retirement, boat research and development with component reliability and sea trials, design philosophy and target wind, sponsors, TV rights, merchandising and headquarters upgrades. On the water, match race duels play out in real time, boat against boat, under real racing rules: right of way, penalties, laylines, wind zones and shifts. Each Cup is made up of round robin groups, a Semi-final, a Challenger Final and the Cup Final, followed by a new season with a rule change, in an open-ended campaign.

games.name: Warstead
games.summary: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

games.name: Police Stories 2
games.summary:
Police Stories 2 is a cooperative tactical top-down police shooter.

The sequel to the iconic Police Stories will feature new challenges, new mechanics, and a brand-new story. Take command of a rundown precinct in the most crime-ridden part of the city. With limited resources, dangerous choices, and enemies on every side, the line between justice and compromise starts to blur.
Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Survive the system.

games.name: Forgotten Towns
games.summary: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

games.name: Watch Out: Shark!
games.summary: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

games.name: Unwanted Guest
games.summary: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

games.name: Sayara's Path
games.summary: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

games.name: My Cozy BookShop
games.summary:
My Cozy Bookshop is a charming blend of shop management sim and light RPG, set in a colorful fantasy world full of magical readers, curious wanderers, and plenty of books to discover & find!

When your grandma decides to retire to a tropical island to finally finish writing her book, she hands the family bookshop over to you with no room for negotiation. The only thing you do get a say in? Renaming the place and making it your own.

games.name: Particle Collectotron
games.summary: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

games.name: Falafel King
games.summary: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv’s Carmel market, back in the early 2000s. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you’ll need every hand for.

games.name: Just One More Season
games.summary: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

games.name: Island Sort
games.summary: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

games.name: Too Slow Again
games.summary: Too Slow Again is a first-person shooter in which every level is a race against the clock. On each track the player has to eliminate every target, complete its objectives and reach the finish line as fast as possible: every hit taken adds two seconds, dying ends the run and restarts are instant, with nothing left to chance. Over 100 tracks are split into weapon circuits for the assault rifle, pistol, shotgun and sniper rifle, set in a bright, flooded white city where glass, screens, steam pipes and gas cans break and explode. Movement includes sprinting, sliding, vaulting, climbing, leaning, ziplines and rappelling. Bronze, silver and gold medals and a leaderboard on every track measure each run, weapons level up from 1 to 50 to unlock attachments, and the Duo and Squad circuits are built for online co-op with two and four players.

games.name: Brain Bomb
games.summary: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

games.name: Applied Shamanism
games.summary: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

games.name: A Game About Shooting Targets
games.summary: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

games.name: Below Lethe
games.summary: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

games.name: Demon Balls
games.summary: A bowling roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit demons, deal with devils, cast spells and feed worms to your ball. Roll up through the heavens and kill God.

games.name: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game in a pet cemetery. Sort 1,093 headstones by animal and cross-reference photographs to put every stone back where it belongs. No timers, no penalties. Just you, the quiet, and a lot of pets somebody loved.

games.name: Mailed It!
games.summary: You're the new night-shift intern at a postal sorting facility. Hit your quota and survive the shift, or build machines to do the work for you. Sorters, fans, conveyors, bizarre contraptions… whatever keeps the mail moving. Because the mail never stops!

games.name: Winds of Viridia
games.summary: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

games.name: Azur
games.summary: Azur (French pronunciation: [azyʁ] ; Occitan: Asur) is a commune in the Landes department in Nouvelle-Aquitaine in southwestern France.

games.name: Fae & Fauna
games.summary: Fae & Fauna is an open world pet collecting role-playing game. Collect magical creatures in undiscovered lands and fight with your companions against the dangers lurking in the wilds!

games.name: Wild Wild Eden
games.summary: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

games.name: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
games.summary: Dive into Omnivael's enchanting world on PC! Master magic, embark on quests, and explore diverse realms. Uncover mysteries today!

games.name: Absym
games.summary: Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

games.name: Farming & Defense: Farmfence
games.summary: Supermarket Simulator meets Farming Simulator—with zombies. Build your store, grow crops, and survive nightly undead attacks in this fast-paced farming defence game. Harvest, sell, and fight to keep your business and farm alive.

games.name: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
games.summary: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

games.name: PlanetBase 2
games.summary: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

games.name: Frontier Wars: Online
games.summary: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

games.name: Asema
games.summary: Build a space factory. Mine, harvest, exploit. Manage logistics with railguns, ballistic payloads and gravity-bending haulers. Fight gravity with Focus, climb the tech tree. Expand and explore the solar system in this Newtonian automation sim. Everything is a potential resource - even the Locals.

games.name: Abjure
games.summary: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

games.name: Ghost Justice
games.summary: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

games.name: Simulacre
games.summary: Simulacre is a 1–4 player online co-op psychological horror game focused on exploration, survival, and distrust. Players explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, while Mimics can imitate familiar voices and create uncertainty within the group. The game can also be played solo.

games.name: Paleokin
games.summary: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

games.name: Empires of Black Powder
games.summary: It's the Napoleonic era, and you must build the battlefield you fight on. Send Pioneers to gather supplies, expand the local town, and prepare your defenses. Command companies in formation, keep your veterans alive, and carry their experience and upgrades into the next battle.

games.name: RuneEra
games.summary: RuneEra is a single-player fantasy colony-management RPG in which players build a guild settlement, automate work and production and equip adventurers with runes that grant abilities and passive effects. Settlement management includes farming, animal husbandry, crafting and the needs and work schedules of guild members. Players form parties and directly control their movement, combat and abilities while exploring a procedurally generated world of biomes, quests, factions and dungeons.

games.name: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build the ultimate miniature hobby store! Order model kits, paint stunning miniatures, negotiate with collectors, and grow your business into every hobbyist's favorite shop.

games.name: Roll Dice no Die
games.summary: Choose your pawn and build a dead man's deck! Challenge yourself in a deadly reimagining of the famous tabletop game where every dice roll can save or kill you! Manipulate the board, make fateful decisions, outsmart the Master, and win this ultimate game of survival!

games.name: Retro Empire
games.summary:
Retro Empire is a first-person simulation game about running a second-hand video game store. Most stock comes from local sellers found through an in-game classifieds app, where the player haggles over the price before meeting them in person. Much of what comes in is dirty or broken, so consoles go to a workbench to be cleaned, taken apart, repaired with replacement parts, and tested before they are priced and put on the shelves.

Customers arrive with their own budgets, compare prices, sell their old games to the store, and bring in faulty consoles for repair jobs. Arcade cabinets can be repaired and fitted with swappable game boards that are fully playable. Each day the store is open earns experience, and new levels unlock furniture, decorations, game and console rentals, wholesale orders, staff who help run the business, and a second venue that can be turned into an arcade hall.

games.name: Roadworn
games.summary: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

games.name: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
games.summary:
Interested in boxing, fitness and bodybuilding?
Do you dream of becoming the coolest boxer and knocking out your opponents in packs?
Do you want to be the most powerful in the gym?
Download the game and let's get started!
Here is a game that can make your fingers tremble with tension, performing the next approach!

games.name: Matchward
games.summary: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

games.name: Scales
games.summary: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

games.name: Sokogeek
games.summary: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

games.name: Ninja JajaMaru Yokai Night Parade
games.summary: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

games.name: UniversiaTCG
games.summary: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes.

games.name: Mr. Panas
games.summary: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land is a video game released for the Nintendo Entertainment System by Color Dreams through its Wisdom Tree label in 1991. Like all Wisdom Tree games, Exodus was not officially licensed by Nintendo. It was ported to the Game Boy. Exodus is based on Crystal Mines, an earlier game from the company when it was known as Color Dreams. According to the instruction manual, the player controls the biblical figure Moses as he leads the Israelites to the Promised Land, meaning he goes through a labyrinth.
aliases: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Edition
games.summary: This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Plus Edition
games.summary: The Premium Plus Edition of Final Fantasy VII Revelation. This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.summary:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set
games.summary: An item set for Final Fantasy VII Revelation.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Series Trilogy Edition
games.summary: The Trilogy Edition of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Series.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Summoning Materia - Polydroid Alexander
games.summary: A summoning materia that summons Polydroid Alexander in the game.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Armor - Nymphwing Bracelet
games.summary: A bracelet that slightly restores MP after battle.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Risk Taker's Choker
games.summary: A choker that restores HP when using a limit break attack.

games.name: Reflect89
games.summary:
REFLECT89 is a 2D arcade shoot ’em up focused on reflexes, precision, and skill.

Players control CORE or AURA and use a rotating shield to reflect incoming projectiles back at enemies. Perfect Reflections, combos, and upgrades help players survive increasingly challenging waves and achieve higher scores.

The campaign spans 10 stages, from 1980 to 1989, featuring 50 waves of enemies and boss encounters. Completing the campaign unlocks ENDLESS SIGNAL, an endless survival mode.

The game features a worldwide leaderboard where players can compete for the highest score.

games.name: Vapor Strange
games.summary: Explore bizarre procedural generated psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, experience shifting rulesets, retro aesthetics, and altered music for a wild and truly strange experience.

games.name: Bossfall
games.summary:
Bossfall is a fast paced Sci-Fi Action RPG Boss Rush. Fight a gauntlet of the universe's most lethal warriors and monsters to rise as the arena's ultimate champion.

Master tight controls to shoot and dash your way through dynamic combat. Every victory rewards you with legendary loot, allowing you to endlessly customize your playstyle and adapt to new challenges.

Key Features:
Action-Packed Arena Combat: Face off against a diverse roster of powerful monsters and formidable adversaries.
Dedicated Boss Rush: Test both your mechanical skills and your build crafting strategy in an exciting mode against back to back boss fights.
Deep Customization: Mix and match legendary weapons, spells, and gear to create game breaking builds.
Tight Mechanics: Master responsive dash and shoot gameplay to effortlessly outmaneuver incoming attacks.
High Replayability: Experiment with different loadouts to conquer higher difficulties for even better rewards.
Will you rise to the challenge and conquer the competition to become the ultimate champion?

games.name: The Edge of the Backrooms
games.summary: After discovering a strange anomaly on Jupiter's moon, Europa, you find yourself in the outer reaches of a dangerous, uncanny complex.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Canada
Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
games.summary: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

games.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
games.summary: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

games.name: Fcorvus
games.summary: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Assemble, search, and compete to reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Play solo, with or versus a friend. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

games.name: Air Raid 1: ReOvercharge
games.summary: Play multi-round PvE battles, choosing your skills and upgrades that will progress through the story. Spend time with your allies in a visual novel format and strengthen your relationships to unlock PvE combat improvements.

games.name: Infinite Hole Sim Remix
games.summary:
Infinite Hole Sim Remix has been remixed to offer a better experience over the original.

Infinite Hole Sim Remix is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!

games.name: Haunted Paws
games.summary: Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Pipe Dream
games.summary: A life and crime sandbox set in 2008 Brooklyn, where the taxes are real, the cops aim like people, the radio has 20 stations, and every dollar comes from something you probably shouldn't be doing. You owe Tony $1,500 by Sunday. Bring up to 15 friends.

games.name: Indie Hoverboard Racing
games.summary: An advenure racing game featuring colourful open worlds and racing on hoverboards. Single player and for all ages.

games.name: Ambrosius
games.summary: Ambrosius is a fantasy dungeon crawler where every monster, room and item is an original hand-painted artwork — not a filter, not AI. Fight through ever-shifting labyrinths, let Corruption steer your fate down one of three story paths, and end every battle in a cinematic kill-cam.

games.name: Dress Your Meat
games.summary: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

games.name: Make The Dead Dead Again
games.summary: Guns, super-powered DNA, and a whole lot of attitude in a third-person shooter. Fight your way through Lux's world as she hunts for her missing mother, and spend your loot making her (and her base) look absolutely incredible. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

games.name: Paid in Blood
games.summary: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

games.name: Rogues & Fate
games.summary: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

games.name: Far Cry 3: Classic Edition
aliases: ファークライ3 クラシックエディション
games.summary:
Far Cry 3 Classic Edition has been updated to run smoothly on modern platforms and allow fans and newcomers to experience the single-player Far Cry 3 campaign in stunning detail.

Explore an island playground as stunningly beautiful as it is diverse – from mountain ranges to swampy grasslands and white sandy beaches. Fight your way through the island’s towns, temples, river ports and more.

Encounter a diverse and realistic cast of characters, including one of Far Cry’s most notorious villains: Vaas Montenegro. Dive into this deep and enriching story where morals are questionable and hope is all but abandoned.

games.name: Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon - Classic Edition
games.summary: Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition is THE 80's-style sci-fi cyber shooter, taking place on a bizarre open world island crawling with evil - now on the current generation of consoles.

games.name: Jammer Dash
games.summary: Jammer Dash is an immersive 2D rhythm experience worth all your time!

games.name: Finding Polka
games.summary: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Space Evolver
games.summary: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of New Zealand
No Way Back: Dark Horizon
games.summary: Survive on a mysterious island! Battle against the infected creatures of a failed experiment, gather resources, build your base, and uncover the dark secret of the island.

games.name: Squadron 42
games.summary: Take the role of a rookie UEE Navy combat pilot in a cinematic single-player epic adventure set in the Star Citizen universe. Battle in the stars and face-to-face as you seamlessly transition between dogfighting and ground combat. Serve aboard a massive Navy capital ship as your custom character interacts and builds relationships with a living, breathing crew. Cutting-edge performance capture brings unprecedented emotion and life to some of your favorite actors. Powered by StarEngine, Squadron 42 pushes gaming graphics and fidelity to the next level.

games.name: Witches Craft
games.summary: Witches Craft is an adult adventure & crafting game following Selene; A fully trained Hedge Witch and Aspiring Alchemist.

games.name: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
games.summary: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

games.name: Touchstarved
games.summary: You were born cursed, with hands that twist the mind of any human you touch. Desperation leads you to the shadowy city of Eridia, where your fate intertwines with 5 monstrous strangers. Each can offer you salvation or damnation. Find a cure for your curse in Touchstarved, a gothic horror romance visual novel.

games.name: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
games.summary: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

games.name: Daba: Land of Water Scar
games.summary: Daba: Land of Water Scar is a new title from Dark Star. It tells the story of a humanoid clay puppet. When the world is on the verge of collapse, the puppet traces the whereabouts of the water fragments within the ancient city, and throughout their journey of defeating enemies and seeking answers, unravels the story of the world and oneself. The game features various landscapes including abandoned ruins, a magnificent ancient city, gloomy prison, vast rift valley, expansive snowfield, deadly forest, and a floating city. Non-linear levels are interconnected, distinct, and intricate.

games.name: Project Mix
games.summary: Project Mix is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending visual novel. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Jest Messter
games.summary:
A comedy-mystery otome visual novel.

Oh no! You're stuck with a pun-curse "gifted" by the mysterious Jester, a mythical entity known to bring happiness in exchange for your memories.

Armed with the worst dad jokes known to mankind, you transferred to the prestigious Marney High in hopes to uncover the Jester's identity... and hopefully make new friends along the way!

Luckily, your new classmates are just as weird as you are: a stuck-up scholar, a brainrot-loving memelord, a two-faced actor, a weapon-wielding roommate, and a secretive senior with a dangerous secret...

So be careful who you trust! As sinister plots start to unravel around you and your classmates, you find yourself tangled in their web of secrets and schemes.

And maybe... your pun-curse is the key to solve them all?

Commercial remaster of "The Punniest Pun Messter".

games.name: Zerra's Adventure
games.summary: Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!

games.name: Piggy One Super Spark
games.summary: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

games.name: Aokaki
games.summary: A disgraced ronin returns to his homeland to find it ravaged by war. Taking up his sword once more, he must battle through the feudal forces of the shogun and take on foes he once called friends. Parry, pogo, and dash your way through a land of insect samurai in this platformer.

games.name: Battle Vision Network
games.summary: Battle your way to victory in this cosmic tactical color-matching game. Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and stun your opponent with overwhelming combos. Every tournament season is unique in this puzzle-battle roguelike.

games.name: Everbloom
games.summary: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

games.name: Turok: Origins
games.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

games.name: Postal 2 VR
games.summary: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

games.name: Sacrata
games.summary: A dark-themed Roguelike survivor game where you must withstand relentless waves of enemies, craft powerful skill builds, unlock new survivors, and take on dark bosses. Claim sacred artifacts and experience an unparalleled thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

games.name: Take Them Down
games.summary: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

games.name: Teeko
games.summary: Hop on the perfect mix of platforming and tower defense as Teeko, a cute sloth. Jump, smash, and plant trees to defeat the rampaging gigante masks of Costa Rica’s Día de las Mascaradas festival and their hordes of enemies.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: Postal 2 Redux
games.summary: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: Rhythm Rat Rampage
games.summary: Rhythm meets bullet heaven in a genre-smashing fusion. Strik-9 challenges you to dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style.

games.name: Son of Thanjai
games.summary: A spoiled prince is betrayed, exiled, and remade into something far more dangerous than a king. Outnumbered and alone, take an empire apart from the inside, with deception, fear, and the Surul Vaal, in a cinematic action-adventure set in an alternate-history medieval South India.

games.name: FrogSpin
games.summary: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

games.name: Daybreak Slam
games.summary: Colorful characters clash in this beginner friendly 2D Fighter. Family friendly themes and aesthetics with simple combat mechanics make Daybreak Slam a welcoming experience for new players to the genre, and allow each character to stand out in their own unique ways that veterans will appreciate.

games.name: Deep Siren
games.summary: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

games.name: Wetter
games.summary: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

games.name: Blast Bebop
games.summary: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

games.name: Contact Protocol
games.summary:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

games.name: Alone: Mnemophobia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a world of nightmares with Alone. A psychological horror game that blends first and third-person perspectives. It will become a part of your mind, just as your mind will become a part of it with every decision you make.

games.name: Fourleaf Fields
games.summary: Welcome to the tiny world of Fourleaf Fields, a cozy farming life sim where you're no bigger than a carrot. Grow towering crops, care for tiny farm bugs, and uncover a web of secrets fueled by gossip - solo or online with friends!

games.name: Black Sailors
games.summary: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.
aliases: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: The Second Reproduction: Reunion
games.summary: A remake/alternative version of the otome visual novel "The Second Reproduction."

games.name: Day Trader Tycoon
games.summary: Play as a day trader gambling on people's pension money and try to beat the stock market. Engage in a comedic story with multiple endings. Meet different characters and get insider info to use for your own advantage. Gamble on cryptocurrency and quickly react to market events.

games.name: Mercy Incore
games.summary: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

games.name: Final Flavor
games.summary: Hone your skills with knives and fire to taste sweet victory... Let them cook! Final Flavor is an old-school dungeon crawler where a diverse party of outcasts slay, bake, and sauté their way to survive. Find the perfect ingredients, following the footsteps of the legendary chef.

games.name: Diviner
games.summary: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

games.name: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
games.summary: Build your crop-dusting empire from a single rusty biplane. Take contracts, mix chemicals, fly through wind and hazards. Then hire pilots, expand to new airfields, and grow your operation. See how far your skills can take you... and your luck.

games.name: Alien Deathstorm
games.summary: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

games.name: Crackheads
games.summary: Build junky vehicles, battle your friends with physics-based weapons, and survive absurd co-op challenges in this chaotic multiplayer sandbox.

games.name: Edge on Truth
games.summary:
A story-driven adventure with a mystery atmosphere.
Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals—will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again and again.

games.name: Intravenous 3
games.summary: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

games.name: Kitaria Fables 2
games.summary: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

games.name: Totopia
games.summary: Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W!

games.name: Life and Lemon
games.summary: Life & Lemon is a cozy fruit farming card game! Grow your orchard business, discover countless combination through card fusing, and make new friends. Learn how to run a successful orchard business and help build a thriving community across a lush, vibrant world!

games.name: Michikusa Wanderer
games.summary: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

games.name: Take That Mainstage!
games.summary: It's 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. You made the leap, now fulfill your destiny and change the world. Build your band, write real music you perform, manage relationships, and reach the top of the charts. In this hybrid life sim, be the one to Take That Mainstage!

games.name: Gravity Circuit 2
games.summary: A new Ark has risen. Switch between the Gravity and Power Circuit in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. Gravity Circuit 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit

games.name: Headcutter
games.summary: HEADCUTTER is a sci-fi spaghetti western FPS with brutal combat, destructible environments, and lots of gore. Track targets as a space bounty hunter, explore maps with multiple routes, and use the crunchy gunplay to cut their heads off so you can get your money!

games.name: Super Tacky Astro Ranger: S.T.A.R.
games.summary: Play as the tackiest hero in the galaxy in this fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Battle through chaotic arenas, master various weapons, defeat the Morg Leader, and escape in style. Be bold, be reckless. Be a true S.T.A.R.

games.name: Tempus Vitae
games.summary: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

games.name: Mr. Records
games.summary: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

games.name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
games.summary: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

games.name: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
games.summary: Wishlist now and get ready for Spyro™’s bold new adventure. Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm.

games.name: Skies of Valoria
games.summary: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

games.name: Strect
games.summary:
Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation!
< STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players.
Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

games.name: Hotel Is Hungry
games.summary: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, and feed the hotel before it decides to feed itself. One wrong room, someone dies. A body horror hotel management game.

games.name: Waifu Bubble
games.summary: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

games.name: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
games.summary: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

games.name: Burning Bridges
games.summary: "Burning Bridges (On and Off and On Again)" is a single released by the British rock band Status Quo in 1988. It was included on the album Ain't Complaining. The tune is based on the traditional English folk song "Darby Kelly". In 1994 Manchester United F.C. used the song as the basis for their FA Cup song "Come On You Reds", which reached number one in the UK Singles Chart in May 1994. The song was reprised, in 2014, for the band's thirty-first studio album Aquostic (Stripped Bare).

games.name: Limes 235
games.summary: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

games.name: Medieval Dynasty: The Backwood
games.summary: Unleash your imagination with our new free DLC introducing The Backwood! This whole new map will be available in Creative Mode, giving you complete freedom to build, design, and misbehave. Immerse yourself in peaceful serenity or let loose and cause

games.name: Momentigrade
games.summary: A fast-paced 3D metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

games.name: Ichorian Tales
games.summary: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

games.name: Lost Museum: Echoes of the Chromageists
aliases: 失落美术馆 -绘灵拾遗录-
失落美術館 -繪靈拾遺錄-
games.summary: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

games.name: Uta Macross
games.summary: The definitive Macross rhythm game, Uta Macross brings together ten songstresses from the Macross Series. Featuring a selection of 50 of its most popular songs, the game recreates famous scenes and dances from the franchise, and lets players put their own dream team of characters together on stage!

games.name: Kirby and the World Beyond
games.summary: Get ready to freely explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby and the World Beyond, the latest 3D Kirby adventure, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027!

games.name: Bloodbrand
games.summary: Bloodbrand is a story-rich adventure game where every decision carries a weight. Navigate yourself through perilous situations with persuasion, deception, seduction. Explore the cold winter nights of the medieval realm of Norn and sate your vampiric hunger for murder, or resist it at a great cost.

games.name: Hellkick
games.summary: One kick, one survivor. Hellkick is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

games.name: Loopfang
games.summary: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

games.name: Kennel Chaos
games.summary: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

games.name: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia
games.summary: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure RPG featuring a washed-up hero who's turning 30, with talking dogs and hamburger monsters! Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

games.name: Lazare's Sacrifice
games.summary: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

games.name: Cozy Cookmaster
games.summary: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management and automation game about turning a tiny food counter into a busy, fully automated restaurant. Start by cooking fries by hand, serving customers and cleaning tables, then unlock new recipes like burgers, hot dogs, donuts and more. Hire chefs, waiters and cleaners to automate the work, use the skill tree to shape your restaurant, and renovate between days by adding tables, kitchen stations and machines. Start with a small counter, build the system and automate the chaos.

games.name: Fishy Bar
