games.summary: Catch fish by day, run a shady lakeside bar by night. Hook 40+ species, cook them into questionable specials, keep the regulars fed and tipsy, dodge taxes and scammers, and upgrade your boat, your bar and your dog. First-person sim. Fresh fish, fishy business.

games.name: HandFoot
games.summary: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

games.name: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
games.summary: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

games.name: My Penguin Friend
games.summary: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

games.name: SubDuctis
games.summary: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again

games.name: The Arcane Open
games.summary: Golf, but every swing is a card. Build a deck of enchanted shots, bend the odds to find the fairway, and play your way through a fantasy golf tournament where anything can happen.

games.name: Rustown
games.summary: Five years after the idiot virus pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

games.name: Historiker
games.summary: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

games.name: Annalynn MD
games.summary: Annalynn MD is a falling block puzzle game that hearkens back to similar titles of the 16-bit era. Twist, turn, and take out germs in three different game modes as you help Annalynn make the world just a little bit healthier.

games.name: Gunmetal Gothic
games.summary: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

games.name: P.O.N.
games.summary: P.O.N. — a realistic first-person stealth-action crime-horror game that lets you see superheroes through the eyes of crime. Players complete missions for a criminal syndicate, staying connected through a tactical tablet. The core mechanic is a super AI that creates tension with its unpredictable and brutal attacks..

games.name: Pistonica
games.summary: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

games.name: Prospera
games.summary: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

games.name: Farhaven
games.summary: Build a shared magical town with the people who matter most. A cozy co-op sandbox RPG for up to 16 players, where every crop planted, secret found, and friendship made benefits your whole group.

games.name: Evolution Survival
games.summary: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Who knows when Natural Selection is at the wheel!

games.name: Outwith
games.summary: Outwith is a first-person, single-player open-world RPG set in a hand-crafted medieval fantasy world. Meet its inhabitants, face lurking dangers, uncover ancient secrets and shape a world that responds to your actions. Let your curiosity guide you as you wander this dark and mysterious land.

games.name: Ball and Stick
games.summary: Roll, swing, launch and cause chaos in a physics-driven sci-fi adventure with unique controls, wild attachments and character customization. Explore bizarre alien worlds alone or with friends, and unleash multiplayer mayhem!

games.name: Age of Legacy
games.summary: In the game, take the role of the fearless gladiator, who must make his way to the very top, which is freedom. There are a dozen unique enemies waiting for you to become stronger and stronger with each victory.

games.name: Shadow Rush
games.summary: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

games.name: Dragon Riders
games.summary: A SFW BL/Bara Gacha (without microtransactions), Visual Novel, and Card Battler game. Customizable Love Interests can be Bara Style or BL Style. The main character escapes a dystopian wasteland by bonding with a sentient dragon and becoming a soldier. He must navigate life in his corrupt nation while forming a relationship with another dragon rider. The gacha unlocks 21 different dragons and riders and over 100 cards to add to the battle deck. Gacha credits are earned organically by playing the visual novel and card battler. There is no real-money gambling possible.

games.name: Rangingstrike
games.summary: Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!

games.name: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
games.summary: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

games.name: Coraland: The Worst Rescuer
games.summary: Coraland is a puzzle adventure game where we follow Joris, a good for nothing rescuer on her first adventure to save Pon-Pon island from imminent danger. The controls are simple and the puzzles have been designed to be accessible for all ages, without outside knowledge to solve them.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 1
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 2
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 3
Lurking In Fear
games.summary: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

games.name: Project Zarya
games.summary: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

games.name: Province: Suroste
games.summary: Province: Suroste is a handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

games.name: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - DLC Character 4
My Hero Academia: All's Justice - DLC Character 5
Spine
games.summary: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

games.name: Drill Keeper
games.summary: Drill Keeper combines roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense into a strategic battle for survival. Dig through completely destructible worlds to strip them of their riches and build an impenetrable fortress of mining.

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Threads of Time
games.summary: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

games.name: Purgatory: Blue
games.summary:
A new visual novel led, written and composed by cittan*.

Akito meets his childhood friend, but for some reason, he is the only one who can see and recognize her.

games.name: Threaded Dungeons
games.summary:
A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

Threaded Dungeons is a turn-based, party-based dungeon crawling RPG.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End představuje akční adventuru subžánru metroidvania, určenou pro konzoli PlayStation 5 i PC s MS Windows; vyznačuje se originálním grafickým zpracováním. Vydání díla, představeného publiku v pořadu »State of Play« v září 2025, je připraveno na rok 2026.

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
games.summary:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

games.name: Orms
games.summary: Orms follows Sam, a boy lost in a surreal world shaped by his fears. Guided by Kira, he must restore a lighthouse to reconnect with his parents. The game is inspired by Machinarium, but crafted in 3D with expanded locations. It blends emotional storytelling with atmospheric exploration.

games.name: Rule the Dungeon
games.summary: Your Report, Your Reality. A pixel-art CRPG where a Dungeon Bureau inspector files otherworldly cases into submission. Evidence shapes success. Keywords forge skills. The clock decides everything.

games.name: Reoxia
games.summary: The story of an astronaut who returns to Earth in the midst of an apocalypse caused by an unknown disease. He mustn't take off the spacesuit to avoid breathing the contaminated air. The devastated world is inhabited by the bloodthirsty infected and mutants, and unknown armed men are hunting him.

games.name: Tsumamigui 3
games.summary:
A censored port of Tsumamigui 3.
That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

games.name: Sleepover
games.summary: Sleepover is a cosmic horror visual-novel about the last two humans alive. After the entire population of Earth mysteriously vanishes, the sole survivor, Yuna, struggles to find meaning in an empty world. After a mysterious girl appears at her front door, the two begin their final night together.

games.name: Tickets, Please!
games.summary: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.

games.name: Survive the Shift
games.summary: workplace survival card decision game. Starting as an intern, you must balance boss trust, team popularity, business output, and personal savings. Slacking rules, dinner culture, and bizarre blame-shifting communications turn into choice cards. Swipe once a day to see how many days you can survive.

games.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
games.summary: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

games.name: Relicfall
games.summary: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

games.name: Dark Island: Faded Memories
games.summary: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

games.name: Pawned Souls
games.summary: Pawned Souls is a 3D soulslike action game mixed with chess, where players control a pawn fighting hostile pieces bound by strict chess movement through real-time sword combat, precision parries, and spatial positioning.

games.name: Hey, Don't Look at Me
games.summary: Hey, Don't Look at Me is a psychological first-person horror game where you'll observe ghosts through binoculars, investigate the circumstances of their deaths, and try to survive inside your own apartment. Just don't forget: sometimes, they're watching you too.

games.name: Cursebreakers
games.summary: Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend's Pass and master sword & sorcery together. Explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and break the curse!

games.name: The Main Menu
games.summary: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

games.name: The Forgotten Ones
games.summary: Leidy dreamed of the city, she never imagined violence would force her there. In this 90s narrative adventure, explore streets and interiors, inspect traces people left behind, hear conflicting family memories, and reconstruct meaningful objects by hand while restoring what violence left unfinished.

games.name: Accursed
games.summary: Bear your vows in Accursed, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

games.name: Love is a Roguelite
games.summary: A turn-based tactical deck-building roguelite where heartbreak makes you stronger. Craft absurd card synergies, outsmart procedural dungeons, and romance your partner across a fracturing timeloop to restore their lost memories—one run at a time.

games.name: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
games.summary: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

games.name: ShatterRush
games.summary: ShatterRush is a multiplayer FPS where fluid parkour movement and massive mechs meet fully destructible environments to create flow-state movement combat you’ve been waiting years for!

games.name: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
games.summary: A tactical board-game battler inspired by the classic Dungeon Dice Monsters 'Dice-to-Tile' logic. Solo-developed over 12 months, featuring a unique system where your Summon Dice physically unfold to build the battlefield in real-time.

games.name: Lazy River
games.summary: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

games.name: College Architect
games.summary: Design, build, and manage a college campus. Become an architect of a prestigious university that only accepts the most elite students, or a community college that allows for normal everyday folks to pursue an education regardless of their academic background. What will you build, Architect?

games.name: Craftopia
games.summary: Craftopia is a game where you can do anything you've ever dreamed of. Thousands of items are categorized by the three eras: Primitive Era, Dragonic Era, Celestial Era. As you progress the game, more items will be available for you to craft!

games.name: Squad
games.summary: Squad is a large scale combined arms multiplayer first-person shooter emphasizing combat realism through communication, team play, emphasizing strong squad cohesion mechanics as well as larger-scale coordination, tactics, and planning. It features 20 large open maps, vehicle-based combined arms gameplay, and player-constructed bases to create a heart-thumping, visceral gaming experience with split-second decision-making in real-world scale firefights.

games.name: Oby Adventure
games.summary: Join Oby on an adventure inspired by the colorful platformers of the 1990s and 2000s. Jump, run and stomp enemies through playful levels packed with surprises. Defeat mighty bosses and restore peace to the Fruitimal Kingdom.

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.summary: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

games.name: R.E.P.O.
games.summary: R.E.P.O. (Retrieve, Extract and Profit Operation) is an online cooperative survival horror game for up to six players, developed by Swedish studio Semiwork using the Unity engine. Players are tasked with locating valuable physics-based objects within procedurally generated environments and carefully transporting them to extraction points without damaging them, all while avoiding hostile creatures. Between levels, players spend earned currency on permanent upgrades, weapons, and tools at a service station. The game emphasizes verbal coordination and strategic planning among teammates.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Self Simulated
games.summary: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer for the Game Boy Color. Play as a robotic version of yourself and navigate over 100 handcrafted levels filled with enemies, hazards, and glitch-filled dangers. Uncover your past and master tight, responsive controls designed for fast retries and fluid movement.

games.name: No, I'm Not A Human
games.summary: An intimate story about a disaster and guests from underground. People are breaking into your home, but not all of them are true people.

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Homura Hime
games.summary: "Homura Hime" is a third person action game, featuring Japanese anime visuals and intense 3D bullet curtain gameplay. Alongside Homurahime, fight against Demon Girls possessed by deviant "emotions", and get closer to discovering the truth of not only the fallen, but also your own veiled legacy.

games.name: Aether & Iron
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

games.name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
aliases: The Reaper Princess and the Monster of Ishokan
シニガミ姫と異書館ノ怪物
games.summary: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Clockfall
games.summary: Master the clock, break the loop. Time is limited and is the ultimate resource in this hybrid Dungeon Crawler packed with phases of village defense. Each run is a fight to earn more time, or unlock new weapons and skills to build your escape.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears
aliases: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood and Gears
Five Nights at Freddy's: BLOOD & GEARS
games.summary:
"The past has a voice and its calling you home."

"You hoped you'd never have to return to this place of sorrow, but after 20 years, something has called you back."

Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears is a complete reimagining of Scott Cawthon's original *Five Nights at Freddy's* game. The game is directed by JDBRYANT and is created by Bloody Fungi, a passionate team of over 30 people.

games.name: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue
games.summary: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

games.name: Villion:Code
games.summary:
A new school RPG produced by Koji Okada.
Genome editing ushers in a "new era of life."
To live with the burden of karma. —Is there hope beyond that?

games.name: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
games.summary: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon is a survivor-style roguelite action RPG for Nintendo Switch. Play as Luna, a curious black cat adventurer, and harness the power of the legendary dragon Selva. Use Scale Change magic to grow giant or shrink tiny while battling legendary monsters in fast-paced 10-minute adventures. Build powerful combinations using weapon, support, and beast cards, and team up with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: A story-driven Metroidvania where the allies you choose to bond with change how you fight and explore. Journey through the high-fantasy world of Raoah, uncover lost civilizations, and forge bonds that shape your path through a land on the brink of collapse.

games.name: Okko the Exiled
games.summary: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

games.name: Salvation Denied
games.summary: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1-4 players. Team up to build wild constructions with heavy machinery and crazy tools. Each mission brings a completely new challenge, while physics and disasters push your creation to the limit.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
games.summary: The Wolf Among Us 2 is an episodic graphic adventure game. It is a sequel to The Wolf Among Us and takes place six months following the events of the first game. Follow Bigby Wolf in a new story filled with not-so-colorful characters from famous fairy tales.

games.name: Mirror Land
games.summary: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

games.name: Shironeko Project Infinity
games.summary: Shironeko New Project is a co-op action RPG based on the mobile game Shironeko Project but will have a new story with new characters.

games.name: Mike & Tyler
games.summary: Mike & Tyler is a point & click adventure game, full of puzzles, mystery and dangerous characters.

games.name: Nonuple Nine: Asymptote
games.summary: "NONUPLE NINE: Asymptote" is a side-scrolling, narrative Sci-fi adventure game. Control the subject girl and solve the mystery of the building where the same floor loops. With vast scientific insights, can you find the answer for the "meaning of humanity" during this deadly journey?

games.name: State of Decay 3
games.summary: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

games.name: Militsioner
games.summary: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

games.name: Ill
games.summary: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

games.name: Being & Becoming
games.summary: Being & Becoming is a dark, atmospheric metroidvania set in a kingdom consumed by a Collective Dream. Play as a Lucid Dreamer, able to possess the corrupted, absorb their spirits, and wield them as weapons to break the world free from its endless slumber.

games.name: Shadow Seeker
games.summary:
Amorita Town, a sleepy location filled with peaceful residents and gloomy scenery.

You are Carlos Ramirez, a seasoned Detective who has experience in many different kinds of cases and investigations. On a fated day, you come face to face with a case you have never witnessed before. A very mysterious and tragic murder of a family that lived in the outskirts of the town. Something about it is not right, it makes you feel extremely uneasy, and almost, unsure.

As your mission deepens, the mystery appears to be shrouded in an evil like never before. What awaits you will tear you down and shake you to your core, an ancient darkness arises from the shadows. Enter the Shadow Seeker.

games.name: Clock Overwhelmed
games.summary: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

games.name: They Speak From the Abyss
games.summary:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

games.name: Espiocracy
games.summary: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
games.summary: Assemble magnetic towers by stacking pieces from opposite poles, to enlighten a electrifying hexagonal board.

games.name: Ink Shapes: Book One
games.summary: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

games.name: A Wake Inn: Rebooked
games.summary:
They say bad things happen in Silver Inn Hotel. Strange noises. Mysterious flashing lights in the night. Weird figures slithering in the dark.

They say something is about to awake soon. Will you dare to witness it?

A Wake Inn comes for PC in Rebooked version - redesigned, adding new content, additional endings and fully animated models of enemies.

games.name: Tremen
games.summary: Fight the hordes of mutants that enslaved humanity through a concrete brutalist hell in this FPS with modern graphics and old school gameplay.

games.name: Constellations: Beyond the Edges
games.summary: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

games.name: The Lost Wild
games.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

games.name: Rooted
games.summary: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
games.summary: A complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, Alice is Dead. Hearts and Diamonds includes all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

games.name: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
games.summary:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

games.name: Long Gone
games.summary: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

games.name: My Wife is a Princess
games.summary: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

games.name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
games.summary: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

games.name: Play Rough
games.summary: PLAY ROUGH is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

games.name: WorldShards
games.summary: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Dig Dig Boom
games.summary: Dig Dig Boom is a mining roguelike where time only moves when you do. Each expedition, the player explores a new cave in hunt for gold, using a variety of tools and their wit.

games.name: Endless Samurai
games.summary: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

games.name: Situation Normal
games.summary: A single-player shoot-'em-up precision platformer.

games.name: Gilded Destiny
games.summary: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.

games.name: DecaPolice
games.summary: DecaPolice is a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series. The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
games.summary: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Forgotten House
games.summary: Be QUIET, otherwise he will notice you. You want to find a way out of this house? Game inspired by Gnarled Hag and Granny.

games.name: Beyond the Plastic Wall
games.summary: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

games.name: Dolos: Your Best Future
games.summary: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

games.name: Neko's Rage
games.summary: 2D pixelart action game with many roguelite mechanics and power up. The gameplay is speed and hardcore but very addictive. You play as Nikki a female cyborg in an apocalyptic world rules by mechanicals creatures.

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

games.name: Zehlar
games.summary: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

games.name: Just in Crime
games.summary: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

games.name: Blackout: Zero Point
games.summary: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

games.name: The God Slayer
games.summary: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

games.name: Undefeated: Genesis
games.summary: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

games.name: Beaten Path
games.summary: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

games.name: October Nightmares
games.summary: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Clown Meat
games.summary: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

games.name: Herosbine: The Unknown Island
games.summary: A story-driven open world, action-adventure RPG set on a mysterious island where the player takes on the role of Tim. Tim is living a normal life as a geeky, introverted boy. He is struggling with his identity and the loss of his best friends, and feels out of place.

games.name: Last Hour of an Epic to the Moon RPG
aliases: Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG
games.summary: You like RPGs, but don't have time to play it all. . . We like RPGs, but don't have time to make it all. . . So here's (only) the last hour of an Epic RPG !!

games.name: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
games.summary: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Vivarium
games.summary: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

games.name: Kemuri
games.summary: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

games.name: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
games.summary:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

games.name: Tidebound
games.summary: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

games.name: Vignettes: The Dream City
games.summary: Vignettes: The Dream City is a first-person surreal dream-crawler game featuring turn-based combat, knowledge-based gameplay, non-linear exploration, and souls-like progression. Your dreams are haunted by a strange city, and you feel supernaturally drawn to explore it. What will you find within?

games.name: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
aliases: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Novel
games.summary: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

games.name: Hexplorando
games.summary: Discover the landscape and cultural heritage of Spain in this cozy 3D puzzle game where each region is a puzzle that brings art, territory, and history to life. Unlock heritage elements you can use in a limitless creative sandbox mode, with procedural quests to help you unleash your creativity.

games.name: OCRPG
games.summary: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

games.name: Angel
games.summary: Angel is a rhythm-racing adventure in which digital climate change threatens the eCho network with extinction. Players can propel through digital landscapes, crafting new break beats to infuse a stagnating network with the spark of renewal. Angel imbues the flow state of racing with the complexity of breakbeat music, redefining arcade and combo-based gameplay and enhancing it with a soundtrack from MyraTV and many other breakbeat enthusiasts.

games.name: Code Exit
games.summary: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

games.name: The Joy of Creation
games.summary:
The classic Five Nights at Freddy’s fan-game returns, rebuilt from the ground up to offer a modern and immersive horror experience with real-time graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5.

The Joy of Creation puts you in the shoes of The Creator, a game developer forced to confront the manifestations of his own mind throughout five unique levels, each with a unique blend of free-roaming and classic sit-and-survive gameplay mechanics.

This game is officially backed by Scott Cawthon as part of the Fazbear Fanverse Initiative.

games.name: Machina of the Farthest
games.summary: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

games.name: Drift Boom Boom
games.summary: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

games.name: Alchemic Beasts
games.summary: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

games.name: Tenjutsu
games.summary:
In Tenjutsu, you play as a renegade yakuza hellbent on defying her former associates and loosening their grip on the Secret Garden City. Revealed at this year's Devolver Direct, this fast and fluid rogue-jutsu is the latest game from Sébastien Benard, designer of the acclaimed Dead Cells.

Four powerful crime syndicates control the city, ruling with an iron fist. To defeat them, you must master a brutal brawling system and build a diverse arsenal of weapons, upgrades, and martial arts techniques, breaking their hold on the streets in a flurry of violence.

The city is reborn as these sinister organizations fall to your fists, tackled in any order you wish. The ruined streets become vibrant and full of life, and you can spend gathered resources in shops and restaurants to help you on your quest.

Shape the city to fit your play style, unlocking new weapons, combat moves, and new areas. Just don't take too long: the longer you spend preparing, the stronger your enemies will become.

games.name: LavaLoop
games.summary: LavaLoop is a music-driven shoot'em up, in a hand-drawn Steampunk universe. Face a mad queen and destroy the planet killing machine. Play as three musician fighters and jump from surprise to surprise in this unique fantasy universe.

games.name: Ties: Soul Link
games.summary:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

games.name: The Standard Model
games.summary: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

games.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
games.summary: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

games.name: Love in Space
games.summary: It is the year 2009. A short time after "the incident". Mankind has fled the scorched crusts of planet earth for a better life in space. Those unlucky few who still reside on earth are forced to live beneath the sea in leaky metal domes. This includes you... 50% Visual Novel - 50% Karaoke-Musical.

games.name: Children of Saturn
games.summary:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

games.name: My Time at Evershine
games.summary: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

games.name: Holy Horror Mansion
games.summary: The young hero, who lives in a mansion atop the apartment building owned by his grandma, finds a camera in a locked room, encounters a ghost and gets caught up in all kinds of turmoil!

games.name: Sea Sniffers
games.summary: Sea Sniffers is a cozy diving game in which you explore the ocean with your trusty seal companion. Encounter strange creatures and exotic treasures in sunken ships or hidden caves. Discover the deep sea and all its secrets!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.summary: Discover the stories of kids growing up in the midst of armed conflicts over the last three decades. Inspired by real testimonies, this narrative adventure follows the lives of children from Bosnia, Syria, and Ukraine.

games.name: Island Keeper
games.summary: Breathe new life into forgotten islands. Pick up trash, recycle it, craft items, and build your own base. As you heal the land, it flourishes into a wild paradise. Explore by walking, riding a boat, or using a submarine, and change a world that reacts to everything you do!

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
games.summary:
The year is 1896. The Martian invasion wipes cities and entire civilizations out of existence. Separated from his loved ones, a young student escapes the capital city already conquered by the aliens.
Along with the player, he will have to survive in the distinctive and dangerous Siberia, stand against the forces of the old world, and inevitably confront its new masters.

games.name: Prolegomena to a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
games.summary: This is a collaborative experiment between you and I. We will participate in a series of interchanges, each lasting three minutes. What will be revealed across our interfaces during that limited time?
aliases: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges

games.name: Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination
games.summary: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

games.name: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
games.summary: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

games.name: Stage Fright
games.summary: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.

games.name: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
games.summary: Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

games.name: Glintseeker Island
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover exciting secrets, excavate countless treasures, and fight enemies and bosses. Save the island from a mysterious threat below!

games.name: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
games.summary: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

games.name: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun
games.summary: Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night? LET THE HUNT BEGIN!

games.name: Medix
games.summary: You are not here to win the war, but to save whom you can before the line breaks. A narrative real-time strategy where you lead a unit of war medics across hand-drawn battlefields and race to reach the wounded as your army retreats before an overwhelming foe. Keep hope alive amidst the chaos.

games.name: Threat Vector
games.summary: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

games.name: Ballistic.exe
games.summary: Ballistic.exe is an advanced weapon simulator, with challenging true-to-life aiming mechanics, full weapon manipulation and customization, and highly accurate ballistic calculations.

games.name: City of None
games.summary: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

games.name: Conjunctivitalizer
games.summary: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

games.name: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
games.summary: Satoyama note Spring walk is a point-and-click visual novel in which you aim to reach your destination while identifying plants in a satoyama in spring. Listen to the animals, observe and identify the plants as you make your way through the forest, and have lunch under the cherry blossom trees!

games.name: Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada
games.summary: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

games.name: Into the Void
games.summary: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

games.name: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
games.summary: The genius Hakase “Mememe”, who wants to sleep all the time, invented “Kawaii Sheep”, which induces sleep with its mysterious healing properties. This is an exponentially kawaii sheep-carrying game in which Hakase puts the whole world to sleep.

games.name: Heretic Red
games.summary: In an isolated, snowy village, a detective monk must solve a series of bizarre murders. Collect evidence, unravel the truth, and expose killers. In this tight-knit community, every resident is a friend and a suspect. As the body count rises, you must use everything you have to stop the bloodshed.

games.name: Hello Sunshine
games.summary: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

games.name: Unravel Trigger: Cold War
games.summary: The sequel to Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War.

games.name: Super Adventure
games.summary: Players will play as special forces and carry out dangerous and tense tasks

games.name: Iris Dissolution
games.summary: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

games.name: Phantasist
games.summary: Phantasist是一款體驗社恐生活的遊戲！

games.name: Skateboard Knight
games.summary: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

games.name: End the Endless
games.summary: End the Endless is a dark fantasy turn based RPG set in the Purgatorial Realms. Harness unique directional based weapon systems in an oppressive environment. Utilize unique abilities, items and even your party members as a resource. Explore the Afterlife and seek to conquer the Seven Terraces.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.name: Dicewood
games.summary: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

games.name: Switcheroo
games.summary: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

games.name: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray
games.summary: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

games.name: Frostpunk: 1886
games.summary: The original Frostpunk experience is being reimagined and expanded with new events, mechanics, and laws within a new Purpose Path. Return to your role as the ruler of Earth's last city, manage its citizens, weigh up your choices and ensure your society's survival.

games.name: Gaucho: Subway Escape
games.summary: The shelter is not safe anymore. You must venture into the Buenos Aires subway, defeat colossal Demon Bosses in a frenetic parry-based combat, explore branching stations, improve your equipment, level up, and claw your way to the surface to save your kitten, Gaucho.

games.name: Shell Bless the Faithless
games.summary: Shell Bless the Faithless is a 3rd Person Roguelite Shooter supporting 1~4 players where you take on the role of a Norse warrior. In a chaotic world where runes, magic, and shotguns coexist, evolve with the blessings of the gods, crush heretical foes and their leaders, and rebuild a macho world!

games.name: Broken Relic
games.summary: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

games.name: Dandelion Void
games.summary: Explore the jungle choked corridors of a derelict ark, adrift between the stars. Construct shelters and loot powerful artifacts from the skeletal remains of your starfaring ancestors. But never let your guard down, because the jungle is alive and hostile…

games.name: Monochrome Serenade
games.summary: A new visual novel by Laplacian and Nagatsuki Tappei, the author of Re:Zero, to be released in 2027. It will be approximately 10 hours long.

games.name: Sea of Remnants
games.summary: Sea of Remnants is an original ocean adventure RPG developed by Joker Studio. Your journey begins as a puppetfolk sailor who has lost their memory. Alongside a mysterious girl, you’ll set sail on a chaotic and colorful voyage—one filled with treasure, conflict, dreams, and unexpected companions. As the seas stretch endlessly before you, an epic world of myth and history slowly unfolds. But beware, Captain: fall overboard, and your mind may be swallowed by the very thing this ocean was named for—forgetting.

games.name: Scratch the Cat
games.summary: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

games.name: Out Fishing
games.summary: Out Fishing is a first-person horror fishing game set around a remote, decaying lake. Players take on the role of a lone angler trying to make a living while unsettling memories and supernatural events gradually surface. Combining slow-paced exploration, psychological horror, and a minimalist survival loop, the game blurs the line between peaceful solitude and creeping dread.

games.name: Souls End
games.summary: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

games.name: The Bagman
games.summary: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

games.name: Unsound Love
games.summary: An open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

games.name: Robot Rhapsody
games.summary: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

games.name: Bakudo
games.summary: Bakudo is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite Bakudo academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

games.name: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
games.summary: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

games.name: Necrofane
games.summary: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

games.name: Blighted
games.summary: Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare in this Metroidvania action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.

games.name: Hole War: The Abyss
games.summary: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

games.name: Chunky Jump!
games.summary: Chunky JUMP! is a survival-horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: Parasensor
games.summary: When Marisol starts a new life as a telecom technician, she finds herself out of her depth in a mutating city. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

games.name: At Fate's End
games.summary: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

games.name: City of Dolorosa
games.summary: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.summary: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

games.name: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
games.summary: Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you can battle unpredictable, dynamic mega-fires solo or in co-op, using ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support and more.

games.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
games.summary:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

games.name: Humblets
games.summary: Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

games.name: Stardream
games.summary: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

games.name: Delving The Depths
games.summary: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler.

games.name: Tsarevna: Age of Tales
games.summary:
Third-person action-adventure game centered on ballet-inspired hack-and-slash combat in a dark fantasy world based on Slavic folklore. Players control Swan, chaining melee combos, building combat ranks, dodging attacks, and using a transforming magical weapon alongside special dances that can heal, control enemies, or alter the flow of battle.

The game combines boss encounters and exploration across locations such as the island of Buyan and the realm of Iriy, with environments and creatures inspired by Slavic myths and fairy tales. Swan is accompanied by Cat Bayun, who can participate in tag-team attacks.

games.name: Among the Waves
games.summary: Among the Waves is a science fiction metroidvania with platforming elements. Explore the dark corridors of the Alatyr-M fortress, diving into mysteries of religion and ancient technology. Manipulate physics with unique abilities, uncover hidden pathways, battle enemies and challenging bosses.

games.name: Terrible Life Expectancy
games.summary: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements. Fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience and only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing... or at least twitching.

games.name: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
games.summary: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

games.name: Wilderlocke
games.summary: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

games.name: Untitled Lollipop Chainsaw Game
games.summary:
The pop and cute high school zombie hunter who took the world by storm is back!

Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back is an all-new title in the Lollipop Chainsaw series.
Juliet returns, in a brand-new outfit and with even more power, to a rebuilt San Romero, now transformed into “Jaredwood,” a sprawling metropolis built around the film industry. When a mysterious director traps her inside his twisted zombie movie, Juliet must fight alongside her allies, uncover the conspiracy behind the chaos, and stop a new threat posed by the Corrupted Realm zombies.

games.name: Sunset Suckerpunch
games.summary: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-sword-gauntlet. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Don't let them take her voice, too.

games.name: Kaguya
games.summary: High-School Heroines Take to the Skies!A fully-voiced bullet hell shoot-'em-up that's friendly to newcomers!Wipe out the AI robot army and save the day!

games.name: Panic in Puzzle World
games.summary: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

games.name: The E-Collector
games.summary: Clean the world, save the future. Join Ekko the robot on a quest to restore a polluted planet. Explore toxic realms, solve eco-puzzles, and battle mutated foes. Upgrade EcoVac 3000, rescue endangered creatures, and transform each region. Enjoy fully included features in this epic eco-adventure!

games.name: Tonin
games.summary: Slice and kick your enemies away! An open-world Japanese-style × Sci-Fi slash action game!

games.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
games.summary: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

games.name: The Secret of Weepstone
games.summary: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

games.name: My Dear Emma
games.summary: Exploring beautiful landscapes and local wildlife. Become part of Emma’s story, a young biologist and nature photographer who has decided to start a new life far from the big city. A narrative-driven adventure to relax, feel, and slow down.

games.name: The Fatum
games.summary: This situation is temporary, but it comes with a strict protocol that you must follow. Morality and cold calculation intertwine in a dark tale. You are an investigator, and your arrival marks a turning point in the lives of those you encounter.

games.name: Wanting Shock
games.summary: Owari and her 7 friends plan to solve an abandoned mystery, but quickly spirals into something sinister.

games.name: Club Defenders
games.summary: Club Defenders is the ultimate fusion of music, strategy, and action! It's up to you to protect our music from the Xilenz. Arm yourselves with powerful music-based towers, sound weapons and music instruments, sync up with your team and unleash the power of music to fend off the alien invaders.

games.name: Vanran
games.summary: Vanran is a dark fantasy action RPG where a human slave in the Demon Realm wields a sealed blade and rises in rebellion. Defeat your enemies, claim their powers, grow stronger, and escape. Seek salvation—or choose vengeance.

games.name: Ignifugo
games.summary: Ignifugo is a top-down action roguelite with auto-battler elements. Control a combat shell and modify it with auto-attacking units. Take advantage of class bonuses, items and abilities to create unique builds as you fight heated battles through five biomes. Will you survive or be reduced to ash?

games.name: Eternity
games.summary:
An unforgettable journey of discovery, hope, and survival, as you strive to unlock the secrets of the universe and pave the way for humanity's destiny.

By intertwining Exploration, Adaptive Gameplay, and Survival, ETERNITY offers a rich and immersive experience where you’re guiding humanity’s last fleet through a procedurally generated galaxy, and your “empire” is a moving city of ships. Every vessel is both a building and a lifeline. You’ll expand by salvaging and refitting new ships, exploit resources across systems, and face moral and political decisions that can shape the fleet’s future.

games.name: Project Evilbane
games.summary: Project Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

games.name: Midnight Souls
games.summary: Explore the mysteries of the small town of Camomile Peaks! Date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

games.name: Ultrasound
games.summary: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

games.name: HyperYuki: Snowboard Syndicate
games.summary: Welcome to the Snowboard Syndicate! Race, Compete, and Explore the slopes as a colorful cast of unique characters! But what’s snowboarding without a little bit of drip? Through exploring and racing, you can unlock cosmetics such as designs for your snowboard and clothes to make sure you shine the brightest while shredding.

games.name: Curse of Dominion
games.summary: Crowned for saving the king, you wield the coveted Blessing of Dominion. Command tense tactical battles, deepen companion Loyalty, evade those who would kill for your power, and watch a secret moral scale quietly reshape Elvorith’s fate.

games.name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
games.summary: Fantasy Point & Click Horror Drama: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you seek the truth of magic’s birth, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

games.name: The Lift
games.summary: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

games.name: Appa
games.summary: Appa is a narrative driven simultaneous card game about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. You play as Varun witnessing surreal nightmares and manifestations of his deceased father and playing a card game with him.

games.name: Living Hell
games.summary: A co-op horror where you must retrieve specimens before sunrise, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations.

games.name: Wild Chorus
games.summary: An adventure game, but you play musical instruments instead of swinging swords. Gather adorable Sound Sprites, cut through the looming Silence, and rebuild the soundtrack of this hand-illustrated world in whatever way you see fit. No musical ability required!

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: No Walls in Heaven
